meaning: यः सर्वज्ञः सर्वकृत् सर्वभूतभृद् यस्माद् अन्यन् न परं किं चनास्ति । अनिर्मितः सत्यजितः पुरुष्टुतः स नो ब्रह्माभिजिता नो ऽभिरक्षतु ॥
text_mt: He who is all-knowing, all-making, sustaining all beings, beyond whom there is nothing else higher, / unfashioned, victorious in truth, much-praised: may that Brahmā protect us with Abhijit.

sanskrit_iast: sthānācyute sthānam indrāya pātave devebhyaś ca ya īrayaṃs trir vicakrame | taṃ svid dhi svargaṃ nākapṛṣṭhaṃ viśvaṃ viṣṇur devaḥ śravaṇenābhirakṣatu ||
meaning: स्थानाच्युते स्थानम् इन्द्राय पातवे देवेभ्यश् च य ईरयंस् त्रिर् विचक्रमे । तं स्विद् धि स्वर्गं नाकपृष्ठं विश्वं विष्णुर् देवः श्रवणेनाभिरक्षतु ॥
text_mt: He who strode [three times], sending forth a place for Indra and the gods to rule, without falling from his place, / indeed to that heaven, the vault of the sky, the universe—may the god Viṣṇu protect [us] with Śravaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭau śatāni śvetaketūnāṃ yāni tvaṃ ca sa tvaṃ nijaghāna bhūyasaḥ | anādeśenobhayataś ca vīḍitāḥ śraviṣṭhābhir no 'bhirakṣantu vājinaḥ ||
meaning: अष्टौ शतानि श्वेतकेतूनां यानि त्वं च स त्वं निजघान भूयसः । अनादेशेनोभयतश् च वीडिताः श्रविष्ठाभिर् नो ऽभिरक्षन्तु वाजिनः ॥
text_mt: The eight hundred white comets, which you, even you, struck down in great numbers, / strengthened on both sides without command: may the horses protect us with the Śraviṣṭhās.

sanskrit_iast: vājā devī devamṛṇānikākubhāv ubhāv ājasya natakarmaṇā śivā | tava vrājaṃ staumasi devabhojanau pratyagbhiṣak śatabhiṣak śivau naḥ ||
meaning: वाजा देवी देवमृणानिकाकुभाव् उभाव् आजस्य नतकर्मणा शिवा । तव व्राजं स्तौमसि देवभोजनौ प्रत्यग्भिषक् शतभिषक् शिवौ नः ॥
text_mt: The divine Vājas, the summits of the divine debt, both auspicious through the humble deed of goat-milk; / we praise your pen, you two who feast the gods, the inward healer: may Śatabhiṣaj be auspicious to us.

sanskrit_iast: śunāsīrau naḥ pramumūtu jihmasau tautau pitṛbhyo dadatuḥ stanau śubhau | tau pūrvajau kṛṇutām ekapād ajaḥ pratiṣṭhānau sarvakāmābhayāya ca ||
meaning: शुनासीरौ नः प्रमुमूतु जिह्मसौ तौतौ पितृभ्यो ददतुः स्तनौ शुभौ । तौ पूर्वजौ कृणुताम् एकपाद् अजः प्रतिष्ठानौ सर्वकामाभयाय च ॥
text_mt: May Śunā and Sīra loosen for us what is crooked; may those two grant their two fair breasts to the ancestors; / may those firstborn two, Aja Ekapād, make the two foundations for all desires and freedom from fear.

sanskrit_iast: sarvārthāya kṛṇomi karmasiddhaye gaviṣṭutāyānekakāriṇe namaḥ | so 'hir budhnyaḥ kṛṇutām uttarau śivau pratiṣṭhānau sarvakāmābhayāya ca ||
meaning: सर्वार्थाय कृणोमि कर्मसिद्धये गविष्टुतायानेककारिणे नमः । सो ऽहिर् बुध्न्यः कृणुताम् उत्तरौ शिवौ प्रतिष्ठानौ सर्वकामाभयाय च ॥

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ mahāhemam ṛṣitaḥ prasāmavid bharadvājaś candramasau divākaram | sajuṣṭānām aśvayujau bhayāya ca sa naḥ pūṣā kṛṇutāṃ revatīṃ śivām ||
meaning: यं महाहेमम् ऋषितः प्रसामविद् भरद्वाजश् चन्द्रमसौ दिवाकरम् । सजुष्टानाम् अश्वयुजौ भयाय च स नः पूषा कृणुतां रेवतीं शिवाम् ॥
text_mt: Whom from Bharadvāja the sage, knowing melodies, the great golden one, the moon, the sun / of those united; and for fear of the two Aśvayuj; may that Pūṣan make Revatī auspicious for us.

sanskrit_iast: jīrṇaṃ santaṃ yau yuvānaṃ hi cakratur ṛṣiṃ dhiyā cyavanaṃ somapau kṛtau | tau naś cittibhir bhiṣajām asya satkarau … prajām aśvinyām aśvinau śivau ||
meaning: जीर्णं सन्तं यौ युवानं हि चक्रतुर् ऋषिं धिया च्यवनं सोमपौ कृतौ । तौ नश् चित्तिभिर् भिषजाम् अस्य सत्करौ … प्रजाम् अश्विन्याम् अश्विनौ शिवौ ॥
text_mt: The two who made the sage Cyavana young when he was aged, by wisdom, and were made soma-drinkers: / may those two auspicious Aśvins, healers who honour this [worshipper], [...] offspring under Aśvinī with insights.

sanskrit_iast: yasya śyāmaśabalau rakṣataḥ svadhā duṣkṛt sukṛd vividhā carṣaṇīdhṛtau | tau savitryā ca savitur dharmacāribhir yamo rājā bharaṇībhir no 'bhirakṣatu ||
meaning: यस्य श्यामशबलौ रक्षतः स्वधा दुष्कृत् सुकृद् विविधा चर्षणीधृतौ । तौ सवित्र्या च सवितुर् धर्मचारिभिर् यमो राजा भरणीभिर् नो ऽभिरक्षतु ॥
text_mt: Whose two dogs, dark and spotted, guard the svadhā, the evil-doer and the good-doer, diverse, sustaining people: / may King Yama, with Sāvitrī and the followers of Savitṛ's law, protect us with the Bharaṇīs.

sanskrit_iast: atha nakṣatrasnānānāṃ vidhiṃ vakṣyāmi sāṃpadam | grahadaivatapūjāṃ ca yeṣu yatra yathāvidhi ||
meaning: अथ नक्षत्रस्नानानां विधिं वक्ष्यामि सांपदम् । ग्रहदैवतपूजां च येषु यत्र यथाविधि ॥
text_mt: Now I shall declare the rite of lunar-mansion baths that brings prosperity, / and the worship of the planets and deities, during which, where, and according to rule.

sanskrit_iast: nakṣatrayogakālajñaḥ kṛtvā tantraṃ yathāvidhi | yajed grahān haviṣyeṇa yathoktena ca devatāḥ ||
meaning: नक्षत्रयोगकालज्ञः कृत्वा तन्त्रं यथाविधि । यजेद् ग्रहान् हविष्येण यथोक्तेन च देवताः ॥
text_mt: Knowing the times of conjunction of the lunar mansions, having performed the procedure according to rule, / one should worship the planets with sacrificial food and the deities as prescribed.

sanskrit_iast: praśastalakṣaṇaṃ kumbhaṃ sasaṃbhārajalaṃ budhaḥ | saṃpātābhihitaṃ kṛtvā mantrair vidhim anusmaran ||
meaning: प्रशस्तलक्षणं कुम्भं ससंभारजलं बुधः । संपाताभिहितं कृत्वा मन्त्रैर् विधिम् अनुस्मरन् ॥
text_mt: The wise man, having prepared a jar of auspicious marks, containing water and ritual accessories, / consecrated by the remnants of the oblation, with mantras, mindful of the rule,

sanskrit_iast: sāvitryā śāntisūktaiś ca mahāvyāhṛtibhis tathā | apāṃ stotraiḥ pavitraiś ca nakṣatrastutibhis tathā ||
meaning: सावित्र्या शान्तिसूक्तैश् च महाव्याहृतिभिस् तथा । अपां स्तोत्रैः पवित्रैश् च नक्षत्रस्तुतिभिस् तथा ॥
text_mt: with the Sāvitrī, with the peace-hymns, and with the great mystical utterances, / with hymns to the waters, purifying hymns, and praises of the lunar mansions,

sanskrit_iast: nakṣatradaivatān mantrān pratinakṣatram āvapet | kāmyāṃś caivāvapen mantrān karmaliṅgavidhānavit ||
meaning: नक्षत्रदैवतान् मन्त्रान् प्रतिनक्षत्रम् आवपेत् । काम्यांश् चैवावपेन् मन्त्रान् कर्मलिङ्गविधानवित् ॥
text_mt: should insert the mantras belonging to the deities of the lunar mansions, lunar mansion by lunar mansion, / and he who knows the rules on the characteristic marks of rites should also insert desire-prompted mantras.

sanskrit_iast: saṃpātyāthābhimantrya vā nakṣatrasnānakovidaḥ | snāpayed arthinaṃ vāgbhiḥ puṇyābhir abhimantritam ||
meaning: संपात्याथाभिमन्त्र्य वा नक्षत्रस्नानकोविदः । स्नापयेद् अर्थिनं वाग्भिः पुण्याभिर् अभिमन्त्रितम् ॥
text_mt: Having poured remnants of the oblation or having consecrated [the jar], he who is skilled in lunar-mansion baths / should bathe the petitioner, consecrated with auspicious words.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa eva vidhir dṛṣṭaḥ sadasyebhyaś ca dakṣiṇā | pūrvam āpyāyayed dehaṃ paścād dadyāt tu dakṣiṇām ||
meaning: एष एव विधिर् दृष्टः सदस्येभ्यश् च दक्षिणा । पूर्वम् आप्याययेद् देहं पश्चाद् दद्यात् तु दक्षिणाम् ॥
text_mt: Just this is the observed rule, and a sacrificial fee to the members of the assembly: / first one should refresh the body, and afterwards give the sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast: anena vidhinā snātvā dadyāc caivātra dakṣiṇām | prāpnoty anunayaṃ puṃsaḥ sa vedaphalam aśnute ||
meaning: अनेन विधिना स्नात्वा दद्याच् चैवात्र दक्षिणाम् । प्राप्नोत्य् अनुनयं पुंसः स वेदफलम् अश्नुते ॥
text_mt: Having bathed according to this rule, one should give a sacrificial fee here; / he attains the favour of the man, and he enjoys the fruit of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast: ātmānaṃ nirmalīkṛtya devān iṣṭvā grahāṃs tathā | vidvadbhyo dakṣiṇā deyā dvijān annena tarpayet ||
meaning: आत्मानं निर्मलीकृत्य देवान् इष्ट्वा ग्रहांस् तथा । विद्वद्भ्यो दक्षिणा देया द्विजान् अन्नेन तर्पयेत् ॥
text_mt: Having purified oneself, and having worshipped the gods and likewise the planets, / a sacrificial fee should be given to the learned, and one should satisfy the twice-born with food.

sanskrit_iast: kṛttikābhiḥ śirīṣasya aśvatthasya vaṭasya ca | snāpayet pattrabhaṅgena ya icched rājapūjitam ||
meaning: कृत्तिकाभिः शिरीषस्य अश्वत्थस्य वटस्य च । स्नापयेत् पत्त्रभङ्गेन य इच्छेद् राजपूजितम् ॥
text_mt: Under Kṛttikā, he who desires to be honoured by the king / should bathe with crushed leaves of the śirīṣa, the aśvattha, and the banyan.

sanskrit_iast: rohiṇyāṃ snāpayed vaiśyaṃ sarvabījair alaṃkṛtam | akṣatān antaraṃ kṛtvā tathā saubhāgyam arhati ||
meaning: रोहिण्यां स्नापयेद् वैश्यं सर्वबीजैर् अलंकृतम् । अक्षतान् अन्तरं कृत्वा तथा सौभाग्यम् अर्हति ॥
text_mt: Under Rohiṇī, one should bathe a vaiśya adorned with all seeds, / putting unbroken grains in between; thus he attains good fortune.

sanskrit_iast: yadā mṛgaśiro yujyet tadā snānaṃ vidhīyate | muktāmaṇisuvarṇena dhanārthī tena snāpayet ||
meaning: यदा मृगशिरो युज्येत् तदा स्नानं विधीयते । मुक्तामणिसुवर्णेन धनार्थी तेन स्नापयेत् ॥
text_mt: When Mṛgaśiras is in conjunction, then a bath is prescribed; / one desiring wealth should bathe with pearls, gems, and gold.

sanskrit_iast: śrīveṣṭakasarjarasatagarośīrapattrakaiḥ | ārdrāyāṃ vaṇijaḥ snātāḥ sulābhāṃs tu labhanti te ||
meaning: श्रीवेष्टकसर्जरसतगरोशीरपत्त्रकैः । आर्द्रायां वणिजः स्नाताः सुलाभांस् तु लभन्ति ते ॥
text_mt: Merchants bathed under Ārdrā with turpentine, resin, tagara, uśīra, and pattraka / indeed obtain good profits.

sanskrit_iast: punarvasubhyāṃ gomārgād āhared agramṛttikām | gopīṭhe snāpayed go 'rthī kṣipraṃ gomān bhaviṣyati ||
meaning: पुनर्वसुभ्यां गोमार्गाद् आहरेद् अग्रमृत्तिकाम् । गोपीठे स्नापयेद् गो ऽर्थी क्षिप्रं गोमान् भविष्यति ॥
text_mt: Under the two Punarvasus, one should fetch top-soil from a cattle-path; / one desiring cattle should bathe on a cow-seat; he will quickly become possessed of cattle.

sanskrit_iast: raktaśālisahasreṇa tāvadbhir gaurasarṣapaiḥ | sahasravīryānantyā ca madayantīpriyaṅgubhiḥ | trīn puṣyān brāhmaṇaḥ snātaḥ pārthivaṃ labhate yaśaḥ ||
meaning: रक्तशालिसहस्रेण तावद्भिर् गौरसर्षपैः । सहस्रवीर्यानन्त्या च मदयन्तीप्रियङ्गुभिः । त्रीन् पुष्यान् ब्राह्मणः स्नातः पार्थिवं लभते यशः ॥
text_mt: With a thousand grains of red rice, as many white mustard seeds, / and sahasravīryā, anantā, madayantī, and priyaṅgu: / a brāhmaṇa bathed under three Puṣyas attains royal glory.

sanskrit_iast: aśleṣāsv āhārayed ubhayataḥ kūlamṛttikāḥ | aśvārohaṃ snāpayet tena kṣipravāhī bhaviṣyati ||
meaning: अश्लेषास्व् आहारयेद् उभयतः कूलमृत्तिकाः । अश्वारोहं स्नापयेत् तेन क्षिप्रवाही भविष्यति ॥
text_mt: Under Āśleṣā, one should procure soil from both banks [of a river]; / one should bathe a horseman with it; he will quickly become a good rider.

sanskrit_iast: maghābhis tu tilaiḥ snāyād utpalaiḥ kamalais tathā | tasmiṃs tu māse sā kanyā kṣipraṃ ca labhate patim ||
meaning: मघाभिस् तु तिलैः स्नायाद् उत्पलैः कमलैस् तथा । तस्मिंस् तु मासे सा कन्या क्षिप्रं च लभते पतिम् ॥
text_mt: Under the Maghās, one should bathe with sesame, with blue lotuses, and with red lotuses; / in that very month that maiden quickly obtains a husband.

sanskrit_iast: atha pūrvayoḥ phalgunyoḥ śatapuṣpā priyaṅgavaḥ | madhv eva ca tṛtīyaṃ syāt saubhāgyaṃ bhogavardhanam ||
meaning: अथ पूर्वयोः फल्गुन्योः शतपुष्पा प्रियङ्गवः । मध्व् एव च तृतीयं स्यात् सौभाग्यं भोगवर्धनम् ॥
text_mt: Now under the prior two Phalgunīs [there should be] dill, priyaṅgu mustard seeds, / and honey should be the third; it brings good fortune and increases enjoyment.

sanskrit_iast: athottarayoḥ phalgunyor akṣatā gaurasarṣapāḥ | etat snānaṃ prayuñjīta prajāsthāpanam uttamam ||
meaning: अथोत्तरयोः फल्गुन्योर् अक्षता गौरसर्षपाः । एतत् स्नानं प्रयुञ्जीत प्रजास्थापनम् उत्तमम् ॥
text_mt: Now under the latter two Phalgunīs [there should be] unbroken grains and white mustard seeds; / one should employ this bath, the supreme establisher of offspring.

sanskrit_iast: hastena sarvakārūṇāṃ caurāṇāṃ cāpi nityaśaḥ | nadīgiritaṭākeṣu mṛttikāsnānam uttamam ||
meaning: हस्तेन सर्वकारूणां चौराणां चापि नित्यशः । नदीगिरितटाकेषु मृत्तिकास्नानम् उत्तमम् ॥
text_mt: Under Hasta, for all artisans and also for thieves, / a mud-bath in rivers, mountains, and ponds is constantly best.

sanskrit_iast: citrāyāṃ citramālyais tu sarvagandhair alaṃkṛtam | yoṣārthī snāpayet tena kṣipraṃ sa labhate priyām ||
meaning: चित्रायां चित्रमाल्यैस् तु सर्वगन्धैर् अलंकृतम् । योषार्थी स्नापयेत् तेन क्षिप्रं स लभते प्रियाम् ॥
text_mt: Under Citrā, one desiring a woman should bathe [himself] adorned with varied garlands / and all perfumes; through this he quickly obtains a beloved [woman].

sanskrit_iast: svātinā tu gandhaiḥ snāyād utpalaiḥ kumudais tathā | tasmiṃs tu māse sā kanyā kṣipraṃ nirvyūhyate tataḥ ||
meaning: स्वातिना तु गन्धैः स्नायाद् उत्पलैः कुमुदैस् तथा । तस्मिंस् तु मासे सा कन्या क्षिप्रं निर्व्यूह्यते ततः ॥
text_mt: Under Svāti, however, she should bathe with perfumes, blue lotuses, and white water lilies; / then in that month that girl is quickly led away [in marriage].

sanskrit_iast: khaḍgasya ca viṣāṇena gajasya ṛṣabhasya vā | viśākhābhyām abhiṣikto rājā pṛthivīm abhiśāsayet ||
meaning: खड्गस्य च विषाणेन गजस्य ऋषभस्य वा । विशाखाभ्याम् अभिषिक्तो राजा पृथिवीम् अभिशासयेत् ॥
text_mt: With the horn of a rhinoceros, of an elephant, or of a bull, / a king consecrated under the two Viśākhās shall rule over the earth.

sanskrit_iast: anūrādhāsv āhārayed valmīkaśatamṛttikāḥ | karṣaṇaṃ snāpayet tena dhanadhānyena vardhate ||
meaning: अनूराधास्व् आहारयेद् वल्मीकशतमृत्तिकाः । कर्षणं स्नापयेत् तेन धनधान्येन वर्धते ॥
text_mt: Under the Anurādhās, one should fetch soil from a hundred anthills; / one should bathe a farmer with it; he increases in wealth and grain.

sanskrit_iast: jyeṣṭhāyāṃ jyaiṣṭhyakāmaṃ tu abhiṣiñcet purohitam | rasaiś ca miśradhānyaiś cābhiṣiktaḥ prāśayed rasān ||
meaning: ज्येष्ठायां ज्यैष्ठ्यकामं तु अभिषिञ्चेत् पुरोहितम् । रसैश् च मिश्रधान्यैश् चाभिषिक्तः प्राशयेद् रसान् ॥
text_mt: Under Jyeṣṭhā, however, one should consecrate a domestic priest who desires preeminence; / and consecrated with fluids and mixed grains, he should ingest the fluids.

sanskrit_iast: mūlena sarvatobhadram upaviṣṭā varavarṇinī | śamīpattrasahasreṇa snānāt putraṃ prasūyate ||
meaning: मूलेन सर्वतोभद्रम् उपविष्टा वरवर्णिनी । शमीपत्त्रसहस्रेण स्नानात् पुत्रं प्रसूयते ॥
text_mt: Under Mūla, a woman of fair complexion, seated upon a sarvatobhadra diagram, / gives birth to a son from a bath with a thousand śamī leaves.

sanskrit_iast: atha pūrvāsv aṣāḍhāsu yā snāyād ahate paṭe | jātarūpeṇa kalyāṇī bhogaṃ bhuṅkte patipriyā ||
meaning: अथ पूर्वास्व् अषाढासु या स्नायाद् अहते पटे । जातरूपेण कल्याणी भोगं भुङ्क्ते पतिप्रिया ॥
text_mt: Now, under the prior Aṣāḍhās, the auspicious woman, beloved of her husband, who bathes / wearing an unwashed garment with gold, enjoys pleasure.

sanskrit_iast: athottarāsv aṣāḍhāsu yaḥ snāyāc ced upoṣitaḥ | mahāhrada uśīreṇa dāsīdāsena vardhate ||
meaning: अथोत्तरास्व् अषाढासु यः स्नायाच् चेद् उपोषितः । महाह्रद उशीरेण दासीदासेन वर्धते ॥
text_mt: Now, under the latter Aṣāḍhās, if one who has fasted bathes / in a great pool with uśīra, he increases in female and male slaves.

sanskrit_iast: vacayotpalakuṣṭhaiś ca brāhmī siddhārthakais tathā | abhijid brāhmaṇaḥ snātaḥ pārthivaṃ labhate yaśaḥ ||
meaning: वचयोत्पलकुष्ठैश् च ब्राह्मी सिद्धार्थकैस् तथा । अभिजिद् ब्राह्मणः स्नातः पार्थिवं लभते यशः ॥
text_mt: With sweet flag, blue lotuses, and kuṣṭha, and likewise brāhmī and white mustard seeds: / a brāhmaṇa bathed under Abhijit attains royal renown.

sanskrit_iast: śravaṇena sravantīnāṃ yaḥ snāyāt saṃgameṣu ca | sa saṃgacchati svarṇena hiraṇyena dhanena vā ||
meaning: श्रवणेन स्रवन्तीनां यः स्नायात् संगमेषु च । स संगच्छति स्वर्णेन हिरण्येन धनेन वा ॥
text_mt: Under Śravaṇa, he who bathes at the confluences of streams / is united with gold, precious metal, or wealth.

sanskrit_iast: śraviṣṭhābhir dhanakāmaṃ tu snāpayed yatra candanaiḥ | etat snānaṃ prayuñjāno dhanadhānyena vardhate ||
meaning: श्रविष्ठाभिर् धनकामं तु स्नापयेद् यत्र चन्दनैः । एतत् स्नानं प्रयुञ्जानो धनधान्येन वर्धते ॥
text_mt: Under the Śraviṣṭhās, one should bathe one who desires wealth with sandalwood pastes; / employing this bath, he increases in wealth and grain.

sanskrit_iast: śatabhiṣag bhiṣakkāmo 'bhiṣiñcec chāntikarmasu | so 'bhiṣikto hatapāpmā sarvarogaiḥ pramucyate ||
meaning: शतभिषग् भिषक्कामो ऽभिषिञ्चेच् छान्तिकर्मसु । सो ऽभिषिक्तो हतपाप्मा सर्वरोगैः प्रमुच्यते ॥
text_mt: Under Śatabhiṣaj, one desiring to be a physician should consecrate [himself] in propitiatory rites; / consecrated, his evil destroyed, he is released from all diseases.

sanskrit_iast: atha pūrvayoḥ proṣṭhapadayo rocanayāñjanena ca | snātā gajaviṣāṇena rājānaṃ janayet sutam ||
meaning: अथ पूर्वयोः प्रोष्ठपदयो रोचनयाञ्जनेन च । स्नाता गजविषाणेन राजानं जनयेत् सुतम् ॥
text_mt: Now, under the prior two Proṣṭhapadās, [a woman] bathed with yellow orpiment, collyrium, / and [water from] an elephant's tusk shall give birth to a king as a son.

sanskrit_iast: athottarayoḥ proṣṭhapadayoḥ prasannāpadmakaṃ madhu | gandharvaṃ snāpayet tena rājavāhī bhaviṣyati ||
meaning: अथोत्तरयोः प्रोष्ठपदयोः प्रसन्नापद्मकं मधु । गन्धर्वं स्नापयेत् तेन राजवाही भविष्यति ॥
text_mt: Now, under the latter two Proṣṭhapadās, [there should be] clear liquor, padmaka wood, and honey; / one should bathe an equestrian with it; he will become a bearer of kings.

sanskrit_iast: khaḍgasya ca viṣāṇena jalena madhusarpiṣā | revatyāṃ kṣatriyaḥ snāto rājā pṛthivīm abhiśāsate ||
meaning: खड्गस्य च विषाणेन जलेन मधुसर्पिषा । रेवत्यां क्षत्रियः स्नातो राजा पृथिवीम् अभिशासते ॥
text_mt: With the horn of a rhinoceros, with water, honey, and clarified butter, / a kṣatriya king bathed under Revatī rules over the earth.

sanskrit_iast: aśvinyāṃ svastikaṃ mālyaṃ madayantīpriyaṅgubhiḥ | rūpājīvāyās tat snānaṃ saubhāgyaṃ bhogavardhanam ||
meaning: अश्विन्यां स्वस्तिकं माल्यं मदयन्तीप्रियङ्गुभिः । रूपाजीवायास् तत् स्नानं सौभाग्यं भोगवर्धनम् ॥
text_mt: Under Aśvinī, a garland shaped like a svastika, with henna and priyaṅgu: / that bath brings good fortune and increases enjoyment for a courtesan.

sanskrit_iast: bharaṇībhir bhadramustais tv elāsiddharthakais tathā | snātā patikulaṃ gacched asapatnam akaṇṭakam ||
meaning: भरणीभिर् भद्रमुस्तैस् त्व् एलासिद्धर्थकैस् तथा । स्नाता पतिकुलं गच्छेद् असपत्नम् अकण्टकम् ॥
text_mt: Under the Bharaṇīs, having bathed with nut grass, cardamom, and white mustard seeds, / she goes to her husband's family, free of rivals and free of obstacles.

sanskrit_iast: sarvajñaḥ sarvaga śaṃsa nārada prajñānam anyasmād anūnaprajñāt svargasya lokasya dehādyairyāt pathibhir upapanno manuṣyaḥ ||
meaning: सर्वज्ञः सर्वग शंस नारद प्रज्ञानम् अन्यस्माद् अनूनप्रज्ञात् स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य देहाद्यैर्यात् पथिभिर् उपपन्नो मनुष्यः ॥
text_mt: Omniscient, all-pervading Nārada, declare the wisdom from that other [sage] of non-deficient wisdom, / endowed with paths by which a mortal goes from the body to the heavenly world!

sanskrit_iast: upoṣitaḥ śuciśīlaḥ puṇyagandho yadā bhavet | prāg astaṃgamanabhojanād yad enaṃ nityam atandritaḥ ||
meaning: उपोषितः शुचिशीलः पुण्यगन्धो यदा भवेत् । प्राग् अस्तंगमनभोजनाद् यद् एनं नित्यम् अतन्द्रितः ॥
text_mt: When, having fasted, pure in conduct, with a sacred scent, / before eating at sunset, he constantly and unweariedly [serves] this [path]:

sanskrit_iast: samayācārapūrvābhiḥ karmasiddhiḥ praśasyate | taṃ kāmadughaṃ svargakāmaḥ paretya pratipadyate ||
meaning: समयाचारपूर्वाभिः कर्मसिद्धिः प्रशस्यते । तं कामदुघं स्वर्गकामः परेत्य प्रतिपद्यते ॥
text_mt: Accomplishment of deeds is praised through [actions] preceded by conventional conduct; / desiring heaven, when deceased, he attains that wish-granting cow.

sanskrit_iast: kṛttikābhiḥ pāyasaṃ sarpiṣā saha bhojayet | taṃ kāmadughaṃ svargakāmaḥ paretya pratipadyate ||
meaning: कृत्तिकाभिः पायसं सर्पिषा सह भोजयेत् । तं कामदुघं स्वर्गकामः परेत्य प्रतिपद्यते ॥
text_mt: Under the Kṛttikās, one should feed [priests] rice cooked in milk along with clarified butter; / desiring heaven, when deceased, he attains that wish-granting cow.

sanskrit_iast: rohiṇyām akṣatair māṣaiḥ sarpirmiśraṃ sahaudanam | dugdhānnapānaṃ maṃheta so 'kṣato yamasādane ||
meaning: रोहिण्याम् अक्षतैर् माषैः सर्पिर्मिश्रं सहौदनम् । दुग्धान्नपानं मंहेत सो ऽक्षतो यमसादने ॥
text_mt: Under Rohiṇī, one should offer unbroken black lentils mixed with clarified butter along with boiled rice, / [and] food and drink made with milk; he remains uninjured in Yama's abode.

sanskrit_iast: mṛgaśirasi maṃheta ajāṃ dhenuṃ payasvinīm | sāsmai sarvān kāmān dugdhvā eti pūrvā payasvinī ||
meaning: मृगशिरसि मंहेत अजां धेनुं पयस्विनीम् । सास्मै सर्वान् कामान् दुग्ध्वा एति पूर्वा पयस्विनी ॥
text_mt: Under Mṛgaśiras, one should offer a female goat, a milch cow yielding abundant milk; / having milked all wishes for him, she, yielding milk, goes before [him].

sanskrit_iast: ārdrāyāṃ kṛsaraṃ dadyāt tailamiśram upoṣitaḥ | punarvasubhyāṃ maṃheta madhvapūpāṃs tv anuttamān ||
meaning: आर्द्रायां कृसरं दद्यात् तैलमिश्रम् उपोषितः । पुनर्वसुभ्यां मंहेत मध्वपूपांस् त्व् अनुत्तमान् ॥
text_mt: Under Ārdrā, having fasted, one should give a mixture of rice and sesame mixed with sesame oil; / under the two Punarvasus, one should offer unsurpassed cakes with honey.

sanskrit_iast: rukmaṃ puṣyeṇa maṃheta so 'kṣato yamasādane | aśleṣā rajataṃ dadyāt saurabheyeṇa preṣitaḥ ||
meaning: रुक्मं पुष्येण मंहेत सो ऽक्षतो यमसादने । अश्लेषा रजतं दद्यात् सौरभेयेण प्रेषितः ॥
text_mt: Under Puṣya, one should offer gold; he remains uninjured in Yama's abode; / under Āśleṣā, he should give silver, [and] sent by an ox,

sanskrit_iast: sarpān nirhanti pretasya paripanthi sukhād bhayāt | maghābhis tu tilān dadyān madhumiśrān smaran pitṝn ||
meaning: सर्पान् निर्हन्ति प्रेतस्य परिपन्थि सुखाद् भयात् । मघाभिस् तु तिलान् दद्यान् मधुमिश्रान् स्मरन् पितॄन् ॥
text_mt: he slays the serpent highwaymen of the deceased through ease and fear. / Under the Maghās, one should give sesame seeds mixed with honey, remembering the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast: kāmais tatropatiṣṭhanti amī ye somayājinaḥ | phāṇiteneṣṭakā miśrā dadyāt pūrvayoḥ phalgunyor madhunottarayoḥ ||
meaning: कामैस् तत्रोपतिष्ठन्ति अमी ये सोमयाजिनः । फाणितेनेष्टका मिश्रा दद्यात् पूर्वयोः फल्गुन्योर् मधुनोत्तरयोः ॥
text_mt: Those Soma-sacrificers attend upon him there with [fulfillment of] desires. / Under the prior two Phalgunīs one should give bricks mixed with treacle, and under the latter two with honey.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvottarayoḥ phalgunyor duhate madhuphāṇite ||
meaning: पूर्वोत्तरयोः फल्गुन्योर् दुहते मधुफाणिते ॥
text_mt: Under the prior and latter Phalgunīs, [cows] yield honey and treacle.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaddhastirathaṃ yuktaṃ hastena tu dadan naraḥ | savituḥ sthānam āpnoti divyāṃ kāmajavāṃ sabhām ||
meaning: बृहद्धस्तिरथं युक्तं हस्तेन तु ददन् नरः । सवितुः स्थानम् आप्नोति दिव्यां कामजवां सभाम् ॥
text_mt: A man who gives a great elephant-drawn chariot under Hasta / attains the realm of Savitṛ, the divine hall moving at will.

sanskrit_iast: citrāyāṃ vṛṣalīṃ dadyāt sarvapuṣpair alaṃkṛtām | gandhaiḥ śuśrūṣamāṇas tu dhruve sthāne sugandhiḥ prapadyate ||
meaning: चित्रायां वृषलीं दद्यात् सर्वपुष्पैर् अलंकृताम् । गन्धैः शुश्रूषमाणस् तु ध्रुवे स्थाने सुगन्धिः प्रपद्यते ॥
text_mt: Under Citrā, one should give a Śūdra woman adorned with all flowers; / serving with perfumes, fragrant, he reaches a firm station.

sanskrit_iast: svātāv ekadhanaṃ dadyād yadyad asya priyaṃ gṛhe | asajjamāno gaccheta aśarīro yathā manaḥ ||
meaning: स्वाताव् एकधनं दद्याद् यद्यद् अस्य प्रियं गृहे । असज्जमानो गच्छेत अशरीरो यथा मनः ॥
text_mt: Under Svāti, one should give a single treasure, whatever in his house is dear [to him]; / unattached, he travels bodiless like the mind.

sanskrit_iast: dhenuṃ tu rūpasaṃpannām anaḍvāhau tu vā vahau | viśākhābhyāṃ madhumanthaṃ prāpayet sthānam uttamam ||
meaning: धेनुं तु रूपसंपन्नाम् अनड्वाहौ तु वा वहौ । विशाखाभ्यां मधुमन्थं प्रापयेत् स्थानम् उत्तमम् ॥
text_mt: Under the two Viśākhās, [giving] a milch cow endowed with good form, or two draft oxen, / [and] a gruel mixed with honey, leads to the highest abode.

sanskrit_iast: anūrādhāsu prāvaraṇam annaṃ tu śuci jyeṣṭhāyāṃ ca | dadyāc cānnaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo bhakṣair uccāvacaiḥ saha ||
meaning: अनूराधासु प्रावरणम् अन्नं तु शुचि ज्येष्ठायां च । दद्याच् चान्नं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो भक्षैर् उच्चावचैः सह ॥
text_mt: Under the Anurādhās, an outer garment, but pure food under Jyeṣṭhā; / and one should give food to brāhmaṇas along with varied delicacies.

sanskrit_iast: surāṃ mūlena maṃhetābrāhmaṇībhya upoṣitaḥ | mātus tenānṛṇo bhavati saṃkarāc ca vimucyate ||
meaning: सुरां मूलेन मंहेताब्राह्मणीभ्य उपोषितः । मातुस् तेनानृणो भवति संकराच् च विमुच्यते ॥
text_mt: Having fasted, one should offer liquor to non-brāhmaṇa women under Mūla; / through this he becomes free of debt to his mother and is released from confusion of caste.

sanskrit_iast: udamantham aṣāḍhāsu pūrvāsu madhunottaram ||
meaning: उदमन्थम् अषाढासु पूर्वासु मधुनोत्तरम् ॥
text_mt: Under the prior Aṣāḍhās [one should give] a gruel of flour in water; under the latter, with honey.

sanskrit_iast: abhijid duhitaraṃ dadyān madhuparkapurogamām | uttame brahmaṇaḥ sthāne sarvakāmaiḥ pramodate ||
meaning: अभिजिद् दुहितरं दद्यान् मधुपर्कपुरोगमाम् । उत्तमे ब्रह्मणः स्थाने सर्वकामैः प्रमोदते ॥
text_mt: Under Abhijit, one should give a daughter preceded by the honey-mixture; / he rejoices in the highest station of Brahmā with all desires.

sanskrit_iast: kambalaṃ śravaṇe dadyād vastrāntaram upoṣitaḥ | śraviṣṭhābhir vastrayugaṃ gandhān śatabhiṣag bhavet ||
meaning: कम्बलं श्रवणे दद्याद् वस्त्रान्तरम् उपोषितः । श्रविष्ठाभिर् वस्त्रयुगं गन्धान् शतभिषग् भवेत् ॥
text_mt: Having fasted, one should give a woolen blanket under Śravaṇa, [and] a second garment; / under the Śraviṣṭhās a pair of garments; under Śatabhiṣaj there should be perfumes.

sanskrit_iast: ajaṃ saṃpacyodanaṃ dadyāt pūrvayoḥ proṣṭhapadayor aurabhreṇa sahottarayoḥ ||
meaning: अजं संपच्योदनं दद्यात् पूर्वयोः प्रोष्ठपदयोर् औरभ्रेण सहोत्तरयोः ॥
text_mt: Having cooked a goat, one should give boiled rice under the prior two Proṣṭhapadās; / under the latter two, along with a ram.

sanskrit_iast: dhenuṃ ca rūpasaṃpannāṃ gaur gṛṣṭiḥ pūrṇadohanīm | revatyāṃ trivatsāṃ dadyāc chubhakāṃsyopadohinīm ||
meaning: धेनुं च रूपसंपन्नां गौर् गृष्टिः पूर्णदोहनीम् । रेवत्यां त्रिवत्सां दद्याच् छुभकांस्योपदोहिनीम् ॥
text_mt: And under Revatī, one should give a milch cow endowed with good form, a cow that has calved once, filling the milk pail, / having had three calves, being milked into an auspicious bell-metal vessel.

sanskrit_iast: vastreṇānaḍvāhau saṃbaddhvā dadyād aśvayujo r naraḥ | daśa varṣasahasrāṇi lomnilomni mahīyate ||
meaning: वस्त्रेणानड्वाहौ संबद्ध्वा दद्याद् अश्वयुजो र् नरः । दश वर्षसहस्राणि लोम्निलोम्नि महीयते ॥
text_mt: Under the two Aśvayujas, a man who gives two draft oxen bound together with a cloth / is honored for ten thousand years for every hair [on their bodies].

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭau varṣasahasrāṇi ajadhenvā payo 'śnute | daśa varṣasahasrāṇi godhenvā payo 'śnute ||
meaning: अष्टौ वर्षसहस्राणि अजधेन्वा पयो ऽश्नुते । दश वर्षसहस्राणि गोधेन्वा पयो ऽश्नुते ॥
text_mt: For eight thousand years he enjoys milk from a milch goat; / for ten thousand years he enjoys milk from a milch cow.

sanskrit_iast: anaḍvāhaṃ tu yo dadyāt suhṛdaṃ sādhuvāhinam | vīraṃ prajānāṃ bhartāraṃ prāpnoti daśadhenudam ||
meaning: अनड्वाहं तु यो दद्यात् सुहृदं साधुवाहिनम् । वीरं प्रजानां भर्तारं प्राप्नोति दशधेनुदम् ॥
text_mt: He who gives a draft ox that is friendly and carries well, / a vigorous bearer of subjects, obtains [the reward of] one who gives ten milch cows.

sanskrit_iast: yadā vatsasya pādau dvau śiras cāpi pradṛśyate | tadā gauḥ pṛthivī jñeyā yāvad garbhaṃ na muñcati ||
meaning: यदा वत्सस्य पादौ द्वौ शिरस् चापि प्रदृश्यते । तदा गौः पृथिवी ज्ञेया यावद् गर्भं न मुञ्चति ॥
text_mt: When the two front feet and the head of the calf are seen, / the cow is to be known as the earth, as long as she has not dropped the fetus.

sanskrit_iast: bharaṇībhiḥ kṛṣṇatilāṃ dadyāt tiladhenuṃ payasvinīm | tayā durgāṇi tarati kṣuradhārāṃś ca parvatān ||
meaning: भरणीभिः कृष्णतिलां दद्यात् तिलधेनुं पयस्विनीम् । तया दुर्गाणि तरति क्षुरधारांश् च पर्वतान् ॥
text_mt: Under the Bharaṇīs, one should give an effigy of a cow made of sesame [seeds] with black sesame, abounding in milk; / by means of it he crosses over difficult passages and mountains with razor-sharp edges.

sanskrit_iast: nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathā somo jyotiṣām iva bhāskaraḥ | bhāti divyaṃ divaṃ jyotiḥ pāvakaḥ śucir uttamaḥ ||
meaning: नक्षत्राणां यथा सोमो ज्योतिषाम् इव भास्करः । भाति दिव्यं दिवं ज्योतिः पावकः शुचिर् उत्तमः ॥
text_mt: Just as Soma [shines] among the lunar mansions, as the sun among heavenly lights, / [so] the purifier, pure and supreme, shines as divine light in heaven.

sanskrit_iast: evam uktāṃ nakṣatradakṣiṇāṃ yo dadātīha jīvaloke | apahatya tamaḥ sarvaṃ brahmaloke mahīyate | yathā yaṣṭus tathādhyetur eṣā brāhmī pratiśrutir eṣā brāhmī pratiśrutir iti || kṛttikārohiṇīmadhye paippalādā mantrāḥ ||
meaning: एवम् उक्तां नक्षत्रदक्षिणां यो ददातीह जीवलोके । अपहत्य तमः सर्वं ब्रह्मलोके महीयते । यथा यष्टुस् तथाध्येतुर् एषा ब्राह्मी प्रतिश्रुतिर् एषा ब्राह्मी प्रतिश्रुतिर् इति ॥ कृत्तिकारोहिणीमध्ये पैप्पलादा मन्त्राः ॥
text_mt:
He who gives the sacrificial fee for the lunar mansions in this living world as described, / having destroyed all darkness, is exalted in the world of Brahmā. / As for the sacrificer, so for the reciter: this is the Vedic promise, this is the Vedic promise.

(Pariśiṣṭa 1b. [Paippalāda Mantras between Kṛttikā and Rohiṇī])

The Paippalāda mantras between Kṛttikā and Rohiṇī [are concluded].

sanskrit_iast: om | brahmaṇe brahmavedāya rudrāya parameṣṭhine | namaskṛtya pravakṣyāmi śeṣam ātharvaṇaṃ vidhim ||
meaning: ओम् । ब्रह्मणे ब्रह्मवेदाय रुद्राय परमेष्ठिने । नमस्कृत्य प्रवक्ष्यामि शेषम् आथर्वणं विधिम् ॥
text_mt: Om. Having bowed to Brahmā, the Brahmaveda, and Rudra Parameṣṭhin, / I shall proclaim the remainder of the Atharvan rule.

sanskrit_iast: daivaṃ prabhavate śreṣṭhaṃ hetumātraṃ tu pauruṣam | daivena tu suguptena śakto jetuṃ vasuṃdharām ||
meaning: दैवं प्रभवते श्रेष्ठं हेतुमात्रं तु पौरुषम् । दैवेन तु सुगुप्तेन शक्तो जेतुं वसुंधराम् ॥
text_mt: Fate is sovereign and paramount, whereas human effort is merely an instrumental cause; / but supported well by fate, one is able to conquer the earth.

sanskrit_iast: daivāt puruṣakārāc ca daivam eva viśiṣyate | tasmād daivaṃ viśeṣeṇa pūjayet tu mahīpatiḥ ||
meaning: दैवात् पुरुषकाराच् च दैवम् एव विशिष्यते । तस्माद् दैवं विशेषेण पूजयेत् तु महीपतिः ॥
text_mt: Between fate and human effort, fate indeed is superior; / therefore the ruler of the earth should especially venerate fate.

sanskrit_iast: daivakarmavidau tasmāt sāṃvatsarapurohitau | gṛhṇīyāt satataṃ rājā dānasaṃmānarañjanaiḥ ||
meaning: दैवकर्मविदौ तस्मात् सांवत्सरपुरोहितौ । गृह्णीयात् सततं राजा दानसंमानरञ्जनैः ॥
text_mt: Therefore, the king should constantly maintain the astrologer and the royal priest, who know rites concerning fate, / through gifts, honors, and pleasing words.

sanskrit_iast: apitā tu yathā bālas tathāsāṃvatsaro nṛpaḥ | amātṛko yathā bālas tathātharvavivarjitaḥ || arimadhye yathaikākī tathā vaidyavivarjitaḥ ||
meaning: अपिता तु यथा बालस् तथासांवत्सरो नृपः । अमातृको यथा बालस् तथाथर्वविवर्जितः ॥ अरिमध्ये यथैकाकी तथा वैद्यविवर्जितः ॥
text_mt: Just as a child is fatherless, so is a king without an astrologer; / just as a child is motherless, so is one destitute of an Atharvan; / just as one is alone in the midst of enemies, so is one destitute of a physician.

sanskrit_iast: dharmeṇa pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāṃ vijayiṣyan mahīpatiḥ | vidyālakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ bhārgavaṃ varayed gurum ||
meaning: धर्मेण पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां विजयिष्यन् महीपतिः । विद्यालक्षणसंपन्नं भार्गवं वरयेद् गुरुम् ॥
text_mt: A ruler of the earth who desires to conquer the entire earth in accordance with dharma / should choose as spiritual guide a descendant of Bhṛgu endowed with learning and bodily signs.

sanskrit_iast: caturvidhasya karmaṇo vedatattvena niścayam | prajāpatir athaiko hi na vedatrayam īkṣate ||
meaning: चतुर्विधस्य कर्मणो वेदतत्त्वेन निश्चयम् । प्रजापतिर् अथैको हि न वेदत्रयम् ईक्षते ॥
text_mt: The determination of fourfold ritual action is made according to the reality of the Veda; / for Prajāpati alone does not look upon the triad of Vedas [apart from the fourth].

sanskrit_iast: atharvabhinnaṃ yac chāntaṃ tac chāntaṃ netarais tribhiḥ | vijñānaṃ triṣu lokeṣu jāyate brahmavedataḥ ||
meaning: अथर्वभिन्नं यच् छान्तं तच् छान्तं नेतरैस् त्रिभिः । विज्ञानं त्रिषु लोकेषु जायते ब्रह्मवेदतः ॥
text_mt: What is pacified by that which belongs to the Atharvan is pacified; it is not pacified by the other three; / supreme knowledge in the three worlds arises from the Brahmaveda.

sanskrit_iast: atharvā sṛjate ghoram adbhutaṃ śamayet tathā | atharvā rakṣate yajñaṃ yajñasya patir aṅgirāḥ ||
meaning: अथर्वा सृजते घोरम् अद्भुतं शमयेत् तथा । अथर्वा रक्षते यज्ञं यज्ञस्य पतिर् अङ्गिराः ॥
text_mt: The Atharvan releases the terrible, and likewise he pacifies portents; / the Atharvan protects the sacrifice; the Aṅgiras is the lord of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: divyāntarikṣabhaumānām utpātānām anekadhā | śamayitā brahmavedajñas tasmād rakṣitā bhṛguḥ ||
meaning: दिव्यान्तरिक्षभौमानाम् उत्पातानाम् अनेकधा । शमयिता ब्रह्मवेदज्ञस् तस्माद् रक्षिता भृगुः ॥
text_mt: The knower of the Brahmaveda is the pacifier of portents of the sky, the intermediate space, and the earth in diverse ways; / therefore the descendant of Bhṛgu is the protector.

sanskrit_iast: brahmā śamayen nādhvaryur na chandogo na bahvṛcaḥ | rakṣāṃsi rakṣati brahmā brahmā tasmād atharvavit ||
meaning: ब्रह्मा शमयेन् नाध्वर्युर् न छन्दोगो न बह्वृचः । रक्षांसि रक्षति ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मा तस्माद् अथर्ववित् ॥
text_mt: The Brahman priest can pacify, not the Adhvaryu, not the Chandoga, not the Bahvṛca; / the Brahman priest guards against the demons; therefore the Brahman priest must be a knower of the Atharvan.

sanskrit_iast: senāyā rakṣaṇe tasmāt svarāṣṭraparivṛddhaye | śāntyarthaṃ ca mahīpālo vṛṇuyād bhārgavaṃ gurum ||
meaning: सेनाया रक्षणे तस्मात् स्वराष्ट्रपरिवृद्धये । शान्त्यर्थं च महीपालो वृणुयाद् भार्गवं गुरुम् ॥
text_mt: Therefore, for the protection of the army, for the increase of his own realm, / and for the sake of propitiation, the ruler of the earth should choose a descendant of Bhṛgu as spiritual guide.

sanskrit_iast: gurave pārthivo dadyāt kotiṃ varaṇadakṣiṇām | ardhamardhaṃ mahībhāgaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu tribhāgataḥ ||
meaning: गुरवे पार्थिवो दद्यात् कोतिं वरणदक्षिणाम् । अर्धमर्धं महीभागं तृतीयं तु त्रिभागतः ॥
text_mt: The earthly ruler should give to the spiritual guide ten million [coins] as the choice-fee, / or half of a territory of the earth, or a third from a threefold division.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ bhūmipramāṇena koṭibhāgaṃ vinirdiśet | yena vā parituṣyeta gurus tat pārthivaś caret ||
meaning: एवं भूमिप्रमाणेन कोटिभागं विनिर्दिशेत् । येन वा परितुष्येत गुरुस् तत् पार्थिवश् चरेत् ॥
text_mt: Thus according to the extent of the land he should assign a crore or a portion; / or the ruler of the earth should do that by which the spiritual guide may be completely satisfied.

sanskrit_iast: ghnanti daivopasargāś ca na ca devo 'bhivarṣati | vīrās tatra na sūyante yad rāṣṭram apurohitam ||
meaning: घ्नन्ति दैवोपसर्गाश् च न च देवो ऽभिवर्षति । वीरास् तत्र न सूयन्ते यद् राष्ट्रम् अपुरोहितम् ॥
text_mt: Ominous afflictions from fate destroy it, and the god does not send rain, / [and] heroes are not born in that realm which has no royal priest.

sanskrit_iast: na haviḥ pratigṛhṇanti devatāḥ pitaro dvijāḥ | tasya bhūmipater yasya gṛhe nātharvavid guruḥ ||
meaning: न हविः प्रतिगृह्णन्ति देवताः पितरो द्विजाः । तस्य भूमिपतेर् यस्य गृहे नाथर्वविद् गुरुः ॥
text_mt: The deities, the ancestors, and the twice-born do not accept an oblation / from that ruler of the earth in whose house there is no spiritual guide who knows the Atharvan.

sanskrit_iast: samāhitāṅgapratyaṅgaṃ vidyācāraguṇānvitam | paippalādaṃ guruṃ kuryāc chrīrāṣṭrārogyavardhanam ||
meaning: समाहिताङ्गप्रत्यङ्गं विद्याचारगुणान्वितम् । पैप्पलादं गुरुं कुर्याच् छ्रीराष्ट्रारोग्यवर्धनम् ॥
text_mt: One should appoint as spiritual guide a follower of the Pippalāda school, whose major and minor limbs are well proportioned, / who is endowed with learning, proper conduct, and virtue, who increases fortune, the realm, and health;

sanskrit_iast: tathā śaunakinaṃ vāpi vedamantravipaścitam | rāṣṭrasya vṛddhikartāraṃ dhanadhānyādibhiḥ sadā ||
meaning: तथा शौनकिनं वापि वेदमन्त्रविपश्चितम् । राष्ट्रस्य वृद्धिकर्तारं धनधान्यादिभिः सदा ॥
text_mt: or likewise a follower of the Śaunaka school, learned in the Vedic mantras, / who continually brings about the increase of the realm through wealth, grain, and the like.

sanskrit_iast: ātharvaṇād ṛte nānyo niyojyo 'tharvavid guruḥ | nṛpeṇa jayakāmena nirmito 'gnir ivādhvare ||
meaning: आथर्वणाद् ऋते नान्यो नियोज्यो ऽथर्वविद् गुरुः । नृपेण जयकामेन निर्मितो ऽग्निर् इवाध्वरे ॥
text_mt: Except for an Atharvan, no other should be appointed as spiritual guide who knows the Atharvan / by a king desiring victory, just as fire is prepared at a sacrificial session.

sanskrit_iast: bahvṛco hanti vai rāṣṭram adhvaryur nāśayet sutān | chandogo dhananāśāya tasmād ātharvaṇo guruḥ ||
meaning: बह्वृचो हन्ति वै राष्ट्रम् अध्वर्युर् नाशयेत् सुतान् । छन्दोगो धननाशाय तस्माद् आथर्वणो गुरुः ॥
text_mt: A Bahvṛca destroys the realm; an Adhvaryu ruins sons; / a Chandoga leads to the destruction of wealth; therefore, the spiritual guide must be an Atharvan.

sanskrit_iast: ajñānād vā pramādād vā yasya syād bahvṛco guruḥ | deśarāṣṭrapurāmātyanāśas tasya na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning: अज्ञानाद् वा प्रमादाद् वा यस्य स्याद् बह्वृचो गुरुः । देशराष्ट्रपुरामात्यनाशस् तस्य न संशयः ॥
text_mt: He whose spiritual guide is a Bahvṛca through ignorance or through negligence / will suffer the destruction of his country, realm, city, and ministers: of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast: yadi vādhvaryavaṃ rājā niyunakti purohitam | śastreṇa vadhyate kṣipraṃ parikṣīṇārthavāhanaḥ ||
meaning: यदि वाध्वर्यवं राजा नियुनक्ति पुरोहितम् । शस्त्रेण वध्यते क्षिप्रं परिक्षीणार्थवाहनः ॥
text_mt: If a king appoints an Adhvaryu priest as his royal priest, / he is swiftly slain by a weapon, his wealth and conveyances having wasted away.

sanskrit_iast: yathaiva paṅgur adhvānam apakṣī cāṇḍajo nabhaḥ | evaṃ chandogaguruṇā rājā vṛddhiṃ na gacchati ||
meaning: यथैव पङ्गुर् अध्वानम् अपक्षी चाण्डजो नभः । एवं छन्दोगगुरुणा राजा वृद्धिं न गच्छति ॥
text_mt: Just as a lame man cannot travel the path, and a wingless bird cannot traverse the sky, / even so a king does not attain prosperity through a Chandoga spiritual guide.

sanskrit_iast: purodhā jalado yasya maudo vā syāt kadā cana | abdād daśabhyo māsebhyo rāṣṭrabhraṃśaṃ sa gacchati ||
meaning: पुरोधा जलदो यस्य मौदो वा स्यात् कदा चन । अब्दाद् दशभ्यो मासेभ्यो राष्ट्रभ्रंशं स गच्छति ॥
text_mt: He whose royal priest should ever be a Jalada or a Mauda / suffers the loss of his realm within a year or ten months.

sanskrit_iast: palālakam idaṃ sarvam ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃsthitam | sāraṃ sāraparaṃ dhānyam atharvāṅgiraso viduḥ ||
meaning: पलालकम् इदं सर्वम् ऋग्यजुःसामसंस्थितम् । सारं सारपरं धान्यम् अथर्वाङ्गिरसो विदुः ॥
text_mt: All this that is contained in the Ṛg-, Yajur-, and Sāmaveda is mere chaff; / the knowers of Atharvan and Aṅgiras know the grain that is the essential, supreme essence.

sanskrit_iast: trayo lokās trayo devās trayo vedās trayo 'gnayaḥ | ardhamātre layaṃ yānti vedaś cātharvaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning: त्रयो लोकास् त्रयो देवास् त्रयो वेदास् त्रयो ऽग्नयः । अर्धमात्रे लयं यान्ति वेदश् चाथर्वणः स्मृतः ॥
text_mt: The three worlds, the three gods, the three Vedas, and the three fires / merge into the half-mora, and that is traditionally known as the Atharvaveda.

sanskrit_iast: na tithir na ca nakṣatraṃ na graho na ca candramāḥ | atharvamantrasaṃprāptyā sarvasiddhir bhaviṣyati ||
meaning: न तिथिर् न च नक्षत्रं न ग्रहो न च चन्द्रमाः । अथर्वमन्त्रसंप्राप्त्या सर्वसिद्धिर् भविष्यति ॥
text_mt: Neither lunar day nor lunar mansion, neither planet nor moon [can impede]: / through the acquisition of the Atharvan mantra, all success will come to pass.

sanskrit_iast: guruṇā paippalādena vedamantravipaścitā | vardhate dhanadhānyena rāṣṭram evaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning: गुरुणा पैप्पलादेन वेदमन्त्रविपश्चिता । वर्धते धनधान्येन राष्ट्रम् एवं न संशयः ॥
text_mt: With a spiritual guide belonging to the Pippalāda school, learned in the Vedic mantras, / the realm increases in wealth and grain in this manner, without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast: stabdhaṃ nṛśaṃsaṃ pramattaṃ śraddhāhīnam aśāstragam | bhūmikāmo na yāceta dātāram api pārthivam ||
meaning: स्तब्धं नृशंसं प्रमत्तं श्रद्धाहीनम् अशास्त्रगम् । भूमिकामो न याचेत दातारम् अपि पार्थिवम् ॥
text_mt: One desiring land should not ask of an arrogant, cruel, negligent king / who lacks faith and does not follow the śāstras, even though he is a giver.

sanskrit_iast: sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ japtvā gāyatryāyājyayājakaḥ | pūyate bhrūṇahāpy evaṃ cāṇḍālānnāda eva ca ||
meaning: सहस्राणां शतं जप्त्वा गायत्र्यायाज्ययाजकः । पूयते भ्रूणहाप्य् एवं चाण्डालान्नाद एव च ॥
text_mt: Having muttered the Gāyatrī a hundred thousand times, one who sacrifices for those unfit to sacrifice / is purified, as is even a killer of an embryo or an eater of a Caṇḍāla's food.

sanskrit_iast: sarvadravyaparityāgāc chuddhir anyair udāhṛtā | anyaiś caturṇāṃ vedānām adhītyādyottamā ṛcaḥ ||
meaning: सर्वद्रव्यपरित्यागाच् छुद्धिर् अन्यैर् उदाहृता । अन्यैश् चतुर्णां वेदानाम् अधीत्याद्योत्तमा ऋचः ॥
text_mt: Purification through the abandonment of all possessions has been declared by others; / and by others, through having recited the beginning and concluding verses of the four Vedas.

sanskrit_iast: yajanād abhicārād vā kva cid vā mantrakarmaṇi | pūtān eva dvijān prāhur agnikāñcanavarcasa iti || iti rāṣṭrasaṃvargaḥ samāptaḥ ||
meaning: यजनाद् अभिचाराद् वा क्व चिद् वा मन्त्रकर्मणि । पूतान् एव द्विजान् प्राहुर् अग्निकाञ्चनवर्चस इति ॥ इति राष्ट्रसंवर्गः समाप्तः ॥
text_mt:
Whether from sacrificing, from sorcery, or anywhere in ritual involving mantras, / they declare the twice-born to be purified indeed, having the radiance of fire and gold.

Thus ends the Preservation of the Realm.

sanskrit_iast: om atha rājaprathamābhiṣeke prakṛtidravyāṇi parīkṣeta ||
meaning: ओम् अथ राजप्रथमाभिषेके प्रकृतिद्रव्याणि परीक्षेत ॥

sanskrit_iast: tad yathā ||
meaning: तद् यथा ॥

sanskrit_iast: rathasiṃhāsanāsichattracāmaradhvajagajavājivastrālaṃkārasāṃvatsaracikitsakapurohitādīny
meaning: रथसिंहासनासिछत्त्रचामरध्वजगजवाजिवस्त्रालंकारसांवत्सरचिकित्सकपुरोहितादीन्य्

sanskrit_iast: upayuktāni nopayojayet ||
meaning: उपयुक्तानि नोपयोजयेत् ॥

sanskrit_iast: śmaśānānaladevatāni nihitāni dravyāṇīty
meaning: श्मशानानलदेवतानि निहितानि द्रव्याणीत्य्

sanskrit_iast: ācāryapurohitavajramukhata ity āha durmatiḥ sa bhāradvājo
meaning: आचार्यपुरोहितवज्रमुखत इत्य् आह दुर्मतिः स भारद्वाजो

sanskrit_iast: na hy agner ivopayuktasyopayogo vidyata iti parāśaro
meaning: न ह्य् अग्नेर् इवोपयुक्तस्योपयोगो विद्यत इति पराशरो

sanskrit_iast: brahmā brahmāṇḍāgnir ivāprameyo
meaning: ब्रह्मा ब्रह्माण्डाग्निर् इवाप्रमेयो

sanskrit_iast: nānyakulopayukto
meaning: नान्यकुलोपयुक्तो

sanskrit_iast: yasyānyakulopayuktaḥ purodhāḥ śāntikapauṣṭikaprāyaścittīyābhicārikanaimittikordhvadehikāny atharvavihitāni karmāṇi kuryāt sa tasya pratyaṅgiro bhūtvā hastyaśvarathapadātikaṃ prakṛtimukhebhyo …
meaning: यस्यान्यकुलोपयुक्तः पुरोधाः शान्तिकपौष्टिकप्रायश्चित्तीयाभिचारिकनैमित्तिकोर्ध्वदेहिकान्य् अथर्वविहितानि कर्माणि कुर्यात् स तस्य प्रत्यङ्गिरो भूत्वा हस्त्यश्वरथपदातिकं प्रकृतिमुखेभ्यो …

sanskrit_iast: variṣyan na punaḥ kuryād anyaṃ rājā purohitam | nirmālyam iva taṃ rājā nānyo bhūyaḥ samācaret ||
meaning: वरिष्यन् न पुनः कुर्याद् अन्यं राजा पुरोहितम् । निर्माल्यम् इव तं राजा नान्यो भूयः समाचरेत् ॥

sanskrit_iast: svajasraṃ hy agnau hetur bhagavato vyādhitapatitonmattābhiśastaprahīṇapradhvastasaṃprasāraṇam ṛtvik ||
meaning: स्वजस्रं ह्य् अग्नौ हेतुर् भगवतो व्याधितपतितोन्मत्ताभिशस्तप्रहीणप्रध्वस्तसंप्रसारणम् ऋत्विक् ॥

sanskrit_iast: tasmāt kulīnaṃ śrotriyaṃ bhṛgvaṅgirovidaṃ vinayākṛtiśaucācārayuktam alolupaṃ vrataniyamacāritravṛttalakṣanaguṇasaṃpannaṃ saṃdhivigrahacintakaṃ māhendrajālaprabhṛtikarmādiṣv abhividakaṃ jitasthānāsanaṃ himātapavarṣasahaṃ hrīdhṛtikam ārjavaṃ śamadamadayādānaśaktisaṃpannaṃ bṛhaspatyuśanasoḥ sthānākṛtipramāṇaṃ varṇāśrutavapuṣā cānumeyaṃ tejasvinaṃ gambhīraṃ sattvayuktaṃ guruṃ vṛṇīyād bhūpatir iti ||
meaning: तस्मात् कुलीनं श्रोत्रियं भृग्वङ्गिरोविदं विनयाकृतिशौचाचारयुक्तम् अलोलुपं व्रतनियमचारित्रवृत्तलक्षनगुणसंपन्नं संधिविग्रहचिन्तकं माहेन्द्रजालप्रभृतिकर्मादिष्व् अभिविदकं जितस्थानासनं हिमातपवर्षसहं ह्रीधृतिकम् आर्जवं शमदमदयादानशक्तिसंपन्नं बृहस्पत्युशनसोः स्थानाकृतिप्रमाणं वर्णाश्रुतवपुषा चानुमेयं तेजस्विनं गम्भीरं सत्त्वयुक्तं गुरुं वृणीयाद् भूपतिर् इति ॥

sanskrit_iast: madhuparkādyena vidhinā yathārthaṃ saṃpādya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt
meaning: मधुपर्काद्येन विधिना यथार्थं संपाद्य दक्षिणां दद्यात्

sanskrit_iast: koṭimadhyāt tṛtīyaṃ bhāgam
meaning: कोटिमध्यात् तृतीयं भागम्

sanskrit_iast: yathābhūmipramāṇena vā
meaning: यथाभूमिप्रमाणेन वा

sanskrit_iast: hastyaśvaṃ narayānaṃ divyam ābharaṇam ātapatraṃ hiraṇyaṃ kṣitigodhanadhānyaratnādikaṃ ca gurave dadyād
meaning: हस्त्यश्वं नरयानं दिव्यम् आभरणम् आतपत्रं हिरण्यं क्षितिगोधनधान्यरत्नादिकं च गुरवे दद्याद्

sanskrit_iast: yena vā parituṣyeta ||
meaning: येन वा परितुष्येत ॥

sanskrit_iast: abhiṣekaḥ saṃhitāvidhau vyākhyātaḥ ||
meaning: अभिषेकः संहिताविधौ व्याख्यातः ॥

sanskrit_iast: hastyaśvaṃ gurave dadyān narayānaṃ tathaiva ca | divyam ābharaṇaṃ caiva ātapatrādim eva ca ||
meaning: हस्त्यश्वं गुरवे दद्यान् नरयानं तथैव च । दिव्यम् आभरणं चैव आतपत्रादिम् एव च ॥

sanskrit_iast: ucchiṣṭārthaṃ na gṛhṇīyān maṅgalārthaṃ mahīpatiḥ | mantrauṣadhyo na sidhyanti rājā tatra vinaśyati ||
meaning: उच्छिष्टार्थं न गृह्णीयान् मङ्गलार्थं महीपतिः । मन्त्रौषध्यो न सिध्यन्ति राजा तत्र विनश्यति ॥

sanskrit_iast: nātidīrghaṃ nātihrasvaṃ nātisthūlaṃ kṛśaṃ tathā | na ca hīnātiriktāṅgaṃ kva cit kuryāt purohitam ||
meaning: नातिदीर्घं नातिह्रस्वं नातिस्थूलं कृशं तथा । न च हीनातिरिक्ताङ्गं क्व चित् कुर्यात् पुरोहितम् ॥

sanskrit_iast: hīnādhikāṅgaṃ patitaṃ vivarṇaṃ stenaṃ jaḍaṃ klībam aśaktiyuktam | bhinnasvaraṃ kāṇaṃ virūpanetraṃ dveṣyaṃ ca rājā guruṃ naiva kuryāt ||
meaning: हीनाधिकाङ्गं पतितं विवर्णं स्तेनं जडं क्लीबम् अशक्तियुक्तम् । भिन्नस्वरं काणं विरूपनेत्रं द्वेष्यं च राजा गुरुं नैव कुर्यात् ॥

sanskrit_iast: hīnādhikāṅge purarāṣṭrahāniḥ kāṇe jaḍe vāhanakośanāśaḥ | stene tv aśakte ca samastadoṣāḥ klībe vivarṇe nṛpatir vinaśyet ||
meaning: हीनाधिकाङ्गे पुरराष्ट्रहानिः काणे जडे वाहनकोशनाशः । स्तेने त्व् अशक्ते च समस्तदोषाः क्लीबे विवर्णे नृपतिर् विनश्येत् ॥

sanskrit_iast: bhinnasvare jāyate gātrabhedo dveṣye gurau vipratipattim āhuḥ | vivarṇanetre patite tu putrān adhvaryuṇā ca nihanti pautrān ||
meaning: भिन्नस्वरे जायते गात्रभेदो द्वेष्ये गुरौ विप्रतिपत्तिम् आहुः । विवर्णनेत्रे पतिते तु पुत्रान् अध्वर्युणा च निहन्ति पौत्रान् ॥

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇe kośakṣayaṃ vidyād rakte vāhanasaṃkṣayaḥ | piṅgalaḥ pārthivaṃ hanyād rāṣṭraṃ hanyāt tu kekaraḥ ||
meaning: कृष्णे कोशक्षयं विद्याद् रक्ते वाहनसंक्षयः । पिङ्गलः पार्थिवं हन्याद् राष्ट्रं हन्यात् तु केकरः ॥

sanskrit_iast: bahvṛcaṃ hi niyuñjyād yaḥ paurohitye tu pārthivaḥ | sa tārapaṅke hastīva saha tenaiva majjati ||
meaning: बह्वृचं हि नियुञ्ज्याद् यः पौरोहित्ये तु पार्थिवः । स तारपङ्के हस्तीव सह तेनैव मज्जति ॥

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryuṃ hi niyuñjyād yaḥ paurohitye tu pārthivaḥ | uttitīrṣur ivāśmānam ādatte svavadhāya saḥ ||
meaning: अध्वर्युं हि नियुञ्ज्याद् यः पौरोहित्ये तु पार्थिवः । उत्तितीर्षुर् इवाश्मानम् आदत्ते स्ववधाय सः ॥

sanskrit_iast: vadhabandhaparikleśaṃ kośavāhanasaṃkṣayaḥ | karoty etānvaye 'vasthās tapoyukto 'pi sāmagaḥ ||
meaning: वधबन्धपरिक्लेशं कोशवाहनसंक्षयः । करोत्य् एतान्वये ऽवस्थास् तपोयुक्तो ऽपि सामगः ॥

sanskrit_iast: anvayākṛtisaṃpannaṃ tasmād bhṛgvaṅgirovidam | gotrāṅgirasavāsiṣṭhaṃ rājā kuryāt purohitam ||
meaning: अन्वयाकृतिसंपन्नं तस्माद् भृग्वङ्गिरोविदम् । गोत्राङ्गिरसवासिष्ठं राजा कुर्यात् पुरोहितम् ॥

sanskrit_iast: makheṣu rāṣṭreṣu pureṣu caiva senāsu rājñāṃ svaniveśaneṣu | ya utpātās trividhā ghorarūpās tān sarvān śamayed brahmavedavit ||
meaning: मखेषु राष्ट्रेषु पुरेषु चैव सेनासु राज्ञां स्वनिवेशनेषु । य उत्पातास् त्रिविधा घोररूपास् तान् सर्वान् शमयेद् ब्रह्मवेदवित् ॥

sanskrit_iast: tasmād guruṃ vedarahasyayuktaṃ caturvidhe karmaṇi cāpramattam | śāntaṃ ca dāntaṃ ca jitendriyaṃ ca kuryān narendraḥ priyadarśanaṃ ca || priyadarśanaṃ ceti || iti rājaprathamābhiṣekaḥ samāptaḥ ||
meaning: तस्माद् गुरुं वेदरहस्ययुक्तं चतुर्विधे कर्मणि चाप्रमत्तम् । शान्तं च दान्तं च जितेन्द्रियं च कुर्यान् नरेन्द्रः प्रियदर्शनं च ॥ प्रियदर्शनं चेति ॥ इति राजप्रथमाभिषेकः समाप्तः ॥
text_mt:
(Pariśiṣṭa 3. The King's First Consecration)

Thus ends the king's first consecration.

sanskrit_iast: om atha purohitakarmāṇi || rājñaḥ prātar utthitasya kṛtasvastyayanasya
meaning: ओम् अथ पुरोहितकर्माणि ॥ राज्ञः प्रातर् उत्थितस्य कृतस्वस्त्ययनस्य
text_mt: Om. Now, the duties of the royal domestic priest. For the king who has risen in the morning and performed his auspicious recitations,

sanskrit_iast: atha purohitaḥ snātānuliptaḥ śuciḥ śuklavāsāḥ soṣṇīṣaḥ savitā prasavānām iti vyākhyātam ||
meaning: अथ पुरोहितः स्नातानुलिप्तः शुचिः शुक्लवासाः सोष्णीषः सविता प्रसवानाम् इति व्याख्यातम् ॥
text_mt: now the royal domestic priest, having bathed, anointed himself, pure, wearing white garments and a turban—[the recitation beginning] "Savitṛ of impulses" has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: imam indra vardhayety uktam ||
meaning: इमम् इन्द्र वर्धयेत्य् उक्तम् ॥
text_mt: "Magnify this Indra" has been stated.

sanskrit_iast: pari dhatteti dvābhyāṃ rājño vastram abhimantrya prayacchet ||
meaning: परि धत्तेति द्वाभ्यां राज्ञो वस्त्रम् अभिमन्त्र्य प्रयच्छेत् ॥
text_mt: Consecrating the king's garment with the two verses beginning "Put on...", he should hand it to him.

sanskrit_iast: yad ābadhnann ity alaṃkārān ||
meaning: यद् आबध्नन्न् इत्य् अलंकारान् ॥
text_mt: The ornaments with "That which they bound..."

sanskrit_iast: siṃhe vyāghra iti siṃhāsanam ||
meaning: सिंहे व्याघ्र इति सिंहासनम् ॥
text_mt: The throne with "In the lion, in the tiger..."

sanskrit_iast: yas te gandha iti gandhān ||
meaning: यस् ते गन्ध इति गन्धान् ॥
text_mt: The perfumes with "The scent of yours which..."

sanskrit_iast: ehi jīvaṃ trāyamāṇam ity akṣiṇī aṅkte ||
meaning: एहि जीवं त्रायमाणम् इत्य् अक्षिणी अङ्क्ते ॥
text_mt: He anoints the two eyes with "Come, the living, the protecting..."

sanskrit_iast: vātaraṃhā ity aśvam ||
meaning: वातरंहा इत्य् अश्वम् ॥

sanskrit_iast: hastivarcasam iti hastinam ||
meaning: हस्तिवर्चसम् इति हस्तिनम् ॥
text_mt: The elephant with "Elephant luster..."

sanskrit_iast: yat te mātā yat te piteti narayānam ||
meaning: यत् ते माता यत् ते पितेति नरयानम् ॥
text_mt: The palanquin with "What your mother, what your father..."

sanskrit_iast: khaḍgaṃ cābhimantrayāmīti khaḍgam ||
meaning: खड्गं चाभिमन्त्रयामीति खड्गम् ॥
text_mt: The sword with "And I consecrate the sword..."

sanskrit_iast: khaḍgaṃ cābhimantrayāmi yaḥ śatrūn mardayiṣyati | marditāḥ śatravo 'nena vaśam āyāntu te sadeti ||
meaning: खड्गं चाभिमन्त्रयामि यः शत्रून् मर्दयिष्यति । मर्दिताः शत्रवो ऽनेन वशम् आयान्तु ते सदेति ॥
text_mt: "And I consecrate the sword which will crush the enemies; / crushed by this, may enemies always come under your control."

sanskrit_iast: paryaṅkam āsanaṃ khaḍgaṃ dhvajaṃ chattraṃ sacāmaram | ratham aśvagajaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dhanur varma śareṣudhim ||
meaning: पर्यङ्कम् आसनं खड्गं ध्वजं छत्त्रं सचामरम् । रथम् अश्वगजं श्रेष्ठं धनुर् वर्म शरेषुधिम् ॥
text_mt: The couch, seat, sword, banner, umbrella with chowrie, / chariot, excellent horse and elephant, bow, armor, arrows, and quiver,

sanskrit_iast: āñjanaṃ gandhamālyāni vastrāṇy ābharaṇāni ca | sarvān śāntyudakenaitān abhyukṣyec cābhimantrayet ||
meaning: आञ्जनं गन्धमाल्यानि वस्त्राण्य् आभरणानि च । सर्वान् शान्त्युदकेनैतान् अभ्युक्ष्येच् चाभिमन्त्रयेत् ॥
text_mt: eye-salve, perfumes, garlands, garments, and ornaments— / having sprinkled all these with the pacifying water, he should consecrate them.

sanskrit_iast: dūrvādīn mūrdhni nikṣipya svastyayanair abhimantrayet | abhayaṃ dyāvāpṛthivīty abhimantrito brāhmaṇān praṇipatya prāk ||
meaning: दूर्वादीन् मूर्ध्नि निक्षिप्य स्वस्त्ययनैर् अभिमन्त्रयेत् । अभयं द्यावापृथिवीत्य् अभिमन्त्रितो ब्राह्मणान् प्रणिपत्य प्राक् ॥
text_mt: Having placed dūrvā grass and other things on his head, he should consecrate him with auspicious recitations. Consecrated with "Freedom from danger, O Heaven and Earth...", having first bowed down to the brahmins,

sanskrit_iast: yuṣmatprasādāc chāntim adhigacchāmīti ||
meaning: युष्मत्प्रसादाच् छान्तिम् अधिगच्छामीति ॥
text_mt: [the king says:] "By your favor, I obtain peace."

sanskrit_iast: tathāstv ity ukto nirgacched iti ||
meaning: तथास्त्व् इत्य् उक्तो निर्गच्छेद् इति ॥
text_mt: Addressed with "So be it!", he should go forth.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃkṛtyasvastyayano yad evāvalokayati ta sidhyati ||
meaning: एवंकृत्यस्वस्त्ययनो यद् एवावलोकयति त सिध्यति ॥
text_mt: Having thus performed the auspicious recitation, whatever he looks upon succeeds.

sanskrit_iast: tad api ślokāḥ ||
meaning: तद् अपि श्लोकाः ॥

sanskrit_iast: asuraiḥ pīḍyamānas tu purā śakro jagatprabhuḥ | kārayām āsa vidhivat purodhastve bṛhaspatim ||
meaning: असुरैः पीड्यमानस् तु पुरा शक्रो जगत्प्रभुः । कारयाम् आस विधिवत् पुरोधस्त्वे बृहस्पतिम् ॥
text_mt: Afflicted by the Asuras in ancient times, Śakra, the lord of the world, / had Bṛhaspati installed according to rule in the office of royal domestic priest.

sanskrit_iast: sa vṛto bhayabhītena śamanārthaṃ bubhūṣatā | maṅgalāni sasarjāṣṭāv abhayārthaṃ śatakratoḥ ||
meaning: स वृतो भयभीतेन शमनार्थं बुभूषता । मङ्गलानि ससर्जाष्टाव् अभयार्थं शतक्रतोः ॥
text_mt: Chosen by him who was terrified by fear and desired pacification, / he emitted eight auspicious things for the safety of Śatakratu.

sanskrit_iast: proktāni maṅgalāny aṣṭau brāhmaṇo gaur hutāśanaḥ | bhūmiḥ siddhārthakāḥ sarpiḥ śamī vrīhiyavau tathā ||
meaning: प्रोक्तानि मङ्गलान्य् अष्टौ ब्राह्मणो गौर् हुताशनः । भूमिः सिद्धार्थकाः सर्पिः शमी व्रीहियवौ तथा ॥
text_mt: The eight auspicious things are declared: a brahmin, a cow, fire, / earth, white mustard seeds, clarified butter, the śamī tree, and rice and barley.

sanskrit_iast: etāni satataṃ puṇyāni saṃpaśyann arcayann api | na prāpnoty āpadaṃ rājā śriyaṃ prāpnoty anuttamām ||
meaning: एतानि सततं पुण्यानि संपश्यन्न् अर्चयन्न् अपि । न प्राप्नोत्य् आपदं राजा श्रियं प्राप्नोत्य् अनुत्तमाम् ॥
text_mt: Always looking upon and venerating these holy things, / the king does not meet with misfortune and attains unsurpassed prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: atha rājakarmāṇi
meaning: अथ राजकर्माणि

sanskrit_iast: viśvāvasau muhūrte snāto abhiṣekamantrair abhimantritaḥ ||
meaning: विश्वावसौ मुहूर्ते स्नातो अभिषेकमन्त्रैर् अभिमन्त्रितः ॥
text_mt: Bathed at the Viśvāvasu muhūrta, consecrated with consecration mantras,

sanskrit_iast: anulepanair anuliptaḥ ||
meaning: अनुलेपनैर् अनुलिप्तः ॥
text_mt: anointed with ointments,

sanskrit_iast: pūrvoktena vidhinā vastrālaṃkārādibhiḥ
meaning: पूर्वोक्तेन विधिना वस्त्रालंकारादिभिः
text_mt: with garments, ornaments, and the like according to the previously stated rule,

sanskrit_iast: suvarṇaniṣkaṃ kṛṣṇalaṃ vā vāmahastena saṃgṛhya ||
meaning: सुवर्णनिष्कं कृष्णलं वा वामहस्तेन संगृह्य ॥
text_mt: taking a golden niṣka or a kṛṣṇala with his left hand,

sanskrit_iast: yad duḥkṛtaṃ yac chabalaṃ sarvaṃ pāpmānaṃ dahatv ity
meaning: यद् दुःकृतं यच् छबलं सर्वं पाप्मानं दहत्व् इत्य्
text_mt: saying: 'Whatever evil deed, whatever blemish [there is], let it burn away all evil,'

sanskrit_iast: anena mantreṇa suvarṇaṃ śarīre nighṛṣya dakṣiṇena hastena viprāya dadyād
meaning: अनेन मन्त्रेण सुवर्णं शरीरे निघृष्य दक्षिणेन हस्तेन विप्राय दद्याद्
text_mt: rubbing the gold on his body with this mantra, he should give it to a brāhmaṇa with his right hand,

sanskrit_iast: dhenuṃ cārogām
meaning: धेनुं चारोगाम्

sanskrit_iast: aparimitaguṇān tilān sauvarṇamaye tāmramaye vā pātre sthāpayitvā yad ajñānād ity abhimantrya viprāya dadyāt ||
meaning: अपरिमितगुणान् तिलान् सौवर्णमये ताम्रमये वा पात्रे स्थापयित्वा यद् अज्ञानाद् इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य विप्राय दद्यात् ॥
text_mt: Having placed an immeasurable quantity of sesame seeds in a vessel made of gold or copper, and having consecrated it with: 'Whatever out of ignorance...', he should give it to a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: yad ajñānāt tathā jñānād yan mayā śabalaṃ kṛtam | tat sarvaṃ tiladānena dahyatām iti hi prabho ||
meaning: यद् अज्ञानात् तथा ज्ञानाद् यन् मया शबलं कृतम् । तत् सर्वं तिलदानेन दह्यताम् इति हि प्रभो ॥
text_mt: 'Whatever blemish was committed by me out of ignorance or out of knowledge, / let all that be burnt by the gift of sesame, O Lord!'

sanskrit_iast: bhūmiś ca sasyasaṃpannā brāhmaṇe vedapārage | yathāśakti pradeyā hi bṛhaspativaco yathā ||
meaning: भूमिश् च सस्यसंपन्ना ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे । यथाशक्ति प्रदेया हि बृहस्पतिवचो यथा ॥
text_mt: And land endowed with crops should indeed be given to a brāhmaṇa who has crossed to the end of the Veda, / according to one's ability, in accordance with the word of Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: sa bhuktvā vividhān bhogān saptasāgaramekhalām | pṛthivīṃ prāpya modeta candravat pṛthivīpatiḥ ||
meaning: स भुक्त्वा विविधान् भोगान् सप्तसागरमेखलाम् । पृथिवीं प्राप्य मोदेत चन्द्रवत् पृथिवीपतिः ॥
text_mt: Having enjoyed various pleasures, having obtained the earth / encircled by the seven oceans, that lord of the earth would rejoice like the moon.

sanskrit_iast: annaṃ tu vividhaṃ nityaṃ pradadyāt dvijātaye | tūryaghoṣeṇa saṃyuktaḥ kṛtasvastyayanas tathā ||
meaning: अन्नं तु विविधं नित्यं प्रदद्यात् द्विजातये । तूर्यघोषेण संयुक्तः कृतस्वस्त्ययनस् तथा ॥
text_mt: He should constantly present diverse foods to the twice-born, / accompanied by the sound of musical instruments, and having auspicious blessings performed.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhadevāṃs tu saṃpūjya kāryaś cāpy utsavo gṛhe | chattrādīni ca yānāni pūjayed vidhivat svayam ||
meaning: गृहदेवांस् तु संपूज्य कार्यश् चाप्य् उत्सवो गृहे । छत्त्रादीनि च यानानि पूजयेद् विधिवत् स्वयम् ॥
text_mt: And having worshipped the household deities, a festival should be held in the home; / and he himself should properly worship the parasol, other royal insignia, and conveyances.

sanskrit_iast: puṣpaiś ca vividhaiḥ śubhraiḥ phalaiś cāpy arcayed budhaḥ tasmāt sarvāṇi satataṃ dānāni tu mahīpatiḥ | dattvā śraddhānvito viprair vṛto bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
meaning: पुष्पैश् च विविधैः शुभ्रैः फलैश् चाप्य् अर्चयेद् बुधः तस्मात् सर्वाणि सततं दानानि तु महीपतिः । दत्त्वा श्रद्धान्वितो विप्रैर् वृतो भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः ॥
text_mt: [And the wise man should worship with various radiant flowers and fruits;] / therefore, the king, having continually made all gifts with faith, / surrounded by brāhmaṇas, should eat with restrained speech.

sanskrit_iast: atha piṣṭamayīṃ rātriṃ caturbhir dīpakaiḥ saha | arcitāṃ gandhamālyena sthāpayet tasya cāgrataḥ ||
meaning: अथ पिष्टमयीं रात्रिं चतुर्भिर् दीपकैः सह । अर्चितां गन्धमाल्येन स्थापयेत् तस्य चाग्रतः ॥
text_mt: Then he should set up before him [an effigy of] Night made of flour, together with four lamps, / worshipped with fragrant unguents and garlands.

sanskrit_iast: namas kṛtvā tato rātrim arcayitvā yathāvidhi | dhūpena cānnapānena stotreṇa ca samarcayet ||
meaning: नमस् कृत्वा ततो रात्रिम् अर्चयित्वा यथाविधि । धूपेन चान्नपानेन स्तोत्रेण च समर्चयेत् ॥
text_mt: Then, having bowed to Night and worshipped her according to rule, / he should venerate her with incense, food, drink, and a hymn of praise:

sanskrit_iast: pāhi māṃ satataṃ devi sarāṣṭraṃ sasuhṛjjanam | uṣase naḥ prayacchasva śāntiṃ ca kṛṇu me sadā | ye tvāṃ prapadyante devi na teṣāṃ vidyate bhayam ||
meaning: पाहि मां सततं देवि सराष्ट्रं ससुहृज्जनम् । उषसे नः प्रयच्छस्व शान्तिं च कृणु मे सदा । ये त्वां प्रपद्यन्ते देवि न तेषां विद्यते भयम् ॥
text_mt: 'Protect me always, O goddess, together with my realm and friends; / deliver us to the dawn, and always make peace for me; / for those who take refuge in you, O goddess, no fear exists.

sanskrit_iast: rātriṃ prapadye jananīṃ sarvabhūtaniveśanīm | bhadrāṃ bhagavatīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ viśvasya jagato niśām ||
meaning: रात्रिं प्रपद्ये जननीं सर्वभूतनिवेशनीम् । भद्रां भगवतीं कृष्णां विश्वस्य जगतो निशाम् ॥
text_mt: I take refuge in Night, the mother, who causes all beings to rest, / the auspicious, the divine, the dark, the night of the entire world.

sanskrit_iast: saṃveśanīṃ saṃyamanīṃ grahanakṣatramālinīm | prapanno 'haṃ śivāṃ rātriṃ bhadre pāram aśīmahi ||
meaning: संवेशनीं संयमनीं ग्रहनक्षत्रमालिनीम् । प्रपन्नो ऽहं शिवां रात्रिं भद्रे पारम् अशीमहि ॥
text_mt: Her who brings to rest, who restrains, garlanded with planets and lunar mansions, / in the auspicious Night I have taken refuge; O auspicious one, may we reach the other shore!

sanskrit_iast: yāṃ sadā sarvabhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca | sāyaṃ prātar namasyanti sā māṃ rātry abhirakṣatv iti ||
meaning: यां सदा सर्वभूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च । सायं प्रातर् नमस्यन्ति सा मां रात्र्य् अभिरक्षत्व् इति ॥
text_mt: Whom all beings, both motionless and moving, / constantly revere evening and morning, let that Night protect me!'

sanskrit_iast: ā rātri pārthivam iṣirā yoṣā trāyamāna ity rātryāṇi ||
meaning: आ रात्रि पार्थिवम् इषिरा योषा त्रायमान इत्य् रात्र्याणि ॥
text_mt: The Night-hymns are: 'Into the earthly space, O Night...', 'The active maiden...', and 'The saving...'

sanskrit_iast: mamobhā mahyam āpa iti sūktābhyām anvālabhya japet ||
meaning: ममोभा मह्यम् आप इति सूक्ताभ्याम् अन्वालभ्य जपेत् ॥
text_mt: Touching [the king], he should murmur the two hymns: 'Both mine...' and 'The waters to me...'

sanskrit_iast: yo naḥ sva iti pañcabhiḥ sarṣapāñ juhuyāt ||
meaning: यो नः स्व इति पञ्चभिः सर्षपाञ् जुहुयात् ॥
text_mt: With the five [stanzas beginning with] 'He who is our own...', he should offer mustard seeds into the fire.

sanskrit_iast: yo 'smin yas tvā mātur iti dīpena nṛpasyopari triṣ parihṛtya praiṣakṛte prayacchet ||
meaning: यो ऽस्मिन् यस् त्वा मातुर् इति दीपेन नृपस्योपरि त्रिष् परिहृत्य प्रैषकृते प्रयच्छेत् ॥
text_mt: Having circled [the lamp] three times over the king with the lamp to the accompaniment of 'He who in this...' and 'He who... from the mother', he should hand it to the messenger.

sanskrit_iast: abhayam ity ṛcā catasraḥ śarkarāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ pratidiśaṃ kṣipet ||
meaning: अभयम् इत्य् ऋचा चतस्रः शर्कराः प्रदक्षिणं प्रतिदिशं क्षिपेत् ॥
text_mt: With the verse 'Fearlessness...', he should cast four pebbles clockwise in every direction.

sanskrit_iast: ehy aśmānam ā tiṣṭheti pañcamīm adhiṣṭhāpayet ||
meaning: एह्य् अश्मानम् आ तिष्ठेति पञ्चमीम् अधिष्ठापयेत् ॥
text_mt: With 'Come, step upon the stone...', he should make him stand on the fifth [stone].

sanskrit_iast: na taṃ yakṣmā aitu deva iti guggulukuṣṭhadūpaṃ dadyāt ||
meaning: न तं यक्ष्मा ऐतु देव इति गुग्गुलुकुष्ठदूपं दद्यात् ॥
text_mt: With 'Let not consumption approach him, O god...', he should offer incense of bdellium and costus.

sanskrit_iast: yas te gandhas tryāyuṣam iti bhūtiṃ prayacchet ||
meaning: यस् ते गन्धस् त्र्यायुषम् इति भूतिं प्रयच्छेत् ॥
text_mt: With 'Whatever fragrance is yours...' and 'A triple lifetime...', he should apply sacred ashes.

sanskrit_iast: dūṣyā dūṣir asīti pratisaram ābadhya
meaning: दूष्या दूषिर् असीति प्रतिसरम् आबध्य
text_mt: Having fastened an amulet with 'You are an undoer of hexes...',

sanskrit_iast: agnir mā pātu vasubhiḥ purastād iti śarkarān pradakṣiṇaṃ pratidiśaṃ kṣipet ||
meaning: अग्निर् मा पातु वसुभिः पुरस्ताद् इति शर्करान् प्रदक्षिणं प्रतिदिशं क्षिपेत् ॥
text_mt: he should cast pebbles clockwise in every direction with 'May Agni protect me from the east with the Vasus...'

sanskrit_iast: bahir niḥsṛtyottareṇa gatvā bāhyenopaniṣkramya suhṛde kuryāc chraddadhate kuryāt ||
meaning: बहिर् निःसृत्योत्तरेण गत्वा बाह्येनोपनिष्क्रम्य सुहृदे कुर्याच् छ्रद्दधते कुर्यात् ॥
text_mt: Going outside, having gone north, having stepped outside, he should perform it for a friend, he should perform it for one who has faith.

sanskrit_iast: naiśam abhayaṃ karma mausalīputraḥ paiṭhīnasiḥ ||
meaning: नैशम् अभयं कर्म मौसलीपुत्रः पैठीनसिः ॥
text_mt: The nightly rite of fearlessness [according to] Paiṭhīnasi, son of Mausalī.

sanskrit_iast: athāto rātrisūktānāṃ vidhim anukramiṣyāmaḥ ||
meaning: अथातो रात्रिसूक्तानां विधिम् अनुक्रमिष्यामः ॥
text_mt: Now next we shall explain the ritual procedure for the Night-hymns.

sanskrit_iast: śuciḥ śuklavāsāḥ purohitaḥ ||
meaning: शुचिः शुक्लवासाः पुरोहितः ॥
text_mt: The royal priest, pure and clad in white,

sanskrit_iast: pārthivasya paścimāṃ saṃdhyām upāsya darbhaiḥ pavitrapāṇī rājānam abhigamya
meaning: पार्थिवस्य पश्चिमां संध्याम् उपास्य दर्भैः पवित्रपाणी राजानम् अभिगम्य
text_mt: having performed the king's evening twilight devotion, holding sacred darbha-grass in his hands, having approached the king,

sanskrit_iast: piṣṭamayīṃ rātriṃ kṛtvā ||
meaning: पिष्टमयीं रात्रिं कृत्वा ॥
text_mt: having fashioned [an effigy of] Night made of flour,

sanskrit_iast: annapānadhūpadīpair arcayitvā mālyaiś ca ||
meaning: अन्नपानधूपदीपैर् अर्चयित्वा माल्यैश् च ॥
text_mt: having worshipped her with food, drink, incense, lamps, and garlands,

sanskrit_iast: prajvalitaiś caturbhir dīpakair arcayitvā ||
meaning: प्रज्वलितैश् चतुर्भिर् दीपकैर् अर्चयित्वा ॥
text_mt: having worshipped her with four burning lamps,

sanskrit_iast: ā rātri pārthivam iṣirā yoṣeti sūktadvayena rātrim upasthāya ||
meaning: आ रात्रि पार्थिवम् इषिरा योषेति सूक्तद्वयेन रात्रिम् उपस्थाय ॥
text_mt: having attended upon Night with the two hymns 'Into the earthly space, O Night...' and 'The active maiden...',

sanskrit_iast: trāyamāṇe viśvajite ahne ca tveti rājānaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ triḥ kṛtvā
meaning: त्रायमाणे विश्वजिते अह्ने च त्वेति राजानं प्रदक्षिणं त्रिः कृत्वा
text_mt: having circumambulated the king three times with 'O saving, all-conquering one' and 'To the day and you',

sanskrit_iast: rājaveśmani dvāre visarjayitvā ||
meaning: राजवेश्मनि द्वारे विसर्जयित्वा ॥
text_mt: having dismissed [the effigy] at the door of the royal palace,

sanskrit_iast: na taṃ yakṣmā aitu deva iti guggulukuṣṭhadhūpaṃ dadyād
meaning: न तं यक्ष्मा ऐतु देव इति गुग्गुलुकुष्ठधूपं दद्याद्
text_mt: he should offer incense of bdellium and costus with 'Let not consumption approach him, O god...'

sanskrit_iast: yas te gandha iti bhūtim abhimantrya
meaning: यस् ते गन्ध इति भूतिम् अभिमन्त्र्य
text_mt: Having consecrated sacred ashes with 'Whatever fragrance is yours...',

sanskrit_iast: tryāyuṣam iti rājñe rakṣāṃ kṛtvā ||
meaning: त्र्यायुषम् इति राज्ञे रक्षां कृत्वा ॥
text_mt: having made protection for the king with 'A triple lifetime...',

sanskrit_iast: asapatnam iti śarkarām abhimantryāṅguṣṭhāt pradakṣiṇaṃ pratidiśaṃ kṣipet ||
meaning: असपत्नम् इति शर्कराम् अभिमन्त्र्याङ्गुष्ठात् प्रदक्षिणं प्रतिदिशं क्षिपेत् ॥
text_mt: having consecrated a pebble with 'Rival-free...', he should throw it from his thumb clockwise in each direction.

sanskrit_iast: śāntā dyaur iti japitvā rājānaṃ vāsagṛhaṃ nayet ||
meaning: शान्ता द्यौर् इति जपित्वा राजानं वासगृहं नयेत् ॥
text_mt: Having murmured 'Peaceful is the sky...', he should lead the king to his bedchamber.

sanskrit_iast: bhūtinā rakṣāṃ kṛtvā niṣkramya
meaning: भूतिना रक्षां कृत्वा निष्क्रम्य
text_mt: Having made protection with sacred ashes, having stepped outside,

sanskrit_iast: evamevam aharahaḥ kuryāt ||
meaning: एवमेवम् अहरहः कुर्यात् ॥
text_mt: he should perform it thus day after day.

sanskrit_iast: yasya rājño janapade atharvā śāntipāragaḥ | nivasaty api tad rāṣṭraṃ vardhate nirupadravam ||
meaning: यस्य राज्ञो जनपदे अथर्वा शान्तिपारगः । निवसत्य् अपि तद् राष्ट्रं वर्धते निरुपद्रवम् ॥
text_mt: In whose realm an Atharvan priest who has mastered propitiatory rites resides, / that king's realm flourishes free of calamities.

sanskrit_iast: yasya rājño janapade sa nāsti vividhair bhayaiḥ | pīḍyate tasya tad rāṣṭraṃ paṅke gaur iva majjati ||
meaning: यस्य राज्ञो जनपदे स नास्ति विविधैर् भयैः । पीड्यते तस्य तद् राष्ट्रं पङ्के गौर् इव मज्जति ॥
text_mt: In whose realm such a priest does not exist, that king's realm / is afflicted by various fears and sinks like a cow in the mud.

sanskrit_iast: tasmād rājā viśeṣeṇa atharvāṇaṃ jitendriyam | dānasaṃmānasatkārair nityaṃ samabhipūjayet ||
meaning: तस्माद् राजा विशेषेण अथर्वाणं जितेन्द्रियम् । दानसंमानसत्कारैर् नित्यं समभिपूजयेत् ॥
text_mt: Therefore, a king should constantly and especially honor / a self-controlled Atharvan priest with gifts, honor, and hospitality.

sanskrit_iast: nityaṃ ca kārayec chāntiṃ grahaṛkṣāṇi pūjayet | bhūmidohān prakurvīta devatāyataneṣu ca ||
meaning: नित्यं च कारयेच् छान्तिं ग्रहऋक्षाणि पूजयेत् । भूमिदोहान् प्रकुर्वीत देवतायतनेषु च ॥
text_mt: And he should constantly have propitiatory rites performed, worship the planets and lunar mansions, / and carry out milking-rites of the earth in the temples of deities.

sanskrit_iast: catuspatheṣu goṣṭheṣu tīrtheṣv apsu ca kārayet | gotarpaṇaṃ ca vidhivat sarvadoṣavināśanam ||
meaning: चतुस्पथेषु गोष्ठेषु तीर्थेष्व् अप्सु च कारयेत् । गोतर्पणं च विधिवत् सर्वदोषविनाशनम् ॥
text_mt: At crossroads, in cowpens, at bathing places, and at waters, he should have performed / the proper water libation for cows, which destroys all defects.

sanskrit_iast: ya evaṃ kārayed rājā sarvakālaṃ jitendriyaḥ | anantaṃ sukham āpanoti kṛtsnāṃ bhuṅkte vasuṃdharām || iti purohitakarmāṇi samāptāni ||
meaning: य एवं कारयेद् राजा सर्वकालं जितेन्द्रियः । अनन्तं सुखम् आपनोति कृत्स्नां भुङ्क्ते वसुंधराम् ॥ इति पुरोहितकर्माणि समाप्तानि ॥
text_mt:
A king who, having mastered his senses, has this performed at all times, / attains endless happiness and enjoys the entire earth.

Thus the duties of the royal priest are completed.

sanskrit_iast: om atha puṣyābhiṣekasya vidhiṃ vakṣyāmi sāṃpadam | dharmārthakāmasaṃyuktaṃ rājā kuryāt purohitam ||
meaning: ओम् अथ पुष्याभिषेकस्य विधिं वक्ष्यामि सांपदम् । धर्मार्थकामसंयुक्तं राजा कुर्यात् पुरोहितम् ॥
text_mt: Om. Now I shall declare the rite of consecration under Puṣya, which brings success; / the king should appoint a royal priest endowed with dharma, material gain, and desire.

sanskrit_iast: sauvarṇarājatais tāmraiḥ kalaśaiḥ pārthivair api | sahasreṇa śatenātha toyagrahaṇam iṣyate ||
meaning: सौवर्णराजतैस् ताम्रैः कलशैः पार्थिवैर् अपि । सहस्रेण शतेनाथ तोयग्रहणम् इष्यते ॥
text_mt: The gathering of water is desired with golden, silver, copper, / and earthenware jars, either by a thousand or by a hundred,

sanskrit_iast: caturṇāṃ sāgarāṇāṃ tu nadīnāṃ ca śatasya tu | abhiṣekāya rājñas tu toyam āhṛtya yatnataḥ ||
meaning: चतुर्णां सागराणां तु नदीनां च शतस्य तु । अभिषेकाय राज्ञस् तु तोयम् आहृत्य यत्नतः ॥
text_mt: having diligently brought water from the four oceans / and from a hundred rivers for the consecration of the king,

sanskrit_iast: ekadvitricaturṇāṃ vā sāgarasya tu pañcamam | oṣadhīs teṣu sarveṣu kalaśeṣūpakalpayet ||
meaning: एकद्वित्रिचतुर्णां वा सागरस्य तु पञ्चमम् । ओषधीस् तेषु सर्वेषु कलशेषूपकल्पयेत् ॥
text_mt: or from one, two, three, or four [rivers], and fifth from an ocean; / he should place medicinal herbs in all those jars.

sanskrit_iast: sahā ca dahadevī ca balā cātibalā tathā | madayantī vacā śvetā vyāghradantī sumaṅgalā ||
meaning: सहा च दहदेवी च बला चातिबला तथा । मदयन्ती वचा श्वेता व्याघ्रदन्ती सुमङ्गला ॥
text_mt: and sahā, dahadevī, balā, and atibalā, / madayantī, vacā, śvetā, vyāghradantī, sumaṅgalā,

sanskrit_iast: śatāvarī jayantī ca śatapuṣpā sacandanā | priyaṅgū rocano aśīram amṛtā ca sasārikā ||
meaning: शतावरी जयन्ती च शतपुष्पा सचन्दना । प्रियङ्गू रोचनो अशीरम् अमृता च ससारिका ॥
text_mt: śatāvarī, jayantī, śatapuṣpā along with candana, / priyaṅgu, rocana, uśīra, and amṛtā along with sārikā,

sanskrit_iast: aśvatthaplakṣabilvānāṃ nyagrodhapanasasya ca | śirīṣāmrakapitthānāṃ pallavaiḥ samalaṃkṛtān ||
meaning: अश्वत्थप्लक्षबिल्वानां न्यग्रोधपनसस्य च । शिरीषाम्रकपित्थानां पल्लवैः समलंकृतान् ॥
text_mt: adorned with sprouts of aśvattha, plakṣa, bilva, / nyagrodha, panasa, / śirīṣa, āmra, and kapittha,

sanskrit_iast: hemaratnauṣadhībilvapuṣpagandhādhivāsitān | ācchāditān sitair vastrair abhimantrya purohitaḥ ||
meaning: हेमरत्नौषधीबिल्वपुष्पगन्धाधिवासितान् । आच्छादितान् सितैर् वस्त्रैर् अभिमन्त्र्य पुरोहितः ॥
text_mt: scented with gold, jewels, herbs, bilva, flowers, and perfumes, / covered with white cloths—the purohita, having consecrated them with mantras,

sanskrit_iast: sāvitry ubhayataḥ kuryāc chaṃ no devī tathaiva ca | hiraṇyavarṇāḥ sūktaṃ ca anuvākādyam eva ca ||
meaning: सावित्र्य् उभयतः कुर्याच् छं नो देवी तथैव च । हिरण्यवर्णाः सूक्तं च अनुवाकाद्यम् एव च ॥
text_mt: should perform [the rite] with the Sāvitrī on both sides, and likewise the [hymn] "śaṃ no devīḥ", / the hymn "hiraṇyavarṇāḥ", and the first anuvāka.

sanskrit_iast: dharaṇī pādapīṭhaṃ syād dūrvāmūlāṅkurān śubhān | tasyopari nyaset pīṭhaṃ haimaṃ raupyam athāpi vā ||
meaning: धरणी पादपीठं स्याद् दूर्वामूलाङ्कुरान् शुभान् । तस्योपरि न्यसेत् पीठं हैमं रौप्यम् अथापि वा ॥
text_mt: The footstool should be [placed on] the earth, with auspicious dūrvā grass roots and sprouts; / upon it he should place a stool made of gold or silver.

sanskrit_iast: anaḍudvyāghrasiṃhānāṃ mṛgasya ca yathākramam | catvāri carmāṇy etāni pūrvād ārabhya vinyaset ||
meaning: अनडुद्व्याघ्रसिंहानां मृगस्य च यथाक्रमम् । चत्वारि चर्माण्य् एतानि पूर्वाद् आरभ्य विन्यसेत् ॥
text_mt: Of an ox, a tiger, a lion, / and a deer, respectively: / he should lay out these four skins beginning from the east.

sanskrit_iast: cāturhotravidhānena juhuyāc ca purohitaḥ | caturdikṣu sthitair viprair vedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ ||
meaning: चातुर्होत्रविधानेन जुहुयाच् च पुरोहितः । चतुर्दिक्षु स्थितैर् विप्रैर् वेदवेदाङ्गपारगैः ॥
text_mt: And according to the rules of the fourfold priesthood, the purohita should offer oblations, / with Brahmins situated in the four directions who have mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.

sanskrit_iast: bilvāhāraḥ phalāhāraḥ payasā vāpi vartayet | saptarātraṃ ghṛtāśī va tato homaṃ prayojayet ||
meaning: बिल्वाहारः फलाहारः पयसा वापि वर्तयेत् । सप्तरात्रं घृताशी व ततो होमं प्रयोजयेत् ॥
text_mt: Subsisting on bilva, subsisting on fruits, or living on milk, / or eating ghee for seven nights, he should then perform the fire oblation.

sanskrit_iast: gavyena payasā kuryāt sauvarṇena sruveṇa tu | vedānām ādibhir mantrair mahāvyāhṛtipūrvakaiḥ ||
meaning: गव्येन पयसा कुर्यात् सौवर्णेन स्रुवेण तु । वेदानाम् आदिभिर् मन्त्रैर् महाव्याहृतिपूर्वकैः ॥
text_mt: He should perform it with cow's milk using a golden ladle, / with the beginning mantras of the Vedas preceded by the great utterances.

sanskrit_iast: śarmavarmā gaṇaś caiva tathā syād aparājitaḥ | āyuṣyaś cābhayaś caiva tathā svastyayano gaṇaḥ ||
meaning: शर्मवर्मा गणश् चैव तथा स्याद् अपराजितः । आयुष्यश् चाभयश् चैव तथा स्वस्त्ययनो गणः ॥
text_mt: The Śarmavarman hymn cycle, and likewise the Aparājita, / the Āyuṣya, the Abhaya, and likewise the Svastyayana hymn cycle—

sanskrit_iast: etān pañca gaṇān hutvā vācayeta dvijottamān | hiraṇyenākṣatārgheṇa phalaiś ca madhusarpiṣā ||
meaning: एतान् पञ्च गणान् हुत्वा वाचयेत द्विजोत्तमान् । हिरण्येनाक्षतार्घेण फलैश् च मधुसर्पिषा ॥
text_mt: having offered oblations with these five hymn cycles, he should have the best of the twice-born recite blessings, / with gold, unhusked barley water-reception gifts, fruits, and honey and ghee.

sanskrit_iast: puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvāsya ārambhaṃ kārayed budhaḥ | tiṣyanakṣatrasaṃyukte mahūrte karaṇe śubhe ||
meaning: पुण्याहं वाचयित्वास्य आरम्भं कारयेद् बुधः । तिष्यनक्षत्रसंयुक्ते महूर्ते करणे शुभे ॥
text_mt: Having had them recite the 'auspicious day' blessing, the wise [priest] should have him begin the rite / at a moment conjoined with the lunar mansion Puṣya, during an auspicious karaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: uccairghoṣa iti tūryāṇy abhimantrya purohitaḥ | sarvatūryaninādena abhiṣikto hy alaṃkṛtaḥ ||
meaning: उच्चैर्घोष इति तूर्याण्य् अभिमन्त्र्य पुरोहितः । सर्वतूर्यनिनादेन अभिषिक्तो ह्य् अलंकृतः ॥
text_mt: The purohita, having consecrated the musical instruments with the hymn "uccairghoṣa", / consecrated and adorned, to the sound of all musical instruments,

sanskrit_iast: siṃhāsanaṃ samāruhya pīṭhikāṃ vā yathākramam | cāmarachattrasaṃyuktaṃ pratihāravibhūṣitam ||
meaning: सिंहासनं समारुह्य पीठिकां वा यथाक्रमम् । चामरछत्त्रसंयुक्तं प्रतिहारविभूषितम् ॥
text_mt: having mounted the lion-throne or stool in due order, / furnished with chowrie and parasol, graced by the chamberlain—

sanskrit_iast: mattadvipacatuṣkaṃ ca caturdikṣu prakalpayet | upaviṣṭas tato rājā prajānāṃ kārayed dhitam | akarā brāhmaṇā gāvaḥ strībālajaḍarogiṇaḥ ||
meaning: मत्तद्विपचतुष्कं च चतुर्दिक्षु प्रकल्पयेत् । उपविष्टस् ततो राजा प्रजानां कारयेद् धितम् । अकरा ब्राह्मणा गावः स्त्रीबालजडरोगिणः ॥
text_mt: and he should place four rutting elephants in the four directions. / The king, seated then, should work for the welfare of his subjects: / tax-free Brahmins, cows, women, children, the simple, and the sick.

sanskrit_iast: tatas tu darśanaṃ deyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ nṛpeṇa tu | śreṇīprakṛtimukhyānāṃ strījanaṃ ca namaskaret ||
meaning: ततस् तु दर्शनं देयं ब्राह्मणानां नृपेण तु । श्रेणीप्रकृतिमुख्यानां स्त्रीजनं च नमस्करेत् ॥
text_mt: Then audience must be granted by the king to the Brahmins, / and to the chiefs of the guilds and subjects; and he should bow to the women.

sanskrit_iast: āśiṣas te hi dāsyanti tuṣṭā janapadā bhuvi | evaṃ prajānurajyeta pṛthivī ca vaśā bhavet ||
meaning: आशिषस् ते हि दास्यन्ति तुष्टा जनपदा भुवि । एवं प्रजानुरज्येत पृथिवी च वशा भवेत् ॥
text_mt: For they, the pleased subjects in the realm, will grant blessings. / In this way the subjects will be pleased, and the earth will come under his control.

sanskrit_iast: purohitaṃ mantriṇaṃ ca senādhyakṣaṃ tathaiva ca | aśvādhyakṣaṃ gajādhyakṣaṃ koṣṭhāgārapatiṃ tathā ||
meaning: पुरोहितं मन्त्रिणं च सेनाध्यक्षं तथैव च । अश्वाध्यक्षं गजाध्यक्षं कोष्ठागारपतिं तथा ॥
text_mt: The purohita, the minister, and likewise the commander of the army, / the master of the horse, the master of the elephants, and the master of the storehouse,

sanskrit_iast: bhāṇḍāgārapatiṃ vaidyaṃ daivajñaṃ ca yathākramam | yathārheṇa ca yogena sarvān saṃpūjayen nṛpaḥ ||
meaning: भाण्डागारपतिं वैद्यं दैवज्ञं च यथाक्रमम् । यथार्हेण च योगेन सर्वान् संपूजयेन् नृपः ॥
text_mt: the master of the treasury, the physician, and the astrologer in due order: / the king should honor all of them according to their worth with fitting gifts.

sanskrit_iast: rājyaṃ purohite nyasya śeṣāṇāṃ ca yathākramam | sthānāntarāṇi cānyāni dattvā sukham avāpnuyāt ||
meaning: राज्यं पुरोहिते न्यस्य शेषाणां च यथाक्रमम् । स्थानान्तराणि चान्यानि दत्त्वा सुखम् अवाप्नुयात् ॥
text_mt: Having entrusted the kingdom to the purohita and assigned the other offices / to the rest in due order, he will obtain happiness.

sanskrit_iast: dūrvāsiddhārthakān sarpiḥ śamīr vrīhiyavau tathā śuklāni caiva puṣpāṇi mūrdhni dadyāt purohitaḥ ||
meaning: दूर्वासिद्धार्थकान् सर्पिः शमीर् व्रीहियवौ तथा शुक्लानि चैव पुष्पाणि मूर्ध्नि दद्यात् पुरोहितः ॥
text_mt: The purohita should place dūrvā grass, white mustard seeds, ghee, / śamī leaves, rice and barley, and white flowers upon [the king's] head.

sanskrit_iast: atharvavihito hy eṣa vidhiḥ puṣyābhiṣecane | rājā snāto mahīṃ bhuṅkte śakralokaṃ sa gacchati || iti puṣyābhiṣekaḥ ||
meaning: अथर्वविहितो ह्य् एष विधिः पुष्याभिषेचने । राजा स्नातो महीं भुङ्क्ते शक्रलोकं स गच्छति ॥ इति पुष्याभिषेकः ॥
text_mt: For this is the rule prescribed in the Atharvan regarding the consecration during Puṣya; / the king, bathed, enjoys the earth and goes to the realm of Śakra.

sanskrit_iast: om athātaḥ piṣṭarātryāḥ kalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||
meaning: ओम् अथातः पिष्टरात्र्याः कल्पं व्याख्यास्यामः ॥
text_mt: Om. Now then we will explain the ordinance of Piṣṭarātrī.

sanskrit_iast: ahatavāsāḥ purastāt talpasya gomayena sthaṇḍilam upalipya
meaning: अहतवासाः पुरस्तात् तल्पस्य गोमयेन स्थण्डिलम् उपलिप्य
text_mt: Wearing unwashed clothes, having smeared a mound with cow dung in front of the bed,

sanskrit_iast: ahatavastreṇa siṃhāsanam avachādya ||
meaning: अहतवस्त्रेण सिंहासनम् अवछाद्य ॥
text_mt: [and] having covered the lion-throne with an unwashed cloth,

sanskrit_iast: yāṃ devāḥ prati nandantīti rātrim āvāhayet ||
meaning: यां देवाः प्रति नन्दन्तीति रात्रिम् आवाहयेत् ॥
