text_mt: Having set down a bamboo hoop, he should lay it down.

sanskrit_iast: dvaipavaiyāghrānaḍuccarma paristīrya ||
meaning: द्वैपवैयाघ्रानडुच्चर्म परिस्तीर्य ॥
text_mt: Having spread out the skin of a leopard, a tiger, or an ox;

sanskrit_iast: tato yā syād adhidevatā tasyai baliṃ dattvā piṇḍāni ca dadyāt ||
meaning: ततो या स्याद् अधिदेवता तस्यै बलिं दत्त्वा पिण्डानि च दद्यात् ॥
text_mt: then, having given an oblation to whichever tutelary deity it may be, he should also present balls of rice.

sanskrit_iast: hastinam ācāmayet ||
meaning: हस्तिनम् आचामयेत् ॥

sanskrit_iast: yasyāṃ diśi sa ripur bhavati tāṃ diśaṃ gatvā hastinam ānayed dhiraṇyena rajatena vajramaṇimuktādibhiḥ śaṅkhena candanena bhadradāruṇayā kuṣṭhena naladena rocanenāñjanena manahśilayā padmakumudotpalair ||
meaning: यस्यां दिशि स रिपुर् भवति तां दिशं गत्वा हस्तिनम् आनयेद् धिरण्येन रजतेन वज्रमणिमुक्तादिभिः शङ्खेन चन्दनेन भद्रदारुणया कुष्ठेन नलदेन रोचनेनाञ्जनेन मनह्शिलया पद्मकुमुदोत्पलैर् ॥
text_mt: Having gone in whichever direction that enemy is, he should lead the elephant [forward] with gold, silver, diamond, pearls, and the like, with conch shell, sandalwood, cedar, costus, spikenard, yellow orpiment, collyrium, realgar, and with red and blue water-lilies.

sanskrit_iast: mamāgne varca iti sūktaṃ dakṣinottaramakhaṃ pratijapet ||
meaning: ममाग्ने वर्च इति सूक्तं दक्षिनोत्तरमखं प्रतिजपेत् ॥
text_mt: He should softly recite the hymn, "My splendor, O Agni," facing south-north towards the rite.

sanskrit_iast: śeṣeṇa gātrāṇy abhyañjayet ||
meaning: शेषेण गात्राण्य् अभ्यञ्जयेत् ॥
text_mt: With the remainder, he should anoint its limbs.

sanskrit_iast: tatra slokāḥ ||
meaning: तत्र स्लोकाः ॥

sanskrit_iast: hastināṃ rakṣaṇe daṇḍaḥ kartavyo vaiṇavo navaḥ | ṣoḍaśāratnimātras tu cāruparvamanaoramaḥ ||
meaning: हस्तिनां रक्षणे दण्डः कर्तव्यो वैणवो नवः । षोडशारत्निमात्रस् तु चारुपर्वमनओरमः ॥
text_mt: "For protecting the elephants, a new bamboo staff should be made; it should measure sixteen cubits, pleasing and with lovely joints.

sanskrit_iast: tena vāraṇān vārayet ||
meaning: तेन वारणान् वारयेत् ॥

sanskrit_iast: dantāgreṣu tṛṇāni kṛtvā yathā havyaṃ vahasi grasati ||
meaning: दन्ताग्रेषु तृणानि कृत्वा यथा हव्यं वहसि ग्रसति ॥
text_mt: Having placed grasses at the tips of the tusks, with the verse, "As you carry the oblation," [the elephant] chews [them].

sanskrit_iast: sujātaṃ jātavedasam ity agniṃ prajvālayet ||
meaning: सुजातं जातवेदसम् इत्य् अग्निं प्रज्वालयेत् ॥
text_mt: With the verse, "The well-born Jātavedas," he should kindle the fire.

sanskrit_iast: sujātaṃ jātavedasam iti vācayed yathā havyam iti nīrājayitvā ||
meaning: सुजातं जातवेदसम् इति वाचयेद् यथा हव्यम् इति नीराजयित्वा ॥
text_mt: He should cause [the priest] to recite "The well-born Jātavedas"; having waved lights with "As you [carry] the oblation,"

sanskrit_iast: nidhiṃ bibhratīti śālāṃ praveśayed ||
meaning: निधिं बिभ्रतीति शालां प्रवेशयेद् ॥
text_mt: he should make [the elephant] enter the stable with "Bearing a treasure."

sanskrit_iast: anapekṣamānāḥ svāni sthānāni vrajanti dīrghāyuṣo balavantaś ca bhavanti ||
meaning: अनपेक्षमानाः स्वानि स्थानानि व्रजन्ति दीर्घायुषो बलवन्तश् च भवन्ति ॥
text_mt: Without looking back, they go to their stalls; they become long-lived and strong.

sanskrit_iast: gosahasraṃ kartre dakṣiṇā grāmavaraṃ ca ||
meaning: गोसहस्रं कर्त्रे दक्षिणा ग्रामवरं च ॥
text_mt: A thousand cows and an excellent village are the sacrificial fee for the officiant.

sanskrit_iast: atha rājñam indramahotsavasya upacārakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||
meaning: अथ राज्ञम् इन्द्रमहोत्सवस्य उपचारकल्पं व्याख्यास्यामः ॥

sanskrit_iast: prauṣṭhapade śuklapakṣe ||
meaning: प्रौष्ठपदे शुक्लपक्षे ॥

sanskrit_iast: saṃbhṛteṣu saṃbhāreṣu brahmā rājā ca ubhau snātau ahatavasanau surabhisujātānulepanau karmaṇyau vratavantau upavasataḥ
meaning: संभृतेषु संभारेषु ब्रह्मा राजा च उभौ स्नातौ अहतवसनौ सुरभिसुजातानुलेपनौ कर्मण्यौ व्रतवन्तौ उपवसतः

sanskrit_iast: vratavantau śvo bhūte śamnodevyāḥ pādair ardharcābhyām ṛcā ṣakṛtvodakaṃ pari vācam ācānto
meaning: व्रतवन्तौ श्वो भूते शम्नोदेव्याः पादैर् अर्धर्चाभ्याम् ऋचा षकृत्वोदकं परि वाचम् आचान्तो
text_mt: 1.4. Having offered into the fire on the third [lunar day] with the hymn, "Great is Indra who by his might," with "To Indra, svāhā!" and so forth, and having worshipped the world guardians, touching the king, he should offer oblations as at the beginning, with: "Hitherward Indra," "Indra the good protector," "Increase this kṣatriya of mine, O Indra," and "Living for a hundred autumns."

sanskrit_iast: barhir upakalpayitvā rājānam anvālabhya juhuyāt ||
meaning: बर्हिर् उपकल्पयित्वा राजानम् अन्वालभ्य जुहुयात् ॥

sanskrit_iast: arvāñcam indraṃ trātāram indram indraḥ sutrāmā imam indra vardhaya kṣatriyaṃ me hantāya vṛṣa indrasya indro jayāti iti ca hutvā rāṣṭrasaṃvargaiś cā
meaning: अर्वाञ्चम् इन्द्रं त्रातारम् इन्द्रम् इन्द्रः सुत्रामा इमम् इन्द्र वर्धय क्षत्रियं मे हन्ताय वृष इन्द्रस्य इन्द्रो जयाति इति च हुत्वा राष्ट्रसंवर्गैश् चा

sanskrit_iast: atha indram utthāpayanti ā tvā ahārṣam antar dhruvādyaur viśas tvā sarvā vāñchantu iti sarvato 'pramattā dhārayerann
meaning: अथ इन्द्रम् उत्थापयन्ति आ त्वा अहार्षम् अन्तर् ध्रुवाद्यौर् विशस् त्वा सर्वा वाञ्छन्तु इति सर्वतो ऽप्रमत्ता धारयेरन्न्

sanskrit_iast: adbhutaṃ hi savanānayet samutthitaṃ bhavati || yadi prācyām agnibhayam || yadi dakṣiṇasyāṃ yamabhayam || yadi pratīcyāṃ varuṇabhayam || yadi udīcyāṃ kṣudbhayam || yadi antardeśebhyobhayato vidyād
meaning: अद्भुतं हि सवनानयेत् समुत्थितं भवति ॥ यदि प्राच्याम् अग्निभयम् ॥ यदि दक्षिणस्यां यमभयम् ॥ यदि प्रतीच्यां वरुणभयम् ॥ यदि उदीच्यां क्षुद्भयम् ॥ यदि अन्तर्देशेभ्योभयतो विद्याद्

sanskrit_iast: agnir mā pātu agniṃ te vasumantam ṛcchantv iti || yathāsvaliṅgaṃ dvābhyāṃ-dvābhyāṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ pratidiśam upasthāpayet ||
meaning: अग्निर् मा पातु अग्निं ते वसुमन्तम् ऋच्छन्त्व् इति ॥ यथास्वलिङ्गं द्वाभ्यां-द्वाभ्यां प्रदक्षिणं प्रतिदिशम् उपस्थापयेत् ॥

sanskrit_iast: gṛdhraś ced asmin nipatati mṛtyor bhayaṃ bhavati || yad vā kṛṣṇaśakunir antarikṣrṇa patati iti japed yas tvā gṛdhraḥ kapota iti antato japet
meaning: गृध्रश् चेद् अस्मिन् निपतति मृत्योर् भयं भवति ॥ यद् वा कृष्णशकुनिर् अन्तरिक्ष्र्ण पतति इति जपेद् यस् त्वा गृध्रः कपोत इति अन्ततो जपेत्

sanskrit_iast: sarvatra anājñāteṣu trirātraṃ ghṛtakambalam ||
meaning: सर्वत्र अनाज्ञातेषु त्रिरात्रं घृतकम्बलम् ॥

sanskrit_iast: śirobhaṅge tu rājānaṃ madhyabhaṅge tu mantriṇam | ādibhaṅge janapadaṃ mūlabhaṅge tu nāgarān ||
meaning: शिरोभङ्गे तु राजानं मध्यभङ्गे तु मन्त्रिणम् । आदिभङ्गे जनपदं मूलभङ्गे तु नागरान् ॥

sanskrit_iast: indrāṭako yadā bhidyād rājakośo vilupyate | rajjuchede parijāte nṛpatis tu vinaśyati ||
meaning: इन्द्राटको यदा भिद्याद् राजकोशो विलुप्यते । रज्जुछेदे परिजाते नृपतिस् तु विनश्यति ॥

sanskrit_iast: sāvitryā abhimantritaṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam āvartayed rājānam abhibhūr yajña iti etais tribhiḥ sūktair anvārabdhe rājani pūrṇahomaṃ juhuyāt ||
meaning: सावित्र्या अभिमन्त्रितं कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणम् आवर्तयेद् राजानम् अभिभूर् यज्ञ इति एतैस् त्रिभिः सूक्तैर् अन्वारब्धे राजनि पूर्णहोमं जुहुयात् ॥

sanskrit_iast: atha paśūnām upācāram ||
meaning: अथ पशूनाम् उपाचारम् ॥

sanskrit_iast: indradevatāḥ syur ye rājño bhṛtyāḥ syuḥ sarve dīkṣitā brahmacāriṇaḥ syur
meaning: इन्द्रदेवताः स्युर् ये राज्ञो भृत्याः स्युः सर्वे दीक्षिता ब्रह्मचारिणः स्युर्

sanskrit_iast: indraṃ copasadya yajeran || trirātraṃ saptarātraṃ vā
meaning: इन्द्रं चोपसद्य यजेरन् ॥ त्रिरात्रं सप्तरात्रं वा

sanskrit_iast: trir ayanam ahnām upatiṣṭhante havisā ca yajante ||
meaning: त्रिर् अयनम् अह्नाम् उपतिष्ठन्ते हविसा च यजन्ते ॥

sanskrit_iast: āvṛta indram aham iti indra kṣatram iti haviṣo hutvā
meaning: आवृत इन्द्रम् अहम् इति इन्द्र क्षत्रम् इति हविषो हुत्वा

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇān svastivācya indram avabhṛthāya vrajanti
meaning: ब्राह्मणान् स्वस्तिवाच्य इन्द्रम् अवभृथाय व्रजन्ति
text_mt: Now on the first lunar day of summer, having bathed with [the formula] "āyuṣyam" ("life-giving"), having plunged with the water hymns, having turned clockwise, and having touched water, [the rite] has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: apāṃ sūktair āplutya pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya apa upaspṛśya anapekṣamāṇāḥ pratyetya brāhmaṇān bhaktyā yad īpsitaṃ varapradānaiḥ paritoṣayet ||
meaning: अपां सूक्तैर् आप्लुत्य प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य अप उपस्पृश्य अनपेक्षमाणाः प्रत्येत्य ब्राह्मणान् भक्त्या यद् ईप्सितं वरप्रदानैः परितोषयेत् ॥

sanskrit_iast: atha haiṣamitikam iti ||
meaning: अथ हैषमितिकम् इति ॥

sanskrit_iast: śvaḥśvo 'sya rāṣṭraṃ jyāyo bhavati eko 'syāṃ pṛthivyāṃ rājā bhavati na purā jarasaḥ pramīyate ya evaṃ veda yaś caivaṃvidvān indramaheṇa carati iti brāhmaṇam ||
meaning: श्वःश्वो ऽस्य राष्ट्रं ज्यायो भवति एको ऽस्यां पृथिव्यां राजा भवति न पुरा जरसः प्रमीयते य एवं वेद यश् चैवंविद्वान् इन्द्रमहेण चरति इति ब्राह्मणम् ॥
text_mt: Now we shall explain the ritual ordinance for the king's great festival of Indra.

sanskrit_iast: athāto dhūrtakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||
meaning: अथातो धूर्तकल्पं व्याख्यास्यामः ॥
text_mt: Now therefore we shall explain the ritual manual of the Rogue.

sanskrit_iast: caturṣucaturṣu māseṣu phālguṇāṣāḍhakārttikapūrvapakṣeṣu nityaṃ kurvīta ||
meaning: चतुर्षुचतुर्षु मासेषु फाल्गुणाषाढकार्त्तिकपूर्वपक्षेषु नित्यं कुर्वीत ॥
text_mt: He should perform it regularly every four months, in the bright fortnights of Phālguna, Āṣāḍha, and Kārttika.

sanskrit_iast: śvo bhūte ṣaṣṭhyām upavāsaṃ kṛtvā prāgudīcīṃ diśaṃ niṣkramya śucau deśe manohare noṣare maṇḍalaṃ trayodaśaratniṃ kṛtvā madhye maṇḍapasya sarvavānaspatyāṃ mālāṃ kṛtvā ghaṇṭāpatākāsrajaḥ pratisaraṃ ca mālāpṛṣṭhe kṛtvā madhye darpaṇāṃś copakalpayitvā tatra yaṃ vahanti hayāḥ śvetā ity āvāhayet ||
meaning: श्वो भूते षष्ठ्याम् उपवासं कृत्वा प्रागुदीचीं दिशं निष्क्रम्य शुचौ देशे मनोहरे नोषरे मण्डलं त्रयोदशरत्निं कृत्वा मध्ये मण्डपस्य सर्ववानस्पत्यां मालां कृत्वा घण्टापताकास्रजः प्रतिसरं च मालापृष्ठे कृत्वा मध्ये दर्पणांश् चोपकल्पयित्वा तत्र यं वहन्ति हयाः श्वेता इत्य् आवाहयेत् ॥
text_mt:
On the next day, having fasted on the sixth lunar day, having gone out to the north-east direction, having made a circle of thirteen cubits in a clean, charming place that is not saline, having placed a garland made of all kinds of forest-trees in the middle of the pavilion, having placed bells, banners, garlands, and an amulet-cord behind the garland, and having arranged mirrors in the middle, he should invite [the deity] there with the verse: "Whom white horses bear..."

"Whom white horses bear, ever-yoked, swift as thought— / that Dhūrta clad in white armor do I invoke.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ vahanti hayāḥ śvetā nityayuktā manojavāḥ | tam ahaṃ śvetasaṃnāhaṃ dhūrtam āvāhayāmy aham ||
meaning: यं वहन्ति हयाः श्वेता नित्ययुक्ता मनोजवाः । तम् अहं श्वेतसंनाहं धूर्तम् आवाहयाम्य् अहम् ॥

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ vahanti gajāḥ siṃhā vyāghrāś cāpi viṣāṇinaḥ | tam ahaṃ siṃhasaṃnāhaṃ dhūrtam āvāhayāmy aham ||
meaning: यं वहन्ति गजाः सिंहा व्याघ्राश् चापि विषाणिनः । तम् अहं सिंहसंनाहं धूर्तम् आवाहयाम्य् अहम् ॥
text_mt: Whom elephants, lions, tigers, and horned beasts bear— / that Dhūrta clad in lion-armor do I invoke.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ vahanti mayūrāś ca citrapakṣā vihaṃgamāḥ | tam ahaṃ citrasaṃnāhaṃ dhūrtam āvāhayāmy aham ||
meaning: यं वहन्ति मयूराश् च चित्रपक्षा विहंगमाः । तम् अहं चित्रसंनाहं धूर्तम् आवाहयाम्य् अहम् ॥
text_mt: Whom peacocks and birds with multicolored wings bear— / that Dhūrta clad in multicolored armor do I invoke.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ vahanti sarvavārṇāḥ sadāyuktā manojavāḥ | tam ahaṃ sarvasaṃnāhaṃ dhūrtam āvāhayāmy aham ||
meaning: यं वहन्ति सर्ववार्णाः सदायुक्ता मनोजवाः । तम् अहं सर्वसंनाहं धूर्तम् आवाहयाम्य् अहम् ॥
text_mt: Whom [steeds] of all colors bear, ever-yoked, swift as thought— / that Dhūrta clad in all kinds of armor do I invoke.

sanskrit_iast: yasyāmoghā sadā śaktir nityaṃ ghaṇtāpatākinī | tam ahaṃ śaktisaṃnāhaṃ dhūrtam āvāhayāmy aham ||
meaning: यस्यामोघा सदा शक्तिर् नित्यं घण्तापताकिनी । तम् अहं शक्तिसंनाहं धूर्तम् आवाहयाम्य् अहम् ॥
text_mt: Whose spear is ever unfailing, constantly adorned with bells and banners— / that Dhūrta equipped with a spear do I invoke.

sanskrit_iast: yaś ca mātṛgaṇair nityaṃ sadā parivṛto yuvā | tam ahaṃ mātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ dhūrtam āvāhayāmy aham ||
meaning: यश् च मातृगणैर् नित्यं सदा परिवृतो युवा । तम् अहं मातृभिः सार्धं धूर्तम् आवाहयाम्य् अहम् ॥
text_mt: And who is ever surrounded by the troops of Mothers, ever youthful— / that Dhūrta along with the Mothers do I invoke.

sanskrit_iast: yaś ca kanyāsahasreṇa sadā parivṛto mahān | tam ahaṃ siṃhasaṃnāhaṃ dhūrtam āvāhayāmy aham ||
meaning: यश् च कन्यासहस्रेण सदा परिवृतो महान् । तम् अहं सिंहसंनाहं धूर्तम् आवाहयाम्य् अहम् ॥
text_mt: And who is ever surrounded by a thousand maidens, the great one— / that [Dhūrta] clad in lion-armor do I invoke.

sanskrit_iast: āyātu devaḥ sagaṇaḥ sasainyaḥ savāhanaḥ sānucaraḥ pratītaḥ | ṣaḍānano 'ṣṭādaśalocanaś ca suvarṇavarṇo laghupūrṇabhāsaḥ ||
meaning: आयातु देवः सगणः ससैन्यः सवाहनः सानुचरः प्रतीतः । षडाननो ऽष्टादशलोचनश् च सुवर्णवर्णो लघुपूर्णभासः ॥
text_mt: May the god arrive with his host, with his army, with his mount, with his attendants, well-pleased, / six-faced and eighteen-eyed, golden-hued, of light and full brilliance.

sanskrit_iast: āyātu devo mama kārttikeyo brahmaṇyapitraiḥ saha mātṛbhiś ca | bhrātrā viśākhena ca viśvarūpa imaṃ baliṃ sānucara juṣasva ||
meaning: आयातु देवो मम कार्त्तिकेयो ब्रह्मण्यपित्रैः सह मातृभिश् च । भ्रात्रा विशाखेन च विश्वरूप इमं बलिं सानुचर जुषस्व ॥
text_mt: May my god Kārttikeya come, together with the Fathers devoted to Brahmā and with the Mothers, / and with his brother Viśākha, all-formed! Accept this offering along with your attendants!"

sanskrit_iast: saṃviśasveti saṃveśayet ||
meaning: संविशस्वेति संवेशयेत् ॥
text_mt: With the words "Seat yourself," he should have him sit down.

sanskrit_iast: saṃviśasva varaghaṇṭāpsaraḥstave yatra subhujo hi nirmitāḥ | saṃviṣṭo me dhehi dīrgham āyuḥ prajāṃ paśūṃś caiva vināyakasena ||
meaning: संविशस्व वरघण्टाप्सरःस्तवे यत्र सुभुजो हि निर्मिताः । संविष्टो मे धेहि दीर्घम् आयुः प्रजां पशूंश् चैव विनायकसेन ॥
text_mt: "Seat yourself amidst the praise of the excellent bells and Apsarases, where fair arms indeed are fashioned; / having sat down, grant me long life, offspring, and cattle, O commander of Vināyaka's army!"

sanskrit_iast: imā āpa iti gandhodakaṃ pādyaṃ dadyāt || pratigṛhṇātu bhagavān devo dhūrta iti || ṣat caiva hiraṇyavarṇā itīme divyo gandharva iti gandhān yas te gandha iti cemāḥ sumanasa iti sumanasaḥ || priyaṃ dhātur iti … ||
meaning: इमा आप इति गन्धोदकं पाद्यं दद्यात् ॥ प्रतिगृह्णातु भगवान् देवो धूर्त इति ॥ षत् चैव हिरण्यवर्णा इतीमे दिव्यो गन्धर्व इति गन्धान् यस् ते गन्ध इति चेमाः सुमनस इति सुमनसः ॥ प्रियं धातुर् इति … ॥
text_mt: With "These waters..." he should present scented water for washing the feet, [saying,] "May the blessed god Dhūrta accept [it]!" And with the six [verses beginning with] "Of golden color...", perfumes with "He is the divine Gandharva...", and with "What scent of yours..." and "These flowers..." [he offers] flowers; with "Dear to the creator..." [he offers paste]...

sanskrit_iast: vanaspatir aso medhya iti dhūpam || yakṣyeṇa te divā agniḥ śukraś ceti dīpam || yo viśvataḥ supratīka iti parṇāni ||
meaning: वनस्पतिर् असो मेध्य इति धूपम् ॥ यक्ष्येण ते दिवा अग्निः शुक्रश् चेति दीपम् ॥ यो विश्वतः सुप्रतीक इति पर्णानि ॥
text_mt: With "The tree is pure..." incense; with "That with an offering by day, Agni, and bright..." a lamp; with "He who has a fair face on all sides..." leaves.

sanskrit_iast: prakṣālya haviṣy upasādayed dadhyodanaṃ kṣīrodanaṃ guḍodanaṃ mudgapayasamiśradhānyamodakāni sarvagandhān sarvarsān udakapūrṇaṃ mūlapurṇaṃ puṣpapūrṇaṃ phalapūrṇaṃ rasapūrṇaṃ copakalpayitvā
meaning: प्रक्षाल्य हविष्य् उपसादयेद् दध्योदनं क्षीरोदनं गुडोदनं मुद्गपयसमिश्रधान्यमोदकानि सर्वगन्धान् सर्वर्सान् उदकपूर्णं मूलपुर्णं पुष्पपूर्णं फलपूर्णं रसपूर्णं चोपकल्पयित्वा
text_mt: Having washed the sacrificial offerings, he should set them down: curd-rice, milk-rice, molasses-rice, sweet cakes made of grains mixed with mung beans and milk, all fragrances, all flavors, having prepared [vessels] filled with water, filled with roots, filled with flowers, filled with fruits, and filled with juices.

sanskrit_iast: indraḥ sītam ity ullikhya agne prety agniṃ praṇīya prajvalya prāñcam idhmam upasamādhāya bhaga etam idhmam iti tisṛbhir etam idhmaṃ sugārhaspatya ity upasamādhāya samiddho agnir iti samiddham anumantrayate ||
meaning: इन्द्रः सीतम् इत्य् उल्लिख्य अग्ने प्रेत्य् अग्निं प्रणीय प्रज्वल्य प्राञ्चम् इध्मम् उपसमाधाय भग एतम् इध्मम् इति तिसृभिर् एतम् इध्मं सुगार्हस्पत्य इत्य् उपसमाधाय समिद्धो अग्निर् इति समिद्धम् अनुमन्त्रयते ॥
text_mt: Having furrowed [the ground] with "Indra the furrow...", having brought forward the fire with "O Agni, advance...", having kindled it, having laid sacrificial fuel pointing eastward, having added this sacrificial fuel with the three verses beginning with "Bhaga, this sacrificial fuel...", having added fuel with "O good lord of the house...", he consecrates the kindled [fire] with "The fire is kindled...".

sanskrit_iast: bhadram icchanto hiraṇyagarbho mamāgne varcas tvayā manyo yas te manyo yad devā devaheḍanam iti ṣat kāmasūktādayo daśa mahīpataye svāhā ||
meaning: भद्रम् इच्छन्तो हिरण्यगर्भो ममाग्ने वर्चस् त्वया मन्यो यस् ते मन्यो यद् देवा देवहेडनम् इति षत् कामसूक्तादयो दश महीपतये स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: Desiring good fortune, [with] "The golden germ...", "Agni, my splendor...", "Through you, O Manyu...", "Whatever Manyu of yours...", "Whatever offense against the gods, O gods...", the six, and ten [verses] beginning with the hymn to desire: "To the lord of the earth, svāhā!"

sanskrit_iast: dhūrtāya skandāya viśākhāya pinākasenāya bhrātṛstrīkāmāya svacchandāya varaghaṇtāya nirmilāya lohitagātrāya śalakaṭaṅkaṭāya svāheti hutvā agnaye prajāpataye ye devā divy ekādaśa stheti anumataye agnaye sviṣṭakṛta iti ca ||
meaning: धूर्ताय स्कन्दाय विशाखाय पिनाकसेनाय भ्रातृस्त्रीकामाय स्वच्छन्दाय वरघण्ताय निर्मिलाय लोहितगात्राय शलकटङ्कटाय स्वाहेति हुत्वा अग्नये प्रजापतये ये देवा दिव्य् एकादश स्थेति अनुमतये अग्नये स्विष्टकृत इति च ॥
text_mt: Having made offerings with: "To Dhūrta, to Skanda, to Viśākha, to Pinākasena, to the one who desires his brother's wife, to the self-willed one, to the one with excellent bells, to the immaculate one, to the red-limbed one, to Śalakaṭaṅkaṭa, svāhā!", and [offering] to Agni, to Prajāpati, with "O you gods who are eleven in heaven...", to Anumati, and to Agni Sviṣṭakṛt;

sanskrit_iast: śivāgnikṛttikānāṃ tu stoṣyāmi varadaṃ śubham | sa me stuto viśvarūpaj sarvān arthān prayacchatu ||
meaning: शिवाग्निकृत्तिकानां तु स्तोष्यामि वरदं शुभम् । स मे स्तुतो विश्वरूपज् सर्वान् अर्थान् प्रयच्छतु ॥
text_mt: "I shall praise the auspicious boon-bestower of Śiva, Agni, and the Kṛttikās; / praised by me, may he of universal form grant all desires,

sanskrit_iast: dhanadhānyakulān bhogān sa me vacanavedanam | dāsīdāsaṃ tathā sthānaṃ maṇiratnaṃ surāñjanam ||
meaning: धनधान्यकुलान् भोगान् स मे वचनवेदनम् । दासीदासं तथा स्थानं मणिरत्नं सुराञ्जनम् ॥
text_mt: possessions of wealth and grain, enjoyments, the making known of my speech, / female and male slaves, and likewise a station, jewels, gems, and divine collyrium.

sanskrit_iast: ye bhaktyā bhajante dhūrtaṃ brahmaṇyaṃ ca yaśasvinam | sarve te dhanavantaḥ syuḥ prajāvanto yaśasvinaḥ ||
meaning: ये भक्त्या भजन्ते धूर्तं ब्रह्मण्यं च यशस्विनम् । सर्वे ते धनवन्तः स्युः प्रजावन्तो यशस्विनः ॥
text_mt: Those who with devotion worship Dhūrta, devoted to Brahmā and glorious, / may all of them become wealthy, possessed of offspring, and glorious.

sanskrit_iast: yathendras tu varān labdhvā prītas tu bhagavān purā | dehi me vipulān bhogān bhaktānāṃ ca viśeṣata iti ||
meaning: यथेन्द्रस् तु वरान् लब्ध्वा प्रीतस् तु भगवान् पुरा । देहि मे विपुलान् भोगान् भक्तानां च विशेषत इति ॥
text_mt: Just as Indra, having obtained boons, was pleased of old, O blessed one, / [so] grant me, and especially to your devotees, vast enjoyments!"

sanskrit_iast: kāmasūktenopahāram upaharet ||
meaning: कामसूक्तेनोपहारम् उपहरेत् ॥
text_mt: He should present the offering-gift with the hymn to desire.

sanskrit_iast: upahāram imaṃ deva mayā bhaktyā niveditam | pratigṛhya yathānyāyam akruddhaḥ sumanā bhava ||
meaning: उपहारम् इमं देव मया भक्त्या निवेदितम् । प्रतिगृह्य यथान्यायम् अक्रुद्धः सुमना भव ॥
text_mt: "This offering-gift, O god, has been presented by me with devotion; / having accepted it according to the rule, be gracious and well-disposed!

sanskrit_iast: sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmi sadyojātāya vai namaḥ | bhavebhave nādibhave bhajasva māṃ bhavodbhaveti bhavāya namaḥ ||
meaning: सद्योजातं प्रपद्यामि सद्योजाताय वै नमः । भवेभवे नादिभवे भजस्व मां भवोद्भवेति भवाय नमः ॥
text_mt: I take refuge in Sadyojāta; homage indeed to Sadyojāta! / In every birth, O you whose birth has no beginning, favor me, O source of existence! Homage to Bhava!

sanskrit_iast: devaṃ prapadye varadaṃ prapadye skandaṃ prapadye ca kumāram ugram | ṣaṇṇāṃ sutaṃ kṛttikānāṃ ṣaḍāsyam agneḥ putraṃ sādhanaṃ gopathoktaiḥ ||
meaning: देवं प्रपद्ये वरदं प्रपद्ये स्कन्दं प्रपद्ये च कुमारम् उग्रम् । षण्णां सुतं कृत्तिकानां षडास्यम् अग्नेः पुत्रं साधनं गोपथोक्तैः ॥
text_mt: I take refuge in the god, I take refuge in the boon-bestower, I take refuge in Skanda, the fierce Kumāra, / the six-faced son of the six Kṛttikās, the son of Agni, the accomplishment [spoken of] by the words of the Gopatha [Brāhmaṇa].

sanskrit_iast: raktāni yasya puṣpāṇi raktaṃ yasya vilepanam | kukkuṭā yasya raktākṣāḥ sa me skandaḥ prasīdatu ||
meaning: रक्तानि यस्य पुष्पाणि रक्तं यस्य विलेपनम् । कुक्कुटा यस्य रक्ताक्षाः स मे स्कन्दः प्रसीदतु ॥
text_mt: Whose flowers are red, whose ointment is red, / whose roosters have red eyes—may that Skanda be gracious to me!

sanskrit_iast: āgneyaṃ kṛttikāputram aindraṃ ke cid adhīyate | ke cit pāśupataṃ raudraṃ yo 'si so 'si namo 'stu ta iti ||
meaning: आग्नेयं कृत्तिकापुत्रम् ऐन्द्रं के चिद् अधीयते । के चित् पाशुपतं रौद्रं यो ऽसि सो ऽसि नमो ऽस्तु त इति ॥
text_mt: Some recite him as belonging to Agni, son of the Kṛttikās, some as belonging to Indra; / some as belonging to Paśupati, to Rudra: whoever you are, homage be to you!"

sanskrit_iast: svāmine namaḥ śaṅkarāyāgniputrāya kṛttikāputrāya namaḥ ||
meaning: स्वामिने नमः शङ्करायाग्निपुत्राय कृत्तिकापुत्राय नमः ॥
text_mt: "Homage to the Lord, to Śaṅkara, to the son of Agni, to the son of the Kṛttikās!"

sanskrit_iast: bhagavān kva cid apratirūpaḥ svāhā bhagavān kva cid apratirūpaḥ ||
meaning: भगवान् क्व चिद् अप्रतिरूपः स्वाहा भगवान् क्व चिद् अप्रतिरूपः ॥
text_mt: "The blessed one is somewhere matchless, svāhā! The blessed one is somewhere matchless!"

sanskrit_iast: maṇiratnavarapratirūpaḥ || kāñcanaratnavarapratirūpa iti ||
meaning: मणिरत्नवरप्रतिरूपः ॥ काञ्चनरत्नवरप्रतिरूप इति ॥
text_mt: "The matchless one of excellent jewels and gems!" "The matchless one of excellent gold and gems!"

sanskrit_iast: ete te deva gandhā etāni puṣpāṇy eṣa dhūpa etāṃ mālāṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā ādityakartitaṃ sūtram iti pratisaram ābadhnīyāt ||
meaning: एते ते देव गन्धा एतानि पुष्पाण्य् एष धूप एतां मालां त्रिः प्रदक्षिणां कृत्वा आदित्यकर्तितं सूत्रम् इति प्रतिसरम् आबध्नीयात् ॥
text_mt:
[Saying,] "These are your perfumes, O god; these are the flowers; this is the incense;" having circumambulated this garland three times from left to right, he should bind on the amulet-cord with the verse: "The thread spun by the sun..."

"The thread was spun by the sun, made three-fold by Indra, / the knot was tied by the Aśvins, the amulet-cord was made by Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast: ādityakartitaṃ sūtram indreṇa trivṛtīkṛtam | aśvibhyāṃ grathito granthir brahmaṇā pratisaraḥ kṛtaḥ ||
meaning: आदित्यकर्तितं सूत्रम् इन्द्रेण त्रिवृतीकृतम् । अश्विभ्यां ग्रथितो ग्रन्थिर् ब्रह्मणा प्रतिसरः कृतः ॥

sanskrit_iast: dhanyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyam aśubhasya ca ghātanam | badhnāmi pratisaram imaṃ sarvaśatrunibarhanam ||
meaning: धन्यं यशस्यम् आयुष्यम् अशुभस्य च घातनम् । बध्नामि प्रतिसरम् इमं सर्वशत्रुनिबर्हनम् ॥
text_mt: Bestowing wealth, bringing fame, giving long life, and destroying misfortune, / I bind this amulet-cord, which destroys all enemies.

sanskrit_iast: rakṣobhyaś ca piśācebhyo gandharvebhyas tathaiva ca | manuṣyebhyo bhayaṃ nāsti yac ca syād duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam ||
meaning: रक्षोभ्यश् च पिशाचेभ्यो गन्धर्वेभ्यस् तथैव च । मनुष्येभ्यो भयं नास्ति यच् च स्याद् दुष्कृतं कृतम् ॥
text_mt: From Rakṣases and Piśācas, and likewise from Gandharvas / and from mortals there is no fear, nor from whatever misdeed may have been committed.

sanskrit_iast: svakṛtāt parakṛtāc ca duṣkṛtāt pratimucyate | sarvasmāt pātakān mukto bhaved vīras tathaiva ca ||
meaning: स्वकृतात् परकृताच् च दुष्कृतात् प्रतिमुच्यते । सर्वस्मात् पातकान् मुक्तो भवेद् वीरस् तथैव च ॥
text_mt: He is released from evil deeds done by himself or done by others; / he is freed from all sin, and he becomes a hero.

sanskrit_iast: abhicārāc ca kṛtyātaḥ strīkṛtād aśubhaṃ ca yat | tāvat tasya bhataṃ nāsti yāvat sūtraṃ sa dhārayet ||
meaning: अभिचाराच् च कृत्यातः स्त्रीकृताद् अशुभं च यत् । तावत् तस्य भतं नास्ति यावत् सूत्रं स धारयेत् ॥
text_mt: From malevolent magic and witchcraft, and whatever inauspicious thing is done by women— / so long as he wears the thread, so long has he no fear.

sanskrit_iast: yāvad āpaś ca gāvaś ca yāvat sthāsyanti parvatāḥ | tāvat tasya bhayaṃ nāsti yaḥ sūtraṃ dhārayiṣyatīti ||
meaning: यावद् आपश् च गावश् च यावत् स्थास्यन्ति पर्वताः । तावत् तस्य भयं नास्ति यः सूत्रं धारयिष्यतीति ॥
text_mt: As long as waters and cows exist, as long as mountains shall endure, / so long has he no fear who shall wear the thread."

sanskrit_iast: anvāyaṃ bhuktvā devaṃ visarjayet ||
meaning: अन्वायं भुक्त्वा देवं विसर्जयेत् ॥
text_mt: Having eaten after the rite, he should dismiss the god:

sanskrit_iast: pramodo nāma gandharvaḥ pradoṣo paridhāvati | muñca śailamayāt pāpan muñcamuñca pramuñca ca ||
meaning: प्रमोदो नाम गन्धर्वः प्रदोषो परिधावति । मुञ्च शैलमयात् पापन् मुञ्चमुञ्च प्रमुञ्च च ॥
text_mt: "The Gandharva named Pramoda runs about at nightfall; / release [me] from the sin consisting of the rock, release, release, completely release!"

sanskrit_iast: yāvat imā āpaḥ pavanena pūtā hiraṇyavarṇā anavadyarūpāḥ | tāvad imaṃ dhūrtaṃ pravāhayāmi pravāhito me dehi varān yathoktān ||
meaning: यावत् इमा आपः पवनेन पूता हिरण्यवर्णा अनवद्यरूपाः । तावद् इमं धूर्तं प्रवाहयामि प्रवाहितो मे देहि वरान् यथोक्तान् ॥
text_mt: "As long as these waters, purified by the wind, are golden-hued and flawless in form, / so long do I send off this scoundrel; once sent off, grant me the boons as spoken."

sanskrit_iast: uditeṣu nakṣatreṣu gṛhān praviṣṭo gṛhiṇīṃ paśyet dhanavati dhanaṃ me dehīti ||
meaning: उदितेषु नक्षत्रेषु गृहान् प्रविष्टो गृहिणीं पश्येत् धनवति धनं मे देहीति ॥
text_mt: When the lunar mansions have risen, entering his house, he should look upon his wife, saying: "O wealthy one, give me wealth!"

sanskrit_iast: yad bhoktuṃ kāmajātaṃ jagatyāṃ manasā saṃhīhate tattad dvijanmā pinākasenayajamānāt kāmam upabhukto bhuktvāmṛtatvaṃ tadvad evābhyupaiti ||
meaning: यद् भोक्तुं कामजातं जगत्यां मनसा संहीहते तत्तद् द्विजन्मा पिनाकसेनयजमानात् कामम् उपभुक्तो भुक्त्वामृतत्वं तद्वद् एवाभ्युपैति ॥
text_mt: Whatever collection of desires he yearns for in his mind to enjoy in the world, that very thing the twice-born enjoys from the patron of the sacrifice, Pinākasena; and having enjoyed it, he attains immortality just like that.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ saṃbhārān kīrtayiṣyāmo yathālakṣaṇasaṃyutān | yaiḥ karma kriyamāṇaṃ hi phalavat syād dvijanmanām ||
meaning: ओं संभारान् कीर्तयिष्यामो यथालक्षणसंयुतान् । यैः कर्म क्रियमाणं हि फलवत् स्याद् द्विजन्मनाम् ॥
text_mt: Oṃ. We shall proclaim the sacrificial materials endowed with their proper characteristics, / through which the rite performed by twice-born men shall indeed be fruitful.

sanskrit_iast: achinnāgrān kuśān ārdrān indranīlasamaprabhān | śuṣkān api śvetavarṇān āhuḥ śāntikarān budhāḥ ||
meaning: अछिन्नाग्रान् कुशान् आर्द्रान् इन्द्रनीलसमप्रभान् । शुष्कान् अपि श्वेतवर्णान् आहुः शान्तिकरान् बुधाः ॥
text_mt: Kuśa grass with unbroken tips, moist, having a luster like sapphire, / and even dry if white in color, the wise declare to be peacemaking.

sanskrit_iast: surabhīṇi ca puṣpāṇi susvādūni phalāni ca manoharāṇi vāsāṃsi saṃbhāreṣūpakalpayet ||
meaning: सुरभीणि च पुष्पाणि सुस्वादूनि फलानि च मनोहराणि वासांसि संभारेषूपकल्पयेत् ॥
text_mt: Fragrant flowers, sweet fruits, / and charming garments one should arrange among the sacrificial materials,

sanskrit_iast: surabhīṇy eva bījāni anyavastūni yāni ca | arghacandanadhūpādi hemaratnādi cottamam ||
meaning: सुरभीण्य् एव बीजानि अन्यवस्तूनि यानि च । अर्घचन्दनधूपादि हेमरत्नादि चोत्तमम् ॥
text_mt: as well as fragrant seeds and whatever other items, / guest-water, sandalwood, incense and the like, and excellent gold, gems, and so forth,

sanskrit_iast: gāvaś ca dakṣiṇārthaṃ hi payasvinyaḥ sulakṣaṇāḥ |
meaning: गावश् च दक्षिणार्थं हि पयस्विन्यः सुलक्षणाः ।
text_mt: and cows for the sacrificial fee, full of milk and possessing auspicious marks.

sanskrit_iast: ṣoḍaśāṣṭau ca catvāraś caturṇāṃ vedavittamāḥ || ṛtvijas tu samākhyātā vayaḥśīlaguṇānvitāḥ | dvātriṃśat ṣoḍaśāṣṭau vā śāntikārye tathādbhute || sahiraṇyāḥ savastrāś ca sālaṃkārāḥ savatsakāḥ | te sadasyā iti proktā vācane yajñakarmaṇi || sarve te 'pi hy atharvāṇa ṛtvijaḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ | śuddhātmāno japair homair vaidikair vītamatsarāḥ ||
meaning: षोडशाष्टौ च चत्वारश् चतुर्णां वेदवित्तमाः ॥ ऋत्विजस् तु समाख्याता वयःशीलगुणान्विताः । द्वात्रिंशत् षोडशाष्टौ वा शान्तिकार्ये तथाद्भुते ॥ सहिरण्याः सवस्त्राश् च सालंकाराः सवत्सकाः । ते सदस्या इति प्रोक्ता वाचने यज्ञकर्मणि ॥ सर्वे ते ऽपि ह्य् अथर्वाण ऋत्विजः षोडश स्मृताः । शुद्धात्मानो जपैर् होमैर् वैदिकैर् वीतमत्सराः ॥
text_mt:
Sixteen, eight, or four of the four [Vedas], best knowers of the Veda,

are designated as the officiating priests, endowed with youth, good conduct, and virtues; / or thirty-two, sixteen, or eight in a propitiatory rite and likewise in [the case of] a portent.

Endowed with gold, with garments, with ornaments, and with calves, / they are declared to be the members of the assembly at the recitation in the sacrificial rite.

All of them are indeed Atharvans, remembered as the sixteen officiating priests,

purified in self through Vedic murmurings and oblations, free from envy.

sanskrit_iast: tāmrarājatahaimānāṃ mṛnmayānām athāpi vā | achidrāṇāṃ savarṇānāṃ kalaśānāṃ ca saṃgrahaḥ ||
meaning: ताम्रराजतहैमानां मृन्मयानाम् अथापि वा । अछिद्राणां सवर्णानां कलशानां च संग्रहः ॥
text_mt: There is also the gathering of water jars made of copper, silver, or gold, / or even made of clay, without holes and of uniform color,

sanskrit_iast: carūṇām atha pātrāṇām indhanānāṃ viśeṣataḥ | yavavrīhitila ādīnām ājyasyāharaṇaṃ tathā ||
meaning: चरूणाम् अथ पात्राणाम् इन्धनानां विशेषतः । यवव्रीहितिल आदीनाम् आज्यस्याहरणं तथा ॥
text_mt: and especially of sacrificial pots, vessels, and pieces of firewood, / as well as the bringing of barley, rice, sesame, and so on, and clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: achidrāsphātitāvakrā dīrghaparvāḥ sumadhyamāḥ | śamīdūrvātarūṇāṃ tu jñeyāḥ śāntau śabhāvāḥ ||
meaning: अछिद्रास्फातितावक्रा दीर्घपर्वाः सुमध्यमाः । शमीदूर्वातरूणां तु ज्ञेयाः शान्तौ शभावाः ॥
text_mt: Unperforated, uncracked, straight, with long joints, and well-proportioned: / such auspicious [staves] of Śamī and Dūrvā trees are to be recognized in a propitiatory rite.

sanskrit_iast: puṣkaratantugovālatruṭisarṣapayavasya tu | ṣaḍguṇitaḥṣaḍguṇito bhavati narasyāṅgulamāne ||
meaning: पुष्करतन्तुगोवालत्रुटिसर्षपयवस्य तु । षड्गुणितःषड्गुणितो भवति नरस्याङ्गुलमाने ॥
text_mt: Six times [the width of] a lotus thread, cow-hair, a speck of dust, a mustard seed, and a barleycorn / becomes [the measure of] a man's inch.

sanskrit_iast: gopucchasadṛśo daṇḍaḥ samaḥ ślakṣṇo manoharaḥ | sruvaś ca śāntuke jñeyaḥ srug uktā yajñalakṣaṇā ||
meaning: गोपुच्छसदृशो दण्डः समः श्लक्ष्णो मनोहरः । स्रुवश् च शान्तुके ज्ञेयः स्रुग् उक्ता यज्ञलक्षणा ॥
text_mt: Resembling a cow's tail, straight, smooth, and charming / is the staff; and the dipping ladle is to be understood in a propitiatory rite, while the offering ladle is stated according to the sacrificial marks.

sanskrit_iast: sauvarṇaḥ śāntike proktaḥ pālaśo vātha khādiraḥ | abhicāre viśeṣeṇa kuryāt sruvam ayomayam ||
meaning: सौवर्णः शान्तिके प्रोक्तः पालशो वाथ खादिरः । अभिचारे विशेषेण कुर्यात् स्रुवम् अयोमयम् ॥
text_mt: A golden [ladle] is prescribed in a propitiatory rite, or one made of Palāśa or Khadira; / in malevolent sorcery especially, one should make a dipping ladle of iron.

sanskrit_iast: kāṃsyaṃ yccāṭane kuryād āśvatthaṃ vaśyakarmaṇi | viśeṣeṇa tu vidveṣe sruvo nimbamayaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning: कांस्यं य्च्चाटने कुर्याद् आश्वत्थं वश्यकर्मणि । विशेषेण तु विद्वेषे स्रुवो निम्बमयः स्मृतः ॥
text_mt: One should make one of bell-metal for eradication, one of Aśvattha in a rite of subjugation; / and especially in [a rite of] enmity, a dipping ladle of Nimba wood is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast: pauṣṭike rājataṃ vidyāt tāmraṃ ca vijayāvaham | amṛtādau tu vijñeyaś cāndanaḥ siddhidaḥ sruvaḥ ||
meaning: पौष्टिके राजतं विद्यात् ताम्रं च विजयावहम् । अमृतादौ तु विज्ञेयश् चान्दनः सिद्धिदः स्रुवः ॥
text_mt: In a prosperity rite one should know it to be of silver, and of copper as bringing victory; / while in [rites for] nectar and the like, a dipping ladle of sandalwood is to be understood as granting success.

sanskrit_iast: sruvāṇāṃ viṣayaṃ jñātvā kīlakānāṃ vidhiṃ tathā | gṛhasyāśmavidhiṃ dikṣu karmasiddhim avāpnuyāt ||
meaning: स्रुवाणां विषयं ज्ञात्वा कीलकानां विधिं तथा । गृहस्याश्मविधिं दिक्षु कर्मसिद्धिम् अवाप्नुयात् ॥
text_mt: Having understood the domain of the dipping ladles, and likewise the rule for the pegs, / and the rule of stones for the house in the directions, one would attain success in the rite.

sanskrit_iast: śleṣmātakārkakaṇṭakikaṭutiktādivarjite | ariṣṭagṛdhrakauśikavihaṃgaiś ca vivarjite ||
meaning: श्लेष्मातकार्ककण्टकिकटुतिक्तादिवर्जिते । अरिष्टगृध्रकौशिकविहंगैश् च विवर्जिते ॥
text_mt: Free from Śleṣmātaka, Arka, thorny, acrid, and bitter [plants], / and avoided by Ariṣṭa, vulture, owl, and [such ominous] birds,

sanskrit_iast: gulmavallīlatāyukte hṛdyaiś ca madhurair drumaiḥ | taruṇaiḥ phalavadbhiś ca śmaśānāsthivivarjite ||
meaning: गुल्मवल्लीलतायुक्ते हृद्यैश् च मधुरैर् द्रुमैः । तरुणैः फलवद्भिश् च श्मशानास्थिविवर्जिते ॥
text_mt: furnished with bushes, creeping plants, and vines, and with delightful and sweet trees, / youthful and fruitful, free from cremation grounds and bones,

sanskrit_iast: mayūracakravākādihaṃsakāraṇḍavādibhiḥ | susvarair nādite deśe hṛdyāṅkurasamanvite ||
meaning: मयूरचक्रवाकादिहंसकारण्डवादिभिः । सुस्वरैर् नादिते देशे हृद्याङ्कुरसमन्विते ॥
text_mt: made resonant with the melodious calls of peacocks, ruddy shelducks, geese, kāraṇḍava ducks, and the like, / furnished with charming sprouts,

sanskrit_iast: nadītaṭe samudrasya saṃgame vā viśeṣataḥ | anindye digvibhāge ca uttare vāparājite ||
meaning: नदीतटे समुद्रस्य संगमे वा विशेषतः । अनिन्द्ये दिग्विभागे च उत्तरे वापराजिते ॥
text_mt: on a riverbank, or especially at a confluence with the ocean, / and in an unblamed region of the compass, either to the north or in the northeast,

sanskrit_iast: bhūmiṃ saṃśodhayet kartā prāgudakppravaṇe śubhe | prācīṃ saṃśodhya yatnena maṇḍapaṃ tatra kārayet ||
meaning: भूमिं संशोधयेत् कर्ता प्रागुदक्प्प्रवणे शुभे । प्राचीं संशोध्य यत्नेन मण्डपं तत्र कारयेत् ॥
text_mt: the agent should purify the ground, sloping to the northeast and auspicious; / having carefully cleared the eastern portion, he should cause a pavilion to be built there,

sanskrit_iast: navakoṣṭhaṃ samaṃ vāpi hastaiḥ ṣoṣaśabhir mitam | caturaśraṃ caturdvāram ekordhvadvāram eva vā ||
meaning: नवकोष्ठं समं वापि हस्तैः षोषशभिर् मितम् । चतुरश्रं चतुर्द्वारम् एकोर्ध्वद्वारम् एव वा ॥
text_mt: having nine compartments, or level, measured at sixteen cubits, / four-cornered, with four doors, or having a single upper door.

sanskrit_iast: tata īśānakoṇe tu snānavediṃ samācaret | daśadvādaśahastaṃ vā yathāvitānam eva vā ||
meaning: तत ईशानकोणे तु स्नानवेदिं समाचरेत् । दशद्वादशहस्तं वा यथावितानम् एव वा ॥
text_mt: Then in the northeast corner he should construct an ablution altar, / measuring ten or twelve cubits, or according to the canopy.

sanskrit_iast: caturguṇocchrayāś caiva mūlastambhās tu ye tataḥ | upastambhās tu ye pārśve tadardhena prakīrtitāḥ ||
meaning: चतुर्गुणोच्छ्रयाश् चैव मूलस्तम्भास् तु ये ततः । उपस्तम्भास् तु ये पार्श्वे तदर्धेन प्रकीर्तिताः ॥
text_mt: And the main pillars from there are four times that in height, / while the secondary pillars at the sides are stated to be half that.

sanskrit_iast: kumbhāḥ stambhais tathā deyāḥ kāmair dvāraṃ diśāṃ smṛtam | yajamānocchrayaṃ vāpi tadardhena prakīrtitāḥ ||
meaning: कुम्भाः स्तम्भैस् तथा देयाः कामैर् द्वारं दिशां स्मृतम् । यजमानोच्छ्रयं वापि तदर्धेन प्रकीर्तिताः ॥
text_mt: Pots are likewise to be placed with the pillars; the door of the directions is remembered according to desire; / or [the pillars] are prescribed to be the height of the patron, or half of that.

sanskrit_iast: kuṇḍākṛti gṛhaṃ kuryād dviguṇaṃ pariveṣtitam | sarvadikṣu plavaṃ caiva kuṇḍasyordhvaṃ na chādayet ||
meaning: कुण्डाकृति गृहं कुर्याद् द्विगुणं परिवेष्तितम् । सर्वदिक्षु प्लवं चैव कुण्डस्योर्ध्वं न छादयेत् ॥
text_mt: He should make the house shaped like a fireplace pit, wrapped double, / with a slope in all directions, and he should not cover the space above the pit.

sanskrit_iast: parito dvādaśasthūnaṃ catuḥstambhaṃ tu madhyataḥ | arcitaṃ pūjitaṃ nityaṃ śāntau śāntigṛhaṃ smṛtam ||
meaning: परितो द्वादशस्थूनं चतुःस्तम्भं तु मध्यतः । अर्चितं पूजितं नित्यं शान्तौ शान्तिगृहं स्मृतम् ॥
text_mt: Having twelve posts all around and four pillars in the middle, / constantly honored and worshipped, it is remembered as the peace-house in a propitiatory rite.

sanskrit_iast: netrādyullocaśobhiṣṭhaṃ nānāvarṇadhvajākulam | raktā pītā ca dhūmrā ca kṛṣṇā nīlātha pāṇḍurā ||
meaning: नेत्राद्युल्लोचशोभिष्ठं नानावर्णध्वजाकुलम् । रक्ता पीता च धूम्रा च कृष्णा नीलाथ पाण्डुरा ॥
text_mt: Very splendid with an awning of silk and the like, crowded with multi-colored banners— / red, yellow, smoky, black, blue, and pale,

sanskrit_iast: vicitrā hīndranīlābhā patākāḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ | aindrāyudhadhūmrakṛṣṇanīlapāṇḍuravarṇakāḥ ||
meaning: विचित्रा हीन्द्रनीलाभा पताकाः षोडश स्मृताः । ऐन्द्रायुधधूम्रकृष्णनीलपाण्डुरवर्णकाः ॥
text_mt: variegated, and resembling sapphire—sixteen flags are remembered, / having the colors of the rainbow, smoky, black, blue, and pale;

sanskrit_iast: pītaraktasitāḥ śyāmā patākāḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ | kalaśān ṣoḍaśān tatra upariṣṭān mahādhvajaḥ ||
meaning: पीतरक्तसिताः श्यामा पताकाः षोडश स्मृताः । कलशान् षोडशान् तत्र उपरिष्टान् महाध्वजः ॥
text_mt: yellow, red, white, and dark: sixteen flags are remembered. / There are sixteen jars there, and above them a great banner.

sanskrit_iast: vastreṇāchāditān kuryāt sahiraṇyān pṛthakpṛthak | maṇimuktāphalaiḥ puṣpair hṛdyaiś ca madhuraiḥ phalaiḥ ||
meaning: वस्त्रेणाछादितान् कुर्यात् सहिरण्यान् पृथक्पृथक् । मणिमुक्ताफलैः पुष्पैर् हृद्यैश् च मधुरैः फलैः ॥
text_mt: He should make them covered with cloth, together with gold, individually, / with jewels, pearls, flowers, and charming, sweet fruits,

sanskrit_iast: samantād dikṣu vinyastaiḥ pradīpaiś cāpy alaṃkṛtam | dhūpair balyupahāraiś ca jayaghoṣaiś ca bandinām ||
meaning: समन्ताद् दिक्षु विन्यस्तैः प्रदीपैश् चाप्य् अलंकृतम् । धूपैर् बल्युपहारैश् च जयघोषैश् च बन्दिनाम् ॥
text_mt: and adorned with lamps set all around in the directions, / with incense, food offerings, and gifts, and with the victory shouts of bards.

sanskrit_iast: śaṅkhatūryaninādais tu vīṇādundubhisasmitaiḥ | pūjyamāno hi nṛpatiḥ praviśet sapurohitaḥ ||
meaning: शङ्खतूर्यनिनादैस् तु वीणादुन्दुभिसस्मितैः । पूज्यमानो हि नृपतिः प्रविशेत् सपुरोहितः ॥
text_mt: Amid the sounds of conches and musical instruments, accompanied by lutes and kettledrums, / being honored indeed, the king should enter together with the royal chaplain.

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ śāntyudakaṃ kṛtvā cātanenānuyojitam | saṃprokṣya vidhivan mantrair ānayed araṇī tataḥ ||
meaning: ततः शान्त्युदकं कृत्वा चातनेनानुयोजितम् । संप्रोक्ष्य विधिवन् मन्त्रैर् आनयेद् अरणी ततः ॥
text_mt: Then, having prepared the propitiatory water combined with the expeller [rite], / having sprinkled it according to rule with mantras, he should then bring the kindling sticks.

sanskrit_iast: mathite 'gnau vidhānena śāntyudakena samantrakam | homaṃ kṛtvā yathoktaṃ tu nimittāny upalakṣayet ||
meaning: मथिते ऽग्नौ विधानेन शान्त्युदकेन समन्त्रकम् । होमं कृत्वा यथोक्तं तु निमित्तान्य् उपलक्षयेत् ॥
text_mt: When the fire is churned according to rule, having performed the oblation with propitiatory water / accompanied by mantras as prescribed, he should observe the omens:

sanskrit_iast: meghadundubhinirghoṣaiḥ prajvalan sarvatas tathā | avyavachinnadīrghārciḥ susnigdhaḥ siddhikārakaḥ ||
meaning: मेघदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषैः प्रज्वलन् सर्वतस् तथा । अव्यवछिन्नदीर्घार्चिः सुस्निग्धः सिद्धिकारकः ॥
text_mt: blazing all around with the rumbles of clouds and kettledrums, / with an unbroken, long flame, very smooth, it brings success.

sanskrit_iast: kiṃśukāśokapadmābho nīlotpalanibhas tathā | vahniḥ siddhikaro jñeyaḥ saptarātrān na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning: किंशुकाशोकपद्माभो नीलोत्पलनिभस् तथा । वह्निः सिद्धिकरो ज्ञेयः सप्तरात्रान् न संशयः ॥
text_mt: Resembling the Kiṃśuka, Aśoka, or lotus, or like the blue water-lily, / the fire should be known as bringing success after seven nights, without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast: hutamātre prajvalati vihasann iva dṛśyate | taṃ vidyāt siddhidaṃ vahniṃ padmavarṇanibhaṃ tathā ||
meaning: हुतमात्रे प्रज्वलति विहसन्न् इव दृश्यते । तं विद्यात् सिद्धिदं वह्निं पद्मवर्णनिभं तथा ॥
text_mt: If, as soon as an offering is made, it blazes up and appears as if laughing, / one should know that fire, resembling the color of a lotus, to be a granter of success.

sanskrit_iast: asnigdhārciḥ sadhūmo yaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇo 'pradakṣiṇaḥ | yathoktaviparītas tu na vahniḥ syāt prayaṃkaraḥ ||
meaning: अस्निग्धार्चिः सधूमो यः कृष्णवर्णो ऽप्रदक्षिणः । यथोक्तविपरीतस् तु न वह्निः स्यात् प्रयंकरः ॥
text_mt: That which has a rough flame, is accompanied by smoke, black-colored, and turning counter-clockwise, / being contrary to what has been described, that fire would not produce favor.

sanskrit_iast: yasmin prasannatām eti hūyamāne hutāśane | tatra nityaṃ mahāsiddhir asamāpte vinirdiśet || asamāpte vinirdiśet || iti saṃbhāralakṣaṇaṃ samāptam ||
meaning: यस्मिन् प्रसन्नताम् एति हूयमाने हुताशने । तत्र नित्यं महासिद्धिर् असमाप्ते विनिर्दिशेत् ॥ असमाप्ते विनिर्दिशेत् ॥ इति संभारलक्षणं समाप्तम् ॥
text_mt: When the oblation-devourer becomes clear while the offering is being made, / there one should always declare great success, even before completion. / Even before completion one should declare it. Thus ends the Characteristics of the Sacrificial Materials.

sanskrit_iast: om athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi araṇyoś caiva lakṣaṇam | rūpam athā pramāṇaṃ ca guṇadoṣān tathaiva ca ||
meaning: ओम् अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि अरण्योश् चैव लक्षणम् । रूपम् अथा प्रमाणं च गुणदोषान् तथैव च ॥
text_mt: Oṃ. Now, therefore, I shall proclaim the characteristics of the two kindling sticks, / their appearance, measure, and likewise their virtues and defects.

sanskrit_iast: coditān śabdaśāstreṇa ācāryeṇa tu dhīmatā | purā kalpe ca yad dṛṣṭam ṛṣibhiś caiva lakṣaṇam ||
meaning: चोदितान् शब्दशास्त्रेण आचार्येण तु धीमता । पुरा कल्पे च यद् दृष्टम् ऋषिभिश् चैव लक्षणम् ॥
text_mt: taught by the grammar-science and by the wise teacher, / and the characteristics observed in the ancient kalpa by the ṛṣis.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhyāgniṃ parisaṃgṛhya dharmapatnyā sahaiva tu | vaitānikās tataḥ kuryād ādhānādyā yathoditāḥ ||
meaning: गृह्याग्निं परिसंगृह्य धर्मपत्न्या सहैव तु । वैतानिकास् ततः कुर्याद् आधानाद्या यथोदिताः ॥
text_mt: Having taken up the domestic fire together with his lawful wife, / he should then perform the śrauta rites, beginning with the establishment of the sacred fires, as prescribed.

sanskrit_iast: tithau śubhāyāṃ nakṣatre diśaṃ gatvā tv aninditām | aśvatthāt tu śamīgarbhād uktam āharaṇaṃ śruteḥ ||
meaning: तिथौ शुभायां नक्षत्रे दिशं गत्वा त्व् अनिन्दिताम् । अश्वत्थात् तु शमीगर्भाद् उक्तम् आहरणं श्रुतेः ॥
text_mt: On an auspicious lunar day, under an auspicious lunar mansion, having gone in an unblemished direction, / the procurement [of fire-drill wood] from an aśvattha tree growing within a śamī is prescribed by sacred revelation.

sanskrit_iast: śamīvṛkṣe tu yo 'śvattho nānyavṛkṣeṇa saṃyutaḥ | madhye mūlaṃ na bāhye tu sa garbhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
meaning: शमीवृक्षे तु यो ऽश्वत्थो नान्यवृक्षेण संयुतः । मध्ये मूलं न बाह्ये तु स गर्भः परिकीर्तितः ॥
text_mt: That aśvattha tree which has grown upon a śamī tree, not joined with any other tree, / whose root is in the middle and not on the outside, is proclaimed to be ‘conceived within’ [śamīgarbha].

sanskrit_iast: abhāve tu śamīgarbhe aśvatthād eva vāharet | prāpte caiva śamīgarbhe samāropya visarjayet ||
meaning: अभावे तु शमीगर्भे अश्वत्थाद् एव वाहरेत् । प्राप्ते चैव शमीगर्भे समारोप्य विसर्जयेत् ॥
text_mt: In the absence of a śamīgarbha, one should fetch it from an ordinary aśvattha tree; / but when a śamīgarbha is obtained, having mounted [the fire upon it], one should discard [the old fire-drill].

sanskrit_iast: caturviṃśāṅgulā dīrghā vistareṇa ṣaḍaṅgulā | caturaṅgulocchrayā ca araṇiś cottarāraṇiḥ ||
meaning: चतुर्विंशाङ्गुला दीर्घा विस्तरेण षडङ्गुला । चतुरङ्गुलोच्छ्रया च अरणिश् चोत्तरारणिः ॥
text_mt: The lower fire-drill [araṇi] and the upper fire-drill [uttarāraṇi] / should be twenty-four fingers long, six fingers wide, and four fingers high.

sanskrit_iast: ā skandhād uraso vāpi iti staudāyanaiḥ smṛtā | bāhumātrā devadarśair jājalair ūrumātrikā ||
meaning: आ स्कन्धाद् उरसो वापि इति स्तौदायनैः स्मृता । बाहुमात्रा देवदर्शैर् जाजलैर् ऊरुमात्रिका ॥
text_mt: It is remembered by the Staudāyanas as reaching from the shoulder or from the chest; / it is the length of an arm according to the Devadarśins, and the length of a thigh according to the Jājalas;

sanskrit_iast: cāraṇavaidyair jaṅghe ca maudenāṣṭāṅgulāni ca | jaladāyanair vitastir vā ṣoḍaśeti tu bhārgavaḥ ||
meaning: चारणवैद्यैर् जङ्घे च मौदेनाष्टाङ्गुलानि च । जलदायनैर् वितस्तिर् वा षोडशेति तु भार्गवः ॥
text_mt: according to the Cāraṇavaidyas, the length of the shanks; according to Mauda, eight fingers; / according to the Jaladāyanas, a span; but Bhārgava says sixteen [fingers].

sanskrit_iast: śiraḥpramāṇe nābhau tu caturviṃśatikaiva hi | śaunakādibhir ācāryair etan mānaṃ prakīrtitam ||
meaning: शिरःप्रमाणे नाभौ तु चतुर्विंशतिकैव हि । शौनकादिभिर् आचार्यैर् एतन् मानं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
text_mt: When measured by the head or the navel, it is indeed twenty-four [fingers]; / this measurement is proclaimed by teachers beginning with Śaunaka.

sanskrit_iast: tasyās tu piṇḍaḥ ṣaḍbhāge caturbhāge tu vistare | caturaśrā ca ślakṣṇā ca chidragranthivivarjitā ||
meaning: तस्यास् तु पिण्डः षड्भागे चतुर्भागे तु विस्तरे । चतुरश्रा च श्लक्ष्णा च छिद्रग्रन्थिविवर्जिता ॥
text_mt: Its thickness is six parts, and its width four parts; / it must be rectangular, smooth, and free from holes and knots.

sanskrit_iast: klinnā bhinnāgnisaṃspṛṣṭā sphuṭitā vidyutā hatā | anyaiś ca doṣaiḥ saṃyuktā varjanīyā prayatnataḥ ||
meaning: क्लिन्ना भिन्नाग्निसंस्पृष्टा स्फुटिता विद्युता हता । अन्यैश् च दोषैः संयुक्ता वर्जनीया प्रयत्नतः ॥
text_mt: One that is sodden, split, touched by fire, cracked, struck by lightning, / or accompanied by other defects, should be avoided with effort.

sanskrit_iast: śirogranthir harec cakṣuś chidrā patnīvināśinī | klinnā vināśayet putrān sphuṭitā śokam āvahet ||
meaning: शिरोग्रन्थिर् हरेच् चक्षुश् छिद्रा पत्नीविनाशिनी । क्लिन्ना विनाशयेत् पुत्रान् स्फुटिता शोकम् आवहेत् ॥
text_mt: A knot at the head destroys eyesight; a hole causes the destruction of one's wife; / a sodden one destroys sons; a cracked one brings grief.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvaśuṣke na kartavyā kṛṣṇe rūkṣe tathaiva ca | ubhe apy ekavṛkṣe ca araṇiś cottarāraṇiḥ ||
meaning: ऊर्ध्वशुष्के न कर्तव्या कृष्णे रूक्षे तथैव च । उभे अप्य् एकवृक्षे च अरणिश् चोत्तरारणिः ॥
text_mt: It must not be made from one that is withered at the top, nor from one that is black or brittle; / both the lower fire-drill and the upper fire-drill must come from the same tree.

sanskrit_iast: tatpramāṇā tadardhā vā bhūyasī vā yathecchayā | anenaiva tu manthavyo na kuryād yonisaṃkaram ||
meaning: तत्प्रमाणा तदर्धा वा भूयसी वा यथेच्छया । अनेनैव तु मन्थव्यो न कुर्याद् योनिसंकरम् ॥
text_mt: [The upper fire-drill should be] of that same measure, or half of it, or larger, as one wishes; / he should churn with this alone, and should not make a mixture of fire-sockets [yonisaṃkara].

sanskrit_iast: yonisaṃkarasaṃkīrṇe mahān doṣaḥ prapadyate | sa yajñas tāmaso nāma phalaṃ tatra na vidyate ||
meaning: योनिसंकरसंकीर्णे महान् दोषः प्रपद्यते । स यज्ञस् तामसो नाम फलं तत्र न विद्यते ॥
text_mt: When there is confusion through a mixture of fire-sockets, great harm ensues; / that sacrifice is called tāmasa [ignorant], and no fruit is found therein.

sanskrit_iast: piṇḍe tv ayanaviṣuvau pṛthutve ṛtavaḥ sthitāḥ | ardhamāsāś ca dīrghatve kālaś cātra pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
meaning: पिण्डे त्व् अयनविषुवौ पृथुत्वे ऋतवः स्थिताः । अर्धमासाश् च दीर्घत्वे कालश् चात्र प्रतिष्ठितः ॥
text_mt: The two solstices and equinoxes reside in its thickness, the seasons in its width, / and the fortnights in its length; Time itself is established herein.

sanskrit_iast: yajamāno 'raṇir iti vadanty eke vipaścitaḥ | tatpradhānāḥ kriyāḥ sarvā yajñaś cāpi tathaiva hi ||
meaning: यजमानो ऽरणिर् इति वदन्त्य् एके विपश्चितः । तत्प्रधानाः क्रियाः सर्वा यज्ञश् चापि तथैव हि ॥
text_mt: Some wise men say that the fire-drill is the sacrificer himself; / for all rites are centered on him, and the sacrifice likewise.

sanskrit_iast: prathame mūlaṣaḍbhāge pādau jaṅgheti kīrtyate | dvitīye jānunī ūrū tṛtīye śroṇir ucyate ||
meaning: प्रथमे मूलषड्भागे पादौ जङ्घेति कीर्त्यते । द्वितीये जानुनी ऊरू तृतीये श्रोणिर् उच्यते ॥
text_mt: In the first sixth-part at the base, it is spoken of as feet and shanks; / in the second, knees and thighs; in the third, the hips are spoken of;

sanskrit_iast: caturthe jaṭharaṃ sāṅgaṃ grīvā caiva tu pañcame | ṣaṣthe śiraḥ samākhyātam aṅgāny etāni nirdiśet ||
meaning: चतुर्थे जठरं साङ्गं ग्रीवा चैव तु पञ्चमे । षष्थे शिरः समाख्यातम् अङ्गान्य् एतानि निर्दिशेत् ॥
text_mt: in the fourth, the belly together with its limbs; in the fifth, the neck; / and in the sixth, the head is declared: one should designate these limbs.

sanskrit_iast: mathite pādajaṅghe ca piśācaḥ saṃprajāyate | jānunoś ca tathā corvo rākṣastvaṃ prayāti hi ||
meaning: मथिते पादजङ्घे च पिशाचः संप्रजायते । जानुनोश् च तथा चोर्वो राक्षस्त्वं प्रयाति हि ॥
text_mt: If it is churned at the feet and shanks, a piśāca is born; / and at the knees and thighs, it leads to the state of a rākṣasa;

sanskrit_iast: śroṇyāṃ ca sarvakāmāḥ syur jaṭhare kṣut tathā smṛtā | urasy amitrā grīvāyāṃ mṛtyuḥ śirasi vedanā ||
meaning: श्रोण्यां च सर्वकामाः स्युर् जठरे क्षुत् तथा स्मृता । उरस्य् अमित्रा ग्रीवायां मृत्युः शिरसि वेदना ॥
text_mt: at the hips, all desires are fulfilled; at the belly, hunger is remembered; / at the chest, enemies [arise]; at the neck, death; at the head, affliction.

sanskrit_iast: śroṇyām evāta aicchanti nirdoṣā kīrtitā yataḥ | tathā vittapaśūn putrān svargam āyuḥ priyaṃ sukham ||
meaning: श्रोण्याम् एवात ऐच्छन्ति निर्दोषा कीर्तिता यतः । तथा वित्तपशून् पुत्रान् स्वर्गम् आयुः प्रियं सुखम् ॥
text_mt: Therefore they desire [it to be churned] only at the hips, because that is declared faultless; / likewise wealth, cattle, sons, heaven, long life, what is dear, and happiness [are gained].

sanskrit_iast: prathamaṃ manthanaṃ śroṇyām ādhāne ca viśeṣataḥ | itarāṇi yatheṣtaṃ hi grīvāṃ sarvatra varjayet ||
meaning: प्रथमं मन्थनं श्रोण्याम् आधाने च विशेषतः । इतराणि यथेष्तं हि ग्रीवां सर्वत्र वर्जयेत् ॥
text_mt: The first churning is at the hips, especially during the establishment of the sacred fires; / others may be performed as desired, but one should avoid the neck everywhere.

sanskrit_iast: trīṇy aṅgulāni tyaktvādau tathā catvāri cāntataḥ | madhye devāḥ sthitās tasmād vahniṃ tatraiva manthayet ||
meaning: त्रीण्य् अङ्गुलानि त्यक्त्वादौ तथा चत्वारि चान्ततः । मध्ये देवाः स्थितास् तस्माद् वह्निं तत्रैव मन्थयेत् ॥
text_mt: Having left three fingers at the start and likewise four at the end, / the gods reside in the middle; therefore one should churn fire right there.

sanskrit_iast: anulomā bhaved yoniḥ pārśvabhedo na vidyate | ānulomyena mathitaḥ sarvān kāmān prayacchati ||
meaning: अनुलोमा भवेद् योनिः पार्श्वभेदो न विद्यते । आनुलोम्येन मथितः सर्वान् कामान् प्रयच्छति ॥
text_mt: The fire-socket must follow the natural grain; there must be no split along the side; / churned in accordance with the grain, it grants all desires.

sanskrit_iast: mūlād aṅgulam utsṛjya trīṇitrīṇi ca pārśvayoḥ | devayonis tu vijñeyā tatra mathyo hutāśanaḥ ||
meaning: मूलाद् अङ्गुलम् उत्सृज्य त्रीणित्रीणि च पार्श्वयोः । देवयोनिस् तु विज्ञेया तत्र मथ्यो हुताशनः ॥
text_mt: Leaving one finger from the base, and three on each of the two sides, / that is to be known as the divine fire-socket; there the consumer of oblations should be churned.

sanskrit_iast: mūlāt tyaktvāṅgulāny aṣṭau agrāt tu dvādaśaiva hi | antare devayoniḥ syāt tatra mathyo hutāśanaḥ ||
meaning: मूलात् त्यक्त्वाङ्गुलान्य् अष्टौ अग्रात् तु द्वादशैव हि । अन्तरे देवयोनिः स्यात् तत्र मथ्यो हुताशनः ॥
text_mt: [Leaving eight fingers from the base, and twelve from the top, / the divine fire-socket will be in between; there the consumer of oblations should be churned.]

sanskrit_iast: vedā yajñāya saṃbhūtā yajñā agnau pratiṣṭhitāḥ | araṇyor jāyate cāgnis tayos tasmāt pradhānatā ||
meaning: वेदा यज्ञाय संभूता यज्ञा अग्नौ प्रतिष्ठिताः । अरण्योर् जायते चाग्निस् तयोस् तस्मात् प्रधानता ॥
text_mt: The Vedas arose for sacrifice; sacrifices are grounded in fire; / and fire is born from the two fire-drills; therefore the two have preeminence.

sanskrit_iast: araṇyardhena caiva syuḥ khādirau cātrapīḍakau | netraṃ tu ṣaḍguṇaṃ cātrād uttaro 'ṣṭāṅgulaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning: अरण्यर्धेन चैव स्युः खादिरौ चात्रपीडकौ । नेत्रं तु षड्गुणं चात्राद् उत्तरो ऽष्टाङ्गुलः स्मृतः ॥
text_mt: The spindle [cātra] and the drill-rest [pīḍaka] should be half the size of the fire-drill and made of khadira wood; / the churning-cord [netra] should be sixfold the spindle; the upper piece [uttara] is remembered as eight fingers.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭāṅgulaḥ pramanthaḥ syāc cātraṃ syād dvādaśāṅgulam | ovīlī dvādaśāṅgulā eṣa yajñavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning: अष्टाङ्गुलः प्रमन्थः स्याच् चात्रं स्याद् द्वादशाङ्गुलम् । ओवीली द्वादशाङ्गुला एष यज्ञविधिः स्मृतः ॥
text_mt: The fire-drill peg [pramantha] should be eight fingers; the spindle should be twelve fingers; / the cross-bar [ovīlī] should be twelve fingers: this is remembered as the sacrificial rule.

sanskrit_iast: vyāmamantraṃ vadanty eke anye hastatrayaṃ viduḥ | trivṛtaṃ muṣṭisaṃyuktaṃ yajñavṛkṣajavalkalaiḥ ||
meaning: व्याममन्त्रं वदन्त्य् एके अन्ये हस्तत्रयं विदुः । त्रिवृतं मुष्टिसंयुक्तं यज्ञवृक्षजवल्कलैः ॥
text_mt: Some call the churning-cord a fathom in length; others know it as three cubits, / three-stranded, furnished with a handgrip, made from the bark of sacrificial trees.

sanskrit_iast: cātre ca bhāskarāḥ proktā uttare vasavas tathā | netre devagaṇāḥ sarve viṣṇuś caiva tu pīḍake ||
meaning: चात्रे च भास्कराः प्रोक्ता उत्तरे वसवस् तथा । नेत्रे देवगणाः सर्वे विष्णुश् चैव तु पीडके ॥
text_mt: The sun gods are declared to reside in the spindle, likewise the Vasus in the upper piece, / all the hosts of gods in the churning-cord, and Viṣṇu in the drill-rest.

sanskrit_iast: araṇir yā dvitīyā tu uttarā sā prakīrtitā | tatraikadeśaṃ saṃgṛhya uttaraḥ sa ca kīrtitaḥ ||
meaning: अरणिर् या द्वितीया तु उत्तरा सा प्रकीर्तिता । तत्रैकदेशं संगृह्य उत्तरः स च कीर्तितः ॥
text_mt: The one that is the second fire-drill is proclaimed as the upper fire-drill; / having taken a single portion thereof, it is called the upper piece [uttara].

sanskrit_iast: prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vāpi bhrāmakaḥ paścimāmukhaḥ | pāṇibhyāṃ pīḍanaṃ śubhram uttarāgraṃ pragṛhya tu ||
meaning: प्राङ्मुखोदङ्मुखो वापि भ्रामकः पश्चिमामुखः । पाणिभ्यां पीडनं शुभ्रम् उत्तराग्रं प्रगृह्य तु ॥
text_mt: Facing east or facing north, the turner should face west; / grasping the clean drill-rest with both hands, with its tip facing north,

sanskrit_iast: mūle mūlaṃ tu saṃyojya cātrasyaivottarasya ca | araṇyupari saṃsthāpya pīḍakena tu pīḍayed ||
meaning: मूले मूलं तु संयोज्य चात्रस्यैवोत्तरस्य च । अरण्युपरि संस्थाप्य पीडकेन तु पीडयेद् ॥
text_mt: joining the base of the spindle to the base of the upper piece, / placing it upon the lower fire-drill, he should press it down with the drill-rest.

sanskrit_iast: netreṇa bhrāmayec cātraṃ yāvad vahniḥ prajāyate | sarvair hi devaiḥ saṃpannas tena sarvasukhaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning: नेत्रेण भ्रामयेच् चात्रं यावद् वह्निः प्रजायते । सर्वैर् हि देवैः संपन्नस् तेन सर्वसुखः स्मृतः ॥
text_mt: With the churning-cord he should rotate the spindle until fire is produced; / endowed with all the gods, it is therefore remembered as bringing all happiness.

sanskrit_iast: brahmādyair daivataiś caiva vidvadbhiś ca tapodhanaiḥ | eṣa yantraprayogas tu dṛṣṭo yajñārthahetubhiḥ ||
meaning: ब्रह्माद्यैर् दैवतैश् चैव विद्वद्भिश् च तपोधनैः । एष यन्त्रप्रयोगस् तु दृष्टो यज्ञार्थहेतुभिः ॥
text_mt: By deities beginning with Brahmā, by the learned, and by those rich in asceticism, / this mechanical application was seen for the purpose of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: yajamānena manthavyaḥ svaśākhāśrotriyeṇa vā | tanmantrena dvijāgryair vā smṛtam etad dhi manthanam ||
meaning: यजमानेन मन्थव्यः स्वशाखाश्रोत्रियेण वा । तन्मन्त्रेन द्विजाग्र्यैर् वा स्मृतम् एतद् धि मन्थनम् ॥
text_mt: It should be churned by the sacrificer, or by a Vedic scholar of his own school, / with its mantra, or by foremost twice-born men; for such is the churning remembered.

sanskrit_iast: atha yady araṇī jīrṇe syātāṃ jantubhir manthanena vā || samānīte nave araṇī āhṛtya śve bhūte darśenāṣṭvā tasmin pūrve śakalīkṛtya gārhapatye prakṣipyopary agnau dhārayan japati ||
meaning: अथ यद्य् अरणी जीर्णे स्यातां जन्तुभिर् मन्थनेन वा ॥ समानीते नवे अरणी आहृत्य श्वे भूते दर्शेनाष्ट्वा तस्मिन् पूर्वे शकलीकृत्य गार्हपत्ये प्रक्षिप्योपर्य् अग्नौ धारयन् जपति ॥
text_mt: Now, if the two fire-drills should become worn out by worms or by churning, / when two new fire-drills have been brought, on the following day, having sacrificed with the new-moon rite, having reduced the previous [fire-drill] to chips and thrown it into the gārhapatya fire, holding [the new one] over the fire, he recites:

sanskrit_iast: ud budhyasvāgne pra viśasya yonyāṃ devayajyāyai voḍhave jātavedaḥ | araṇyor araṇī saṃ carasva jīrṇāṃ tvacam ajīrṇayā nir ṇudasvety
meaning: उद् बुध्यस्वाग्ने प्र विशस्य योन्यां देवयज्यायै वोढवे जातवेदः । अरण्योर् अरणी सं चरस्व जीर्णां त्वचम् अजीर्णया निर् णुदस्वेत्य्
text_mt: ‘Awake, O Fire, enter into this fire-socket to bear [the offering] for divine worship, O Jātavedas; / move between the two fire-drills; cast off the old skin with the unaged one!’

sanskrit_iast: ājyaṃ saṃskṛtyāhavanīye manasvatīṃ juhoti || putrārthī śrāvayet ||
meaning: आज्यं संस्कृत्याहवनीये मनस्वतीं जुहोति ॥ पुत्रार्थी श्रावयेत् ॥
text_mt: Having consecrated clarified butter, he offers the manasvatī libation into the āhavanīya fire. [One seeking a son should have this recited].

sanskrit_iast: mano jyotir juṣatām ājyasya vichinnaṃ yajñaṃ sam imaṃ dadhātu | yā iṣṭā uṣaso yā aniṣṭās tāḥ saṃ cinomi haviṣā ghṛtena svāheti agnaye 'gnimate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapati || śarāv odanaṃ sadakṣiṇaṃ dadāti || sā prakṛteṣtiḥ saṃgṛhyate ||
meaning: मनो ज्योतिर् जुषताम् आज्यस्य विछिन्नं यज्ञं सम् इमं दधातु । या इष्टा उषसो या अनिष्टास् ताः सं चिनोमि हविषा घृतेन स्वाहेति अग्नये ऽग्निमते ऽष्टाकपालं पुरोडाशं निर्वपति ॥ शराव् ओदनं सदक्षिणं ददाति ॥ सा प्रकृतेष्तिः संगृह्यते ॥
text_mt: ‘May the mind-light enjoy the clarified butter; may it join together this broken sacrifice; / whatever dawns have been sacrificed to and whatever have not, those I gather together with oblation and ghee, svāhā!’ He offers an eight-pot-sherd cake to Agni Fire-possessing. He gives a bowl of boiled rice with a sacrificial fee. That basic sacrifice is concluded.

sanskrit_iast: prasaṅgenaiva kathitam agnimanthanam atra vai | araṇyoś cāṅgasaṃbhūtaṃ netraṃ cātraṃ ca pīḍakaḥ ||
meaning: प्रसङ्गेनैव कथितम् अग्निमन्थनम् अत्र वै । अरण्योश् चाङ्गसंभूतं नेत्रं चात्रं च पीडकः ॥
text_mt: In this context, the churning of fire has indeed been explained in passing, / along with the parts that arise from the two fire-drills: the churning-cord, spindle, and drill-rest.

sanskrit_iast: ya idaṃ dhārayiṣyati araṇyor iha lakṣaṇam | na tasya durlabhaṃ kiṃ cid loke paratra ca ||
meaning: य इदं धारयिष्यति अरण्योर् इह लक्षणम् । न तस्य दुर्लभं किं चिद् लोके परत्र च ॥
text_mt: Whoever will retain this characteristic of the two fire-drills here, / nothing is difficult for him to obtain in this world or in the next.

sanskrit_iast: putrārthī śrāvayen nityam acirāl labhate sutam | śrutaśīlaṃ vṛttavantaṃ dīrghāyur vipulāṃ prajām ||
meaning: पुत्रार्थी श्रावयेन् नित्यम् अचिराल् लभते सुतम् । श्रुतशीलं वृत्तवन्तं दीर्घायुर् विपुलां प्रजाम् ॥
text_mt: One desiring a son should recite it regularly; before long he obtains a son / endowed with learning and virtue, of good conduct, long-lived, and abundant offspring.

sanskrit_iast: etad evaṃ samākhyātaṃ pippalādena dhīmatā | dvijānāṃ bālavṛddhānāṃ puraścaraṇam uttamam ||
meaning: एतद् एवं समाख्यातं पिप्पलादेन धीमता । द्विजानां बालवृद्धानां पुरश्चरणम् उत्तमम् ॥
text_mt: Thus has this been explained by the wise Pippalāda; / it is the highest preliminary observance for twice-born men, both young and old.

sanskrit_iast: adhītyaitac ca dehānte paraṃ brahmādhigacchati | na tasya mṛtyur na jarā nidrā vyādhir na caiva hi | kṣutpipāsābhayaṃ nāsti brahmabhūtaḥ sa tiṣṭhati ||
meaning: अधीत्यैतच् च देहान्ते परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति । न तस्य मृत्युर् न जरा निद्रा व्याधिर् न चैव हि । क्षुत्पिपासाभयं नास्ति ब्रह्मभूतः स तिष्ठति ॥
text_mt: Having studied this, at the end of the body he attains the supreme Brahman; / for him there is neither death nor old age, nor sleep, nor disease; / there is no fear of hunger or thirst; he abides having become Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: om athāto yajñapātrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yonir eva ca | rūpaṃ tathā pramāṇaṃ ca kramenaiva prakathyate ||
meaning: ओम् अथातो यज्ञपात्राणां लक्षणं योनिर् एव च । रूपं तथा प्रमाणं च क्रमेनैव प्रकथ्यते ॥
text_mt: Om. Now therefore the characteristics, origin, / form, and dimensions of the sacrificial vessels are proclaimed in proper order.

sanskrit_iast: camasagrahapātrāṇi homapātrāṇi yāni ca | yajñavṛkṣās tathā śākhā brahmavede pradarśitāḥ ||
meaning: चमसग्रहपात्राणि होमपात्राणि यानि च । यज्ञवृक्षास् तथा शाखा ब्रह्मवेदे प्रदर्शिताः ॥
text_mt: The cup-vessels and scoop-vessels, and whichever are the offering-vessels, / as well as sacrificial trees and branches, are taught in the Brahmaveda.

sanskrit_iast: pitṛpiṇḍeṣu darvyādyam agniṣvāttaṃ ca yājñikam | sāyaṃhomeṣu nityāni tathā naimittikāni ca ||
meaning: पितृपिण्डेषु दर्व्याद्यम् अग्निष्वात्तं च याज्ञिकम् । सायंहोमेषु नित्यानि तथा नैमित्तिकानि च ॥
text_mt: For ancestral food-balls the ladle and so forth, both the Agniṣvātta ancestral rites and sacrificial rites, / and in the evening offerings, both regular and occasional rites [are prescribed].

sanskrit_iast: bilvākṛtiś caruḥ proktas tāmro vā mṛnmayo 'pi vā | grīvāyāṃ mukhavistīrṇaś carusthālīti kīrttitaḥ ||
meaning: बिल्वाकृतिश् चरुः प्रोक्तस् ताम्रो वा मृन्मयो ऽपि वा । ग्रीवायां मुखविस्तीर्णश् चरुस्थालीति कीर्त्तितः ॥
text_mt: The caru is declared to have the shape of a bilva fruit, either of copper or made of clay; / wide at the neck and opening, it is known as the caru-pot.

sanskrit_iast: kuśasyāmrasya vā parṇair veṇor vā balbajasya vā | catuṣkoṇārdhavītaṃ ca loke śūrpaṃ tad ucyate ||
meaning: कुशस्याम्रस्य वा पर्णैर् वेणोर् वा बल्बजस्य वा । चतुष्कोणार्धवीतं च लोके शूर्पं तद् उच्यते ॥
text_mt: Made from the leaves of kuśa or mango, or from bamboo or balbaja grass, / having four corners and half-woven, it is called a winnowing basket in worldly practice.

sanskrit_iast: asiḥ khaḍgaṃ ca nistriṃśaḥ paryāyāḥ parikīrttitāḥ | tadākṛṭy eva yad rūpaṃ yajñe sphyaṃ ca vadanti tam ||
meaning: असिः खड्गं च निस्त्रिंशः पर्यायाः परिकीर्त्तिताः । तदाकृट्य् एव यद् रूपं यज्ञे स्फ्यं च वदन्ति तम् ॥
text_mt: Sword, scimitar, and curved blade are proclaimed as synonyms; / whatever form has such a shape, that they call the sacrificial wooden sword in ritual.

sanskrit_iast: idhmocchrayam ardhakhātaṃ khātenaiva tu vistaraḥ | madhye hīnaṃ tathordhvāgraṃ vāraṇaṃ tad ulūkhalam ||
meaning: इध्मोच्छ्रयम् अर्धखातं खातेनैव तु विस्तरः । मध्ये हीनं तथोर्ध्वाग्रं वारणं तद् उलूखलम् ॥
text_mt: Having the height of sacrificial fuel, half hollowed out, its width being equal to the hollow, / narrow in the middle, and top-ended, that mortar is made of varaṇa wood.

sanskrit_iast: sthūlatvān muṣṭimātraṃ ca skandhamātraṃ pramāṇataḥ | vāraṇaṃ musalaṃ caiva adhastāl lohaveṣṭitam ||
meaning: स्थूलत्वान् मुष्टिमात्रं च स्कन्धमात्रं प्रमाणतः । वारणं मुसलं चैव अधस्ताल् लोहवेष्टितम् ॥
text_mt: In thickness the measure of a fist, and in length reaching the shoulder, / the pestle is also made of varaṇa wood, bound with iron at the bottom.

sanskrit_iast: sruvas tu mūladaṇḍaś ca bilaṃ cāṅguṣṭhaparvaṇaḥ | samavete pṛthagbhūte bilārdhe daṇḍavṛttatā ||
meaning: स्रुवस् तु मूलदण्डश् च बिलं चाङ्गुष्ठपर्वणः । समवेते पृथग्भूते बिलार्धे दण्डवृत्तता ॥
text_mt: The sruva ladle has a handle made from the root, and its bowl is the size of the thumb's phalanx; / joined together or separate, the handle is round along half the bowl.

sanskrit_iast: vaikaṅkatī dhruvā proktā sarvayajñeṣu yā smṛtā | tathāgnihotrahavaṇī sruvaś cāpi tathā smṛtaḥ ||
meaning: वैकङ्कती ध्रुवा प्रोक्ता सर्वयज्ञेषु या स्मृता । तथाग्निहोत्रहवणी स्रुवश् चापि तथा स्मृतः ॥
text_mt: The dhruvā ladle is declared to be made of vikaṅkata wood, as traditionally remembered in all sacrifices; / likewise the Agnihotra ladle, and the sruva ladle is also traditionally remembered thus.

sanskrit_iast: mūladaṇḍā tvagbilā ca puṣkaraṃ caturaṅgulam | puṣkarād dviguṇaṃ cāgraṃ gajoṣṭhaṃ paripaṭhyate ||
meaning: मूलदण्डा त्वग्बिला च पुष्करं चतुरङ्गुलम् । पुष्कराद् द्विगुणं चाग्रं गजोष्ठं परिपठ्यते ॥
text_mt: With handle from the root and bowl with skin, the bowl's basin is four finger-breadths; / twice the basin is the front, which is recited as [shaped like] an elephant's lip.

sanskrit_iast: netrādikaraṇair hīnaṃ nāsikābhyāṃ dvijais tathā | dvyaṅgulaḥ khātā ca bilād aṅgulaṃ caiva piṇḍikā | vṛttā vā caturaśrā vā sādhastāc chobhanā smṛtā ||
meaning: नेत्रादिकरणैर् हीनं नासिकाभ्यां द्विजैस् तथा । द्व्यङ्गुलः खाता च बिलाद् अङ्गुलं चैव पिण्डिका । वृत्ता वा चतुरश्रा वा साधस्ताच् छोभना स्मृता ॥
text_mt: [Lacking organs such as eyes, two nostrils, likewise by the twice-born; / two finger-breadths deep from the bowl, and a pedestal of one finger-breadth; / whether round or four-sided, beneath it is considered auspicious.]

sanskrit_iast: ardhāṅgulaṃ pṛthutvena bilabāhyaṃ samantataḥ | bilaṃ vṛttaṃ sruco madhye daṇḍasthaulyaṃ bilārdhataḥ ||
meaning: अर्धाङ्गुलं पृथुत्वेन बिलबाह्यं समन्ततः । बिलं वृत्तं स्रुचो मध्ये दण्डस्थौल्यं बिलार्धतः ॥
text_mt: Half a finger-breadth in width all around the outside of the bowl; / the bowl is round in the middle of the sruk ladle; the thickness of the handle is half the bowl.

sanskrit_iast: caturviṃśatyaṅgulaṃ daṇḍaṃ vadanty eke manīṣiṇaḥ | saptatriṃśad aṅgulāni sā sruk caiva prakīrtitā ||
meaning: चतुर्विंशत्यङ्गुलं दण्डं वदन्त्य् एके मनीषिणः । सप्तत्रिंशद् अङ्गुलानि सा स्रुक् चैव प्रकीर्तिता ॥
text_mt: Some wise men say the handle is twenty-four finger-breadths; / that sruk ladle is proclaimed to be thirty-seven finger-breadths [in all].

sanskrit_iast: bhinnā viśīrṇā vakrā ca klinnā ca sphuṭitā tathā | suṣirā granthibhir yuktā cakṣurādivināśinī ||
meaning: भिन्ना विशीर्णा वक्रा च क्लिन्ना च स्फुटिता तथा । सुषिरा ग्रन्थिभिर् युक्ता चक्षुरादिविनाशिनी ॥
text_mt: Broken, shattered, crooked, moist, split, / hollow, or having knots, it destroys the eyes and other [faculties].

sanskrit_iast: dagdhaśeṣe 'rdhaśuṣke ca vidyutā caiva pātite | unmūlye patite bhagne manasāpi na cintayet ||
meaning: दग्धशेषे ऽर्धशुष्के च विद्युता चैव पातिते । उन्मूल्ये पतिते भग्ने मनसापि न चिन्तयेत् ॥
text_mt: If charred, half-dried, felled by lightning, / uprooted, fallen, or broken, one should not even mentally contemplate [using it].

sanskrit_iast: śubhanakṣatrātithiṣu śubhāṃ gatvā diśaṃ budhaḥ | sruvārthaṃ pātayed vṛkṣaṃ prātaḥ prāgraṃ ca saumyavāk ||
meaning: शुभनक्षत्रातिथिषु शुभां गत्वा दिशं बुधः । स्रुवार्थं पातयेद् वृक्षं प्रातः प्राग्रं च सौम्यवाक् ॥
text_mt: Under auspicious lunar mansions and lunar days, having gone in an auspicious direction, the wise man, / speaking gently, should fell the tree in the morning, falling eastward, for the sake of the sruva ladle.

sanskrit_iast: mṛgo hariṇaruruś ca kṛṣṇapṛṣṭhaśiras tathā | yat tasya carma tvak caiva tat kṛṣṇājinam ucyate ||
meaning: मृगो हरिणरुरुश् च कृष्णपृष्ठशिरस् तथा । यत् तस्य चर्म त्वक् चैव तत् कृष्णाजिनम् उच्यते ॥
text_mt: The deer is the spotted antelope or the ruru deer, with black back and head; / whatever is its hide and skin, that is called the black-antelope skin.

sanskrit_iast: vāmamuṣṭigṛhītās tu prachidyante sakṛt kuśāḥ | paraśunāsinā vā tat sakṛdāchinnam ucyate ||
meaning: वाममुष्टिगृहीतास् तु प्रछिद्यन्ते सकृत् कुशाः । परशुनासिना वा तत् सकृदाछिन्नम् उच्यते ॥
text_mt: Grasped with the left fist, the kuśa grasses are cut off at a single stroke; / with an axe or a sword, that is called 'severed at a single stroke'.

sanskrit_iast: aṅguṣṭhaparvāgramukhaṃ darvyākṛti tu mekṣaṇam | vaikaṅkate pālāśe vā prādeśas tu pramāṇataḥ ||
meaning: अङ्गुष्ठपर्वाग्रमुखं दर्व्याकृति तु मेक्षणम् । वैकङ्कते पालाशे वा प्रादेशस् तु प्रमाणतः ॥
text_mt: With its tip shaped like a thumb's phalanx and having the form of a ladle, the stirring-stick / is made of vikaṅkata or palāśa wood, and a span in measure.

sanskrit_iast: alābu vaiṇavaṃ vāpi dārvyaṃ vaiṇavam eva vā | akṣāv amaṇḍalau proktau yathā dṛṣṭaṃ pura rṣibhiḥ ||
meaning: अलाबु वैणवं वापि दार्व्यं वैणवम् एव वा । अक्षाव् अमण्डलौ प्रोक्तौ यथा दृष्टं पुर र्षिभिः ॥
text_mt: Made of bottle-gourd or bamboo, or of wood or bamboo, / the two axles are declared unbent, as seen anciently by the seers.

sanskrit_iast: cakrābhyāṃ kāṣṭhasaṃghātaiḥ śilpibhiś caiva yat kṛtam | loke prasiddhaṃ śakaṭam agniṣṭhaṃ yājñike vidhau ||
meaning: चक्राभ्यां काष्ठसंघातैः शिल्पिभिश् चैव यत् कृतम् । लोके प्रसिद्धं शकटम् अग्निष्ठं याज्ञिके विधौ ॥
text_mt: What is made with two wheels and collections of timber by artisans, / well known in worldly life as a cart, is placed near the fire in sacrificial procedure.

sanskrit_iast: ājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ vijānīyān navanītaṃ susaṃskṛtam | sauvīrādy añjanaṃ caiva atha vā daivikaṃ tathā ||
meaning: आज्यं घृतं विजानीयान् नवनीतं सुसंस्कृतम् । सौवीराद्य् अञ्जनं चैव अथ वा दैविकं तथा ॥
text_mt: One should know sacrificial butter to be ghee, well-clarified fresh butter; / collyrium made of antimony and so forth, or else intended for divine rites;

sanskrit_iast: abhyañjanaṃ ca tat praktaṃ tilatailaṃ ca yad viduḥ | āsanaṃ kaśipu proktaṃ kāyasthaṃ copabarhaṇam ||
meaning: अभ्यञ्जनं च तत् प्रक्तं तिलतैलं च यद् विदुः । आसनं कशिपु प्रोक्तं कायस्थं चोपबर्हणम् ॥
text_mt: And that anointing is proclaimed to be sesame oil, as they know it; / the mat is called kaśipu, and a pillow is for the body.

sanskrit_iast: yavodarair aṣṭabhis tu aṅgulaṃ paripaṭhyate | carutviṃśatyaṅgulaṃ tu yājñikair hasta ākṛtaḥ ||
meaning: यवोदरैर् अष्टभिस् तु अङ्गुलं परिपठ्यते । चरुत्विंशत्यङ्गुलं तु याज्ञिकैर् हस्त आकृतः ॥
text_mt: By eight barley-belly widths a finger-breadth is reckoned; / twenty-four finger-breadths is fashioned as a cubit by ritualists.

sanskrit_iast: hastamātraṃ sruvaḥ khaḍgaṃ sakṛdāchinnam eva ca | bāhumātrā juhūḥ proktā dhruvā barhis tathaiva ca ||
meaning: हस्तमात्रं स्रुवः खड्गं सकृदाछिन्नम् एव च । बाहुमात्रा जुहूः प्रोक्ता ध्रुवा बर्हिस् तथैव च ॥
text_mt: A cubit in measure is the sruva ladle, the wooden sword, and the grass severed at a single stroke; / the juhū ladle is declared to be an arm's length, and likewise the dhruvā ladle and the sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: tāmraś caiva sruvaḥ proktaḥ khaḍgaṃ khādiram eva ca | pālāśī ca juhūḥ kāryā idhmāś caiva viśeṣataḥ ||
meaning: ताम्रश् चैव स्रुवः प्रोक्तः खड्गं खादिरम् एव च । पालाशी च जुहूः कार्या इध्माश् चैव विशेषतः ॥
text_mt: The sruva ladle is proclaimed to be copper, and the wooden sword of khadira wood; / the juhū ladle should be made of palāśa wood, and sacrificial fuels especially so.

sanskrit_iast: grahāḥ pātrāṇi camasā daṇḍayūpāsanāni ca | vṛkṣeṣu yājñikeṣu syur yathālābheṣu nānyataḥ ||
meaning: ग्रहाः पात्राणि चमसा दण्डयूपासनानि च । वृक्षेषु याज्ञिकेषु स्युर् यथालाभेषु नान्यतः ॥
text_mt: The scoops, vessels, cups, staff, sacrificial post, and seats / should be made from sacrificial trees, as available, and not from any others.

sanskrit_iast: samidhaḥ prādeśamātryo nityahome prakīrtitāḥ | samillakṣaṇadṛṣṭāni pramāṇāni yathākramam ||
meaning: समिधः प्रादेशमात्र्यो नित्यहोमे प्रकीर्तिताः । समिल्लक्षणदृष्टानि प्रमाणानि यथाक्रमम् ॥
text_mt: Kindling-sticks are proclaimed to be the measure of a span for the daily offering; / the measures observed in the characteristics of kindling-sticks are according to order:

sanskrit_iast: śamy aśvatthaḥ palāśaś ca khādiro 'tha vikaṅkataḥ | kāśmaryodumbaro bilvo yajñavṛkṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
meaning: शम्य् अश्वत्थः पलाशश् च खादिरो ऽथ विकङ्कतः । काश्मर्योदुम्बरो बिल्वो यज्ञवृक्षाः प्रकीर्तिताः ॥
text_mt: Śamī, aśvattha, palāśa, khadira, then vikaṅkata, / kāśmarya, udumbara, and bilva are proclaimed as sacrificial trees.

sanskrit_iast: eṣām alābhe vṛkṣāṇām anye grāhyās tu yājñikaiḥ | yajñāṅgakārye draṣṭavyāḥ samidarthaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
meaning: एषाम् अलाभे वृक्षाणाम् अन्ये ग्राह्यास् तु याज्ञिकैः । यज्ञाङ्गकार्ये द्रष्टव्याः समिदर्थं विशेषतः ॥
text_mt: If these trees are unavailable, others may be taken by ritualists; / they are to be considered for ritual functions, especially for the purpose of kindling-sticks.

sanskrit_iast: yavavrīhimahāvrīhiprayaṅgūṇāṃ hi taṇḍulāḥ | śyāmākataṇḍulatilā āsādyāḥ śruticoditāḥ ||
meaning: यवव्रीहिमहाव्रीहिप्रयङ्गूणां हि तण्डुलाः । श्यामाकतण्डुलतिला आसाद्याः श्रुतिचोदिताः ॥
text_mt: Grains of barley, rice, large rice, and Italian millet, / grains of wild rice, and sesame seeds are to be procured as enjoined by scripture.

sanskrit_iast: sāyaṃhomeṣu yad dravyaṃ prātarhomeṣu tad bhavet | bhinnadravyahutaṃ yat tu na hutaṃ tasya tad bhavet ||
meaning: सायंहोमेषु यद् द्रव्यं प्रातर्होमेषु तद् भवेत् । भिन्नद्रव्यहुतं यत् तु न हुतं तस्य तद् भवेत् ॥
text_mt: Whatever substance is used in the evening offerings, that should be used in the morning offerings; / but that which is offered with different substances is considered not offered.

sanskrit_iast: udite 'nudite caiva samayādhyuṣite tathā | kṣudhākāle tathāpy keke pakṣahomaṃ tu kārayet ||
meaning: उदिते ऽनुदिते चैव समयाध्युषिते तथा । क्षुधाकाले तथाप्य् केके पक्षहोमं तु कारयेत् ॥
text_mt: When [the sun] has risen, before it has risen, or when it has passed the twilight boundary, / or at the time of hunger, according to some, one should perform the fortnightly offering.

sanskrit_iast: yāyāvarāṇāṃ munibhiḥ pakṣahomas tu taiḥ smṛtaḥ | yathā kathaṃ cid vacanaṃ śrutyuktaṃ dvija ācāret ||
meaning: यायावराणां मुनिभिः पक्षहोमस् तु तैः स्मृतः । यथा कथं चिद् वचनं श्रुत्युक्तं द्विज आचारेत् ॥
text_mt: The fortnightly offering is remembered by the sages for wandering mendicants; / somehow or other the twice-born should perform the declaration spoken in scripture.

sanskrit_iast: āturaḥ pathikaś caiva rājopadravapīḍitaḥ | pakṣahomaṃ tadā kuryān nistīrya satataṃ caret ||
meaning: आतुरः पथिकश् चैव राजोपद्रवपीडितः । पक्षहोमं तदा कुर्यान् निस्तीर्य सततं चरेत् ॥
text_mt: When sick, on a journey, or oppressed by royal trouble, / one may then perform the fortnightly offering; having crossed over [the danger], he should practice regularly.

sanskrit_iast: caturdaśagṛhītaṃ tu sakṛd unnayate haviḥ | ekā samit sakṛd dhomaḥ so 'rdhamāsāya kalpate ||
meaning: चतुर्दशगृहीतं तु सकृद् उन्नयते हविः । एका समित् सकृद् धोमः सो ऽर्धमासाय कल्पते ॥
text_mt: Taking up fourteen portions, he ladles out the oblation once; / one kindling-stick, a single offering—that serves for half a month.

sanskrit_iast: caturdaśaguṇaṃ kṛtvā srucā pātreṇa pūrvavat | evaṃ gārhapatye ca dakṣiṇāgnau ca juhvati ||
meaning: चतुर्दशगुणं कृत्वा स्रुचा पात्रेण पूर्ववत् । एवं गार्हपत्ये च दक्षिणाग्नौ च जुह्वति ॥
text_mt: Having made it fourteen-fold with the ladle and vessel as before, / thus they sacrifice in the Gārhapatya and in the Dakṣiṇāgni fires.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvā hutvāhutīḥ sāyaṃ vyuṣṭāyām apare 'hni | etenaiva vidhānena juhvati prātarāhutīḥ ||
meaning: पूर्वा हुत्वाहुतीः सायं व्युष्टायाम् अपरे ऽह्नि । एतेनैव विधानेन जुह्वति प्रातराहुतीः ॥
text_mt: Having offered the former oblations in the evening, when dawn breaks on the next day, / they offer the morning oblations by this very same procedure.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣibhiś ca purā dṛṣṭam āpatkāleṣu sarvataḥ | araṇyoś ca samāropya śrutidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ||
meaning: ऋषिभिश् च पुरा दृष्टम् आपत्कालेषु सर्वतः । अरण्योश् च समारोप्य श्रुतिदृष्टेन कर्मणा ॥
text_mt: And it was seen by the seers of old in times of distress everywhere; / and having deposited [the fires] into the two churning-sticks by the rite seen in scripture,

sanskrit_iast: homārtheṣv etad draṣṭavyam āhitāgnigṛheṣv api | tatprayojanamātraṃ tu na doṣaḥ sūtakeṣu ca ||
meaning: होमार्थेष्व् एतद् द्रष्टव्यम् आहिताग्निगृहेष्व् अपि । तत्प्रयोजनमात्रं तु न दोषः सूतकेषु च ॥
text_mt: this is to be observed for the purposes of the offerings even in the houses of fire-keepers; / it is solely for that purpose, and there is no fault during periods of impurity.

sanskrit_iast: sadyaḥśaucādikaṃ proktaṃ sūtakaṃ ca dvijātibhiḥ | svayaṃhomīti vacanān na doṣaḥ śruticodanāt ||
meaning: सद्यःशौचादिकं प्रोक्तं सूतकं च द्विजातिभिः । स्वयंहोमीति वचनान् न दोषः श्रुतिचोदनात् ॥
text_mt: Immediate purification and other forms of impurity are proclaimed by the twice-born; / by the statement 'he is one who offers for himself', there is no fault according to scriptural injunction.

sanskrit_iast: vratināṃ sattriṇāṃ caiva mahārājāhitāgnayaḥ | eṣāṃ doṣo na vidyeta sāyamprātaḥ kriye sthite ||
meaning: व्रतिनां सत्त्रिणां चैव महाराजाहिताग्नयः । एषां दोषो न विद्येत सायम्प्रातः क्रिये स्थिते ॥
text_mt: For those observing vows and those performing long sacrificial sessions, as well as great kings who maintain sacred fires, / no fault exists in their case when the morning and evening rites are duly maintained.

sanskrit_iast: pālāśyaḥ samidho 'doṣā nityaṃ home prakīrtitāḥ | atha vā kauśikoktānāṃ yajñiyānāṃ mahīruhām ||
meaning: पालाश्यः समिधो ऽदोषा नित्यं होमे प्रकीर्तिताः । अथ वा कौशिकोक्तानां यज्ञियानां महीरुहाम् ॥
text_mt: Palāśa fuel-sticks are proclaimed to be faultless for regular offerings at all times, / or else [fuel-sticks] of sacrificial trees declared by Kauśika.

sanskrit_iast: aṅgulatrayam āvartya ucchraye 'py aṅgulatrayam | puroḍāśapramāṇaṃ tu sarvatra kathitaṃ nṛṇām ||
meaning: अङ्गुलत्रयम् आवर्त्य उच्छ्रये ऽप्य् अङ्गुलत्रयम् । पुरोडाशप्रमाणं तु सर्वत्र कथितं नृणाम् ॥
text_mt: Three digits around, and three digits in height— / this measure of the sacrificial cake is declared universally for men.

sanskrit_iast: ṣoḍaśāṅgulam āvartya tribhāgaṃ cottaram ṛju | dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi sthānaṃ dakṣiṇāgneḥ prakīrtitam ||
meaning: षोडशाङ्गुलम् आवर्त्य त्रिभागं चोत्तरम् ऋजु । दक्षिणस्यां दिशि स्थानं दक्षिणाग्नेः प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
text_mt: Sixteen digits in circumference, a third [thereof] straight toward the north: / the place of the Dakṣiṇāgni fire is proclaimed in the southern quarter.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭāviṃśaty aṅgulāni gārhapatyaṃ prakīrtitam | āhavanīyam caturviṃśatiś caturaśraṃ tu kārayet ||
