The bad-dream-destroying [mantras]: 'dauṣvapnyam', 'daurjīvityam', 'paro 'paihi', 'yo naḥ', 'jīvo 'si', 'pary āvarte duṣvapnyāt', 'yat svapne annam aśnāmi', 'yo na stāyad dipsati', 'yo naḥ suptāñ jāgrataḥ', 'yan me manaso duṣvapnyam', 'kāma svapnam', 'suptvā', the three sections [beginning with] 'vidma te svapna'—these are bad-dream-destroying [mantras]. Thus ends the bad-dream-destroying hymn cycle.

The longevity-bestowing [hymns are]: 'yathā dyauḥ', 'prāṇāpānau', 'ojo 'si', 'tubhyam eva', 'akṣībhyāṃ te', 'muñcāmi tvā', 'uta devāḥ', 'āvatas te', 'upa priyam', 'antakāya mṛtyave', 'ā rabhasva', 'prāṇāya namaḥ', 'viṣāsahim'—these are the longevity-bestowing [hymns]. Thus the longevity-bestowing cycle [ends].

The splendor-bestowing [hymns are]: 'ye triṣaptāḥ', 'asmin vasu', 'prātar agnim', 'hastivarcasam', 'siṃhe vyāghre', 'yaśo haviḥ', 'yaśasaṃ mā', 'indraḥ', 'girāv aragarāṭeṣu', 'yathā somaḥ prātaḥsavane', 'yac ca varco akṣeṣu', 'yena mahānaghnyā jaghanam'—these are the splendor-bestowing [hymns]. Thus the splendor-bestowing cycle [ends].

The auspicious-journey [hymns are]: 'amūḥ pāre', 'pātaṃ na indrāpūṣaṇā', 'tvaṣṭā me daivyam', 'yena soma', 'namo devavadhebhyaḥ', 'abhayaṃ mitrāvaruṇau', 'upa prāgāt sahasrākṣaḥ', 'anamitraṃ no adharāt', 'yamo mṛtyuḥ', 'bṛhaspatir naḥ pari pātu', 'tyam ū ṣu', 'trātāram indraḥ', 'sutrāmā sa sutrāmā', 'ā mandrair indra', 'marmāṇi te', 'varma me dyāvāpṛthivī', 'aindrāgnaṃ varma', 'girayas te', 'yat te madhyam', 'yās te prācīḥ', 'mā naḥ paścāt'—these are the auspicious-journey [hymns]. Thus the auspicious-journey cycle [ends].

The fearlessness [hymns are]: 'svastidā viśām', 'brāhmaṇena paryuktāsi', 'na tā arvā', 'reṇukakāṭaḥ', 'abhayaṃ mitrāvaruṇau', 'abhayaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī', 'asmai grāmāya', 'hataṃ tardam', 'pūṣemā āśāḥ', 'indraḥ sutrāmā', 'maitaṃ panthām', 'svastidā viśāṃ patiḥ', 'nama te ghoṣiṇībhyaḥ', 'ā te rāṣṭram', 'idam uc chreyaḥ', 'yata indra bhayāmahe'—these are the fearlessness [hymns]. Thus the fearlessness cycle [ends].

The invincible [hymns are]: 'vidmā śarasya', 'mā no vidan', 'adārasṛt', 'svastidā', 'saṃśitaṃ me', 'tvayā manyo', 'yas te manyo', 'etā devasenāḥ', 'avamanyuḥ', 'nirhastaḥ', 'pari vartmāni', 'abhibhūr indraḥ', 'jāyati', 'abhi tvendra'—these are the invincible [hymns]. Thus the invincible cycle [ends].

The armor-and-protection [cycle is]: 'yaḥ sapatnaḥ', 'itaś ca yad amutaś ca', 'apendra dviṣataḥ', 'yūyaṃ naḥ pravataḥ', 'imam agna āyuṣe', 'tisro devīḥ', 'uruvyacā naḥ', 'indrasya śarmāsi', excluding the final [stanza]; 'yena devā asurāṇām', 'anaḍudbhyas tvam', these two; 'tanūṣ ṭe vājin', 'vājasya nu prasave', 'devānāṃ patnīr adhi brūhi', 'rakṣohaṇaṃ vājinam', 'ye srāktyam', 'varma me dyāvāpṛthivī', 'aindrāgnaṃ varma', 'bahulaṃ varma mahyam', 'ayaṃ mitraḥ', 'pṛthivyod akrāmat', 'asapatnaṃ purastāt'—this is the armor-and-protection [cycle]. Thus the armor-and-protection cycle [ends].

The divine-fortress [cycle is]: 'ye purastāt', 'brahma jajñānam', 'sahasradhāraḥ', 'evāgnir mā pātu', 'agniṃ te vasuvantam', 'mitraḥ', 'pṛthivyod akrāmat', 'apa ny adhuḥ', 'pauruṣeyaṃ vadham', 'jitam asmākam'—this is the divine-fortress [cycle]. Thus the divine-fortress cycle [ends].

The Rudra [cycle is]: 'ye 'syāṃ prācī dik'—thus the Rudra cycle. Thus the Rudra cycle [ends].

The raudra gaṇa is: 'rudra jalāṣabheṣaja', 'ye 'syāṃ prācī dik', 'ud itas trayo akraman', 'bhavāśarvau manve vām', 'brahma jajñānam', 'anāptā ye', 'sahasradhāra eva', 'grīṣmo hemantaḥ', 'anaḍudbhyas tvam', 'mahyam āpaḥ', 'vaiśvānaraḥ', 'yamo mṛtyuḥ', 'yāṃ te rudra', 'yo agnau rudraḥ', 'bhavāśarvau mṛḍatam', 'bhavāśarvāv idaṃ brūmaḥ', 'yas te sarpo vṛścikaḥ', 'tasmai prācyā diśo 'ntardeśāt'—thus the raudra gaṇa. Thus the raudra gaṇa [ends].

The Citrā cycle: 'mā no vidan', 'adārasṛt', 'svastidā viśām', 'amūḥ pāre', 'aghadviṣṭāḥ', 'agne yat te tapaḥ'—these five sūktas; 'rudra jalāṣabheṣaja', 'ye 'syāṃ prācī dik', 'vi devāḥ', 'uta devāḥ', 'agner manve', and the others, the mṛgāra sūktas, excluding the final one; 'apa naḥ śośucad agham', 'pṛthivyām agnaye', 'mamāgne', 'brahma jajñānam', 'anāptā ye', 'sahasradhāre', 'savitā prasavānām', 'nava prāṇān', 'pātaṃ naḥ', 'tvaṣṭā me', 'yena soma', 'namo devavadhebhyaḥ', 'abhayaṃ mitrāvaruṇau', 'upa prāgāt sahasrākṣaḥ', 'siṃhe vyāghre', 'abhayaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī', 'grīṣmo hemantaḥ', 'anaḍudbhyas tvam', 'mahyam āpaḥ', 'vaiśvānaraḥ', 'yamo mṛtyuḥ', 'abhi tvendra viśvajit', 'trāyamāṇāyai', 'imaṃ me agne', 'viṣāṇā pāśān', 'śakadhūmam', 'somārudrā', these two; 'bṛhaspatir naḥ', 'tyam ū ṣu', 'trātāram indraḥ', 'sutrāmā', 'ā mandrair indra', 'marmāṇi te', 'antakāya mṛtyave', 'ā rabhasva', 'ayaṃ pratisaraḥ', 'ayaṃ me varaṇaḥ', 'bhavāśarvau mṛḍatam', 'prāṇāya namaḥ', the complete hymn 'agniṃ brūmaḥ', the first two [stanzas] of 'satyaṃ bṛhat', 'girayas te', 'yat te madhyam', 'yās te prācīḥ', 'mā naḥ paścāt', 'grīṣmas te bhūme', 'varṣāṇi', 'upasthās te bhūme mātaḥ', 'sahasraśṛṅgo vṛṣabhaḥ', 'jātavedāḥ', 'mā pra gāma patho yo yajñasya', and the section 'tasmai prācyā diśo 'ntardeśāt'—this is the Citrā cycle. Thus the Citrā cycle [ends].

The Patnīvant [cycle consists of] three sūktas: 'aditiḥ', 'dyauḥ', 'sinīvālī kuhūṃ devīm'—this is the Patnīvant [cycle]. Thus the Patnīvant cycle [ends]. / 'svasti mātā', 'indra juṣasva', 'ayā viṣṭhāḥ', 'śive te stām', 'pādābhyāṃ te', 'saṃ te śīrṣṇaḥ', one stanza 'vatso virājaḥ', two stanzas 'uccā patantam', 'bhūyān indraḥ', 'viṣāsahim', 'sahamānam'—this is the Āditya cycle.

'śaṃ no devī', 'śaṃ na indrāgnī', 'śaṃ no vāto vātu', 'śāntā dyauḥ'—this is the Pippalādi propitiatory cycle. Thus the Pippalādi propitiatory cycle [ends].

The five sūktas beginning with 'gane yat' are related to the five offspring, they are related to the five peoples; this is the Pañcāpatya cycle. Thus the Pañcāpatya cycle [ends].

'ambayo yanti', 'śambhumayobhubhyām', 'brahma jajñānam', 'asya vāmasya', 'yo rohitaḥ', 'ud asya ketavaḥ', two sūktas 'mūrdhāham', 'viṣāsahim'—this is the Salila cycle. Thus the Salila cycle [ends].

[The hymn beginning] "ye triṣaptāḥ" is the Viśvakarman hymn cycle.

[The hymns beginning] "aghadviṣṭāḥ", "devajātā", "śaṃ no devī", "varaṇo vārayātai", "pippalī", "vidradhasya", and "yā babhravaḥ" form the Gaṇakarman and the Medicine hymn cycle. Thus ends the Medicine hymn cycle.

[The hymns beginning] "ayaṃ te yoniḥ", "ā no bhara", and the hymn of substance "dhītī vā ye" form the Uplifting hymn cycle. Thus ends the Uplifting hymn cycle.

[The hymns beginning] "ambayo yanti", "śambhumayobhū", "hiraṇyavarṇāḥ", "niḥsālām", "ye agnayaḥ", "brahma jajñānam", [the verse] "ekaitāḥ", "devā mṛgāra-" hymns excluding the last, "apa naḥ śośucad agham", "punantu mā", "sasruṣīr himavataḥ pra sravanti", "vāyoḥ pūtaḥ pavitreṇa", "śaṃ ca no mayaś ca naḥ", "anaḍudbhyaḥ", "tvaṃ mahyam", "āpaḥ", "vaiśvānaraḥ", "raśmibhiḥ", "yamo mṛtyuḥ", "viśvajit", "saṃjñānaṃ naḥ", "yady antarikṣe", "punar maitv indriyam", "śivā naḥ", "śaṃ no vāto vātu", and "agniṃ brūmo vanaspatīn" form the Propitiatory hymn cycle. Thus, with all these hymns, is the Great Propitiatory hymn cycle declared by Kauśika.

[The hymns beginning] "ambayo yanti", "śambhumayobhū", "hiraṇyavarṇāḥ", "uta devāḥ", "yady antarikṣe", "punar naitv indriyam", "śivā naḥ", "śaṃ no vāto vātu", and "agniṃ brūmo vanaspatīn" form the Śāntātīya, the Lesser Propitiatory hymn cycle.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspatir mahendrāya cakāra ghṛtakambalam ||
meaning: बृहस्पतिर् महेन्द्राय चकार घृतकम्बलम् ॥
text_mt:
[The hymns beginning] "ye triṣaptāḥ", "mamāgne varcaḥ", "prātar agnim", "girāv aragarāṭeṣu", "divas pṛthivyāḥ", "hastivarcasam", "siṃhe vyāghre", "yaśo haviḥ", and with the three [verses beginning] "yas te gandhaḥ" form the Splendor hymn cycle.

[The hymns beginning] "yā asurāḥ", "manuṣyāḥ", "mā no vidan", and "namo devavadhebhyaḥ" form the Fearlessness hymn cycle.

[The hymn beginning] "bhūto bhūteṣu" forms the Royal Consecration hymn cycle for a king.

[The hymns beginning] "ya āśānām", "āśāpālebhyaḥ", the seven hymns [beginning] "agner manve", "yā oṣadhayaḥ somarājñīḥ", "vaiśvānaro na ā gamat", "chumbhanī", "dyāvāpṛthivī", "yad arvācīnam", and "agniṃ brūmo vanaspatīn"—excluding these four: "muñcantu naḥ", "bhavāśārvau", "yā devīḥ", and "yan mātalī rathakrītam"—form the Sin-clearing hymn cycle.

Om. Having bowed to Brahmā, to the Brahmaveda, and to the Self-born, / I shall proclaim the Ghee Blanket, in accordance with the recitation of Brahmā.

Bṛhaspati performed the Ghee Blanket for Mahendra.

sanskrit_iast: athendro ha vā asuraiḥ parājitaś cintām āpede
meaning: अथेन्द्रो ह वा असुरैः पराजितश् चिन्ताम् आपेदे
text_mt: Now, indeed, Indra, having been defeated by the asuras, fell into anxious thought.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ savitābravīt prāyaścittaṃ kuruṣvāpratiruddho bhaviṣyasīti
meaning: तं सविताब्रवीत् प्रायश्चित्तं कुरुष्वाप्रतिरुद्धो भविष्यसीति
text_mt: Savitṛ said to him: "Perform an expiation; you will become unopposed."

sanskrit_iast: tam indro 'bravīt || bhagavan tvam evāpratiruddhaḥ prāyaścittaṃ kurv iti ||
meaning: तम् इन्द्रो ऽब्रवीत् ॥ भगवन् त्वम् एवाप्रतिरुद्धः प्रायश्चित्तं कुर्व् इति ॥
text_mt: Indra said to him: "Venerable one, you yourself are unopposed; perform the expiation!"

sanskrit_iast: sa prāyaścittam akarot
meaning: स प्रायश्चित्तम् अकरोत्
text_mt: He performed the expiation.

sanskrit_iast: puṇye nakṣatre bārhaspatye muhūrte 'bhijity audumbaraṃ kumbhaṃ droṇena sāḍhakena pūrayitvā tasminn eva vāsaprabhṛtayaḥ oṣadhayo darbhaprabhṛtayaś ca bilvagaurasarṣapāś cety etān saṃbhārān saṃbhṛtya ghṛtakumbhaṃ barhiṣy ādhāyaitair gaṇair ājyaṃ juhuyāt ||
meaning: पुण्ये नक्षत्रे बार्हस्पत्ये मुहूर्ते ऽभिजित्य् औदुम्बरं कुम्भं द्रोणेन साढकेन पूरयित्वा तस्मिन्न् एव वासप्रभृतयः ओषधयो दर्भप्रभृतयश् च बिल्वगौरसर्षपाश् चेत्य् एतान् संभारान् संभृत्य घृतकुम्भं बर्हिष्य् आधायैतैर् गणैर् आज्यं जुहुयात् ॥
text_mt: Under an auspicious lunar mansion, at the Bārhaspatya muhūrta, on Abhijit, having filled an udumbara vessel with a droṇa and an āḍhaka [of ghee], having gathered these requisites in it—herbs beginning with vāsā, [grasses] beginning with darbha, bilva fruits, and white mustard seeds—and having placed the ghee-vessel on the sacrificial grass, he should offer clarified butter with these hymn cycles.

sanskrit_iast: pra pateta ity ekenāṅgādaṅgāc chamalam avalikhya sapatnaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ hṛdaye imarmaṇi vāsināvidhya gomayena kāṣāyeṇa vācchādya śānter apratighātakaṃ karma tato jyeṣṭhaṃ ghṛtakambalaṃ brahmaṇaḥ putram akarot
meaning: प्र पतेत इत्य् एकेनाङ्गादङ्गाच् छमलम् अवलिख्य सपत्नं भ्रातृव्यं हृदये इमर्मणि वासिनाविध्य गोमयेन काषायेण वाच्छाद्य शान्तेर् अप्रतिघातकं कर्म ततो ज्येष्ठं घृतकम्बलं ब्रह्मणः पुत्रम् अकरोत्
text_mt: With the single [verse beginning] "pra pateta", having scraped away the taint from limb to limb, having pierced the adversary and rival in the vital point of the heart with an adze, and having covered it with cowdung or an ochre cloth, [he performs] the rite that does not impede propitiation; then he made the Eldest Ghee Blanket, the son of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast: tasya ha vā etasya ghṛtakambalasya sāvitrīgaṇaśarīrasya śantātīyaḥ śiraḥ triṣaptīyo mukhaṃ rudraraudrau cakṣuṣī ghṛtaliṅga āsyaṃ nairṛto jihvā dantoṣṭhāv abhayāparājitau kṛtyādūṣaṇacātanau śrotre śarmavarmasvastyayanau bāhū mātṛnāmavāṣṭoṣpatyau pādau … pāyuś ca bhaiṣajyaṃ nyāyaḥ prāṇāpānāv iti mīmāṃsata ity
meaning: तस्य ह वा एतस्य घृतकम्बलस्य सावित्रीगणशरीरस्य शन्तातीयः शिरः त्रिषप्तीयो मुखं रुद्ररौद्रौ चक्षुषी घृतलिङ्ग आस्यं नैरृतो जिह्वा दन्तोष्ठाव् अभयापराजितौ कृत्यादूषणचातनौ श्रोत्रे शर्मवर्मस्वस्त्ययनौ बाहू मातृनामवाष्टोष्पत्यौ पादौ … पायुश् च भैषज्यं न्यायः प्राणापानाव् इति मीमांसत इत्य्
text_mt: Now, of this very Ghee Blanket whose body is the Sāvitrī hymn cycle, the Śantātīya is the head; the Triṣaptīya is the face; the Rudra and Raudra are the two eyes; the Ghṛtaliṅga is the mouth; the Nairṛta is the tongue; the Abhaya and Aparājita are the teeth and lips; the Kṛtyādūṣaṇa and Cātana are the two ears; the Śarmavarma and Svastyayana are the two arms; the Mātṛnāma and Vāstoṣpatya are the two feet; [...] and the anus is the Medicine hymn cycle; the bodily winds are breath and downward breath—so they consider.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa ha vai jyeṣṭho ghṛtakambalo brahmaṇaḥ putro 'parājitagaṇeneṣṭvendro 'surān ajayan mṛtyum alakṣmīm arātiṃ duḥsvapnadurbhūtāny ajayad
meaning: एष ह वै ज्येष्ठो घृतकम्बलो ब्रह्मणः पुत्रो ऽपराजितगणेनेष्ट्वेन्द्रो ऽसुरान् अजयन् मृत्युम् अलक्ष्मीम् अरातिं दुःस्वप्नदुर्भूतान्य् अजयद्
text_mt: This indeed was the Eldest Ghee Blanket, the son of Brahmā; having sacrificed with the Aparājita hymn cycle, Indra conquered the asuras; he conquered death, misfortune, hostility, bad dreams, and ill-formed beings.

sanskrit_iast: yathā caivaṃvidvān ghṛtakambalaṃ kurute sarvakāmān āpnoti sarvavyādhirahito bhavati brahmalokam avāpnotīti brāhmaṇam ||
meaning: यथा चैवंविद्वान् घृतकम्बलं कुरुते सर्वकामान् आप्नोति सर्वव्याधिरहितो भवति ब्रह्मलोकम् अवाप्नोतीति ब्राह्मणम् ॥
text_mt: And when one knowing thus performs the Ghee Blanket, he attains all desires, becomes free from all disease, and attains the world of Brahmā—thus says the Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: yadā sarvam idaṃ vyāptam asurair nāvaśeṣitam | sthātuṃ devāḥ parābhūtās te 'tharvāṇam upāgatāḥ ||
meaning: यदा सर्वम् इदं व्याप्तम् असुरैर् नावशेषितम् । स्थातुं देवाः पराभूतास् ते ऽथर्वाणम् उपागताः ॥
text_mt: When all this [world] was pervaded by the asuras and nothing was left remaining, / the gods, defeated [and unable] to stand, approached Atharvan:

sanskrit_iast: karmādy ekaṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ yad bhṛgvaṅgirasor matam | asurāṇāṃ vadhārthāyety uktaḥ kartātha so 'bhavat ||
meaning: कर्माद्य् एकं कुरुष्व त्वं यद् भृग्वङ्गिरसोर् मतम् । असुराणां वधार्थायेत्य् उक्तः कर्ताथ सो ऽभवत् ॥
text_mt: "Perform you now a singular rite approved by Bhṛgu and Aṅgiras / for the slaughter of the asuras." Addressed thus, he then became the performer.

sanskrit_iast: paracakropasṛṣṭasya rājño vijayam icchataḥ | pratiruddhasya vā bhūyaḥ śrīkāmasyecchataḥ śriyam ||
meaning: परचक्रोपसृष्टस्य राज्ञो विजयम् इच्छतः । प्रतिरुद्धस्य वा भूयः श्रीकामस्येच्छतः श्रियम् ॥
text_mt: For a king beset by a rival army and desiring victory, / or who is obstructed again, or desirous of royal fortune seeking prosperity,

sanskrit_iast: prādurbhāvādbhutānāṃ ca grahāṇāṃ vigrahe tathā | śaṅkamāno 'bhicārād vā kārayed ghṛtakambalam ||
meaning: प्रादुर्भावाद्भुतानां च ग्रहाणां विग्रहे तथा । शङ्कमानो ऽभिचाराद् वा कारयेद् घृतकम्बलम् ॥
text_mt: upon the appearance of portents and likewise during a clash of the planets, / or suspecting sorcery, one should have the Ghee Blanket performed.

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtamātrā tu vijñeyā māgadhaprasthasaṃmitā | śatāni pañca droṇānāṃ palaikaśatam eva vā ||
meaning: घृतमात्रा तु विज्ञेया मागधप्रस्थसंमिता । शतानि पञ्च द्रोणानां पलैकशतम् एव वा ॥
text_mt: The measure of ghee is to be understood as reckoned by the Māgadha prastha: / five hundred droṇas, or exactly one hundred and one palas.

sanskrit_iast: sarvapāpapraṇāśāya sarvakāmārthasiddhaye | sarvarogakṣayārthāya prayojyo ghṛtakambalaḥ ||
meaning: सर्वपापप्रणाशाय सर्वकामार्थसिद्धये । सर्वरोगक्षयार्थाय प्रयोज्यो घृतकम्बलः ॥
text_mt: [The Ghee Blanket is to be employed / for the destruction of all sins, for the accomplishment of all desired ends, and for the destruction of all diseases.]

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtapramāṇaṃ vakṣyāmi māṣakaṃ pañcakṛṣṇalam | māṣakāṇi catuhṣaṣṭiḥ palam ekaṃ vidhīyate ||
meaning: घृतप्रमाणं वक्ष्यामि माषकं पञ्चकृष्णलम् । माषकाणि चतुह्षष्टिः पलम् एकं विधीयते ॥
text_mt: I shall state the measure of ghee: five kṛṣṇalas are a māṣaka; / sixty-four māṣakas are prescribed as one pala.

sanskrit_iast: dvātriṃśatpalakaṃ prasthaṃ māgadhaiḥ parikīrtitam | āḍhakaṃ tu catuḥprasthaṃ caturbhir droṇam āḍhakaiḥ ||
meaning: द्वात्रिंशत्पलकं प्रस्थं मागधैः परिकीर्तितम् । आढकं तु चतुःप्रस्थं चतुर्भिर् द्रोणम् आढकैः ॥
text_mt: A prastha is proclaimed by the Māgadhas to consist of thirty-two palas; / an āḍhaka consists of four prasthas, and a droṇa consists of four āḍhakas.

sanskrit_iast: droṇapramāṇaṃ vijñeyaṃ brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ purā | dvādaśābhyadhikair nityaṃ palānāṃ pañcabhiḥ śataiḥ ||
meaning: द्रोणप्रमाणं विज्ञेयं ब्रह्मणा निर्मितं पुरा । द्वादशाभ्यधिकैर् नित्यं पलानां पञ्चभिः शतैः ॥
text_mt: The measure of a droṇa is to be known as fashioned of old by Brahmā / as constantly consisting of five hundred palas plus twelve.

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtamātrā tu vijñeyā māgadhaprasthasaṃmitā | śatāni pañca droṇānāṃ palānāṃ vā śatottare ||
meaning: घृतमात्रा तु विज्ञेया मागधप्रस्थसंमिता । शतानि पञ्च द्रोणानां पलानां वा शतोत्तरे ॥
text_mt: [The measure of ghee is to be understood as reckoned by the Māgadha prastha: / five hundred droṇas, or with one hundred palas above.]

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtadroṇaśatenokta eko droṇavaras tathā | yathāśakti prayuñjīta ghṛtaṃ kṛtvātha bhāgaśaḥ ||
meaning: घृतद्रोणशतेनोक्त एको द्रोणवरस् तथा । यथाशक्ति प्रयुञ्जीत घृतं कृत्वाथ भागशः ॥
text_mt: It is stated as one hundred droṇas of ghee, and likewise a single best droṇa; / according to one's capacity, one should employ the ghee after dividing it into portions.

sanskrit_iast: caturbhāgo 'bhiṣekāya caturbhāgas tu hūyate | bhāgo deyaḥ sadasyebhyaḥ kartā bhāgena yujyate ||
meaning: चतुर्भागो ऽभिषेकाय चतुर्भागस् तु हूयते । भागो देयः सदस्येभ्यः कर्ता भागेन युज्यते ॥
text_mt: A fourth portion is for consecration, but a fourth portion is offered into the fire; / a portion is to be given to the members of the assembly; the performer is joined with a portion.

sanskrit_iast: puṣye prayogaṃ kurvīta prājāpatye 'tha mārute | vaiṣṇave pūṣadaivatye uttareṣv atha vā triṣu ||
meaning: पुष्ये प्रयोगं कुर्वीत प्राजापत्ये ऽथ मारुते । वैष्णवे पूषदैवत्ये उत्तरेष्व् अथ वा त्रिषु ॥
text_mt: One should perform the rite under Puṣya, or under Prājāpatya, or under Māruta, / or under Vaiṣṇava, under the deity Pūṣan, or under the three latter [lunar mansions],

sanskrit_iast: taptakṛchrāvasāne vā sarvakṛchrasya cāntataḥ | yasmin vā snātakā brūyus tatra kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
meaning: तप्तकृछ्रावसाने वा सर्वकृछ्रस्य चान्ततः । यस्मिन् वा स्नातका ब्रूयुस् तत्र कुर्याद् विचक्षणः ॥
text_mt: or at the conclusion of a Taptakṛcchra penance, or at the end of a Sarvakṛcchra; / or wherever the snātakas should specify, there the discerning man should perform it.

sanskrit_iast: pākayajñavidhānena kṛtvopakramaṇaṃ budhaḥ | niśākāle bahirgrāme kuryād agniniveśanam ||
meaning: पाकयज्ञविधानेन कृत्वोपक्रमणं बुधः । निशाकाले बहिर्ग्रामे कुर्याद् अग्निनिवेशनम् ॥
text_mt: Having made the preparation according to the rules for domestic sacrifice, the wise man / should install the fire outside the village at night.

sanskrit_iast: yajeta nirṛtiṃ tatra kṛṣṇavāsāś catuṣpathe | yathoktaṃ nairṛtair mantrair havirbhiś ca yathākramam ||
meaning: यजेत निरृतिं तत्र कृष्णवासाश् चतुष्पथे । यथोक्तं नैरृतैर् मन्त्रैर् हविर्भिश् च यथाक्रमम् ॥
text_mt: Dressed in black garments, he should sacrifice there to Nirṛti at a crossroad / according to the injunction, with the mantras to Nirṛti and the oblations in proper order.

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīyena tu sūktena nivedya balim antataḥ | yathāvyāvartane caiva yad uktaṃ tat samācaret ||
meaning: तृतीयेन तु सूक्तेन निवेद्य बलिम् अन्ततः । यथाव्यावर्तने चैव यद् उक्तं तत् समाचरेत् ॥
text_mt: Having presented the bali offering at the end with the third hymn, / he should then perform exactly what is prescribed in the chapter on turning away.

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ snātaḥ śuklavāsāḥ prāśya śāntyudakaṃ śuciḥ | paryukṣyopasamādhāya ghṛtasaṃskāra iṣyate ||
meaning: ततः स्नातः शुक्लवासाः प्राश्य शान्त्युदकं शुचिः । पर्युक्ष्योपसमाधाय घृतसंस्कार इष्यते ॥
text_mt: Then, having bathed, wearing white garments, pure after sipping propitiatory water, / having sprinkled [around the fire] and added fuel, the preparation of the clarified butter is prescribed:

sanskrit_iast: pūrvaṃ mahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ sāvitryā tadanantaram | śāntiś ca brahma jajñānaṃ brahma bhrājad itīti ca ||
meaning: पूर्वं महाव्याहृतिभिः सावित्र्या तदनन्तरम् । शान्तिश् च ब्रह्म जज्ञानं ब्रह्म भ्राजद् इतीति च ॥
text_mt: First with the Great Utterances, immediately thereafter with the Sāvitrī verse, / and the propitiatory [verses]: 'Brahmā born [first],' and 'Brahmā shining,' and so forth,

sanskrit_iast: agne gobhir agne 'bhyāvartinn agne jātavedaḥ saha rayyā punar ūrjeti ||
meaning: अग्ने गोभिर् अग्ने ऽभ्यावर्तिन्न् अग्ने जातवेदः सह रय्या पुनर् ऊर्जेति ॥
text_mt: 'O Agni, with cattle,' 'O Agni, turning towards us,' 'O Agni, Jātavedas,' 'Together with wealth,' and 'Return with strength,'

sanskrit_iast: agnim purohitam agna ā yāhi vītaye | bṛhaspatir na ity ekā bṛhaspate yuvaṃ tathā ||
meaning: अग्निम् पुरोहितम् अग्न आ याहि वीतये । बृहस्पतिर् न इत्य् एका बृहस्पते युवं तथा ॥
text_mt: 'I praise Agni the domestic priest,' 'O Agni, come for the feast,' / the single [verse] 'May Bṛhaspati [protect] us,' and likewise 'O Bṛhaspati, you two.'

sanskrit_iast: etair ājyaṃ ca juhuyāt saṃpātān ānayed ghṛte | kṛtyādūṣaṇamantraiś ca kuryāc chāntyudake vidhim ||
meaning: एतैर् आज्यं च जुहुयात् संपातान् आनयेद् घृते । कृत्यादूषणमन्त्रैश् च कुर्याच् छान्त्युदके विधिम् ॥
text_mt: With these [mantras] one should offer clarified butter and drop the residue into the clarified butter; / and with the sorcery-spoiling mantras one should perform the rite in the propitiatory water.

sanskrit_iast: saṃpātān ānayet tatra cātanair mātṛnāmabhiḥ | vāstoṣpatyair vāṣṭoṣpatāv ānayet samadūṣaṇam ||
meaning: संपातान् आनयेत् तत्र चातनैर् मातृनामभिः । वास्तोष्पत्यैर् वाष्टोष्पताव् आनयेत् समदूषणम् ॥
text_mt: There he should drop the residue with the expelling [mantras and] the names of the mothers; / with the mantras to the Lord of the Dwelling one should drop the pacifying-destroying [residue] into [the water] to the Lord of the Dwelling.

sanskrit_iast: nidhāya havir āsādya ghṛtakumbhaṃ susaṃskṛtam | ghṛtabhāgau tu yāv anyau pūrveṇāgner nidhāpayet ||
meaning: निधाय हविर् आसाद्य घृतकुम्भं सुसंस्कृतम् । घृतभागौ तु याव् अन्यौ पूर्वेणाग्नेर् निधापयेत् ॥
text_mt: Having placed down the oblation and set down the well-prepared pot of clarified butter, / he should have the other two portions of clarified butter placed to the east of the fire.

sanskrit_iast: darbhādīn tu vāsādīṃś ca saṃbhārān gaurasarṣapān | bilvaṃ ca kumbhe nidhāyāpareṇāgner nidhāpayet ||
meaning: दर्भादीन् तु वासादींश् च संभारान् गौरसर्षपान् । बिल्वं च कुम्भे निधायापरेणाग्नेर् निधापयेत् ॥
text_mt: Having placed the requisites such as darbha grass, garments, white mustard, / and bilva wood into a pot, he should have them placed to the west of the fire.

sanskrit_iast: sāvitraḥ śantātīyaś ca kṛtyādūṣaṇa eva ca | abhayāparājitāyuṣyā varcasyaś ca tataḥ paraḥ ||
meaning: सावित्रः शन्तातीयश् च कृत्यादूषण एव च । अभयापराजितायुष्या वर्चस्यश् च ततः परः ॥
text_mt: The Sāvitra hymn, the 'Śaṃ tātīya,' and the sorcery-spoiling [hymn], / the Abhayā, the Aparājitā, the Āyuṣyā, and after that the Varcasya;

sanskrit_iast: saṃsaktīyaḥ suṣuptīyaḥ svastyayanaḥ śarmavarma ca | cātano mātṛnāmāni bhaiṣajyaṃ nyāya eva ca ||
meaning: संसक्तीयः सुषुप्तीयः स्वस्त्ययनः शर्मवर्म च । चातनो मातृनामानि भैषज्यं न्याय एव च ॥
text_mt: the Saṃsaktīya, the Suṣuptīya, the Svastyayana, and the Śarmavarma; / the Cātana, the names of the mothers, the Bhaiṣajya, and the Nyāya;

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtaliṅgau tathā raudrau saṃpātān ānayed ghṛte | gaṇānteṣu yathāśakti brāhmaṇān svastivācayet ||
meaning: घृतलिङ्गौ तथा रौद्रौ संपातान् आनयेद् घृते । गणान्तेषु यथाशक्ति ब्राह्मणान् स्वस्तिवाचयेत् ॥
text_mt: likewise the two [hymns] containing the characteristic mark of clarified butter and the two Rudra hymns: he should drop the residue into the clarified butter. / At the end of the hymn cycles he should have the Brahmins speak blessings according to his ability.

sanskrit_iast: yo 'sminn akṣībhyāṃ te sahasrākṣaṃ brahma jajñānam | brahma bhrājad ud agād idam āpas tathāpaś ca ||
meaning: यो ऽस्मिन्न् अक्षीभ्यां ते सहस्राक्षं ब्रह्म जज्ञानम् । ब्रह्म भ्राजद् उद् अगाद् इदम् आपस् तथापश् च ॥
text_mt: 'He who in this [person],' 'From your eyes,' 'Thousand-eyed,' 'Brahmā born [first],' / 'Brahmā shining,' 'Arisen,' 'This, O waters,' and likewise 'Waters,'

sanskrit_iast: abhiṣiñcet sarvamantrair āyuṣyair abhayais tathā | mṛṇmayaś cātra bhavati dveṣyasya ca parākṛtiḥ ||
meaning: अभिषिञ्चेत् सर्वमन्त्रैर् आयुष्यैर् अभयैस् तथा । मृण्मयश् चात्र भवति द्वेष्यस्य च पराकृतिः ॥
text_mt: he should consecrate [him] with all the longevity-conferring mantras and with the fear-dispelling ones. / And here an effigy of the hated [enemy] is made of clay.

sanskrit_iast: abhiṣiñcet sarvamantrair āyuṣyair abhayais tathā | mṛṇmayaś cātra bhavati dveṣyasya ca parākṛtiḥ ||
meaning: अभिषिञ्चेत् सर्वमन्त्रैर् आयुष्यैर् अभयैस् तथा । मृण्मयश् चात्र भवति द्वेष्यस्य च पराकृतिः ॥
text_mt: He should consecrate [him] with all the longevity-conferring mantras and with the fear-dispelling ones. / And here an effigy of the hated [enemy] is made of clay.

sanskrit_iast: tasyopariṣṭād abhiṣicya kuryān mātrātalekhanīm | aṅgādaṅgād athānyena pra pateti catasṛbhiḥ ||
meaning: तस्योपरिष्टाद् अभिषिच्य कुर्यान् मात्रातलेखनीम् । अङ्गादङ्गाद् अथान्येन प्र पतेति चतसृभिः ॥
text_mt: Having consecrated over him, he should make a drawing [of him] with an instrument of measured length: / 'From limb to limb,' then with another [verse], and with the four [verses beginning] 'Fly away.'

sanskrit_iast: bhrātṛvyaham iti vaiśvānaroyanty avasānena | dyāvādinā paryāyeṇa samalaṃkṛṭam ullikhet ||
meaning: भ्रातृव्यहम् इति वैश्वानरोयन्त्य् अवसानेन । द्यावादिना पर्यायेण समलंकृटम् उल्लिखेत् ॥
text_mt: With the conclusion of 'Slayer of the rival,' [and] 'belonging to Vaiśvānara,' / with the round beginning with 'Heaven [and earth],' he should scrape the fully adorned [effigy]:

sanskrit_iast: dviṣantaṃ me parāvad vi dviṣantaṃ nir dahantu me | bhrātṛvyatān iti dvābhyāṃ paryāyāś ca trayaḥ parāḥ ||
meaning: द्विषन्तं मे परावद् वि द्विषन्तं निर् दहन्तु मे । भ्रातृव्यतान् इति द्वाभ्यां पर्यायाश् च त्रयः पराः ॥
text_mt: 'Drive away the one who hates me,' 'Let them burn out the one who hates me,' / with the two [verses beginning] 'Those enemies,' and the next three rounds.

sanskrit_iast: anvālabhya tu kartāram upaviṣṭa udaṅmukhaḥ | svapnatakmāṣṭanayanaiḥ saubhāgyair varmabhis tathā ||
meaning: अन्वालभ्य तु कर्तारम् उपविष्ट उदङ्मुखः । स्वप्नतक्माष्टनयनैः सौभाग्यैर् वर्मभिस् तथा ॥
text_mt: Remaining in contact with the sacrificer, seated facing north, / with [verses against] bad dreams, consumption, and the eight-eyed one, with [mantras of] good fortune and protections,

sanskrit_iast: rudraraudraparair mantrair ājyahomo vidhīyate | srāktyaṃ vā yadi vāśvattham audumbaram athāpi vā ||
meaning: रुद्ररौद्रपरैर् मन्त्रैर् आज्यहोमो विधीयते । स्राक्त्यं वा यदि वाश्वत्थम् औदुम्बरम् अथापि वा ॥
text_mt: an oblation of clarified butter is prescribed with mantras addressed to Rudra and ferocious [deities]. / An amulet of sraktya wood, or of aśvattha wood, or of udumbara wood,

sanskrit_iast: śaṅkhaṃ ca maṇim ābadhya pratisarair abhimantrayet | anvārabhyābhiṣekaṃ tu raudrābhyāṃ juhuyāt tataḥ ||
meaning: शङ्खं च मणिम् आबध्य प्रतिसरैर् अभिमन्त्रयेत् । अन्वारभ्याभिषेकं तु रौद्राभ्यां जुहुयात् ततः ॥
text_mt: and having bound on a conch-shell amulet, he should consecrate it with protective amulets. / Remaining in contact [with the sacrificer] during the consecration, he should then sacrifice with the two Rudra hymns.

sanskrit_iast: yat te vāsa iti paridhānaṃ yathoktaṃ paridhāpayet | rocanā guggulu ghṛtam abhyañjanam athāñjanam ||
meaning: यत् ते वास इति परिधानं यथोक्तं परिधापयेत् । रोचना गुग्गुलु घृतम् अभ्यञ्जनम् अथाञ्जनम् ॥
text_mt: With 'What garment is yours,' he should have him put on the garment as prescribed; / yellow pigment, bdellium, clarified butter, unguent, and eye-salve:

sanskrit_iast: tata etair alaṃkṛtya īkṣayetādarṣe mukham | daśa gā dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād vṛṣabhaṃ ghṛtam eva ca ||
meaning: तत एतैर् अलंकृत्य ईक्षयेतादर्षे मुखम् । दश गा दक्षिणां दद्याद् वृषभं घृतम् एव च ॥
text_mt: then, having adorned him with these, he should have him look at his face in a mirror. / He should give ten cows as a sacrificial fee, and a bull, and clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇān svastivācyātha prāṅmukhaḥ saṃviśet tataḥ | rakṣohaṇam ity anuvākaṃ japet kartātha ṛtvijaḥ ||
meaning: ब्राह्मणान् स्वस्तिवाच्याथ प्राङ्मुखः संविशेत् ततः । रक्षोहणम् इत्य् अनुवाकं जपेत् कर्ताथ ऋत्विजः ॥
text_mt: Then, having had the Brahmins speak blessings, he should lie down facing east; / the sacrificer and then the officiating priests should recite the section [beginning] 'Demon-slaying.'

sanskrit_iast: śarmavarmaitad uktaṃ snātasya rakṣobhyo 'bhayaṃkaram iti ||
meaning: शर्मवर्मैतद् उक्तं स्नातस्य रक्षोभ्यो ऽभयंकरम् इति ॥
text_mt: This is called the 'Śarmavarma,' which confers freedom from fear of demons for one who has bathed.

sanskrit_iast: na rākṣasā na gandharvā na piśācā na cāsurāḥ | krūrāḥ puruṣamarmajñā na hiṃsanti ghṛtārcitam ||
meaning: न राक्षसा न गन्धर्वा न पिशाचा न चासुराः । क्रूराः पुरुषमर्मज्ञा न हिंसन्ति घृतार्चितम् ॥
text_mt: Neither rākṣasas, nor gandharvas, nor piśācas, nor asuras, / cruel and aware of a man's vulnerable spots, harm one who is anointed with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: siddhābhiṣeko naiśaś ca ghṛtakambalam eva ca | lakṣaḥ puṣyābhiṣekaś ca pradhānāvabhṛtas tathā ||
meaning: सिद्धाभिषेको नैशश् च घृतकम्बलम् एव च । लक्षः पुष्याभिषेकश् च प्रधानावभृतस् तथा ॥
text_mt: The accomplished consecration, the night [consecration], the clarified-butter blanket, / the lakṣa rite, the Puṣya consecration, and likewise the principal final bath:

sanskrit_iast: mahāśāntitrayastriṃśat tatra ṣaṭ prastaraiḥ saha | niyatānyevadṛchāyā kartavyā bhūtim icchatā ||
meaning: महाशान्तित्रयस्त्रिंशत् तत्र षट् प्रस्तरैः सह । नियतान्येवदृछाया कर्तव्या भूतिम् इच्छता ॥
text_mt: the thirty-three great propitiatory rites, together with six bed-rites there, / must certainly be performed at will by one who desires prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ namo 'tharvavedāya || akṣarāni vilomāni na svaraṃ pratilomayet | pratyārambhanighāteṣu sthānāny anyāni nirdiśet ||
meaning: ओं नमो ऽथर्ववेदाय ॥ अक्षरानि विलोमानि न स्वरं प्रतिलोमयेत् । प्रत्यारम्भनिघातेषु स्थानान्य् अन्यानि निर्दिशेत् ॥
text_mt: The syllables are in reverse order; one must not invert the accent. / In the new beginnings and low accents, one should indicate other positions.

sanskrit_iast: yakāras tu takārānto antyasvaritasaṃjñitaḥ | sa tūdāttaḥ sa evādau dakāraḥ śiṣyate guruḥ ||
meaning: यकारस् तु तकारान्तो अन्त्यस्वरितसंज्ञितः । स तूदात्तः स एवादौ दकारः शिष्यते गुरुः ॥
text_mt: The syllable 'ya', however, ends in 'ta', designated as having a final circumflex accent; / but that is acute; it is that very 'da' at the beginning that remains heavy.

sanskrit_iast: dakārāt svaryate nīcam upodātte pra yojayet | anyāni tu yathāpūrvam udāttapracitāni tu ||
meaning: दकारात् स्वर्यते नीचम् उपोदात्ते प्र योजयेत् । अन्यानि तु यथापूर्वम् उदात्तप्रचितानि तु ॥
text_mt: From the 'da' a low tone is made circumflex; he should apply it before an acute; / but the others are as before, acute and unaccented.

sanskrit_iast: prathamo 'ṣṭākṣaro 'rdharco dvitīyaḥ ṣoḍaśākṣaraḥ | ādāv ante ca vijñeyā vyāhṛtiś cāpy atharvaṇām ||
meaning: प्रथमो ऽष्टाक्षरो ऽर्धर्चो द्वितीयः षोडशाक्षरः । आदाव् अन्ते च विज्ञेया व्याहृतिश् चाप्य् अथर्वणाम् ॥
text_mt: The first half-verse has eight syllables; the second has sixteen syllables; / and at the beginning and the end, the utterance of the Atharvans is to be recognized.

sanskrit_iast: raktavarṇā vilomā ca yamena parikīrtitā | sarvaśatruvināśāya sarvakarmārthasiddhaye ||
meaning: रक्तवर्णा विलोमा च यमेन परिकीर्तिता । सर्वशत्रुविनाशाय सर्वकर्मार्थसिद्धये ॥
text_mt: Red in color and reversed, it was proclaimed by Yama / for the destruction of all enemies and for the achievement of all ritual ends.

sanskrit_iast: mṛtyuś ca devatā cāsyā nichannaṃ chanda ucyate | svāhākāre tu phaṭkāraḥ koṭihome vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning: मृत्युश् च देवता चास्या निछन्नं छन्द उच्यते । स्वाहाकारे तु फट्कारः कोटिहोमे विधिः स्मृतः ॥
text_mt: Its deity is Death, and its metre is called Nichannā; / instead of the exclamation 'svāhā', 'phaṭ' is the rule remembered in the ten-million offering.

sanskrit_iast: anulomāṃ vilomāṃ vā gāyatrīṃ yaḥ paṭhet sadā | sarvārthās tasya sidhyanti na cānarthān samaśnute ||
meaning: अनुलोमां विलोमां वा गायत्रीं यः पठेत् सदा । सर्वार्थास् तस्य सिध्यन्ति न चानर्थान् समश्नुते ॥
text_mt: Whoever constantly recites the Gāyatrī in regular or reverse order, / all his aims succeed, and he incurs no misfortunes.

sanskrit_iast: t yā da co pra naḥ yo yo dhi || hi ma dhī sya va de rgo bha yam ṇī re rva tu vi tsa ta t ||
meaning: त् या द चो प्र नः यो यो धि ॥ हि म धी स्य व दे र्गो भ यम् णी रे र्व तु वि त्स त त् ॥
text_mt: t yā da co pra naḥ yo yo dhi || hi ma dhī sya va de rgo bha yam ṇī re rva tu vi tsa ta t

sanskrit_iast: oṃ kaṭuke kaṭukapattre subhage āsuri rakte raktavāsase | atharvaṇasya duhite aghore aghorakarmakārike ||
meaning: ओं कटुके कटुकपत्त्रे सुभगे आसुरि रक्ते रक्तवाससे । अथर्वणस्य दुहिते अघोरे अघोरकर्मकारिके ॥
text_mt: Om! O pungent one, with pungent leaves, fortunate one, Āsurī, red one, wearing red garments, / daughter of Atharvan, not terrible, doer of deeds that are not terrible!

sanskrit_iast: amukaṃ hanahana dahadaha pacapaca mathamatha | tāvad daha tāvat paca yāvan me vaśam ānayasi svāhā ||
meaning: अमुकं हनहन दहदह पचपच मथमथ । तावद् दह तावत् पच यावन् मे वशम् आनयसि स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: Smite, smite such-and-such a person! Burn, burn! Cook, cook! Crush, crush! / Burn so long, cook so long, until you bring [him] under my power, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: śayyāvasthitāyās tāvaj japed yāvat svapiti || prasthitāyā gatiṃ daha svāhā || upaviṣṭāyā bhagaṃ daha svāhā || suptāyā mano daha svāhā prabuddhāyā gṛdayaṃ daha svāheti ||
meaning: शय्यावस्थितायास् तावज् जपेद् यावत् स्वपिति ॥ प्रस्थिताया गतिं दह स्वाहा ॥ उपविष्टाया भगं दह स्वाहा ॥ सुप्ताया मनो दह स्वाहा प्रबुद्धाया गृदयं दह स्वाहेति ॥
text_mt: One should recite as long as she who is in bed sleeps: / 'Burn the gait of her when she has set forth, svāhā! Burn the vulva of her when she is seated, svāhā! Burn the mind of her when she is asleep, svāhā! Burn the heart of her when she is awakened, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: athāta āsurīkalpam upadeśād atharvaṇaḥ | nāsyās tithir na nakṣatraṃ nopavāso vidhīyate ||
meaning: अथात आसुरीकल्पम् उपदेशाद् अथर्वणः । नास्यास् तिथिर् न नक्षत्रं नोपवासो विधीयते ॥
text_mt: Now then the ordinance on the Āsurī according to the instruction of Atharvan: / for this rite no lunar day is prescribed, nor a lunar mansion, nor fasting.

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtādidravyasarveṣu āsurī śatajāpitā | pattrādyavayavaś cāsyā jikaiṣā cānuyāyinī ||
meaning: घृतादिद्रव्यसर्वेषु आसुरी शतजापिता । पत्त्राद्यवयवश् चास्या जिकैषा चानुयायिनी ॥
text_mt: Over all substances such as clarified butter, the Āsurī [mantra] is recited one hundred times; / and its parts such as leaves, and this victorious [mustard plant], are to be used.

sanskrit_iast: hantukāmo hi śatrūṃś ca vaśīkurvaṃś ca bhūpatīn | āsurīślakṣṇapiṣṭājyaṃ juhuyād ākṛtiṃ budhaḥ ||
meaning: हन्तुकामो हि शत्रूंश् च वशीकुर्वंश् च भूपतीन् । आसुरीश्लक्ष्णपिष्टाज्यं जुहुयाद् आकृतिं बुधः ॥
text_mt: Desiring to slay enemies and bringing kings under his power, / the wise man should offer an effigy made of clarified butter and finely ground mustard into the fire.

sanskrit_iast: arkendhanāgniṃ prajvālya chittvāstreṇākṛtiṃ tu tām | pādāgrato 'ṣṭasahasraṃ juhuyād yasya vaśy asau ||
meaning: अर्केन्धनाग्निं प्रज्वाल्य छित्त्वास्त्रेणाकृतिं तु ताम् । पादाग्रतो ऽष्टसहस्रं जुहुयाद् यस्य वश्य् असौ ॥
text_mt: Having kindled a fire with arka-wood fuel, and having cut that effigy with a weapon, / he should sacrifice eight thousand [pieces] from the tip of the foot; then that person becomes subservient to him.

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtāktayā strī vaśinī pālāśāgnau dvijottamāḥ | guḍāktayā kṣatriyās tu vaiśyās tu dadhimiśrayā ||
meaning: घृताक्तया स्त्री वशिनी पालाशाग्नौ द्विजोत्तमाः । गुडाक्तया क्षत्रियास् तु वैश्यास् तु दधिमिश्रया ॥
text_mt: With [mustard] smeared with clarified butter in a palāśa-wood fire, a woman is subjugated; [with it] best of twice-born [are subjugated]; / with [mustard] smeared with molasses, kṣatriyas [are subjugated]; but with [mustard] mixed with curd, vaiśyas [are subjugated];

sanskrit_iast: śūdrās tu lavaṇamiśrai rājikāṃ piṣṭayed budhaḥ | ā saptāhāt sarva ete āsurīhomato vaśāḥ ||
meaning: शूद्रास् तु लवणमिश्रै राजिकां पिष्टयेद् बुधः । आ सप्ताहात् सर्व एते आसुरीहोमतो वशाः ॥
text_mt: for śūdras, the wise man should grind black mustard mixed with salt: / up to seven days, all these become subjugated from the Āsurī offering.

sanskrit_iast: kaṭutailena trisaṃdhyaṃ kulocchedaṃ karoti hi | śunāṃ tu lomabhiḥ sārdham apasmārī tribhir dinaiḥ ||
meaning: कटुतैलेन त्रिसंध्यं कुलोच्छेदं करोति हि । शुनां तु लोमभिः सार्धम् अपस्मारी त्रिभिर् दिनैः ॥
text_mt: With pungent oil offered at the three junctures of the day, it causes the destruction of a family; / together with hairs of dogs, [it makes an enemy] epileptic within three days.

sanskrit_iast: nivṛttiḥ kṣīramadhvājyair lavaṇena tu sajvarī | arkaidhaḥsamidagnau tu kāryo visphoṭasaṃbhavaḥ ||
meaning: निवृत्तिः क्षीरमध्वाज्यैर् लवणेन तु सज्वरी । अर्कैधःसमिदग्नौ तु कार्यो विस्फोटसंभवः ॥
text_mt: Relief [comes] through milk, honey, and ghee; but [one becomes] feverish through salt. / An outbreak of boils is to be produced in a fire with Arka kindling and fuel.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām upaśamaṃ vidyāt surāśvaryā ghṛtena ca | arkakṣīrāktayāṛkāgnāv akṣiṇī sphoṭayed dviṣaḥ ||
meaning: तेषाम् उपशमं विद्यात् सुराश्वर्या घृतेन च । अर्कक्षीराक्तयाऋकाग्नाव् अक्षिणी स्फोटयेद् द्विषः ॥
text_mt: One should know their appeasement [comes] through Surāśvarī and ghee. / With [fuel] smeared with Arka sap in an Arka fire, he should burst the eyes of his enemy.

sanskrit_iast: gatāsumāṃsaṃ tasyaiva nirmālyaṃ citibhasma ca | eṣāṃ cūrṇena saṃspṛṣṭo hāsyaśīlo 'bhijāyate ||
meaning: गतासुमांसं तस्यैव निर्माल्यं चितिभस्म च । एषां चूर्णेन संस्पृष्टो हास्यशीलो ऽभिजायते ॥
text_mt: The flesh of a corpse, leftover offerings of that very [spirit], and funeral-pyre ashes— / touched with the powder of these, one becomes prone to laughter.

sanskrit_iast: ajākṣīrāktayā homāt tasya mokṣo vidhīyate | tagaraṃ kuṣṭhamāṃsī ca tasyāḥ pattrāṇi caiva hi ||
meaning: अजाक्षीराक्तया होमात् तस्य मोक्षो विधीयते । तगरं कुष्ठमांसी च तस्याः पत्त्राणि चैव हि ॥
text_mt: Release for him is prescribed by an oblation with [fuel] smeared with goat's milk. / Tagara, kuṣṭha, māṃsī, and indeed its leaves—

sanskrit_iast: etaiḥ ślakṣṇais tu saṃspṛṣṭaḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ paridhāvati | tasyāḥ phalāni mūlāni surabhīhastimedasā ||
meaning: एतैः श्लक्ष्णैस् तु संस्पृष्टः पृष्ठतः परिधावति । तस्याः फलानि मूलानि सुरभीहस्तिमेदसा ॥
text_mt: touched with these [ground] finely, he runs after behind him. / Its fruits, roots, with fragrant elephant-marrow—

sanskrit_iast: sūkṣmāt taddravyasaṃsparśād anudhāvaty acetasaḥ | achidrapattrāṇy asita uśīraḥ sarṣapās tathā ||
meaning: सूक्ष्मात् तद्द्रव्यसंस्पर्शाद् अनुधावत्य् अचेतसः । अछिद्रपत्त्राण्य् असित उशीरः सर्षपास् तथा ॥
text_mt: from the fine touch of that substance, the mindless one runs after. / Leaves without holes, black uśīra, and likewise mustard seeds—

sanskrit_iast: etacśūrṇāt pūrvaphalaṃ ghṛte caivāparājayaḥ ||
meaning: एतच्शूर्णात् पूर्वफलं घृते चैवापराजयः ॥
text_mt: from this powder comes the previous result, and in ghee [it yields] non-defeat.

sanskrit_iast: kusumāni manahśilāpriyaṅgutagarāṇi ca | gajendramadasaṃyuktaṃ kiṃ kurvāṇas tv akṛd varam ||
meaning: कुसुमानि मनह्शिलाप्रियङ्गुतगराणि च । गजेन्द्रमदसंयुक्तं किं कुर्वाणस् त्व् अकृद् वरम् ॥
text_mt: Flowers, realgar, priyaṅgu, and tagara, / joined with the rut of an elephant-king—what best thing might he doing [not accomplish]?

sanskrit_iast: yāś ca striyo 'bhigacchanti tā vaśāḥ padālepataḥ | sapuṣpāṃ tāṃ samādāya añjanaṃ nāgakeśaram ||
meaning: याश् च स्त्रियो ऽभिगच्छन्ति ता वशाः पदालेपतः । सपुष्पां तां समादाय अञ्जनं नागकेशरम् ॥
text_mt: And whatever women approach, they are subjugated by anointing the feet. / Taking that along with its flower, [along with] collyrium and nāgakeśara,

sanskrit_iast: anenāktābhyām akṣibhyāṃ yamyaṃ paśyet sa kiṃkaraḥ | añjanaṃ tagaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ devījaṃ kāṣṭham eva ca ||
meaning: अनेनाक्ताभ्याम् अक्षिभ्यां यम्यं पश्येत् स किंकरः । अञ्जनं तगरं कुष्ठं देवीजं काष्ठम् एव च ॥
text_mt: with eyes anointed with this, as a servant he would see what pertains to Yama. / Collyrium, tagara, kuṣṭha, and the wood born of the goddess,

sanskrit_iast: māṇsī ca sarvabhūtānāṃ saubhāgyasya tu kāraṇam | tatsamidhāṃ lakṣahomān nidhānaṃ paśyate mahat ||
meaning: माण्सी च सर्वभूतानां सौभाग्यस्य तु कारणम् । तत्समिधां लक्षहोमान् निधानं पश्यते महत् ॥
text_mt: and māṃsī are the cause of good fortune for all beings. / From a hundred-thousand oblations of its fuel-sticks, one sees a great treasure.

sanskrit_iast: sarpirdadhimadhvaktapattrāṇāṃ vṛddhaputrī sahasrataḥ | rājyaṃ tu labhate vaśyaṃ tatpattratrisahasrataḥ ||
meaning: सर्पिर्दधिमध्वक्तपत्त्राणां वृद्धपुत्री सहस्रतः । राज्यं तु लभते वश्यं तत्पत्त्रत्रिसहस्रतः ॥
text_mt: From a thousand leaves smeared with ghee, curd, and honey, [an old woman becomes] rich in sons; / and from three thousand of its leaves, one obtains a kingdom brought under control.

sanskrit_iast: svarṇasahasrasyāptis tu tatpuṣpāṇāṃ tu lakṣataḥ | sahasrajāpāc ca tadvad udake kṣīrabhakṣiṇaḥ ||
meaning: स्वर्णसहस्रस्याप्तिस् तु तत्पुष्पाणां तु लक्षतः । सहस्रजापाच् च तद्वद् उदके क्षीरभक्षिणः ॥
text_mt: The attainment of a thousand [pieces of] gold [results] from a hundred thousand of its flowers; / and likewise from a thousandfold recitation by one subsisting on milk in water.

sanskrit_iast: vāripūrṇe 'tha kalaśe lokeśīpallavān kṣipet | snānād alakṣmyā mucyeta sauvarṇakalaśe 'pi tu ||
meaning: वारिपूर्णे ऽथ कलशे लोकेशीपल्लवान् क्षिपेत् । स्नानाद् अलक्ष्म्या मुच्येत सौवर्णकलशे ऽपि तु ॥
text_mt: Then, into a water-filled pot one should cast shoots of the Lokeśī [plant]. / From bathing [with it], even in a golden pot, one would be freed from misfortune;

sanskrit_iast: vināyakebhyaḥ snānato daurbhāgyāc caiva durbhagāt | pṛṣṭhataś cānudhāvanti saṃspṛṣṭa udakena tu ||
meaning: विनायकेभ्यः स्नानतो दौर्भाग्याच् चैव दुर्भगात् । पृष्ठतश् चानुधावन्ति संस्पृष्ट उदकेन तु ॥
text_mt: from bathing [one is freed] from the Vināyakas, and from misfortune and being unfortunate; / and touched with the water, they run behind [him].

sanskrit_iast: uśīraṃ tagaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ mustā tatpattrasarṣapāḥ | cūrṇenābhihatas tūrṇam īśvaro 'pi vaśo bhavet ||
meaning: उशीरं तगरं कुष्ठं मुस्ता तत्पत्त्रसर्षपाः । चूर्णेनाभिहतस् तूर्णम् ईश्वरो ऽपि वशो भवेत् ॥
text_mt: Uśīra, tagara, kuṣṭha, mustā, its leaves, and mustard seeds— / struck quickly with this powder, even a lord would become subjugated.

sanskrit_iast: tulasībhūmahādevīcūrṇaspṛṣṭas tathā vaśī | rājābhayaṃ sureśvarīmārjanād bhāraṇāt tathā ||
meaning: तुलसीभूमहादेवीचूर्णस्पृष्टस् तथा वशी । राजाभयं सुरेश्वरीमार्जनाद् भारणात् तथा ॥
text_mt: Likewise, touched with the powder of tulasī, bhū[myāmalakī], and mahādevī, he is subjugated. / Fearlessness from the king [comes] from cleansing with and wearing Sureśvarī.

sanskrit_iast: na syāt tasyādbhutaṃ kiṃ cin na kṣudropadravas tathā | nānaiśvaryaṃ nāprajatvaṃ yasya devy āsurī gṛhe ||
meaning: न स्यात् तस्याद्भुतं किं चिन् न क्षुद्रोपद्रवस् तथा । नानैश्वर्यं नाप्रजत्वं यस्य देव्य् आसुरी गृहे ॥
text_mt: For him there would be no portent whatsoever, nor minor affliction, / nor lack of sovereignty, nor childlessness, in whose house the goddess Āsurī resides.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ nama ucchuṣmebhyaḥ
meaning: ओं नम उच्छुष्मेभ्यः

sanskrit_iast: … śikhāṃ devīṃ prapadye śaṃkarāyaṇīṃ | sarvārthasādhanīṃ vibhvīṃ sarveśīṃ brahmacāriṇīm ||
meaning: … शिखां देवीं प्रपद्ये शंकरायणीं । सर्वार्थसाधनीं विभ्वीं सर्वेशीं ब्रह्मचारिणीम् ॥
text_mt: […] I take refuge in the goddess crest[-mantra], the refuge of Śaṅkara, / the accomplisher of all aims, the all-pervading, the ruler of all, the celibate.

sanskrit_iast: te iṣṭakākārakarālam aticaturmukham || caturvidhais tu rūpaṃ dhyānam ||
meaning: ते इष्टकाकारकरालम् अतिचतुर्मुखम् ॥ चतुर्विधैस् तु रूपं ध्यानम् ॥
text_mt: Them: formidable, having the form of a brick, exceedingly four-faced. / And the visualization [is of] fourfold form.

sanskrit_iast: śive jaṭile brahmacāriṇi stambhani jambhani mohani huṃ phaṭ namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: शिवे जटिले ब्रह्मचारिणि स्तम्भनि जम्भनि मोहनि हुं फट् नमः स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: O auspicious one, matted-haired one, celibate one, paralyzer, crusher, deluder, huṃ phaṭ, homage, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: ātmarakṣā ||
meaning: आत्मरक्षा ॥

sanskrit_iast: prācyāṃ diśīndro rājā devānām ādhipatyaṃ kurute | taṃ devaṃ bhagavantaṃ sagaṇaṃ sānucaraṃ saparivāraṃ saśirāḥ praṇipatya vijñāpayati | vajreṇa praharaṇenemāṃ diśaṃ vidiśaṃ ca sarvakalikaluṣam aśubhaṃ praśamayoṃ namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: प्राच्यां दिशीन्द्रो राजा देवानाम् आधिपत्यं कुरुते । तं देवं भगवन्तं सगणं सानुचरं सपरिवारं सशिराः प्रणिपत्य विज्ञापयति । वज्रेण प्रहरणेनेमां दिशं विदिशं च सर्वकलिकलुषम् अशुभं प्रशमयों नमः स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: In the eastern direction, King Indra exercises sovereignty over the gods. Bowing down with head bent, he addresses that divine Lord together with his host, together with his followers, together with his retinue: 'With the thunderbolt as weapon, pacify every Kali-defilement and evil in this direction and intermediate direction! Om, homage, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi yamo rājā pretānām ādhipatyam iti | daṇḍena praharaṇeneti ||
meaning: दक्षिणस्यां दिशि यमो राजा प्रेतानाम् आधिपत्यम् इति । दण्डेन प्रहरणेनेति ॥
text_mt: In the southern direction, King Yama exercises sovereignty over the ghosts: 'With the staff as weapon...'

sanskrit_iast: pratīcyāṃ diśi varuṇo rājāpām ādhipatyam iti | pāśena praharaṇeneti ||
meaning: प्रतीच्यां दिशि वरुणो राजापाम् आधिपत्यम् इति । पाशेन प्रहरणेनेति ॥
text_mt: In the western direction, King Varuṇa exercises sovereignty over the waters: 'With the noose as weapon...'

sanskrit_iast: udīcyāṃ diśi kubero rājā yakṣāṇām ādhipatyam iti | gadayā prahareṇeti ||
meaning: उदीच्यां दिशि कुबेरो राजा यक्षाणाम् आधिपत्यम् इति । गदया प्रहरेणेति ॥
text_mt: In the northern direction, King Kubera exercises sovereignty over the yakṣas: 'With the mace as weapon...'

sanskrit_iast: dhruvāyāṃ diśi vāsukī rājā nāgānām ādhipatyam iti | daṃṣṭrayā praharaṇeneti ||
meaning: ध्रुवायां दिशि वासुकी राजा नागानाम् आधिपत्यम् इति । दंष्ट्रया प्रहरणेनेति ॥
text_mt: In the fixed direction, King Vāsuki exercises sovereignty over the nāgas: 'With the fang as weapon...'

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvāyāṃ diśi somo rājā nakṣatrāṇām ādhipatyaṃ kurute | taṃ devaṃ bhagavaṃ sagaṇaṃ sānucaraṃ saparivāraṃ saśirāḥ praṇipatya vijñāpayati || tejasā praharaṇenemāṃ diśaṃ vidiśaṃ ca sarvakalikaluṣam aśubhaṃ praśamayoṃ namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: ऊर्ध्वायां दिशि सोमो राजा नक्षत्राणाम् आधिपत्यं कुरुते । तं देवं भगवं सगणं सानुचरं सपरिवारं सशिराः प्रणिपत्य विज्ञापयति ॥ तेजसा प्रहरणेनेमां दिशं विदिशं च सर्वकलिकलुषम् अशुभं प्रशमयों नमः स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: In the upper direction, King Soma exercises sovereignty over the lunar mansions. Bowing down with head bent, he addresses that divine Lord together with his host, together with his followers, together with his retinue: 'With splendor as weapon, pacify every Kali-defilement and evil in this direction and intermediate direction! Om, homage, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: athocchuṣmahṛdayam || dyurudyuru daradara vidārayavidāraya milimili namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: अथोच्छुष्महृदयम् ॥ द्युरुद्युरु दरदर विदारयविदारय मिलिमिलि नमः स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: Now the heart[-mantra] of Ucchuṣma: dyuru dyuru dara dara vidāraya vidāraya mili mili, homage, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: ucchuṣmaśikhā || śive jaṭila iti prathamaḥ ||
meaning: उच्छुष्मशिखा ॥ शिवे जटिल इति प्रथमः ॥
text_mt: The crest[-mantra] of Ucchuṣma: 'O auspicious one, matted-haired one' is the first.

sanskrit_iast: kurukuru murumuru mahā muñca mahā muñca viduvidu namaḥ svāhā || iti kavacam ||
meaning: कुरुकुरु मुरुमुरु महा मुञ्च महा मुञ्च विदुविदु नमः स्वाहा ॥ इति कवचम् ॥
text_mt: kuru kuru muru muru mahā muñca mahā muñca vidu vidu, homage, svāhā! This is the armor[-mantra].

sanskrit_iast: oṃ namo mahāpiṅgalāya siṃhanādanādine namaḥ svāhā || ity astramantraḥ ||
meaning: ओं नमो महापिङ्गलाय सिंहनादनादिने नमः स्वाहा ॥ इत्य् अस्त्रमन्त्रः ॥
text_mt: Om, homage to the Great Tawny One who roars with the roar of a lion, homage, svāhā! This is the weapon-mantra.

sanskrit_iast: eṣām ucchuṣmarudrāṇām ataḥ kalpo nigadyate | atharvavedodbhavānāṃ tithyṛkṣādyayogataḥ ||
meaning: एषाम् उच्छुष्मरुद्राणाम् अतः कल्पो निगद्यते । अथर्ववेदोद्भवानां तिथ्यृक्षाद्ययोगतः ॥
text_mt: Now the ritual manual of these Ucchuṣma Rudras is proclaimed, / born of the Atharvaveda, independent of the conjunction of lunar days and lunar mansions.

sanskrit_iast: grāme vāthāpy araṇye vā pracareta yathāvidhi | sadyaḥsiddhikarā hy ete ucchuṣmāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||
meaning: ग्रामे वाथाप्य् अरण्ये वा प्रचरेत यथाविधि । सद्यःसिद्धिकरा ह्य् एते उच्छुष्माः परिकीर्तिताः ॥
text_mt: Whether in the village or in the forest, one should perform it according to the rule; / for these Ucchuṣmas are declared to bring immediate success.

sanskrit_iast: ātmarakṣāṃ diśāṃ bandhaṃ śikhābandhaṃ ca sarvadā | etair eva yathāyogam ādau kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
meaning: आत्मरक्षां दिशां बन्धं शिखाबन्धं च सर्वदा । एतैर् एव यथायोगम् आदौ कुर्याद् विचक्षणः ॥
text_mt: Protection of oneself, binding of the directions, and binding of the crest: / the wise one should always do these first with these very [mantras] appropriately.

sanskrit_iast: khadirasyodumbarasya tathā bilvapalāśayoḥ | dadhisarpirmadhuyujāṃ śāntānāṃ vāpi bilvataḥ ||
meaning: खदिरस्योदुम्बरस्य तथा बिल्वपलाशयोः । दधिसर्पिर्मधुयुजां शान्तानां वापि बिल्वतः ॥
text_mt: Of khadira, of udumbara, and likewise of bilva and palāśa, / joined with curd, ghee, and honey, or from calm bilva [wood]—

sanskrit_iast: samitsahasratritayaṃ hutvā śāntir gavāṃ bhavet | tīkṣṇāsṛgviṣayuktānāṃ phaṭkāraś ca vināśane ||
meaning: समित्सहस्रत्रितयं हुत्वा शान्तिर् गवां भवेत् । तीक्ष्णासृग्विषयुक्तानां फट्कारश् च विनाशने ॥
text_mt: having offered three thousand fuel-sticks, there is pacification for cattle. / And for destruction, with [sticks] smeared with pungent blood and poison, with the exclamation phaṭ.

sanskrit_iast: prayogād apy asiddhiś cet tatkarmedaṃ samārabhet | ucchuṣmarūpī bhakṣayaṃs tīkṣṇaḥ saktūdakāni tu ||
meaning: प्रयोगाद् अप्य् असिद्धिश् चेत् तत्कर्मेदं समारभेत् । उच्छुष्मरूपी भक्षयंस् तीक्ष्णः सक्तूदकानि तु ॥
text_mt: If even from [that] practice there is no success, he should undertake this rite: / having the form of Ucchuṣma, consuming pungent roasted-barley water,

sanskrit_iast: abhīṣṭāṃ vā striyaṃ gatvā dhyātvā vā reta utsṛjet | mūtrāṃ purīṣaṃ cotsṛjya gokaṅkālādhirohaṇam ||
meaning: अभीष्टां वा स्त्रियं गत्वा ध्यात्वा वा रेत उत्सृजेत् । मूत्रां पुरीषं चोत्सृज्य गोकङ्कालाधिरोहणम् ॥
text_mt: or having approached a desired woman, or having meditated, he should discharge semen; / and having discharged urine and feces, climbing onto a cow carcass,

sanskrit_iast: kṛtvā mantraṃ niśi japed yāvad gośṛṅgataś caret | jvālābhaṅgaṃ tatas tasya karmasiddhiṃ samādiśet ||
meaning: कृत्वा मन्त्रं निशि जपेद् यावद् गोशृङ्गतश् चरेत् । ज्वालाभङ्गं ततस् तस्य कर्मसिद्धिं समादिशेत् ॥
text_mt: he should recite the mantra at night as long as a flame-breaking moves from the cow's horn; / then one should declare success in his rite.

sanskrit_iast: dadhimadhughṛtāktānām iti śeṣaḥ ||
meaning: दधिमधुघृताक्तानाम् इति शेषः ॥
text_mt: ['Smeared with curd, honey, and ghee' is the ellipsis.]

sanskrit_iast: saptakṣīrāñjaligrāsaḥ sruvo hy asmin praśasyate | kṣīraṃ tenātha juhuyād dhanakāmasya nityaśaḥ ||
meaning: सप्तक्षीराञ्जलिग्रासः स्रुवो ह्य् अस्मिन् प्रशस्यते । क्षीरं तेनाथ जुहुयाद् धनकामस्य नित्यशः ॥
text_mt: A ladle holding a portion of seven folded hands of milk is praised in this [rite]; / with it, one desiring wealth should continually offer milk;

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtena tejaskāmasya āyuḥkāmasya dūrvayā | kukusaṃ tumbaraṃ vāpi vidyād uccāṭakarmaṇi ||
meaning: घृतेन तेजस्कामस्य आयुःकामस्य दूर्वया । कुकुसं तुम्बरं वापि विद्याद् उच्चाटकर्मणि ॥
text_mt: with ghee, one desiring splendor; with dūrvā grass, one desiring longevity. / One should know chaff or tumbara in the rite of eradication.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇaṃ tu vaśīkartuṃ śālipiṣṭamayīṃ tanum | kṛtvā catuṣpathaṃ gatvā gṛhītvā śastram uttamam ||
meaning: ब्राह्मणं तु वशीकर्तुं शालिपिष्टमयीं तनुम् । कृत्वा चतुष्पथं गत्वा गृहीत्वा शस्त्रम् उत्तमम् ॥
text_mt: To subjugate a Brahmin, making a figure made of rice flour, / going to a crossroads, taking an excellent weapon,

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭottarasahasreṇa kṛtvā tadabhimantraṇam | aṣṭāṅgaṃ tena tāṃ chitvā mantrato vaśam ānayet ||
meaning: अष्टोत्तरसहस्रेण कृत्वा तदभिमन्त्रणम् । अष्टाङ्गं तेन तां छित्वा मन्त्रतो वशम् आनयेत् ॥
text_mt: having consecrated it with a thousand and eight [recitations], / having cut it into eight parts with that, he should bring [him] under control by means of the mantra.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭottarasahasraṃ vā prakṛte juhuyād budhaḥ | brāhmaṇīṃ tu vaśīkartuṃ kuryān māṣamayīṃ tanum ||
meaning: अष्टोत्तरसहस्रं वा प्रकृते जुहुयाद् बुधः । ब्राह्मणीं तु वशीकर्तुं कुर्यान् माषमयीं तनुम् ॥
text_mt: Or the wise one should offer a thousand and eight in the primary substance. / To subjugate a Brahmin woman, he should make a figure made of black gram.

sanskrit_iast: sarpirdadhimadhvaktānāṃ lājānām āhutīḥ śubhāḥ | kanyākāmo 'ṣṭasahasraṃ hutvā kanyām avāpnuyāt ||
meaning: सर्पिर्दधिमध्वक्तानां लाजानाम् आहुतीः शुभाः । कन्याकामो ऽष्टसहस्रं हुत्वा कन्याम् अवाप्नुयात् ॥
text_mt: Having offered eight thousand auspicious oblations of parched grain / smeared with ghee, curd, and honey, one desiring a maiden would obtain a maiden.

sanskrit_iast: api vā piṣṭamayyāḥ prāg juhuyāt saṃdhyayāhutīḥ | darbheṣīkāṃ vābhimantrya tadgṛhe niścalāṃ nyaset ||
meaning: अपि वा पिष्टमय्याः प्राग् जुहुयात् संध्ययाहुतीः । दर्भेषीकां वाभिमन्त्र्य तद्गृहे निश्चलां न्यसेत् ॥
text_mt: Or before the flour figure, he should offer oblations at twilight; / or having consecrated a reed of darbha grass, he should place it motionless in her house.

sanskrit_iast: tāvad udvejayet sā tu vajrabhūtā hi tadgṛham | kanyāyāḥ sādhanīyāyās tu yāval lābhas tato bhavet ||
meaning: तावद् उद्वेजयेत् सा तु वज्रभूता हि तद्गृहम् । कन्यायाः साधनीयायास् तु यावल् लाभस् ततो भवेत् ॥
text_mt: It will agitate that house, turned into a thunderbolt, / until the maiden who is to be won is obtained.

sanskrit_iast: pradhānam anyaṃ vā kiṃ cid vaśīkartuṃ narottamam | samidhaḥ khadirādīnām audumbaryaś ca homayet ||
meaning: प्रधानम् अन्यं वा किं चिद् वशीकर्तुं नरोत्तमम् । समिधः खदिरादीनाम् औदुम्बर्यश् च होमयेत् ॥
text_mt: Or, to subjugate an eminent person or any best of men, / he should offer sacrificial kindling of khadira and other [trees], and of udumbara.

sanskrit_iast: śmaśānakhaṭvāṅgamayīṃ homayen mantrasādhane | palāṇḍulaśunaprasthaṃ hutvā mastaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning: श्मशानखट्वाङ्गमयीं होमयेन् मन्त्रसाधने । पलाण्डुलशुनप्रस्थं हुत्वा मस्तं न संशयः ॥
text_mt: In the accomplishment of the mantra, he should offer [an effigy] made of a cot-leg from a cremation ground; / having offered a prastha of onion and garlic, [the target's] head is destroyed, no doubt.

sanskrit_iast: śirīṣāṅgamayīṃ rājño balis trimadhureṇa tu | brāhmaṇe pāyasamayīṃ kṣatriyasya viṣāṇikām ||
meaning: शिरीषाङ्गमयीं राज्ञो बलिस् त्रिमधुरेण तु । ब्राह्मणे पायसमयीं क्षत्रियस्य विषाणिकाम् ॥
text_mt: For a king, [an effigy] made of śirīṣa wood, with an oblation of the three sweets; / for a Brahmin, one made of rice-milk; for a kṣatriya, a horn [effigy];

sanskrit_iast: vaiśyasya sādhane homyāś cūrṇaiḥ surabhisaṃskṛtāḥ | catuṣpathe tu śūdrasya padminyutkaraṇena tu ||
meaning: वैश्यस्य साधने होम्याश् चूर्णैः सुरभिसंस्कृताः । चतुष्पथे तु शूद्रस्य पद्मिन्युत्करणेन तु ॥
text_mt: In the rite for a vaiśya, [effigies] treated with fragrant powders are to be offered into the fire; / but at a crossroads for a śūdra, using lotus scraps.

sanskrit_iast: likhitvā nāma saṃgṛhya karāgrāṅgulipīḍitām | śiraḥpīḍā jvaraḥ śūlaṃ vimatiḥ svastyasaṃgatiḥ ||
meaning: लिखित्वा नाम संगृह्य कराग्राङ्गुलिपीडिताम् । शिरःपीडा ज्वरः शूलं विमतिः स्वस्त्यसंगतिः ॥
text_mt: Having written the name and seized [the effigy], squeezed with the tips of the fingers of the hand, / headache, fever, colic, mental confusion, and loss of well-being [occur].

sanskrit_iast: balyādyā vā prayoktavyā brāhmaṇādicatuṣṭaye | evaṃ saty abhicāraś ca caturṇām api darśitaḥ ||
meaning: बल्याद्या वा प्रयोक्तव्या ब्राह्मणादिचतुष्टये । एवं सत्य् अभिचारश् च चतुर्णाम् अपि दर्शितः ॥
text_mt: Or offerings and the rest are to be applied to the four [castes] beginning with the Brahmin; / in this way, the sorcery rite for all four has been demonstrated.

sanskrit_iast: liṅgaṃ vā rājasarṣapaiḥ samālikhyātha dhūpayet | gaurair arghaṃ tathā dadyān mriyate sāpy asaṃśayam ||
meaning: लिङ्गं वा राजसर्षपैः समालिख्याथ धूपयेत् । गौरैर् अर्घं तथा दद्यान् म्रियते साप्य् असंशयम् ॥
text_mt: Or having drawn a phallus with brown mustard seeds, he should then fumigate it; / he should also give an offering of water with white [mustard seeds]; she too dies without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast: abhakṣabhakṣo hy asvāsthyaṃ sarvarogaprakopanam | niḥsaṃjñatā piṇḍapāto japāvṛttyā bhavanti hi ||
meaning: अभक्षभक्षो ह्य् अस्वास्थ्यं सर्वरोगप्रकोपनम् । निःसंज्ञता पिण्डपातो जपावृत्त्या भवन्ति हि ॥
text_mt: Eating forbidden food, ill-health, aggravation of all diseases, / unconsciousness, and abortion indeed occur through repetition of the recitation.

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśaṃ na japtavyaṃ kulotsādas tato bhavet ||
meaning: एकादशं न जप्तव्यं कुलोत्सादस् ततो भवेत् ॥
text_mt: An eleventh [recitation] must not be recited; destruction of the family would result from that.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ namo mahāpiṅgalāya trivṛte trivṛte namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: ओं नमो महापिङ्गलाय त्रिवृते त्रिवृते नमः स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: Oṃ, homage to Mahāpiṅgala, the threefold, the threefold! Homage, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: namaḥ sarāntitevatevasu trivṛte trivṛte triparvaṇe triśīrṣāya namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: नमः सरान्तितेवतेवसु त्रिवृते त्रिवृते त्रिपर्वणे त्रिशीर्षाय नमः स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: Homage, sarāntitevatevasu, threefold, threefold, three-jointed, three-headed! Homage, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: namaḥ kaṭavikaṭakaṇṭemāṭe pāṭale vikale asauryāsau asauryāsau pṛthivīṣṭakā iṣṭakājinātyūnyo saugaluṃtigaluṃtekaṭamasi kaṭapravṛte pradviṣa rudra raudreṇāveśayāveśaya hanahana dahadaha pacapaca mathamatha vidhvaṃsayavidhvaṃsaya viśveśvara yogeśvara maheśvara namas te 'stu mā mā hiṃsīḥ huṃ phaṭ namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: नमः कटविकटकण्टेमाटे पाटले विकले असौर्यासौ असौर्यासौ पृथिवीष्टका इष्टकाजिनात्यून्यो सौगलुंतिगलुंतेकटमसि कटप्रवृते प्रद्विष रुद्र रौद्रेणावेशयावेशय हनहन दहदह पचपच मथमथ विध्वंसयविध्वंसय विश्वेश्वर योगेश्वर महेश्वर नमस् ते ऽस्तु मा मा हिंसीः हुं फट् नमः स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: Homage, kaṭavikaṭakaṇṭemāṭe pāṭale vikale asauryāsau asauryāsau pṛthivīṣṭakā iṣṭakājinātyūnyo saugaluṃtigaluṃtekaṭamasi kaṭapravṛte pradviṣa, Rudra! Through Rudra's power, possess, possess! Slay, slay! Burn, burn! Cook, cook! Churn, churn! Destroy, destroy! O Lord of all, Lord of Yoga, Maheśvara, homage be to you! Do not harm me! Huṃ phaṭ, homage, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: kālāya karālāya namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: कालाय करालाय नमः स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: To Kāla, the dreadful! Homage, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: kṛtāntāya namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: कृतान्ताय नमः स्वाहा ॥

sanskrit_iast: amoghāya namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: अमोघाय नमः स्वाहा ॥

sanskrit_iast: aghorāya namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: अघोराय नमः स्वाहा ॥

sanskrit_iast: anivartāya namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: अनिवर्ताय नमः स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: To Anivarta! Homage, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: bhagāya namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: भगाय नमः स्वाहा ॥

sanskrit_iast: bhagapramathanāya namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: भगप्रमथनाय नमः स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: To Bhagapramathana! Homage, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣabhāya namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: वृषभाय नमः स्वाहा ॥

sanskrit_iast: indranetrāya namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: इन्द्रनेत्राय नमः स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: To Indranetra! Homage, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: suvarṇacūḍāya namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: सुवर्णचूडाय नमः स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: To Suvarṇacūḍa! Homage, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: hāhāhīhī namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: हाहाहीही नमः स्वाहा ॥

sanskrit_iast: namas tīkṣṇāya tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāya bhīṣaṇāya sahasrapādāyānantaśīrṣāya vāmanāya namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: नमस् तीक्ष्णाय तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्राय भीषणाय सहस्रपादायानन्तशीर्षाय वामनाय नमः स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: Homage to the sharp one, the sharp-fanged, the terrifying, the thousand-footed, the endless-headed, the dwarf! Homage, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: mahāvaktrāya piṅgalanetrāya namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: महावक्त्राय पिङ्गलनेत्राय नमः स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: To the large-mouthed, the yellow-eyed! Homage, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: khanakhanāya namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: खनखनाय नमः स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: To Khanakhana! Homage, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: ghanaghanāya namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: घनघनाय नमः स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: To Ghanaghana! Homage, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: ghusughusāya namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: घुसुघुसाय नमः स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: To Ghusughusa! Homage, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: alepāya namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: अलेपाय नमः स्वाहा ॥

sanskrit_iast: paśave namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: पशवे नमः स्वाहा ॥

sanskrit_iast: mahāpaśupataye namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: महापशुपतये नमः स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: To Mahāpaśupati! Homage, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: ucchuṣmāya namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: उच्छुष्माय नमः स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: To Ucchuṣma! Homage, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: ucchuṣmarudrāya namaḥ svāhā ||
meaning: उच्छुष्मरुद्राय नमः स्वाहा ॥
text_mt: To Ucchuṣmarudra! Homage, svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: eṣāṃ krameṇa kṛtyāni vakṣyamāṇāni yojayet | aṣṭasahasrābhijaptam anyad dravyaṃ tu homataḥ ||
meaning: एषां क्रमेण कृत्यानि वक्ष्यमाणानि योजयेत् । अष्टसहस्राभिजप्तम् अन्यद् द्रव्यं तु होमतः ॥
text_mt: He should apply the deeds to be described for these in due order; / any other substance, consecrated eight thousand times, is [offered] by oblation.

sanskrit_iast: śatror nāmnā lavaṇasya sahasram aṣṭakādhikam | hutvā dhanāyuṣor hānir jvareṇa sa ca śuṣyati ||
meaning: शत्रोर् नाम्ना लवणस्य सहस्रम् अष्टकाधिकम् । हुत्वा धनायुषोर् हानिर् ज्वरेण स च शुष्यति ॥
text_mt: Having offered a thousand and eight [portions] of salt with the name of the enemy, / there is loss of wealth and life, and he withers away with fever.

sanskrit_iast: kṣipraṃ śāntir bhavet tasya kṣīrahomāt tu tāvataḥ ||
meaning: क्षिप्रं शान्तिर् भवेत् तस्य क्षीरहोमात् तु तावतः ॥
text_mt: Prompt appeasement for him will occur from an offering of that same amount of milk.

sanskrit_iast: kaṇaiḥ puttalikāṃ kṛtvā gośṛṅgeṇārghadhūpabe | aṣṭasahasrābhijaptaṃ madanasya tu kaṇṭakam || tenāṣṭādaśavedhāt tu mūlakṣīrān nivartanam ||
meaning: कणैः पुत्तलिकां कृत्वा गोशृङ्गेणार्घधूपबे । अष्टसहस्राभिजप्तं मदनस्य तु कण्टकम् ॥ तेनाष्टादशवेधात् तु मूलक्षीरान् निवर्तनम् ॥
text_mt: Having made a doll of grain particles, with cow-horn for water-offering and fumigation, / a thorn of the madana tree consecrated eight thousand times— / from piercing it eighteen times with that, cessation [comes] from milky sap of roots.

sanskrit_iast: dadhnā ca madhusarpirbhyāṃ ttrivarṇaiḥ sarṣapair hutaiḥ || gaurair aṣṭasahasreṇa japtair āveśayed ripūn ||
meaning: दध्ना च मधुसर्पिर्भ्यां त्त्रिवर्णैः सर्षपैर् हुतैः ॥ गौरैर् अष्टसहस्रेण जप्तैर् आवेशयेद् रिपून् ॥
text_mt: With curd, honey, and ghee, and three-colored mustard seeds offered into fire, / or with white [mustard seeds] recited over eight thousand times, he should cause enemies to be possessed.

sanskrit_iast: dadhyādyabhyaktalājānāṃ homād aṣṭasahasrataḥ || nāśayet satatajvaraṃ dvitīyādiṃ ca dūrataḥ ||
meaning: दध्याद्यभ्यक्तलाजानां होमाद् अष्टसहस्रतः ॥ नाशयेत् सततज्वरं द्वितीयादिं च दूरतः ॥
text_mt: From eight thousand oblations of parched grain smeared with curd and the other [substances], / he destroys continuous fever, tertian [fever], and the rest from afar.

sanskrit_iast: parijapya darbheṣīkāṃ kumbhakārādiveśmasu | nyastvā pākaṃ surāpākaṃ kaivartādi vināśayet ||
meaning: परिजप्य दर्भेषीकां कुम्भकारादिवेश्मसु । न्यस्त्वा पाकं सुरापाकं कैवर्तादि विनाशयेत् ॥
text_mt: Having recited over a darbha reed and placed it in the houses of potters and others, / he ruins the baking [of pots], the brewing of liquor, the work of fishermen, and so on.

sanskrit_iast: akṣatais taṇḍulaiḥ kṛtvā pratidehaṃ suśobhanam | saṃsthāpya dhānyarāśau taṃ candanāduru dāhayet | baliṃ trimadhuraṃ dattvā syāt sa rāśiś caturguṇaḥ ||
meaning: अक्षतैस् तण्डुलैः कृत्वा प्रतिदेहं सुशोभनम् । संस्थाप्य धान्यराशौ तं चन्दनादुरु दाहयेत् । बलिं त्रिमधुरं दत्त्वा स्यात् स राशिश् चतुर्गुणः ॥
text_mt: Having made a very fine likeness [of a body] with unhusked rice, / placing it upon a heap of grain, he should burn it with sandalwood and agallochum; / having given an offering of the three sweets, that heap will become fourfold.

sanskrit_iast: khādiraṃ kīlakaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ tailāktaṃ dvādaśāṅgulam | parijaptaṃ grāmamadhye nikhanet sadya udvaset ||
meaning: खादिरं कीलकं तीक्ष्णं तैलाक्तं द्वादशाङ्गुलम् । परिजप्तं ग्राममध्ये निखनेत् सद्य उद्वसेत् ॥
text_mt: A sharp peg of khadira wood, twelve finger-breadths long, smeared with oil, / recited over and driven into the middle of a village, [the village] is immediately depopulated.

sanskrit_iast: mahāpātakadoṣeṇa grāmī nirdhanatāṃ vrajet | kṣīreṇa kīlakasnānāt kuryāt tuṣṭas tu śāntikam ||
meaning: महापातकदोषेण ग्रामी निर्धनतां व्रजेत् । क्षीरेण कीलकस्नानात् कुर्यात् तुष्टस् तु शान्तिकम् ॥
text_mt: A villager falls into poverty because of the fault of a grave sin; / but when propitiated, he should perform a pacification rite by bathing the peg with milk.

sanskrit_iast: kṣīrasyāṣṭasahasraṃ ca juhuyāt tadanantaram ||
meaning: क्षीरस्याष्टसहस्रं च जुहुयात् तदनन्तरम् ॥
text_mt: And immediately after that, he should offer eight thousand [oblations] of milk.

sanskrit_iast: kalāpamantrāṃ guṭikāṃ tannāmnā gavyamāṃsataḥ | mahāpātakasaṃbandhāj jāyate 'sya dhanakṣayaḥ ||
meaning: कलापमन्त्रां गुटिकां तन्नाम्ना गव्यमांसतः । महापातकसंबन्धाज् जायते ऽस्य धनक्षयः ॥
text_mt: A pill made with the Kalāpa mantra from beef with his name; / from the connection with the grave sin, loss of his wealth occurs.

sanskrit_iast: trivarṇasarṣapair homāt saha trimadhureṇa tu | saṃpadyate sutas tasya medhāvī śrutadhārakaḥ | taddhomāt ke cid icchanti unmattatvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning: त्रिवर्णसर्षपैर् होमात् सह त्रिमधुरेण तु । संपद्यते सुतस् तस्य मेधावी श्रुतधारकः । तद्धोमात् के चिद् इच्छन्ति उन्मत्तत्वं न संशयः ॥
text_mt: From an oblation of three-colored mustard seeds together with the three sweets, / a son is born to him, intelligent and retaining sacred tradition; / some desire insanity from offering that, no doubt.

sanskrit_iast: tilā dūrvā trimadhuraṃ homato vyādhinigraham | taṇḍulaprakṣepaś ca ||
meaning: तिला दूर्वा त्रिमधुरं होमतो व्याधिनिग्रहम् । तण्डुलप्रक्षेपश् च ॥
text_mt: Sesame, dūrvā grass, and the three sweets [lead] through oblation to the suppression of disease, and the throwing of rice grains.

sanskrit_iast: tryaktodumbarasamidho dogdhrī dhenv aṣṭakapradāḥ | ekāhaṃ bhaikṣabhug bhūtvā māsāṣṭakayutasya vā ||
meaning: त्र्यक्तोदुम्बरसमिधो दोग्ध्री धेन्व् अष्टकप्रदाः । एकाहं भैक्षभुग् भूत्वा मासाष्टकयुतस्य वा ॥
text_mt: Kindling of udumbara smeared with the three [sweets] yields eight milch cows, / for one living on alms for a single day, or for a period of eight months.

sanskrit_iast: prādeśāntaṃ bilvavṛkṣaṃ mūlaśākhāsamanvitam | kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ sāyaṃ hutvā tu rukmabhāk ||
meaning: प्रादेशान्तं बिल्ववृक्षं मूलशाखासमन्वितम् । कृष्णाष्टम्यां चतुर्दश्यां सायं हुत्वा तु रुक्मभाक् ॥
text_mt: Having offered in the evening on the dark eighth or fourteenth [lunar day] a bilva tree / measuring a span, complete with roots and branches, he becomes possessed of gold.

sanskrit_iast: samidhāṃ vaitasīnāṃ tu agnāv arkendhanād dhute | ahorātrikahomāt syāt parjanyo bahuvarṣadaḥ | lakṣatrayaṃ bhaikṣāhāro japtvā karmaitad ārabhet ||
meaning: समिधां वैतसीनां तु अग्नाव् अर्केन्धनाद् धुते । अहोरात्रिकहोमात् स्यात् पर्जन्यो बहुवर्षदः । लक्षत्रयं भैक्षाहारो जप्त्वा कर्मैतद् आरभेत् ॥
text_mt: From sacrificial sticks of reed offered into the fire with arka fuel, / from an oblation lasting a day and a night, Parjanya brings abundant rain; / living on alms, having recited [the mantra] three hundred thousand times, he should begin this rite.

sanskrit_iast: dugdhāktān sarṣapān hutvā tasmād bhasma mukhe kṣipet | sarveṣu vyavahāreṣu sa bhavaty aparājitaḥ ||
meaning: दुग्धाक्तान् सर्षपान् हुत्वा तस्माद् भस्म मुखे क्षिपेत् । सर्वेषु व्यवहारेषु स भवत्य् अपराजितः ॥
text_mt: Having offered mustard seeds smeared with milk, he should throw ashes from that into his mouth; / in all transactions he becomes unconquered.

sanskrit_iast: śastraṃ japtam upādāya raṇe grasto na jīyate | khanakhanāyeti mantraḥ pūrvasevārtha ucyate ||
meaning: शस्त्रं जप्तम् उपादाय रणे ग्रस्तो न जीयते । खनखनायेति मन्त्रः पूर्वसेवार्थ उच्यते ॥
text_mt: Taking a weapon recited over, he is not overcome when trapped in battle; / the mantra beginning with 'khanakhanāya' is spoken for preliminary service.

sanskrit_iast: uttarasyā viśeṣād vā cedānīm ata uttaram | khādiratryaktasamidhāṃ pūrvasevā sahasrataḥ | atasīsamidhām evaṃ medhāvī viduṣāṃ prabhuḥ ||
meaning: उत्तरस्या विशेषाद् वा चेदानीम् अत उत्तरम् । खादिरत्र्यक्तसमिधां पूर्वसेवा सहस्रतः । अतसीसमिधाम् एवं मेधावी विदुषां प्रभुः ॥
text_mt: Or from the distinction of the subsequent [rite], now following that: / the preliminary service of khadira kindling smeared with the three [sweets] is performed with a thousand [oblations]; / likewise with flax kindling, [he becomes] intelligent, a master of the wise.

sanskrit_iast: gocarmamātraṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ gomayenopalepayet | tatrāgniṃ trikapāleṣu jvālayitvā praṇamya ca ||
meaning: गोचर्ममात्रं स्थण्डिलं गोमयेनोपलेपयेत् । तत्राग्निं त्रिकपालेषु ज्वालयित्वा प्रणम्य च ॥
text_mt: He should smear a mound the size of a cow-hide with cow dung; / having kindled a fire there in three potsherds and bowed down,

sanskrit_iast: śirasā vānareṇātha mukhavādyaṃ tu kārayet | yatra tac chrūyate tatra āgacchanti varastriyaḥ ||
meaning: शिरसा वानरेणाथ मुखवाद्यं तु कारयेत् । यत्र तच् छ्रूयते तत्र आगच्छन्ति वरस्त्रियः ॥
text_mt: He should then make mouth-music with the skull of a monkey; / wherever that is heard, excellent women arrive there.

sanskrit_iast: damṣṭrāghaṇṭāninādās tu jvālāmukhabhayānakāḥ | yat tvaṃ kāmayase putra tat sarvaṃ dadmahe vayam ||
meaning: दम्ष्ट्राघण्टानिनादास् तु ज्वालामुखभयानकाः । यत् त्वं कामयसे पुत्र तत् सर्वं दद्महे वयम् ॥
text_mt: With the sounds of bells and fangs, dreadful with flaming faces, [they say]: / 'Whatever you desire, son, all that we grant.'

sanskrit_iast: iti bruvatyaḥ sarvās tā yatra homaḥ kṛto bhavet | tadbhasmanā tu saṃspṛṣṭāś chāgalyaḥ suprabhāvataḥ ||
meaning: इति ब्रुवत्यः सर्वास् ता यत्र होमः कृतो भवेत् । तद्भस्मना तु संस्पृष्टाश् छागल्यः सुप्रभावतः ॥
text_mt: All of them speaking thus, wherever the fire offering has been made, / touched by that ash, goats [are produced] by great supernormal power.

sanskrit_iast: lakṣajāpottaraṃ gatvā nadīm udadhigāminīm | vālukāsthaṇḍile liṅgaṃ tanmayaṃ tajjasadmani ||
meaning: लक्षजापोत्तरं गत्वा नदीम् उदधिगामिनीम् । वालुकास्थण्डिले लिङ्गं तन्मयं तज्जसद्मनि ॥
text_mt: After a hundred thousand recitations, having gone to a river flowing to the sea, / on a mound of sand, a phallus made of that, in a shrine born of that [sand]—

sanskrit_iast: padmāṣṭaśatam āhṛtya pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ | udake nābhimātre ca suprabhātaṃ punar japet ||
meaning: पद्माष्टशतम् आहृत्य पूजयित्वा विधानतः । उदके नाभिमात्रे च सुप्रभातं पुनर् जपेत् ॥
text_mt: Having procured one hundred and eight lotuses and worshipped according to rule, / standing in water reaching up to the navel, he should again mutter [the prayer for] an auspicious dawn.

sanskrit_iast: tato māṇḍaliko rājā dīnārāṇāṃ gavāṃ śatam | praṇamya śraddhayā tasmai dadyād uddhara mām iti ||
meaning: ततो माण्डलिको राजा दीनाराणां गवां शतम् । प्रणम्य श्रद्धया तस्मै दद्याद् उद्धर माम् इति ॥
text_mt: Then a vassal king, bowing down with faith, should give to him / a hundred dinars and a hundred cows, saying: 'Rescue me!'

sanskrit_iast: lakṣajapād abādhyas tu paśūnāṃ damṣṭriśṛṅgiṇām | itareṣāṃ paśūnāṃ tu lakṣatritayavardhanam ||
meaning: लक्षजपाद् अबाध्यस् तु पशूनां दम्ष्ट्रिशृङ्गिणाम् । इतरेषां पशूनां तु लक्षत्रितयवर्धनम् ॥
text_mt: From muttering a hundred thousand times, one is unassailable by animals possessing tusks and horns; / but for other animals, there is an increase of three hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast: saṃjaptaśivanirmālyadānād unmattatāṃ vrajet || śamāya candanaṃ dadyāt triṣv etaṃ mantrasaṃskṛtam ||
meaning: संजप्तशिवनिर्माल्यदानाद् उन्मत्ततां व्रजेत् ॥ शमाय चन्दनं दद्यात् त्रिष्व् एतं मन्त्रसंस्कृतम् ॥
text_mt: From giving the consecrated leftovers of an offering to Śiva, one would go mad. / For pacification, he should offer sandalwood consecrated with this mantra in the three [daily rites].

sanskrit_iast: samādhinānumantritaṃ gośṛṅgam arimandire | nikhātaṃ sadya evainaṃ mandiraṃ paridīpayet ||
meaning: समाधिनानुमन्त्रितं गोशृङ्गम् अरिमन्दिरे । निखातं सद्य एवैनं मन्दिरं परिदीपयेत् ॥
text_mt: A cow-horn consecrated with meditation, buried in the enemy's house, / will set that house on fire immediately.

sanskrit_iast: tīkṣṇatailaṃ kaṭu proktaṃ darvī grāmasruvas tathā | trimadhuraṃ tv atra vijñeyaṃ madhusarpistilātmakam ||
meaning: तीक्ष्णतैलं कटु प्रोक्तं दर्वी ग्रामस्रुवस् तथा । त्रिमधुरं त्व् अत्र विज्ञेयं मधुसर्पिस्तिलात्मकम् ॥
text_mt: Pungent oil is called pungent, the ladle [is called] the village-spoon; / and the three sweets are to be understood here as consisting of honey, clarified butter, and sesame.

sanskrit_iast: saṃmukhaṃ mānasaṃ dhyāyañ śubhaṃ karma prayojayet | vimukhaṃ bhañjanādau tu naraḥ karmaṇi siddhibhāk ||
meaning: संमुखं मानसं ध्यायञ् शुभं कर्म प्रयोजयेत् । विमुखं भञ्जनादौ तु नरः कर्मणि सिद्धिभाक् ॥
text_mt: Meditating in his mind on [the deity] facing him, he should perform an auspicious rite; / but [facing] away [from him] in rituals of breaking and the like: [thus] a man attains success in his rite.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭottaras trisāhasro homo hāsya prakīrtitaḥ | kīlakāstrādi yac cānyat tat sahasrābhimantritam || ity ucchuṣmakalpaḥ samāptaḥ || iti pariśiṣṭānāṃ pūrvārdhaṃ samāptam iti ||
meaning: अष्टोत्तरस् त्रिसाहस्रो होमो हास्य प्रकीर्तितः । कीलकास्त्रादि यच् चान्यत् तत् सहस्राभिमन्त्रितम् ॥ इत्य् उच्छुष्मकल्पः समाप्तः ॥ इति परिशिष्टानां पूर्वार्धं समाप्तम् इति ॥
text_mt:
A burnt offering of three thousand and eight [oblations] is declared for it; / and whatever else, such as a peg or weapon, is consecrated with a thousand [repetitions].

Thus ends the Ucchuṣmakalpa. / Thus ends the first half of the Supplements.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ bhṛgvaṅgirorūpadhāriṇe śivāya namaḥ || atha yatraitad apahanyamāne musalaṃ patati tad ghoraṃ bhavati tad apy etad ṛcoktam ||
meaning: ओं भृग्वङ्गिरोरूपधारिणे शिवाय नमः ॥ अथ यत्रैतद् अपहन्यमाने मुसलं पतति तद् घोरं भवति तद् अप्य् एतद् ऋचोक्तम् ॥
text_mt: Oṃ. Homage to Śiva who bears the form of Bhṛgu and Aṅgiras. / Now, when the pestle falls while pounding is going on, that is dreadful; about this it is also said in a verse:

sanskrit_iast: ulūlhalān musalaṃ patitaṃ hinasti patnīṃkule jyeṣṭham | kṛṣīḥ prajāḥ paśavaḥ saṃviśeante yathendrasṛṣṭaṃ prapateta vajram iti ||
meaning: उलूल्हलान् मुसलं पतितं हिनस्ति पत्नींकुले ज्येष्ठम् । कृषीः प्रजाः पशवः संविशेअन्ते यथेन्द्रसृष्टं प्रपतेत वज्रम् इति ॥
text_mt: ‘The pestle falling from the mortar harms the wife, the eldest in the family, / the crops, the offspring, [and] the cattle enter [ruin], as if a thunderbolt hurled by Indra should fall.’

sanskrit_iast: tad vajraṃ śāntyudakena saṃprokṣya arātīyor ity ullikhya yat tvā śikva iti prakṣālya barhiṣy ādhāya juhoti ||
meaning: तद् वज्रं शान्त्युदकेन संप्रोक्ष्य अरातीयोर् इत्य् उल्लिख्य यत् त्वा शिक्व इति प्रक्षाल्य बर्हिष्य् आधाय जुहोति ॥
text_mt: Sprinkling that thunderbolt with propitiatory water, scratching lines with [the verse] ‘arātīyoḥ…’, washing it with ‘yat tvā śikvaḥ…’, [and] placing it on the sacrificial grass, he makes an offering:

sanskrit_iast: vajraḥ patitas tu varaṃ hinasti taṃ tvā vayam apahanma ghoram | sa naḥ śivo 'stu dviṣatāṃ vadhāya sapatnān me dviṣato hantu sarvān ||
meaning: वज्रः पतितस् तु वरं हिनस्ति तं त्वा वयम् अपहन्म घोरम् । स नः शिवो ऽस्तु द्विषतां वधाय सपत्नान् मे द्विषतो हन्तु सर्वान् ॥
text_mt: ‘The fallen thunderbolt indeed harms the best; we drive you away, dreadful one! / May it be auspicious for us, for the slaughter of enemies; let it slay all my spiteful rivals!’

sanskrit_iast: yadvat prajāḥ papanayad dhastād yadi volūkhalāt | sapatnān me paripāhi māṃ tv evaṃ paripāhi naḥ ||
meaning: यद्वत् प्रजाः पपनयद् धस्ताद् यदि वोलूखलात् । सपत्नान् मे परिपाहि मां त्व् एवं परिपाहि नः ॥
text_mt: ‘Just as it might fell the offspring from the hand or from the mortar, / protect [us] from my rivals; protect me thus, protect us!’

sanskrit_iast: yady antarikṣe yadi vāsi soccair vajraḥ sṛṣṭo yadi vā pārthivair uta | mantrāḥ prayuktā vitatā mahānto 'ghoro vajro musalaprapātaḥ ||
meaning: यद्य् अन्तरिक्षे यदि वासि सोच्चैर् वज्रः सृष्टो यदि वा पार्थिवैर् उत । मन्त्राः प्रयुक्ता वितता महान्तो ऽघोरो वज्रो मुसलप्रपातः ॥
text_mt: ‘Whether you are in the intermediate space or high above, whether the thunderbolt is hurled by earthly [beings], / the great mantras have been employed and extended; unauspiciousness is gone from the thunderbolt, the fall of the pestle.’

sanskrit_iast: vajro 'si sapatnaheti tisraḥ ||
meaning: वज्रो ऽसि सपत्नहेति तिस्रः ॥
text_mt: [He recites] the three [verses beginning with] ‘You are a thunderbolt, slayer of rivals’:

sanskrit_iast: vajro 'si sapatnahā tvayādya vṛtraṃ sākṣīya | tvām adya vanaspate vṛkṣāṇām ud ayuṣmahi ||
meaning: वज्रो ऽसि सपत्नहा त्वयाद्य वृत्रं साक्षीय । त्वाम् अद्य वनस्पते वृक्षाणाम् उद् अयुष्महि ॥
text_mt: ‘You are a thunderbolt, slayer of rivals; may I overcome Vṛtra today through you! / We have raised you today, O tree among trees!’

sanskrit_iast: sa na indrapurohito viśvataḥ pāhi rakṣasaḥ | abhi gāvo anūṣatābhi dyumnaṃ bṛhaspate ||
meaning: स न इन्द्रपुरोहितो विश्वतः पाहि रक्षसः । अभि गावो अनूषताभि द्युम्नं बृहस्पते ॥
text_mt: ‘As our Indra-chaplain, protect us on all sides from demons! / The cows have lowed toward [us], toward glory, O Bṛhaspati!’

sanskrit_iast: prāṇa prāṇaṃ trāyasvāso asave mṛḍa | nirṛte nirṛtyā naḥ pāśebhyo muñca iti ||
meaning: प्राण प्राणं त्रायस्वासो असवे मृड । निरृते निरृत्या नः पाशेभ्यो मुञ्च इति ॥
text_mt: ‘O breath, protect the breath! O spirit, be gracious unto the spirit! / O Nirṛti, release us from Nirṛti's fetters!’

sanskrit_iast: tyam ū ṣu trātāram indraḥ sutrāmā sa sutrāmā ā mandrair indra marmāṇi te varmaṇā chādayāmīti ulūkhalamusale saṃpātān ānīya saṃsthāpya homān ulūkhalam annenaiva pūrayitvā pratipravartayed ulūkhalamusalaṃ vasanaṃ ca gāṃ ca kartre dadyāt sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
meaning: त्यम् ऊ षु त्रातारम् इन्द्रः सुत्रामा स सुत्रामा आ मन्द्रैर् इन्द्र मर्माणि ते वर्मणा छादयामीति उलूखलमुसले संपातान् आनीय संस्थाप्य होमान् उलूखलम् अन्नेनैव पूरयित्वा प्रतिप्रवर्तयेद् उलूखलमुसलं वसनं च गां च कर्त्रे दद्यात् सा तत्र प्रायश्चित्तिः ॥
text_mt: With ‘tyam ū ṣu trātāram…’, ‘indraḥ sutrāmā…’, ‘sa sutrāmā…’, ‘ā mandrair indra…’, ‘marmāṇi te varmaṇā chādayāmi…’, bringing the dregs of the offerings to the mortar and pestle, concluding the burnt offerings, filling the mortar with food itself, he should set the mortar and pestle back into motion; and he should give a garment and a cow to the officiant. That is the expiation in that case.

sanskrit_iast: atha yat kāko 'bhimṛśati tan mṛtyum āśaṅkyaṃ bhavati || tad apy etad ṛcoktam || … antakāya mṛtyava ā rabhasva prāṇāya nama iti svāheti agnau hutvā sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
meaning: अथ यत् काको ऽभिमृशति तन् मृत्युम् आशङ्क्यं भवति ॥ तद् अप्य् एतद् ऋचोक्तम् ॥ … अन्तकाय मृत्यव आ रभस्व प्राणाय नम इति स्वाहेति अग्नौ हुत्वा सा तत्र प्रायश्चित्तिः ॥
