text_mt: Now, when a crow touches [a person], death is to be feared. / About this it is also said in a verse: […] offering into the fire with ‘antakāya mṛtyave…’, ‘ā rabhasva…’, ‘prāṇāya nama iti svāhā’, that is the expiation in that case.

sanskrit_iast: athāta ājyasthālī cyavate pracalati vā kā tatra prāyaścittiḥ || saṃnatimahāvyāhṛtisāvitrīkūṣmāṇḍyaḥ sa sarvābhir juhuyāt sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
meaning: अथात आज्यस्थाली च्यवते प्रचलति वा का तत्र प्रायश्चित्तिः ॥ संनतिमहाव्याहृतिसावित्रीकूष्माण्ड्यः स सर्वाभिर् जुहुयात् सा तत्र प्रायश्चित्तिः ॥
text_mt: Now then, if the ghee-pot falls or shifts, what is the expiation in that case? / With the saṃnati-formulas, the mahāvyāhṛtis, the Sāvitrī, and the Kūṣmāṇḍa [verses], he should make an offering with all of them. That is the expiation in that case.

sanskrit_iast: atha pavitram cet praṇaśyeta karmamadhyāt pramādataḥ | anyac chittvā mantrayeta karmaśeṣam upakramet | ātmendriyasamāyuktaṃ tena mantreṇa kārayet ||
meaning: अथ पवित्रम् चेत् प्रणश्येत कर्ममध्यात् प्रमादतः । अन्यच् छित्त्वा मन्त्रयेत कर्मशेषम् उपक्रमेत् । आत्मेन्द्रियसमायुक्तं तेन मन्त्रेण कारयेत् ॥
text_mt: Now, if through negligence the strainer should be lost from the middle of the rite: / having cut another, he should consecrate it and proceed with the remainder of the rite; / he should have it performed with that mantra connected with the self and the faculties.

sanskrit_iast: vāyoḥ pūtaḥ pavitreṇa yan me chidraṃ punar maitv indriyaṃ mā na āpo medhāṃ mā no medhāṃ mā naḥ piparid aśvineti saṃnatibhir ājyaṃ juhuyād vyāhṛtibhiś ca gāṃ ca kartre dadyāt sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
meaning: वायोः पूतः पवित्रेण यन् मे छिद्रं पुनर् मैत्व् इन्द्रियं मा न आपो मेधां मा नो मेधां मा नः पिपरिद् अश्विनेति संनतिभिर् आज्यं जुहुयाद् व्याहृतिभिश् च गां च कर्त्रे दद्यात् सा तत्र प्रायश्चित्तिः ॥
text_mt: With ‘vāyoḥ pūtaḥ pavitreṇa…’, ‘yan me chidram…’, ‘punar maitv indriyam…’, ‘mā na āpo medhām…’, ‘mā no medhām…’, ‘mā naḥ piparid aśvinā…’, with the saṃnatis and the vyāhṛtis he should offer clarified butter, and he should give a cow to the officiant. That is the expiation in that case.

sanskrit_iast: atha yasyāsamāpte karmaṇi barhir ādīpyeta tatas tan nirvāpya juhuyāt ||
meaning: अथ यस्यासमाप्ते कर्मणि बर्हिर् आदीप्येत ततस् तन् निर्वाप्य जुहुयात् ॥
text_mt: Now, if someone's sacrificial grass should catch fire before the rite is concluded, he should extinguish it and then make an offering:

sanskrit_iast: yad agnir barhir adahad vedyā vāso apāṃ tataḥ | tvam eva no jātavedo duritāt pāhi tasmāt ||
meaning: यद् अग्निर् बर्हिर् अदहद् वेद्या वासो अपां ततः । त्वम् एव नो जातवेदो दुरितात् पाहि तस्मात् ॥
text_mt: ‘Since Agni burnt the sacrificial grass, the garment of the altar, from the waters then, / do you yourself, O Jātavedas, protect us from that distress!’

sanskrit_iast: nirdagdhā no amitrās tu yathedaṃ barhis tathā | amitrāṇāṃ śriyaṃ bhūtiṃ tām eṣāṃ pari nir jahi ||
meaning: निर्दग्धा नो अमित्रास् तु यथेदं बर्हिस् तथा । अमित्राणां श्रियं भूतिं ताम् एषां परि निर् जहि ॥
text_mt: ‘May our enemies be completely burnt up, just as this sacrificial grass [is]! / Slay away their prosperity and power, that of the enemies!’

sanskrit_iast: yatkāmās te juhumas tan no astu viśāmpate | ye devā yajñam āyānti te no rakṣantu sarvataḥ ||
meaning: यत्कामास् ते जुहुमस् तन् नो अस्तु विशाम्पते । ये देवा यज्ञम् आयान्ति ते नो रक्षन्तु सर्वतः ॥
text_mt: ‘Whatever desire we have when offering to you, let that be ours, O lord of the clans! / Whatever gods come to the sacrifice, let them protect us on all sides!’

sanskrit_iast: avadagdhaṃ duḥsvapnyam avadagdhā arātayaḥ | sarvāś ca yātudhānyaḥ ||
meaning: अवदग्धं दुःस्वप्न्यम् अवदग्धा अरातयः । सर्वाश् च यातुधान्यः ॥
text_mt: ‘Burnt away is bad dreaming, burnt away are the adversaries / and all the sorceresses!’

sanskrit_iast: mā tvā dabhan yātudhānā mā bradhnaḥ śamyum icchata | darbho rājā samudriyaḥ pari naḥ pātu viśvataḥ ||
meaning: मा त्वा दभन् यातुधाना मा ब्रध्नः शम्युम् इच्छत । दर्भो राजा समुद्रियः परि नः पातु विश्वतः ॥
text_mt: ‘Let not the sorcerers harm you; let not the ruddy sun seek harm. / May the royal darbha-grass of the ocean protect us on all sides!’

sanskrit_iast: ato 'nyad barhir upakalpyodakena saṃprokṣya punaḥ stṛṇāti ||
meaning: अतो ऽन्यद् बर्हिर् उपकल्प्योदकेन संप्रोक्ष्य पुनः स्तृणाति ॥
text_mt: Having procured other sacrificial grass and sprinkled it with water, he strews it again:

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ barhir amṛteneha siktaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ haritaṃ te stṛṇāmi | tad vai purāṇam abhinavaṃ stṛṇīṣva vāsaḥ praśastaṃ prati me gṛhāṇety anyena ca barhiṣābhiprachādaye ||
meaning: इदं बर्हिर् अमृतेनेह सिक्तं हिरण्मयं हरितं ते स्तृणामि । तद् वै पुराणम् अभिनवं स्तृणीष्व वासः प्रशस्तं प्रति मे गृहाणेत्य् अन्येन च बर्हिषाभिप्रछादये ॥
text_mt: ‘Sprinkled here with nectar, golden, green, I strew this sacrificial grass for you; / strew that ancient one as new; accept from me a praised garment!’ and he covers it over with other sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: āhutyāṃ tu gṛhītāyāṃ hutocchiṣṭaṃ pramādataḥ | tam āhutiṃ pratiṣṭhāpya śaṃ no devīr ity ācamya brahmāparam ity ardharcenemāṃ hutvā brahmajyeṣṭheti hutvā sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
meaning: आहुत्यां तु गृहीतायां हुतोच्छिष्टं प्रमादतः । तम् आहुतिं प्रतिष्ठाप्य शं नो देवीर् इत्य् आचम्य ब्रह्मापरम् इत्य् अर्धर्चेनेमां हुत्वा ब्रह्मज्येष्ठेति हुत्वा सा तत्र प्रायश्चित्तिः ॥
text_mt: When an oblation has been taken up, but through negligence it is left over after the offering: / having set down that oblation, having sipped water with ‘śaṃ no devīḥ…’, having offered this with the half-verse ‘brahmāparam…’, [and] having offered with ‘brahmajyeṣṭhā…’, that is the expiation in that case.

sanskrit_iast: keśakīṭāvapannā cec chaṃbhuvāya svāheti bhasmani hutvā havir utpūyānyāṃ juhuyāt sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
meaning: केशकीटावपन्ना चेच् छंभुवाय स्वाहेति भस्मनि हुत्वा हविर् उत्पूयान्यां जुहुयात् सा तत्र प्रायश्चित्तिः ॥
text_mt: If it is contaminated by hair or insects: having offered into the ashes with ‘śaṃbhuvāya svāhā’, having purified the sacrificial oblation, he should offer another. That is the expiation in that case.

sanskrit_iast: atha cec calitadantaṃ patitadantaṃ vopanayet tatra prāyaścittam āha gṛhe vā barhiḥ vā pitā vācāryo vā dvādaśarātraṃ dīkṣeyātāṃ kartā trirātraṃ gaurasarṣapasarpiḥpayobhiḥ snātaḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ śuklavāsāḥ paurṇamāsaṃ tantram ājyabhāgānte sāvitrīm anuyojayet tena śāntyudakenainam ācāmayati saṃprokṣati ca ||
meaning: अथ चेच् चलितदन्तं पतितदन्तं वोपनयेत् तत्र प्रायश्चित्तम् आह गृहे वा बर्हिः वा पिता वाचार्यो वा द्वादशरात्रं दीक्षेयातां कर्ता त्रिरात्रं गौरसर्षपसर्पिःपयोभिः स्नातः प्रयतः शुचिः शुक्लवासाः पौर्णमासं तन्त्रम् आज्यभागान्ते सावित्रीम् अनुयोजयेत् तेन शान्त्युदकेनैनम् आचामयति संप्रोक्षति च ॥
text_mt: Now, if he should initiate one whose tooth is loose or whose tooth has fallen out, he states the expiation for that: in the house or on the sacrificial grass, the father or the teacher should undergo consecration for twelve nights; the performer for three nights, bathed with white mustard, clarified butter, and milk, restrained, pure, wearing white clothes; at the end of the ghee-portions of the full-moon rite he should apply the Sāvitrī; with that propitiatory water he makes him sip and sprinkles him.

sanskrit_iast: sāvitrī śāntir brahma jajñānaṃ ye triṣaptā agniṃ brūma āyuṣyavarcasyasvastyayanābhayāparājitaśarmavarmabhir juhuyāt taṃ saṃpātya yaḥ śramāt tapaso yo vetasaṃ yo bhūtam ūrdhvā asyedāvatsarāya yady antarikṣe punar maitv indriyam ity āplāvayati sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
meaning: सावित्री शान्तिर् ब्रह्म जज्ञानं ये त्रिषप्ता अग्निं ब्रूम आयुष्यवर्चस्यस्वस्त्ययनाभयापराजितशर्मवर्मभिर् जुहुयात् तं संपात्य यः श्रमात् तपसो यो वेतसं यो भूतम् ऊर्ध्वा अस्येदावत्सराय यद्य् अन्तरिक्षे पुनर् मैत्व् इन्द्रियम् इत्य् आप्लावयति सा तत्र प्रायश्चित्तिः ॥
text_mt: With the Sāvitrī, the Śānti [hymns], ‘brahma jajñānam…’, ‘ye triṣaptāḥ…’, ‘agniṃ brūmaḥ…’, and the Āyuṣya, Varcasya, Svastyayana, Abhaya, Aparājita, and Śarmavarma [hymns], he should make an offering; having infused it with the dregs of the offering, with ‘yaḥ śramāt…’, ‘tapaso yo…’, ‘vetasaṃ yo…’, ‘bhūtam ūrdhvā asya…’, ‘idāvatsarāya…’, ‘yady antarikṣe…’, ‘punar maitv indriyam…’, he bathes [him]. That is the expiation in that case.

sanskrit_iast: naśyec cen madughamaṇiḥ śāmyed vāgnir vivāhajaḥ | atyadbhutaṃ dvayam idaṃ dampatyos tu vināśanam ||
meaning: नश्येच् चेन् मदुघमणिः शाम्येद् वाग्निर् विवाहजः । अत्यद्भुतं द्वयम् इदं दम्पत्योस् तु विनाशनम् ॥
text_mt: If an amulet of madugha should be lost, or if the nuptial fire should go out: / these two are a grave portent, bringing ruin to the couple.

sanskrit_iast: pūtudārumaṇis tatra bandhyo mantrāś ca mādughāḥ | pūtudāru na vindyāc ced yavaṃ tatra niyojayet ||
meaning: पूतुदारुमणिस् तत्र बन्ध्यो मन्त्राश् च मादुघाः । पूतुदारु न विन्द्याच् चेद् यवं तत्र नियोजयेत् ॥
text_mt: An amulet of pūtudāru-wood is to be bound there, and the madugha-mantras [recited]; / if he should not find pūtudāru, he should employ barley in that case.

sanskrit_iast: āyuṣmantau suprajasau suvīrau dhātā pūṣā draviṇe nau dadhātu | vimuñcatāṃ śamalaṃ kilbiṣaṃ nau dīrgham āyuś ca savitā kṛṇotv iti śāntyudakenāṅguliṃ saṃprokṣya badhnīyāt
meaning: आयुष्मन्तौ सुप्रजसौ सुवीरौ धाता पूषा द्रविणे नौ दधातु । विमुञ्चतां शमलं किल्बिषं नौ दीर्घम् आयुश् च सविता कृणोत्व् इति शान्त्युदकेनाङ्गुलिं संप्रोक्ष्य बध्नीयात्
text_mt: With the words, 'May Dhātṛ and Pūṣan bestow wealth upon us two, full of vitality, with good offspring and brave sons; may they remove stain and guilt from us two, and may Savitṛ make our life long,' having sprinkled [it] with propitiatory water, he should tie [the amulet] on the finger.

sanskrit_iast: samidho 'bhyādadhyād upatiṣṭeta saṃnatibhir vyāhṛtibhir juhuyād gāṃ ca kartre dadyāt sā atra prāyaścittḥ ||
meaning: समिधो ऽभ्यादध्याद् उपतिष्टेत संनतिभिर् व्याहृतिभिर् जुहुयाद् गां च कर्त्रे दद्यात् सा अत्र प्रायश्चित्त्ः ॥
text_mt: He should add kindling-sticks [to the fire], attend upon [it], offer oblations with the Saṃnati [formulas and] the Vyāhṛtis, and give a cow to the officiant. That is the expiation here.

sanskrit_iast: om atha yasya tantre 'praṇīto 'huto 'gnir upaśāmyati || punas tvādityā ity agniṃ prāṇīya saṃnatibhir vyāhṛtibhiḥ samās tvāgne 'bhy arcateti ca sūktābhyāṃ juhuyāt parisaṃkhyāhomāṃś ca ||
meaning: ओम् अथ यस्य तन्त्रे ऽप्रणीतो ऽहुतो ऽग्निर् उपशाम्यति ॥ पुनस् त्वादित्या इत्य् अग्निं प्राणीय संनतिभिर् व्याहृतिभिः समास् त्वाग्ने ऽभ्य् अर्चतेति च सूक्ताभ्यां जुहुयात् परिसंख्याहोमांश् च ॥
text_mt: Om. Now, in the case of one whose fire is extinguished during the ritual procedure, before it has been carried forward and without an offering having been made: having carried the fire forward with the words, 'May the Ādityas again [bring] you...', he should offer oblations with the Saṃnati [formulas], with the Vyāhṛtis, and with the two hymns, 'Yearly for you, Agni...' and 'Revere [him]...', as well as the enumeration oblations.

sanskrit_iast: atha yatraitad vivāhagnir upaśāmyati agnipraṇayanamantraiḥ prājāpatyaṃ praṇīya prāktantraṃ praṇīya yad devā yad vidvāṃso 'pamityam apratītaṃ yad dhastābhyaṃ yad adīvyann ity etaiḥ sūktair ājyaṃ juhuyāt samidho 'bhyādadhyād upatiṣṭheta vāsaḥ kartre dadyāt ||
meaning: अथ यत्रैतद् विवाहग्निर् उपशाम्यति अग्निप्रणयनमन्त्रैः प्राजापत्यं प्रणीय प्राक्तन्त्रं प्रणीय यद् देवा यद् विद्वांसो ऽपमित्यम् अप्रतीतं यद् धस्ताभ्यं यद् अदीव्यन्न् इत्य् एतैः सूक्तैर् आज्यं जुहुयात् समिधो ऽभ्यादध्याद् उपतिष्ठेत वासः कर्त्रे दद्यात् ॥
text_mt: Now, where the marriage fire is extinguished: having carried forward [the fire] pertaining to Prajāpati with the mantras for carrying forward fire, and having set up the preliminary ritual procedure, he should offer oblations of clarified butter with these hymns: 'Whatever the gods...', 'Whatever the wise...', 'Unrequited loan...', 'What with the hands...', and 'What having not gambled...'; he should add kindling-sticks, attend upon [it], and give a garment to the officiant.

sanskrit_iast: atha yatraitat kālātītāsu kriyāsv atīta uttarāyaṇe ājyabhāgānte yan me skannaṃ yad asmṛtīty anumantrayet tasmai prācyā diśo antardeśād iti paryāyān ekaviṃśatiṃ juhuyāt saṃskārātīte ca karmaṇi ||
meaning: अथ यत्रैतत् कालातीतासु क्रियास्व् अतीत उत्तरायणे आज्यभागान्ते यन् मे स्कन्नं यद् अस्मृतीत्य् अनुमन्त्रयेत् तस्मै प्राच्या दिशो अन्तर्देशाद् इति पर्यायान् एकविंशतिं जुहुयात् संस्कारातीते च कर्मणि ॥
text_mt: Now, where the rites have passed their proper time, or the northern course of the sun has passed: at the end of the portions of clarified butter, he should pronounce over [it] the mantras, 'What of mine has been spilled...' and 'What has been forgotten...'; for that, he should offer the twenty-one sections [beginning with] 'From the eastern direction, from the intermediate quarter...', also when a rite of passage has passed its proper time.

sanskrit_iast: atha yatraitat prāṇīto 'gnir upaśāmyati || yady antarikṣe punar maitv indriyaṃ punas tvādityā ity agniṃ praṇīya prajvālya mamāgne varca iti samidham ādhāya śeṣaṃ karma samāpayet ||
meaning: अथ यत्रैतत् प्राणीतो ऽग्निर् उपशाम्यति ॥ यद्य् अन्तरिक्षे पुनर् मैत्व् इन्द्रियं पुनस् त्वादित्या इत्य् अग्निं प्रणीय प्रज्वाल्य ममाग्ने वर्च इति समिधम् आधाय शेषं कर्म समापयेत् ॥
text_mt: Now, where the fire is extinguished after it has been carried forward: having carried the fire forward with the words, 'If in the intermediate space...', 'May my faculty return to me...', and 'May the Ādityas again [bring] you...', and having kindled it, he should place a kindling-stick on it with the words, 'My brilliance, Agni...', and complete the rest of the rite.

sanskrit_iast: atha yasyopayāmo 'vapated dhastāt sa yan me upayāma ity ādadīta,
meaning: अथ यस्योपयामो ऽवपतेद् धस्तात् स यन् मे उपयाम इत्य् आददीत,
text_mt: Now, from whose hand the ladle should fall, he should pick it up with [the verse beginning with], 'What ladle of mine...':

sanskrit_iast: yan me upayāmo 'patad dhastād ya āyuṣā pariṣkṛtaḥ | tam ahaṃ punar ādade ||
meaning: यन् मे उपयामो ऽपतद् धस्ताद् य आयुषा परिष्कृतः । तम् अहं पुनर् आददे ॥
text_mt: 'What ladle of mine fell from my hand, adorned with life, / that I take up again.'

sanskrit_iast: punar indraḥ punar bhagaḥ punar me brahmaṇaspatiḥ | brahma jīvitu dād ity ādadīta
meaning: पुनर् इन्द्रः पुनर् भगः पुनर् मे ब्रह्मणस्पतिः । ब्रह्म जीवितु दाद् इत्य् आददीत
text_mt: 'Again Indra, again Bhaga, again Brahmaṇaspati for me / may give the sacred lore to live.' With these words [he should take it up].

sanskrit_iast: yan me chidraṃ yad asmṛtīti juhuyāt ||
meaning: यन् मे छिद्रं यद् अस्मृतीति जुहुयात् ॥
text_mt: He should offer an oblation with the words, 'Whatever flaw of mine...', and 'Whatever has been forgotten...'.

sanskrit_iast: yan me sruvo 'patad dhastād ity upayāmena vyākhyātam ||
meaning: यन् मे स्रुवो ऽपतद् धस्ताद् इत्य् उपयामेन व्याख्यातम् ॥
text_mt: [The case where one says,] 'What dipping-spoon of mine fell from my hand...', is explained by [the procedure for] the ladle.

sanskrit_iast: mekhalādīni cet plaveran punar upanayeta || vimocanīyān homān hutvānyaṃ brāhmaṇam anūcānam upaveśyodapātraṃ cāparājitena niṣkramya vāso yajñopavītādi dattvābhyukṣyācamyāpāṃ sūktaiḥ pavitraiś ca saṃprokṣya priyaṃ mā kṛṇu deveṣv iti yajñopavītaṃ dattvā vimṛgvarīṃ mā naḥ paścād iti dvābhyāṃ prāṅmukha upaviśya mahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ sāvitrī śāntisūktaṃ brahma jajñānaṃ yad asmṛty anumatiḥ sarvam iti juhuyād abhyātānaiś ca ||
meaning: मेखलादीनि चेत् प्लवेरन् पुनर् उपनयेत ॥ विमोचनीयान् होमान् हुत्वान्यं ब्राह्मणम् अनूचानम् उपवेश्योदपात्रं चापराजितेन निष्क्रम्य वासो यज्ञोपवीतादि दत्त्वाभ्युक्ष्याचम्यापां सूक्तैः पवित्रैश् च संप्रोक्ष्य प्रियं मा कृणु देवेष्व् इति यज्ञोपवीतं दत्त्वा विमृग्वरीं मा नः पश्चाद् इति द्वाभ्यां प्राङ्मुख उपविश्य महाव्याहृतिभिः सावित्री शान्तिसूक्तं ब्रह्म जज्ञानं यद् अस्मृत्य् अनुमतिः सर्वम् इति जुहुयाद् अभ्यातानैश् च ॥
text_mt: If the girdle and other [accoutrements] should float away, he should initiate [the boy] again. Having offered the discharge oblations, having seated another learned brahmin, and having gone out with the undefeated water-pot, having given a garment, sacred thread, and the like, having sprinkled [himself], sipped water, and consecrated [him] with the hymns to the waters and purifying [verses], having given the sacred thread with the words, 'Make me dear among the gods...', and having sat facing east with the two [hymns], 'The cleansing one...' and 'Do not behind us...', he should offer oblations with the great Vyāhṛtis, the Sāvitrī, the propitiatory hymn, 'The sacred word first born...', 'Whatever has been forgotten...', and 'Anumati, all...', and with the Abhyātāna formulas.

sanskrit_iast: atha yatraitan mekhalā prapatati jīrṇā vā syāt tāṃ sāvitryoddhṛtyāntaṃ kṛtvā śāntyudakena saṃprokṣya mahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ sāvitrī śāntisūktaṃ brahma jajñānaṃ ye triṣaptā idāvatsarāya ghṛtena tvāgniṃ brhūma iti ||
meaning: अथ यत्रैतन् मेखला प्रपतति जीर्णा वा स्यात् तां सावित्र्योद्धृत्यान्तं कृत्वा शान्त्युदकेन संप्रोक्ष्य महाव्याहृतिभिः सावित्री शान्तिसूक्तं ब्रह्म जज्ञानं ये त्रिषप्ता इदावत्सराय घृतेन त्वाग्निं ब्र्हूम इति ॥
text_mt: Now, where the girdle falls off or becomes worn out: having taken it off with the Sāvitrī, made an end [to its use], and sprinkled [the new one] with propitiatory water, [he should offer oblations] with the great Vyāhṛtis, the Sāvitrī, the propitiatory hymn, 'The sacred word first born...', 'Those thrice seven...', 'For the Idāvatsara...', and 'With ghee we [praise] you, Agni...'

sanskrit_iast: caturthyām ahutāyāṃ yadi ghaṭodakaṃ naśyeta tathaiva punar ānīya śaṃ no devīr iheta devīr ity anumantryāmbayo yanty āpo hi ṣṭhā śaṃ no devīr iti saṃpātya vyāhṛtyā saṃnatyā ca juhuyāt āpo bhṛgvaṅgirorūpam apāṃ puṣpam ity udakumbham abhimantrayet || vāso dakṣiṇā ||
meaning: चतुर्थ्याम् अहुतायां यदि घटोदकं नश्येत तथैव पुनर् आनीय शं नो देवीर् इहेत देवीर् इत्य् अनुमन्त्र्याम्बयो यन्त्य् आपो हि ष्ठा शं नो देवीर् इति संपात्य व्याहृत्या संनत्या च जुहुयात् आपो भृग्वङ्गिरोरूपम् अपां पुष्पम् इत्य् उदकुम्भम् अभिमन्त्रयेत् ॥ वासो दक्षिणा ॥
text_mt: If, while the fourth [oblation] has not been offered, the jar-water should be lost, having brought [water] again in the same manner, having consecrated it with 'May the divine [waters] be auspicious for us...' and 'Here, O divine [waters]...', having poured it with 'The mothers go...', 'The waters indeed are...', and 'May the divine [waters] be auspicious for us...', he should make an offering with a Vyāhṛti and a Saṃnati; he should recite over the water-jar the verses, 'Waters are the form of Bhṛgu and Aṅgiras...' and 'Flower of the waters...'. A garment is the sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast: atha yasyāsamāpte karmaṇy udapātraṃ pravarteta tad anumantrayate
meaning: अथ यस्यासमाप्ते कर्मण्य् उदपात्रं प्रवर्तेत तद् अनुमन्त्रयते
text_mt: Now, in the case of one whose water-pot rolls over when the rite is not yet finished, he recites over it:

sanskrit_iast: yad udapātraṃ pravartate brahmaṇāsthāpitaṃ mahat | sthānāc cyutaṃ pravartitaṃ tan me vahatu kilbiṣam || ity āsthāpayati ||
meaning: यद् उदपात्रं प्रवर्तते ब्रह्मणास्थापितं महत् । स्थानाच् च्युतं प्रवर्तितं तन् मे वहतु किल्बिषम् ॥ इत्य् आस्थापयति ॥
text_mt: 'The great water-pot that rolls over, placed by the sacred word, / fallen from its place, rolling: let it carry away my guilt.' With these words he sets it up.

sanskrit_iast: pūraṇena pūrayitvā punaḥ pūrṇam ity etayā |
meaning: पूरणेन पूरयित्वा पुनः पूर्णम् इत्य् एतया ।
text_mt: Having filled it with a filling [mantra], with this [verse beginning with], 'Filled again...':

sanskrit_iast: punaḥ pūrṇam idaṃ pātraṃ brahmaṇāsthāpayāmasi | viśvais tad devair abhiṣṭutam ||
meaning: पुनः पूर्णम् इदं पात्रं ब्रह्मणास्थापयामसि । विश्वैस् तद् देवैर् अभिष्टुतम् ॥
text_mt: 'This vessel, filled again, we set up by the sacred word, / praised by all the gods.'

sanskrit_iast: ūrjaṃ puṣṭaṃ dadhātu no rāyas poṣaṃ śriyam āyuḥ | mayi karma samṛdhyatām iti ||
meaning: ऊर्जं पुष्टं दधातु नो रायस् पोषं श्रियम् आयुः । मयि कर्म समृध्यताम् इति ॥
text_mt: 'May it place in us vigor, nourishment, increase of wealth, fortune, and long life; / may the rite succeed in me.' [With these words he sets it up].

sanskrit_iast: atha cet prabhajyeta bhūmir bhūmim agād ity anumantryānyataram āhṛtya yady antarikṣe punar maitv indriyam ity anumantrya vaiśvānaro na ūtaya ud enaṃ vaiśvānaro raśmibhir iti juhuyāt sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
meaning: अथ चेत् प्रभज्येत भूमिर् भूमिम् अगाद् इत्य् अनुमन्त्र्यान्यतरम् आहृत्य यद्य् अन्तरिक्षे पुनर् मैत्व् इन्द्रियम् इत्य् अनुमन्त्र्य वैश्वानरो न ऊतय उद् एनं वैश्वानरो रश्मिभिर् इति जुहुयात् सा तत्र प्रायश्चित्तिः ॥
text_mt: Now, if it should break, having recited over it, 'Earth has gone to earth...', having brought another [pot], and having recited over it, 'If in the intermediate space...', and 'May my faculty return to me...', he should offer oblations with 'Vaiśvānara for our aid...' and 'Upward this Vaiśvānara with his rays...'. That is the expiation in that case.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ brahmakūrcavidhiṃ puṇyaṃ saṃkṣepād vacmy asaṃśayam | pāvanānāṃ paraṃ yo hi pāvanaṃ tapasāṃ tapaḥ ||
meaning: ओं ब्रह्मकूर्चविधिं पुण्यं संक्षेपाद् वच्म्य् असंशयम् । पावनानां परं यो हि पावनं तपसां तपः ॥
text_mt: Om. I declare concisely and without doubt the holy procedure for the Brahmakūrca, which is the supreme purifier among purifiers, the austerity of austerities.

sanskrit_iast: snātvā śuciḥ śucau deśe gomayenāvasecite | vastreṇa saṃhite cāpi sitapuṣpaiḥ prapūjite ||
meaning: स्नात्वा शुचिः शुचौ देशे गोमयेनावसेचिते । वस्त्रेण संहिते चापि सितपुष्पैः प्रपूजिते ॥
text_mt: Having bathed and become clean in a clean place sprinkled with cow dung, covered with a cloth, and worshipped with white flowers;

sanskrit_iast: ahorātrositaḥ kṣāntaḥ pavitrātmā prapāvanaḥ | śuklavāsāḥ sugandhiḥ prāg upaviṣṭaḥ kuśāsane ||
meaning: अहोरात्रोसितः क्षान्तः पवित्रात्मा प्रपावनः । शुक्लवासाः सुगन्धिः प्राग् उपविष्टः कुशासने ॥
text_mt: having fasted for a day and night, patient, pure in soul, thoroughly purifying, dressed in white garments, fragrant, seated facing east on a kuśa-grass mat;

sanskrit_iast: gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam | āharet tāmrapātre tu śakṛn mūtraṃ tv abhūgatam ||
meaning: गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिः कुशोदकम् । आहरेत् ताम्रपात्रे तु शकृन् मूत्रं त्व् अभूगतम् ॥
text_mt: he should collect cow urine, cow dung, milk, curd, clarified butter, and kuśa-water in a copper vessel; but the dung and urine must not have fallen on the ground.

sanskrit_iast: gomūtraṃ nīlavarṇāyāḥ kṛṣṇāyā gomayaṃ tathā | payas tu tāmravarṇāyāḥ śvetāya āhared dadhi ||
meaning: गोमूत्रं नीलवर्णायाः कृष्णाया गोमयं तथा । पयस् तु ताम्रवर्णायाः श्वेताय आहरेद् दधि ॥
text_mt: [He should collect] the cow urine from a tawny cow, the cow dung likewise from a black one, but milk from a copper-colored one; he should take curd from a white cow;

sanskrit_iast: kapilāyā ghṛtaṃ grāhyam alābhe syāt tu pañcamam ||
meaning: कपिलाया घृतं ग्राह्यम् अलाभे स्यात् तु पञ्चमम् ॥
text_mt: clarified butter should be taken from a brown cow; in the absence [of a specific one], [any cow] may be the fifth.

sanskrit_iast: gomūtraikapalaṃ dadyād aṅguṣṭhāgraṃ tu gomayam | kṣīrasya sapta dadhnas tu trīṇy ekaikaṃ ghṛtāmbhasoḥ ||
meaning: गोमूत्रैकपलं दद्याद् अङ्गुष्ठाग्रं तु गोमयम् । क्षीरस्य सप्त दध्नस् तु त्रीण्य् एकैकं घृताम्भसोः ॥
text_mt: He should give one pala of cow urine, but cow dung [in the amount of] the tip of a thumb; seven [palas] of milk, but three of curd, and one each of clarified butter and water.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatryāhṛtya gomūtraṃ gandhadvāreti gomayam | ā pyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhi ||
meaning: गायत्र्याहृत्य गोमूत्रं गन्धद्वारेति गोमयम् । आ प्यायस्वेति च क्षीरं दधिक्राव्णेति वै दधि ॥
text_mt: Having collected the cow urine with the Gāyatrī, the cow dung with 'Having the gate of fragrance...', the milk with 'Swell up...', and the curd with 'With Dadhikrāvan...';

sanskrit_iast: tejo 'si śukram ity ajyaṃ devasya tvā kuśodakam | saptapattrās tu ye darbhā achinnāgrāḥ samāyutāḥ ||
meaning: तेजो ऽसि शुक्रम् इत्य् अज्यं देवस्य त्वा कुशोदकम् । सप्तपत्त्रास् तु ये दर्भा अछिन्नाग्राः समायुताः ॥
text_mt: the clarified butter with 'You are brilliance, bright...', and the kuśa-water with 'Of the god...'; and whichever darbha blades have seven leaves, unbroken tips, and are joined together:

sanskrit_iast: taiḥ samuddhṛtya hotavyaṃ devatābhyo yathākarmam | agnaye svāhā somāya prajāpataya ity api ||
meaning: तैः समुद्धृत्य होतव्यं देवताभ्यो यथाकर्मम् । अग्नये स्वाहा सोमाय प्रजापतय इत्य् अपि ॥
text_mt: having scooped [the mixture] up with these, oblations should be offered to the deities according to the rite: 'To Agni svāhā', 'To Soma', and also 'To Prajāpati';

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspate ati yad idaṃ viṣṇur itīti ca | mānastokena gāyatryā etaiś ca juhuyāt tataḥ ||
meaning: बृहस्पते अति यद् इदं विष्णुर् इतीति च । मानस्तोकेन गायत्र्या एतैश् च जुहुयात् ततः ॥
text_mt: and with 'O Bṛhaspati, whatever...', 'This Viṣṇu...', with 'Do not harm our child...', and with the Gāyatrī; then he should make oblations with these.

sanskrit_iast: praṇavena praṇavenaiva pibec ca praṇavena tu | hotavyaṃ praṇavenaiva pibec ca praṇavena tu ||
meaning: प्रणवेन प्रणवेनैव पिबेच् च प्रणवेन तु । होतव्यं प्रणवेनैव पिबेच् च प्रणवेन तु ॥
text_mt: With the syllable Om, with the syllable Om alone he should drink, and with the syllable Om [offer]; oblations should be made with the syllable Om alone, and he should drink with the syllable Om.

sanskrit_iast: madhyamena palāśasya padmapattreṇa vā pibet | api vā tāmrapātreṇa hutaśeṣaṃ viśuddhaye ||
meaning: मध्यमेन पलाशस्य पद्मपत्त्रेण वा पिबेत् । अपि वा ताम्रपात्रेण हुतशेषं विशुद्धये ॥
text_mt: He should drink the remainder of the oblation for purification with the middle leaf of a palāśa or with a lotus leaf, or even with a copper vessel.

sanskrit_iast: yat tvagasthigataṃ pāpaṃ dehe tiṣṭhati dehinām | brahmakūrco dahet sarvaṃ pradīpto 'gnir ivendhanam ||
meaning: यत् त्वगस्थिगतं पापं देहे तिष्ठति देहिनाम् । ब्रह्मकूर्चो दहेत् सर्वं प्रदीप्तो ऽग्निर् इवेन्धनम् ॥
text_mt: Whatever sin residing in skin and bone dwells in the bodies of embodied beings, the Brahmakūrca consumes it all, like a blazing fire consumes firewood.

sanskrit_iast: trayodaśyādicaturṣu triḥsnānākṣārabhojanam | pañcadaśyāṃ pañcagavyaṃ sopavāsaṃ mahāphalam ||
meaning: त्रयोदश्यादिचतुर्षु त्रिःस्नानाक्षारभोजनम् । पञ्चदश्यां पञ्चगव्यं सोपवासं महाफलम् ॥
text_mt: Bathing thrice daily and eating non-pungent food for the four [days] starting with the thirteenth; taking the five products of the cow on the fifteenth while fasting yields great fruit.

sanskrit_iast: abhojyābhakṣyaśūdrānnabhakṣaṇe vedavikraye | pratigrahe kālamantrahīne home dyumaithune ||
meaning: अभोज्याभक्ष्यशूद्रान्नभक्षणे वेदविक्रये । प्रतिग्रहे कालमन्त्रहीने होमे द्युमैथुने ॥
text_mt: In the case of eating forbidden food, uneatable things, or the food of a Śūdra; in selling the Veda; in improper acceptance of gifts; in a fire offering deficient in time or mantra; in daytime sexual intercourse;

sanskrit_iast: bālatve yat kṛtaṃ caiva yuvā vṛddhavayās tathā | mātāpitṛkṛtaṃ caiva tat kṣaṇād eva nirdahet ||
meaning: बालत्वे यत् कृतं चैव युवा वृद्धवयास् तथा । मातापितृकृतं चैव तत् क्षणाद् एव निर्दहेत् ॥
text_mt: and whatever was done in childhood, youth, or old age, and also that done by parents: it burns [that sin] away that very instant.

sanskrit_iast: māsemāse prayuñjānodevalokam avāpnuyāt | ardhamāseardhamāse ca ṛṣīṇāṃ lokam uttamam ||
meaning: मासेमासे प्रयुञ्जानोदेवलोकम् अवाप्नुयात् । अर्धमासेअर्धमासे च ऋषीणां लोकम् उत्तमम् ॥
text_mt: Practicing it month after month, he would attain the world of the gods; and half-month after half-month, the highest world of the seers.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍrātre caiva ṣaḍrātre brahmalokam anāmayam | aharahaḥ prayuñjānaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati ||
meaning: षड्रात्रे चैव षड्रात्रे ब्रह्मलोकम् अनामयम् । अहरहः प्रयुञ्जानः परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति ॥
text_mt: And every six nights, the healthy world of Brahmā; practicing it day after day, he reaches the supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast: anena vidhinaiveṣṭvā devatarpaṇapūrvakam | brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ hy etat pavitraṃ paramaṃ hitam ||
meaning: अनेन विधिनैवेष्ट्वा देवतर्पणपूर्वकम् । ब्रह्मणा निर्मितं ह्य् एतत् पवित्रं परमं हितम् ॥
text_mt:
Having sacrificed by this very rule, preceded by a water libation to the gods —
for this was fashioned by Brahmā as supreme, purifying, and beneficial.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ pippalādaṃ mahāprājñam idam ūcur maharṣayaḥ | bhūmikhātasya śuddhyarthaṃ vidhiṃ prabrūhi tattvataḥ ||
meaning: ओं पिप्पलादं महाप्राज्ञम् इदम् ऊचुर् महर्षयः । भूमिखातस्य शुद्ध्यर्थं विधिं प्रब्रूहि तत्त्वतः ॥
text_mt:
Om. The great seers said this to Pippalāda of great wisdom:
"Tell us truly the rule for purifying an excavation in the earth."

sanskrit_iast: kūpavāpītaḍāgeṣu puṣkariṇyāṃ ca veśmasu | ahorātroṣito bhūtvā tataḥ karma samārabhet ||
meaning: कूपवापीतडागेषु पुष्करिण्यां च वेश्मसु । अहोरात्रोषितो भूत्वा ततः कर्म समारभेत् ॥
text_mt:
For wells, step-wells, tanks, and lotus ponds in houses:
having fasted for a day and a night, he should then undertake the rite.

sanskrit_iast: śāntyudakena tad brahmā pūrvoktaṃ yad agastinā | pari prāgād iti dvābhyām abhimantrayate tataḥ ||
meaning: शान्त्युदकेन तद् ब्रह्मा पूर्वोक्तं यद् अगस्तिना । परि प्रागाद् इति द्वाभ्याम् अभिमन्त्रयते ततः ॥
text_mt:
With the propitiatory water, that brahman which was previously spoken of by Agasti —
he then consecrates it with the two [mantras beginning with] "He has walked around".

sanskrit_iast: carutantreṇa vidhinā caruṃ bhaumaṃ tu nirvapet | prāktantram ājyabhāgāntaṃ satyaṃ bṛhad iti smṛtam ||
meaning: चरुतन्त्रेण विधिना चरुं भौमं तु निर्वपेत् । प्राक्तन्त्रम् आज्यभागान्तं सत्यं बृहद् इति स्मृतम् ॥
text_mt:
By the rule of the sacrificial-mush paradigm, he should offer a sacrificial mush to the Earth;
the preliminary paradigm ending with the portions of clarified butter is handed down as "Satyaṃ bṛhat".

sanskrit_iast: havir ājyaṃ samidhaś ca upasthānaṃ yathākramam | kūpādīnāṃ samīpe tu japen mantrān samāhitaḥ ||
meaning: हविर् आज्यं समिधश् च उपस्थानं यथाक्रमम् । कूपादीनां समीपे तु जपेन् मन्त्रान् समाहितः ॥
text_mt:
The oblation, the clarified butter, and the kindling sticks, and worship in regular succession;
and near the wells and other [reservoirs], he should recite mantras with focused mind:

sanskrit_iast: ambayo yanty āpo hi ṣṭhā śaṃ no devīr iti trayam | hiraṇyavarṇāḥ punantu mā sasruṣīr himavato 'psu te ||
meaning: अम्बयो यन्त्य् आपो हि ष्ठा शं नो देवीर् इति त्रयम् । हिरण्यवर्णाः पुनन्तु मा सस्रुषीर् हिमवतो ऽप्सु ते ॥
text_mt:
The triad "The mothers go", "The waters indeed are", "May the divine waters be propitious to us";
"Golden-colored", "May they purify me", "Flowing from the snowy mountain", "In your waters".

sanskrit_iast: japtvā tu dhenum ānītāṃ pibantīm anumantrayet | ā gāva iti sūktena tārayet tu tathaiva gām ||
meaning: जप्त्वा तु धेनुम् आनीतां पिबन्तीम् अनुमन्त्रयेत् । आ गाव इति सूक्तेन तारयेत् तु तथैव गाम् ॥
text_mt:
Having recited [these], he should consecrate a brought cow as she drinks;
and he should cause the cow to cross with the hymn "The cows have come".

sanskrit_iast: kūpavāpītaḍāgānāṃ samīpe cābhimantrayet | upa hvaye sūyavasāt kartre dadyāt tu gāṃ śubhām ||
meaning: कूपवापीतडागानां समीपे चाभिमन्त्रयेत् । उप ह्वये सूयवसात् कर्त्रे दद्यात् तु गां शुभाम् ॥
text_mt:
And near the wells, step-wells, and tanks, he should consecrate [her]
with "I call [the cow] from good pasture", and he should give an auspicious cow to the priest.

sanskrit_iast: kāmasūktena gṛhṇīyāt karma saṃsthāpayet tataḥ | hiraṇyarajatādīnāṃ matsyādīn kārayed budhaḥ ||
meaning: कामसूक्तेन गृह्णीयात् कर्म संस्थापयेत् ततः । हिरण्यरजतादीनां मत्स्यादीन् कारयेद् बुधः ॥
text_mt:
He should receive it with the desire-hymn; then he should conclude the rite.
The wise man should have fish and other creatures fashioned out of gold, silver, and other metals:

sanskrit_iast: sauvarṇau kūrmamakarau rājatau matsyamudgarau | tāmrau kulīrakarkaṭāv āyasaḥ śiśumārakaḥ ||
meaning: सौवर्णौ कूर्ममकरौ राजतौ मत्स्यमुद्गरौ । ताम्रौ कुलीरकर्कटाव् आयसः शिशुमारकः ॥
text_mt:
A golden tortoise and sea-monster, a silver fish and mudgara-fish,
a copper crab and crayfish, an iron dolphin.

sanskrit_iast: śāntyudakaṃ pañcagavyaṃ tasminn eva jale kṣipet | kartṛdātārau snāyetāṃ drupadād iva śumbhanī ||
meaning: शान्त्युदकं पञ्चगव्यं तस्मिन्न् एव जले क्षिपेत् । कर्तृदातारौ स्नायेतां द्रुपदाद् इव शुम्भनी ॥
text_mt:
He should cast the propitiatory water and five products of the cow into that very water;
the patron and the giver should bathe, [reciting] "Like one released from a wooden post", [and] "Purifying".

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tataḥ | samyag vidhānam etad dhi kūpādeḥ saṃprakīrtitam | puṇyaṃ karma dvijātīnāṃ svargasyākṣayyam icchatām ||
meaning: ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा तु पुण्याहं वाचयेत् ततः । सम्यग् विधानम् एतद् धि कूपादेः संप्रकीर्तितम् । पुण्यं कर्म द्विजातीनां स्वर्गस्याक्षय्यम् इच्छताम् ॥
text_mt:
Having fed the brāhmaṇas, he should then have them pronounce the day auspicious.
For this has been proclaimed as the complete rule for wells and the like,
an auspicious rite for twice-born men desiring inexhaustible heaven.

sanskrit_iast: om atha pāśupatavratādeśo
meaning: ओम् अथ पाशुपतव्रतादेशो
text_mt: Om. Now follows the instruction on the Pāőupata observance.

sanskrit_iast: nāśrotriyāya nācaritavedavratāya nākṛtavapanāya dadīta ||
meaning: नाश्रोत्रियाय नाचरितवेदव्रताय नाकृतवपनाय ददीत ॥
text_mt: One should not give it to one who has not studied the Veda, to one who has not performed the Vedic observances, or to one who has not had his head shaved.

sanskrit_iast: māsadvitricatuṣpañcasaṃvatsaradvādaśasaṃvatsaraparimitaṃ naiṣṭhikaṃ vā
meaning: मासद्वित्रिचतुष्पञ्चसंवत्सरद्वादशसंवत्सरपरिमितं नैष्ठिकं वा
text_mt: It is measured by one month, two, three, four, or five, or twelve years, or lifelong.

sanskrit_iast: athāsyāyatanāni ||
meaning: अथास्यायतनानि ॥

sanskrit_iast: mahādevāyatane 'pāṃ samīpe ||
meaning: महादेवायतने ऽपां समीपे ॥
text_mt: In a sanctuary of Mahādeva, near water,

sanskrit_iast: giriguhāyāṃ gavāṃ goṣṭhe 'gnyāgāre vā
meaning: गिरिगुहायां गवां गोष्ठे ऽग्न्यागारे वा
text_mt: in a mountain cave, in a cowshed, or in a fire-sanctuary,

sanskrit_iast: nadīnāṃ bahūnāṃ pratiśraye
meaning: नदीनां बहूनां प्रतिश्रये
text_mt: [or] at the confluence of many rivers.

sanskrit_iast: anusavanam ||
meaning: अनुसवनम् ॥

sanskrit_iast: bhasmanā snānaṃ raudrahomasnapanaṃ ca sarpiḥkṣīragandhodakair
meaning: भस्मना स्नानं रौद्रहोमस्नपनं च सर्पिःक्षीरगन्धोदकैर्
text_mt: bathing with ashes, the offering to Rudra, and bathing [the deity] with clarified butter, milk, and fragrant water,

sanskrit_iast: gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpodanapāyasayāvakalājādi pradakṣiṇāntaṃ ca ||
meaning: गन्धपुष्पधूपदीपोदनपायसयावकलाजादि प्रदक्षिणान्तं च ॥
text_mt: and [offering] perfume, flowers, incense, a lamp, boiled rice, rice-pudding, barley gruel, parched grains, and so forth, ending with circumambulation.

sanskrit_iast: nivedya nirmālyagandhahārīhāsagītavādanādyupahārān
meaning: निवेद्य निर्माल्यगन्धहारीहासगीतवादनाद्युपहारान्
text_mt: Having presented the offerings: removing the leftover garlands, laughter, song, instrumental music, and other presentations,

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇena tṛtīyam upatiṣṭhate
meaning: दक्षिणेन तृतीयम् उपतिष्ठते
text_mt: he attends upon the third with the right side:

sanskrit_iast: kaṭakakeyūradhāriṇe namo vṛṣāya namo vṛṣabhadhvajāya namo
meaning: कटककेयूरधारिणे नमो वृषाय नमो वृषभध्वजाय नमो
text_mt: "Homage to the wearer of bracelets and armlets! Homage to the bull! Homage to the one whose banner is a bull! Homage!"

sanskrit_iast: vānaraṃ te mukhaṃ raudram anindyaṃ śubhaṃ paśum evājananevājanakaṃ ghoraṃ jīvaṃ jātyam eva rukmaṃ dadāmīti ekavāsā vivāsā vā virāgāṇi vastrāṇi dadīta ||
meaning: वानरं ते मुखं रौद्रम् अनिन्द्यं शुभं पशुम् एवाजननेवाजनकं घोरं जीवं जात्यम् एव रुक्मं ददामीति एकवासा विवासा वा विरागाणि वस्त्राणि ददीत ॥
text_mt: "Thy monkey-like, terrible, irreproachable, auspicious face [...] I give gold that is living and genuine"; wearing a single garment or naked, he should give dyed garments.

sanskrit_iast: gocarmamātraṃ sthaṇḍilam upalipya gomayenollikhyābhyukṣyāgne prehīty agniṃ praṇīyopasamādhāya paristīrya brahmāṇaṃ kalpayitvā nānyadevatādiśi rudrasya dakṣiṇodapātraṃ sthāpayitvā mahāvyāhṛtibhir agnyāyatane nidhāya rudram āvāhayati ||
meaning: गोचर्ममात्रं स्थण्डिलम् उपलिप्य गोमयेनोल्लिख्याभ्युक्ष्याग्ने प्रेहीत्य् अग्निं प्रणीयोपसमाधाय परिस्तीर्य ब्रह्माणं कल्पयित्वा नान्यदेवतादिशि रुद्रस्य दक्षिणोदपात्रं स्थापयित्वा महाव्याहृतिभिर् अग्न्यायतने निधाय रुद्रम् आवाहयति ॥
text_mt: Having smeared a mound the size of a cowhide with cow dung, having drawn lines and sprinkled it, having brought forward the fire with "Come forward, O fire", having laid it on, spread [grass] around it, and appointed the Brahman priest, having set down Rudra's vessel of water on the southern side in no other deity's direction, and having deposited it in the fire-sanctuary with the great sacred utterances, he invokes Rudra:

sanskrit_iast: rudraṃ kruddhāśanimukhaṃ devānām īśvaraṃ param | śvetapiṅgalaṃ devānām mahādevam prapadye śaraṇāgataḥ ||
meaning: रुद्रं क्रुद्धाशनिमुखं देवानाम् ईश्वरं परम् । श्वेतपिङ्गलं देवानाम् महादेवम् प्रपद्ये शरणागतः ॥
text_mt:
"Rudra, whose face is like an angry thunderbolt, the supreme lord of the gods,
the white and reddish-brown one of the gods, [Mahādeva], I approach, seeking refuge.

sanskrit_iast: yasya yuktā rathe siṃhā vyāghrāś ca viṣamānanāḥ | tam ahaṃ pauṇḍarīkākṣaṃ devam āvāhaye śivam ity āvāhyābhyarcya ||
meaning: यस्य युक्ता रथे सिंहा व्याघ्राश् च विषमाननाः । तम् अहं पौण्डरीकाक्षं देवम् आवाहये शिवम् इत्य् आवाह्याभ्यर्च्य ॥
text_mt:
He to whose chariot are yoked lions and tigers of fierce mien —
that lotus-eyed, auspicious god I invoke"; having thus invoked and worshiped him:

sanskrit_iast: na taṃ yakṣmaitu deva iti gugguluṃ dhūpaṃ ca dadyāt ||
meaning: न तं यक्ष्मैतु देव इति गुग्गुलुं धूपं च दद्यात् ॥
text_mt: He should offer bdellium and incense with "May disease not come upon him, O god".

sanskrit_iast: tat puruṣāya vidmahe mahādevāya dhīmahi | tan no rudraḥ pracodayāt ||
meaning: तत् पुरुषाय विद्महे महादेवाय धीमहि । तन् नो रुद्रः प्रचोदयात् ॥
text_mt:
"We know that person, we meditate upon Mahādeva;
may that Rudra impel us."

sanskrit_iast: tasmai devāya vidmahe mahādevāya dhīmahi | tan no rudro 'numanyatām || iti rudrasāvitrīṃ japtvā ||
meaning: तस्मै देवाय विद्महे महादेवाय धीमहि । तन् नो रुद्रो ऽनुमन्यताम् ॥ इति रुद्रसावित्रीं जप्त्वा ॥
text_mt:
"We know that god, we meditate upon Mahādeva;
may that Rudra favor us." Having recited this Sāvitrī of Rudra:

sanskrit_iast: yo agnau rudra ity anumantrayen namo astu yāvad āvāhane devadevasyāvāhayāmy aham iti ||
meaning: यो अग्नौ रुद्र इत्य् अनुमन्त्रयेन् नमो अस्तु यावद् आवाहने देवदेवस्यावाहयाम्य् अहम् इति ॥
text_mt: He should recite along with "The Rudra who is in the fire", "Homage be", as long as in the invocation [he recites] "I invoke the god of gods".

sanskrit_iast: pramardane sarvāsuravināśāya oṃ phaṭkāraṃ karoti ||
meaning: प्रमर्दने सर्वासुरविनाशाय ओं फट्कारं करोति ॥
text_mt: At the crushing, for the destruction of all demons, he utters "Oṃ phaṭ".

sanskrit_iast: nivedane 'ham amukaṃ nivedayāmīti jaṭī muṇḍī pañcaśikhī vā ||
meaning: निवेदने ऽहम् अमुकं निवेदयामीति जटी मुण्डी पञ्चशिखी वा ॥
text_mt: At the dedication, [saying] "I dedicate so-and-so", wearing matted hair, shaved-headed, or having five tufts;

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇo ha vā aham amukasagotro bhagavato maheśvarasya vrataṃ cariṣyāmīti vācayitvā ||
meaning: ब्राह्मणो ह वा अहम् अमुकसगोत्रो भगवतो महेश्वरस्य व्रतं चरिष्यामीति वाचयित्वा ॥
text_mt: having had him recite: "Indeed, I, a brāhmaṇa of such-and-such lineage, will perform the observance of the Blessed Maheśvara";

sanskrit_iast: tato 'sya mauñjīṃ prayacchati || sāvitryā tu daṇḍaṃ pālāśaṃ bailvam āśvatthaṃ vā asiṃ lakuṭaṃ khaṭvāṅgaṃ paraśuṃ vā ||
meaning: ततो ऽस्य मौञ्जीं प्रयच्छति ॥ सावित्र्या तु दण्डं पालाशं बैल्वम् आश्वत्थं वा असिं लकुटं खट्वाङ्गं परशुं वा ॥
text_mt: then he gives him the muñja-grass girdle. But with the Sāvitrī, a staff of palāőa, bilva, or aśvattha wood, or a sword, a club, a skull-topped staff, or an axe.

sanskrit_iast: aghorebhyo 'tha ghorebhyo 'ghoraghoratarebhyaś ca | sarvataḥ śarvaśarvebhyo namas te rudra rūpebhya ity ādau śarvaṃ namaskṛtyopaviśyājyaṃ niratiśāyitvedhmān ādīpayaty antara iti
meaning: अघोरेभ्यो ऽथ घोरेभ्यो ऽघोरघोरतरेभ्यश् च । सर्वतः शर्वशर्वेभ्यो नमस् ते रुद्र रूपेभ्य इत्य् आदौ शर्वं नमस्कृत्योपविश्याज्यं निरतिशायित्वेध्मान् आदीपयत्य् अन्तर इति
text_mt:
"Homage to the non-terrific, and to the terrific, and to the exceedingly terrific and non-terrific;
to all of them everywhere, O Śarva, homage to thy forms, O Rudra"; having first bowed to Śarva with this, having sat down and set aside the clarified butter, he kindles the kindling sticks within [with the mantra]:

sanskrit_iast: idhmā jātavedasaḥ samiddhasya tebhyo vardhayasva prajayā paśubhiḥ śriyā gṛhair dhaneneti ||
meaning: इध्मा जातवेदसः समिद्धस्य तेभ्यो वर्धयस्व प्रजया पशुभिः श्रिया गृहैर् धनेनेति ॥
text_mt: "Kindling sticks of Jātavedas, from them when kindled do thou prosper with offspring, cattle, fortune, homes, and wealth."

sanskrit_iast: yavāghārau ājyabhāgau juhuyād
meaning: यवाघारौ आज्यभागौ जुहुयाद्
text_mt: He should offer the two libations of barley and the two portions of clarified butter:

sanskrit_iast: vāyave svāhā || śarvāya rudrāya svāhā || paśupataye bhīmāya svāhā || śāntāyādhipataye devāya svāheti ||
meaning: वायवे स्वाहा ॥ शर्वाय रुद्राय स्वाहा ॥ पशुपतये भीमाय स्वाहा ॥ शान्तायाधिपतये देवाय स्वाहेति ॥
text_mt: "To Vāyu, svāhā! To Śarva Rudra, svāhā! To Paśupati the terrible, svāhā! To the peaceful overlord, the god, svāhā!"

sanskrit_iast: evam eva patnīnāṃ tūṣṇīm adhipasya juhuyād
meaning: एवम् एव पत्नीनां तूष्णीम् अधिपस्य जुहुयाद्
text_mt: In this very way, he should offer silently for the wives of the overlord;

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ sarveṣu vratanivedaneṣu vrātapatīr juhoti ||
meaning: एवं सर्वेषु व्रतनिवेदनेषु व्रातपतीर् जुहोति ॥
text_mt: thus in all dedications of the observance, he makes the offerings to the lords of the troop.

sanskrit_iast: vratena tvam ity ubhayīruham iti pañcabhī raudrān homān hutvā homāvasānena bhasmanā snānaṃ karoti ||
meaning: व्रतेन त्वम् इत्य् उभयीरुहम् इति पञ्चभी रौद्रान् होमान् हुत्वा होमावसानेन भस्मना स्नानं करोति ॥
text_mt: Having offered the offerings to Rudra with the five [mantras beginning with] "Thou through observance", "Growing in both", he bathes with the ashes at the end of the oblation:

sanskrit_iast: bhasmasnānam tāvad grahīṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam | bhasmasnānena rudro hi snāto 'bhūt pūta ātmanā ||
meaning: भस्मस्नानम् तावद् ग्रहीष्यामि सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् । भस्मस्नानेन रुद्रो हि स्नातो ऽभूत् पूत आत्मना ॥
text_mt:
"I will take the ash-bath that destroys all sin;
for through the ash-bath Rudra indeed became bathed, purified in himself.

sanskrit_iast: bhasmanā snāyate rudro viṣṇuḥ snāyate bhasmanā | tena snānena snāmy ahaṃ yena snāto maheśvaraḥ ||
meaning: भस्मना स्नायते रुद्रो विष्णुः स्नायते भस्मना । तेन स्नानेन स्नाम्य् अहं येन स्नातो महेश्वरः ॥
text_mt:
Rudra bathes with ash, Viṣṇu bathes with ash;
with that bath I bathe, with which Maheśvara bathed.

sanskrit_iast: yena snātā umā devī rudro bhartā maheśvaraḥ | yena snātā gaṇāḥ sarve yena snātā dvijātayaḥ ||
meaning: येन स्नाता उमा देवी रुद्रो भर्ता महेश्वरः । येन स्नाता गणाः सर्वे येन स्नाता द्विजातयः ॥
text_mt:
With which goddess Umā bathed, and her husband Rudra Maheśvara;
with which all the host bathed, with which the twice-born bathed.

sanskrit_iast: yena snātā śivaḥ śarvaḥ śaṃkaraś ca vṛṣadhvajaḥ | snātāni sarvabhūtāni gaṅgāyamunayāgame ||
meaning: येन स्नाता शिवः शर्वः शंकरश् च वृषध्वजः । स्नातानि सर्वभूतानि गङ्गायमुनयागमे ॥
text_mt:
With which Śiva, Śarva, and Śaṃkara, whose banner is a bull, bathed;
all beings bathed at the confluence of the Gaṅgā and Yamunā.

sanskrit_iast: snāto 'haṃ sarvatīrtheṣu nadīprasravaṇeṣu ca | vāruṇāgneyasaumyānāṃ bhasmanā snānam uttamam | tena snānena snāmy ahaṃ yena snāto maheśvaraḥ ||
meaning: स्नातो ऽहं सर्वतीर्थेषु नदीप्रस्रवणेषु च । वारुणाग्नेयसौम्यानां भस्मना स्नानम् उत्तमम् । तेन स्नानेन स्नाम्य् अहं येन स्नातो महेश्वरः ॥

sanskrit_iast: bhūtis tu piṅgalo babhrur bhūtir viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ | bhūtir brahmā mahendraś ca bhūtir devāḥ saha rṣibhiḥ ||
meaning: भूतिस् तु पिङ्गलो बभ्रुर् भूतिर् विष्णुः सनातनः । भूतिर् ब्रह्मा महेन्द्रश् च भूतिर् देवाः सह र्षिभिः ॥
text_mt: Sacred ash is Piṅgala and Babhru; sacred ash is the eternal Viṣṇu; / sacred ash is Brahmā and Mahendra; sacred ash is the gods along with the seers.

sanskrit_iast: bhūtir me 'lakṣmīṃ nirṇuded bhūtir me śriyam āvahet | bhūtir ma āyuṣā vittaṃ varco brahma prayacchatu ||
meaning: भूतिर् मे ऽलक्ष्मीं निर्णुदेद् भूतिर् मे श्रियम् आवहेत् । भूतिर् म आयुषा वित्तं वर्चो ब्रह्म प्रयच्छतु ॥
text_mt: May sacred ash drive away misfortune from me; may sacred ash bring me prosperity; / may sacred ash bestow on me wealth with longevity, splendour, and sacred knowledge.

sanskrit_iast: bhasmanā caranto nityaṃ dhyāyinaḥ paricintakāḥ | yānti pāśupataṃ sthānaṃ punarāvṛttidurlabham ||
meaning: भस्मना चरन्तो नित्यं ध्यायिनः परिचिन्तकाः । यान्ति पाशुपतं स्थानं पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् ॥
text_mt: Those who constantly wander with ash, meditating and contemplating, / go to the abode of Paśupati, from which return is hard to attain.

sanskrit_iast: vācā tu yat kṛtaṃ karma manasā ca vicintitam | alakṣmīś cāpad duḥsvapnaṃ bhasmanā tat praṇaśyatu ||
meaning: वाचा तु यत् कृतं कर्म मनसा च विचिन्तितम् । अलक्ष्मीश् चापद् दुःस्वप्नं भस्मना तत् प्रणश्यतु ॥
text_mt: Whatever deed was done by speech and thought of with the mind, / misfortune, distress, and bad dreams—may that perish by means of the ash!

sanskrit_iast: mokṣaṇaṃ mokṣakāle ca bhasmaśeṣaṃ visarjayet | mukto 'haṃ sarvapāpebhyo rudralokaṃ vrajāmy aham ||
meaning: मोक्षणं मोक्षकाले च भस्मशेषं विसर्जयेत् । मुक्तो ऽहं सर्वपापेभ्यो रुद्रलोकं व्रजाम्य् अहम् ॥
text_mt: At the time of release, he should cast off the liberation and the remaining ash: / 'Freed from all sins, I go to the world of Rudra.'

sanskrit_iast: etat snānaṃ vāruṇaṃ parvasu śarīralepena yathākāmaṃ parvasūpavaset ||
meaning: एतत् स्नानं वारुणं पर्वसु शरीरलेपेन यथाकामं पर्वसूपवसेत् ॥
text_mt: This is the bath of Varuṇa; on the change-of-moon days, by anointing the body, he should fast on the change-of-moon days as he desires.

sanskrit_iast: strīśūdraṃ nābhibhāṣeta ||
meaning: स्त्रीशूद्रं नाभिभाषेत ॥
text_mt: He should not speak to a woman or a Śūdra.

sanskrit_iast: tadā sāvitrīṃ japet ||
meaning: तदा सावित्रीं जपेत् ॥

sanskrit_iast: yadi bhāṣeta tadā rudrasāvitrīṃ japet ||
meaning: यदि भाषेत तदा रुद्रसावित्रीं जपेत् ॥
text_mt: If he should speak, then he should mutter the Rudrasāvitrī.

sanskrit_iast: kamaṇḍalukapāle bhinne bhūmir bhūmim agād ity apsu praveśayet ||
meaning: कमण्डलुकपाले भिन्ने भूमिर् भूमिम् अगाद् इत्य् अप्सु प्रवेशयेत् ॥
text_mt: When his water-pot or skull-bowl is broken, he should cast it into the waters with the words: 'Earth has gone to earth.'

sanskrit_iast: retaḥskande yan me retas tejasā saṃniṣadya dehāt praskandet punar na bhavāya | tad agnir vāyuḥ … … api ceyaṃ pṛthivī kañcakhanteti ||
meaning: रेतःस्कन्दे यन् मे रेतस् तेजसा संनिषद्य देहात् प्रस्कन्देत् पुनर् न भवाय । तद् अग्निर् वायुः … … अपि चेयं पृथिवी कञ्चखन्तेति ॥
text_mt: Upon emission of semen: 'Whatever semen of mine, having settled with splendour, should fall from my body not for rebirth, may that Agni, Vāyu... and also this earth [...]'.

sanskrit_iast: samyak kva cit karoti
meaning: सम्यक् क्व चित् करोति

sanskrit_iast: vratam upādhyāyāchando vartayet ||
meaning: व्रतम् उपाध्यायाछन्दो वर्तयेत् ॥
text_mt: He should carry out the vow according to the desire of the teacher.

sanskrit_iast: tata udīkṣaṇam ||
meaning: तत उदीक्षणम् ॥

sanskrit_iast: vrātapatīr juhoti ||
meaning: व्रातपतीर् जुहोति ॥

sanskrit_iast: samāso 'haṃ vratasviṣṭakṛta iti hutvādityābhimukhas tiṣṭheta ||
meaning: समासो ऽहं व्रतस्विष्टकृत इति हुत्वादित्याभिमुखस् तिष्ठेत ॥
text_mt: Having offered an oblation with the words: 'I am joined with the Sviṣṭakṛt of the vow', he should stand facing the sun.

sanskrit_iast: yan me duruktaṃ durhutaṃ durdhyātaṃ durvicintitam | tan me bhagavān īśānaḥ sarvaṃ tvaṃ kṣantum arhasi ||
meaning: यन् मे दुरुक्तं दुर्हुतं दुर्ध्यातं दुर्विचिन्तितम् । तन् मे भगवान् ईशानः सर्वं त्वं क्षन्तुम् अर्हसि ॥
text_mt: Whatever of mine was badly spoken, badly offered, badly meditated, badly thought, / all that, O venerable Īśāna, you ought to forgive.

sanskrit_iast: navonavo bhavasi jāyamāna ity apsu pravāhayed
meaning: नवोनवो भवसि जायमान इत्य् अप्सु प्रवाहयेद्
text_mt: He should cast [it] into the waters with the words: 'Ever new you become, being born'.

sanskrit_iast: ye śraddhayedaṃ paśupater vrataṃ caranti | teṣāṃ madhu viśakṣe he dadate na punargamanaṃ madhurivādyehaiva ca | te rudrā viratau paśupatisāyujyaṃ gaccha n ti tad eṣa ślokaḥ ||
meaning: ये श्रद्धयेदं पशुपतेर् व्रतं चरन्ति । तेषां मधु विशक्षे हे ददते न पुनर्गमनं मधुरिवाद्येहैव च । ते रुद्रा विरतौ पशुपतिसायुज्यं गच्छ न् ति तद् एष श्लोकः ॥
text_mt: Those who undertake this vow of Paśupati with faith—for them sweet is the discernment, they give [...] no return, like sweetness here today; those Rudras, upon cessation, attain union with Paśupati. Regarding this, there is this verse:

sanskrit_iast: vilīnapāśapañjarāḥ samāptatattvagocarāḥ | prayānti śaṃkaraṃ paraṃ patiṃ vibhuṃ sadāśivam ||
meaning: विलीनपाशपञ्जराः समाप्ततत्त्वगोचराः । प्रयान्ति शंकरं परं पतिं विभुं सदाशिवम् ॥
text_mt: Those whose cage of fetters has dissolved, who have attained the sphere of reality, / go to Śaṃkara, the supreme, all-pervading Lord, Sadāśiva.

sanskrit_iast: om athātaḥ saṃdhyopāsanavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||
meaning: ओम् अथातः संध्योपासनविधिं व्याख्यास्यामः ॥
text_mt: Om. Now, therefore, we shall explain the rules for the twilight devotion.

sanskrit_iast: prāṅ vodaṅ vā grāmān niṣkramya śuciḥ śucau deśe guptatīrthāyataneṣu vā
meaning: प्राङ् वोदङ् वा ग्रामान् निष्क्रम्य शुचिः शुचौ देशे गुप्ततीर्थायतनेषु वा
text_mt: Going out from the village towards the east or towards the north, pure, in a pure place or in secluded sacred bathing-places and temples,

sanskrit_iast: suprakṣālitapāṇipādavadanaḥ prāg vīrāsanenopaviśya jīvā sthety ācamyāpo hi ṣṭhety abhyukṣya prāṇāyāmān kṛtvācamyottiṣṭhan dakṣiṇahastasthā āpo ayojālā ity apa utsṛjed bahudhā ||
meaning: सुप्रक्षालितपाणिपादवदनः प्राग् वीरासनेनोपविश्य जीवा स्थेत्य् आचम्यापो हि ष्ठेत्य् अभ्युक्ष्य प्राणायामान् कृत्वाचम्योत्तिष्ठन् दक्षिणहस्तस्था आपो अयोजाला इत्य् अप उत्सृजेद् बहुधा ॥
text_mt: having thoroughly washed hands, feet, and face, having first sat down in the hero's posture, having sipped water with the words 'You are alive', having sprinkled himself with the words 'Waters indeed are you', having performed breath-controls, having sipped water, rising up, he should disperse the water held in his right hand in many directions with the words 'The waters are net-traps of iron'.

sanskrit_iast: hariḥ suparṇa iti prātar
meaning: हरिः सुपर्ण इति प्रातर्
text_mt: In the morning, with 'The tawny one, the fair-winged bird';

sanskrit_iast: ud u tyaṃ citraṃ devānām iti madhyaṃdine
meaning: उद् उ त्यं चित्रं देवानाम् इति मध्यंदिने
text_mt: at midday, with 'Up that [famous eye]...' and 'The wonderful [countenance] of the gods...';

sanskrit_iast: atha sauramantrān yathākāmaṃ japed
meaning: अथ सौरमन्त्रान् यथाकामं जपेद्
text_mt: then he should mutter solar mantras as he desires,

sanskrit_iast: ud vayaṃ tamasas parīti ca
meaning: उद् वयं तमसस् परीति च
text_mt: and with 'Up from the darkness...';

sanskrit_iast: ud ghed abhi śrutāmagham ity astamita āsīnaḥ
meaning: उद् घेद् अभि श्रुतामघम् इत्य् अस्तमित आसीनः
text_mt: when the sun has set, seated, with 'Up indeed towards the celebrated wealth...';

sanskrit_iast: sāvitryante vāñjalayo japaś ca ||
meaning: सावित्र्यन्ते वाञ्जलयो जपश् च ॥
text_mt: or at the end of the Sāvitrī, folded-hands offerings and muttering [are performed].

sanskrit_iast: athordhvajānur āsīna iti vīrāsanī
meaning: अथोर्ध्वजानुर् आसीन इति वीरासनी
text_mt: Then, one who assumes the hero's posture is seated with upright knees.

sanskrit_iast: pratyutthāyābhayaṃ paścād abhayaṃ purastād ity upatiṣṭhate
meaning: प्रत्युत्थायाभयं पश्चाद् अभयं पुरस्ताद् इत्य् उपतिष्ठते
text_mt: Rising to meet [the deity], he attends upon [the sun] with 'Freedom from fear behind, freedom from fear in front'.

sanskrit_iast: tiṣṭhan prātaḥ prāṅmukha
meaning: तिष्ठन् प्रातः प्राङ्मुख
text_mt: Standing in the morning, facing east,

sanskrit_iast: āyātu varadety āvāhya
meaning: आयातु वरदेत्य् आवाह्य

sanskrit_iast: gāyatraṃ chandaḥ savitā devatā viśvāmitra ṛṣir
meaning: गायत्रं छन्दः सविता देवता विश्वामित्र ऋषिर्
text_mt: the meter being the Gāyatrī, the deity being Savitṛ, the seer being Viśvāmitra,

sanskrit_iast: yathākṣaraṃ daivataṃ rūpaṃ ca manasi samādhāya mahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ saṃdhāya gāyatrīṃ japet ||
meaning: यथाक्षरं दैवतं रूपं च मनसि समाधाय महाव्याहृतिभिः संधाय गायत्रीं जपेत् ॥
text_mt: having fixed in mind the deity and form according to each syllable, having joined it with the great mystical utterances, he should mutter the Gāyatrī.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭakṛtva ekādaśakṛtvo dvādaśakṛtvaḥ pañcadaśakṛtvaḥ śatakṛtvaḥ sahasrakṛtva iti ||
meaning: अष्टकृत्व एकादशकृत्वो द्वादशकृत्वः पञ्चदशकृत्वः शतकृत्वः सहस्रकृत्व इति ॥
text_mt: Eight times, eleven times, twelve times, fifteen times, a hundred times, or a thousand times.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭakṛtvaḥ prayuktā gāyatrī gāyatreṇa chandasā saṃmitā bhūlokam abhijayati ||
meaning: अष्टकृत्वः प्रयुक्ता गायत्री गायत्रेण छन्दसा संमिता भूलोकम् अभिजयति ॥
text_mt: Employed eight times, commensurate with the Gāyatrī meter, it completely conquers the earthly world.

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśakṛtvaḥ prayuktā traiṣṭubhena chandasā saṃmitāntarikṣalokam abhijayati ||
meaning: एकादशकृत्वः प्रयुक्ता त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसा संमितान्तरिक्षलोकम् अभिजयति ॥
text_mt: Employed eleven times, commensurate with the Triṣṭubh meter, it completely conquers the intermediate world.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśakṛtvaḥ prayuktā jāgatena chandasā saṃmitā divaṃ lokam abhijayati ||
meaning: द्वादशकृत्वः प्रयुक्ता जागतेन छन्दसा संमिता दिवं लोकम् अभिजयति ॥
text_mt: Employed twelve times, commensurate with the Jagatī meter, it completely conquers the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśakṛtvaḥ prayuktā pañcadaśena vajreṇa saṃmitā brahmalokam abhijayati ||
meaning: पञ्चदशकृत्वः प्रयुक्ता पञ्चदशेन वज्रेण संमिता ब्रह्मलोकम् अभिजयति ॥
text_mt: Employed fifteen times, commensurate with the fifteen-fold thunderbolt, it completely conquers the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast: śatakṛtvaḥ prayuktā śataparvaṇā vajreṇa saṃmitā sarvāṇl lokān abhijayati ||
meaning: शतकृत्वः प्रयुक्ता शतपर्वणा वज्रेण संमिता सर्वाण्ल् लोकान् अभिजयति ॥
text_mt: Employed a hundred times, commensurate with the hundred-jointed thunderbolt, it completely conquers all worlds.

sanskrit_iast: sahasrakṛtvaḥ prayuktāgniṣṭomāptoryāmādīnāṃ kratūnāṃ phalam avāpnoti ||
meaning: सहस्रकृत्वः प्रयुक्ताग्निष्टोमाप्तोर्यामादीनां क्रतूनां फलम् अवाप्नोति ॥
text_mt: Employed a thousand times, he attains the fruit of sacrifices such as the Agniṣṭoma and the Āptoryāma.

sanskrit_iast: ato yathākāmaṃ japitvā paśyema śaradaḥ śatam indra jīvety āśiṣaḥ prārthayate ||
meaning: अतो यथाकामं जपित्वा पश्येम शरदः शतम् इन्द्र जीवेत्य् आशिषः प्रार्थयते ॥
text_mt: Therefore, having muttered as he desires, he requests blessings with: 'May we see a hundred autumns; O Indra, live!'

sanskrit_iast: stutā mayā varadeti visṛjyodīrāṇā uta sūryasyāvṛtam asapatnaṃ purastād yasmāt kośād iti yathārtham upatiṣṭhate ||
meaning: स्तुता मया वरदेति विसृज्योदीराणा उत सूर्यस्यावृतम् असपत्नं पुरस्ताद् यस्मात् कोशाद् इति यथार्थम् उपतिष्ठते ॥
text_mt: Having dismissed [her] with 'Praised by me, O boon-giver', he attends upon [the sun] according to need with 'Arisen', 'And the course of the sun', 'Without a rival in the east', and 'From which treasure'.

sanskrit_iast: ya imāṃ na vindanti nādhīyate saṃdhyākāle nopāsate te hy aśrotriyā bhavanty anupanītāḥ kriyāhīnāś chedanabhedanabhojanamaithunāny abhicarantaḥ ||
meaning: य इमां न विन्दन्ति नाधीयते संध्याकाले नोपासते ते ह्य् अश्रोत्रिया भवन्त्य् अनुपनीताः क्रियाहीनाश् छेदनभेदनभोजनमैथुनान्य् अभिचरन्तः ॥
text_mt: Those who do not know this, do not study it, and do not worship during the twilight time—they indeed become non-knowers of the Veda, uninitiated, devoid of rites, engaging in cutting, dividing, [illicit] eating, and sexual intercourse.

sanskrit_iast: saṃdhyākāle hy ajapantaḥ śvasūkarasṛgālakukkuṭasarpayoniṣu varṣasahasrāṇi jāyante ||
meaning: संध्याकाले ह्य् अजपन्तः श्वसूकरसृगालकुक्कुटसर्पयोनिषु वर्षसहस्राणि जायन्ते ॥
text_mt: For those who do not mutter during the twilight time are born in the wombs of dogs, pigs, jackals, cocks, and snakes for thousands of years.

sanskrit_iast: samās tasyaivopajāyante ||
meaning: समास् तस्यैवोपजायन्ते ॥
text_mt: Years are produced for that very reason.

sanskrit_iast: tasmād yathoktāṃ sāyaṃ prātaḥ saṃdhyām upāsīta ||
meaning: तस्माद् यथोक्तां सायं प्रातः संध्याम् उपासीत ॥
text_mt: Therefore, one should attend upon the evening and morning twilight as prescribed.

sanskrit_iast: araṇyacarito guptaḥ śuklabrāhmaṇakarmasu | prāyeṇa labhate lokān yathoktāṃs tāṃ samācaran ||
meaning: अरण्यचरितो गुप्तः शुक्लब्राह्मणकर्मसु । प्रायेण लभते लोकान् यथोक्तांस् तां समाचरन् ॥
text_mt: Living in the forest, restrained in the pure duties of a Brahmin, / practicing that as prescribed, he generally attains the worlds.

sanskrit_iast: sāyaṃ saṃdhyām upāsīta kṛtavīrāsano dvijaḥ | kṛtottānas tathā prātaḥ prāñjaliḥ susamāhitaḥ ||
meaning: सायं संध्याम् उपासीत कृतवीरासनो द्विजः । कृतोत्तानस् तथा प्रातः प्राञ्जलिः सुसमाहितः ॥
text_mt: A twice-born man should attend upon the evening twilight having assumed the hero's posture; / and likewise in the morning, standing upright, with folded hands, well concentrated.

sanskrit_iast: etad vīrāsanaṃ sthānaṃ brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ purā | dvijānaṃ bālavṛddhānāṃ puraścaraṇam uttamam ||
meaning: एतद् वीरासनं स्थानं ब्रह्मणा निर्मितं पुरा । द्विजानं बालवृद्धानां पुरश्चरणम् उत्तमम् ॥
text_mt: This posture of the hero was fashioned by Brahmā in ancient times / as the supreme preliminary practice for the twice-born, both young and old.

sanskrit_iast: sāyaṃ prātas tu yaḥ saṃdhyām askannām upatiṣṭhate | sa tayā pāvito devyā brāhmahaḥ pūtakilbiṣaḥ ||
meaning: सायं प्रातस् तु यः संध्याम् अस्कन्नाम् उपतिष्ठते । स तया पावितो देव्या ब्राह्महः पूतकिल्बिषः ॥
text_mt: He who attends without failure upon the twilight in the evening and in the morning, / purified by that goddess, becomes a knower of Brahman, his sins cleansed.

sanskrit_iast: na sīdet pratigṛhṇānaḥ pṛthvīm api sasāgarām | ye cāsya viṣamāḥ ke cid divi sūryādayo grahāḥ ||
meaning: न सीदेत् प्रतिगृह्णानः पृथ्वीम् अपि ससागराम् । ये चास्य विषमाः के चिद् दिवि सूर्यादयो ग्रहाः ॥
text_mt: He would not suffer, even when accepting as a gift the whole earth together with the oceans; / and whichever planets in heaven, beginning with the sun, are adverse to him,

sanskrit_iast: te cāsya saumyā jāyante śivāḥ sukhakarāḥ sadā | sthānaṃ vīrāsanaṃ caeṣāṃ pṛthivī ca pradakṣiṇā | agnihotraṃ hutaṃ caiṣāṃ ye vai saṃdhyām upāsate ||
meaning: ते चास्य सौम्या जायन्ते शिवाः सुखकराः सदा । स्थानं वीरासनं चएषां पृथिवी च प्रदक्षिणा । अग्निहोत्रं हुतं चैषां ये वै संध्याम् उपासते ॥
text_mt: they become benevolent to him, auspicious, and ever-conferring happiness. / The hero's posture is their seat, the earth is circumambulated by them, / and the Agnihotra is offered by those who indeed attend upon the twilight.

sanskrit_iast: ardhāstamita āditye ardhodite divākare | gāyatryās tatra sāṃnidhyaṃ saṃdhyākālaḥ sa ucyate ||
meaning: अर्धास्तमित आदित्ये अर्धोदिते दिवाकरे । गायत्र्यास् तत्र सांनिध्यं संध्याकालः स उच्यते ॥
text_mt: When the sun is half-set and when the maker of day is half-risen, / there is the presence of the Gāyatrī; that is called the twilight time.

sanskrit_iast: bhūmyādityāntaraṃ yas tu chādayec caturaṅgulam | tāṃ tu saṃdhyāṃ parāṃ vidyāc chāyāsaṃbhedane pare ||
meaning: भूम्यादित्यान्तरं यस् तु छादयेच् चतुरङ्गुलम् । तां तु संध्यां परां विद्याच् छायासंभेदने परे ॥
text_mt: When a space of four finger-breadths covers the interval between the earth and the sun, / one should know that to be the supreme twilight, when the blending of shadows is ultimate.

sanskrit_iast: yāvantas tu karād bhraṣṭāḥ patanti jalabindavaḥ | bhūtvā vajrāṇi te sarve patanti hy asureṣu vai ||
meaning: यावन्तस् तु कराद् भ्रष्टाः पतन्ति जलबिन्दवः । भूत्वा वज्राणि ते सर्वे पतन्ति ह्य् असुरेषु वै ॥
text_mt: As many drops of water as fall having slipped from the hand, / turning into thunderbolts, all of them fall indeed upon the asuras.

sanskrit_iast: tato vibhāvasus teṣāṃ prītātmāpyāyate varam | yair ahaṃ mokṣito viprais teṣāṃ loko tathā mama ||
meaning: ततो विभावसुस् तेषां प्रीतात्माप्यायते वरम् । यैर् अहं मोक्षितो विप्रैस् तेषां लोको तथा मम ॥
text_mt: Then the sun, his heart delighted, grants a boon to them: / “Those brahmins by whom I have been liberated, their world is also mine.”

sanskrit_iast: gāyatryā akṣamālāyāṃ sāyaṃ prātaḥ śataṃ japet | caturṇāṃ khalu vedānāṃ samagraṃ labhate phalam ||
meaning: गायत्र्या अक्षमालायां सायं प्रातः शतं जपेत् । चतुर्णां खलु वेदानां समग्रं लभते फलम् ॥
text_mt: One should recite the Gāyatrī a hundred times on a rosary in the evening and morning; / indeed, one obtains the complete fruit of the four Vedas.

sanskrit_iast: saṃdhyāṃ ye nopatiṣṭhanti brāhmaṇyaṃ nopapadyate | upapadyeta vā bhūyo yadi syus tīrthamṛtyavaḥ ||
meaning: संध्यां ये नोपतिष्ठन्ति ब्राह्मण्यं नोपपद्यते । उपपद्येत वा भूयो यदि स्युस् तीर्थमृत्यवः ॥
text_mt: Those who do not perform the twilight devotions do not attain brahminhood; / or they might attain it once more if they die at a sacred bathing-place.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣayo dīrghasaṃdhyatvād dīrghāṇy āyumṣy adhārayan | tasmād dīrghām upāsīta samicchan vṛddhim āyuṣaḥ ||
meaning: ऋषयो दीर्घसंध्यत्वाद् दीर्घाण्य् आयुम्ष्य् अधारयन् । तस्माद् दीर्घाम् उपासीत समिच्छन् वृद्धिम् आयुषः ॥
text_mt: The seers maintained long lifespans because of prolonged twilight devotions; / therefore one desiring increase of life should perform the twilight devotion at length.

sanskrit_iast: tad yathāgnir devānāṃ brāhmaṇo manuṣyāṇāṃ vasanta ṛtūnām evaṃ gāyatrī chandasām ||
meaning: तद् यथाग्निर् देवानां ब्राह्मणो मनुष्याणां वसन्त ऋतूनाम् एवं गायत्री छन्दसाम् ॥
text_mt: Now, just as fire is [foremost] among the gods, the brahmin among men, [and] spring among the seasons, so is the Gāyatrī among the meters.

sanskrit_iast: tad yathā gāyatrī katyakṣarā katipadā kiṃ vāsyā gotraṃ kiṃ vāsya rūpaṃ kīdṛśaṃ tasyāḥ śarīraṃ bhavati ||
meaning: तद् यथा गायत्री कत्यक्षरा कतिपदा किं वास्या गोत्रं किं वास्य रूपं कीदृशं तस्याः शरीरं भवति ॥
text_mt: In this regard: how many syllables does the Gāyatrī have, how many feet, or what is its lineage, or what is its form, [and] what sort of body does it have?

sanskrit_iast: yad vai bhūḥ sa ṛgvedo yad bhuva iti so 'tharvaveda iti
meaning: यद् वै भूः स ऋग्वेदो यद् भुव इति सो ऽथर्ववेद इति
text_mt: What is 'bhūḥ' is the Ṛgveda; what is 'bhuvaḥ' is the Atharvaveda.

sanskrit_iast: tad yathedam akṣaram om ity akṣaraṃ tat paramaṃ śam ity akṣaraṃ guhyaṃ tat paramaṃ pavitram ||
meaning: तद् यथेदम् अक्षरम् ओम् इत्य् अक्षरं तत् परमं शम् इत्य् अक्षरं गुह्यं तत् परमं पवित्रम् ॥
text_mt: In this regard: this syllable 'om' is the supreme syllable; the secret syllable 'śam' is supreme purification.

sanskrit_iast: ādityo vai sāvitry ādityena saha sāvitrī stauti suvati prātaḥ prasuvati tasmāt sāvitrīt v am ||
meaning: आदित्यो वै सावित्र्य् आदित्येन सह सावित्री स्तौति सुवति प्रातः प्रसुवति तस्मात् सावित्रीत् व् अम् ॥
text_mt: The sun indeed is Sāvitrī; together with the sun Sāvitrī praises, brings forth, in the morning impels forth—therefore is the nature of Sāvitrī.

sanskrit_iast: akṣaradaivataṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ
meaning: अक्षरदैवतं व्याख्यास्यामः
text_mt: We shall explain the deity of each syllable:

sanskrit_iast: prathamam āgneyaṃ dvitīyam āśvinaṃ tṛtīyaṃ saumyaṃ caturthaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ sāvitraṃ pañcamaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ pauṣṇaṃ saptamaṃ mārutam aṣṭamaṃ bārhaspatyaṃ navamaṃ maitraṃ daśamaṃ vāruṇam ekādaśam aindraṃ dvādaśaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ vasūnāṃ trayodaśaṃ caturdaśaṃ rudrāṇāṃ pañcadaśam ādityānām aditeḥ ṣoḍaśaṃ vāyavyaṃ saptadaśamaṃ bhaumam aṣṭādaśam ekonaviṃśam āntarikṣaṃ divyaṃ viṃśaṃ digdevatāni catvāry akṣarāṇi ||
meaning: प्रथमम् आग्नेयं द्वितीयम् आश्विनं तृतीयं सौम्यं चतुर्थं वैष्णवं सावित्रं पञ्चमं षष्ठं पौष्णं सप्तमं मारुतम् अष्टमं बार्हस्पत्यं नवमं मैत्रं दशमं वारुणम् एकादशम् ऐन्द्रं द्वादशं वैश्वदेवं वसूनां त्रयोदशं चतुर्दशं रुद्राणां पञ्चदशम् आदित्यानाम् अदितेः षोडशं वायव्यं सप्तदशमं भौमम् अष्टादशम् एकोनविंशम् आन्तरिक्षं दिव्यं विंशं दिग्देवतानि चत्वार्य् अक्षराणि ॥
text_mt: The first belongs to Agni; the second to the Aśvins; the third to Soma; the fourth to Viṣṇu; the fifth to Savitṛ; the sixth to Pūṣan; the seventh to the Maruts; the eighth to Bṛhaspati; the ninth to Mitra; the tenth to Varuṇa; the eleventh to Indra; the twelfth to the Viśvedevas; the thirteenth to the Vasus; the fourteenth to the Rudras; the fifteenth to the Ādityas; the sixteenth to Aditi; the seventeenth to Vāyu; the eighteenth to the Earth; the nineteenth to the Intermediate Space; the twentieth to Heaven; and the four syllables [beyond] belong to the deities of the directions.

sanskrit_iast: atha yat pūrvāṃ saṃdhyām upāste tad gāyatryāḥ śiras tena pṛthivīṃ jayati ||
meaning: अथ यत् पूर्वां संध्याम् उपास्ते तद् गायत्र्याः शिरस् तेन पृथिवीं जयति ॥
text_mt: Now, that one performs the morning twilight devotion, that is the Gāyatrī's head; by that one conquers the earth.

sanskrit_iast: atha yan madhyāhne tīkṣṇaṃ rudras tapati tad dvitīyaṃ śiras tenāntarikṣaṃ jayati ||
meaning: अथ यन् मध्याह्ने तीक्ष्णं रुद्रस् तपति तद् द्वितीयं शिरस् तेनान्तरिक्षं जयति ॥
text_mt: Now, when Rudra burns fiercely at midday, that is the second head; by that one conquers the intermediate space.

sanskrit_iast: atha yad astamiyāt tat tṛtīyaṃ śiras tena divaṃ jayati ||
meaning: अथ यद् अस्तमियात् तत् तृतीयं शिरस् तेन दिवं जयति ॥
text_mt: Now, when [the sun] sets, that is the third head; by that one conquers heaven.

sanskrit_iast: tasyā oṃkāraḥ śiraḥ saha vyāhṛtibhir darbhāḥ keśā oṣadhīvanaspatayo lomāni cakṣuṣī sūryācandramasau vidyud dhasitaṃ viṣṇuvaruṇau urasī rudro hṛdaye paurṇamāsī cāmāvāsyā ca stanau ahaś ca rātrī ca pārśve
meaning: तस्या ओंकारः शिरः सह व्याहृतिभिर् दर्भाः केशा ओषधीवनस्पतयो लोमानि चक्षुषी सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ विद्युद् धसितं विष्णुवरुणौ उरसी रुद्रो हृदये पौर्णमासी चामावास्या च स्तनौ अहश् च रात्री च पार्श्वे
text_mt: Its head is the syllable oṃ together with the sacred utterances; the sacred grass is its hair; herbs and trees are the body hairs; the sun and moon are the two eyes; lightning is the smile; Viṣṇu and Varuṇa are the two breasts; Rudra is in the heart; the full-moon day and the new-moon day are the two teats; day and night are the two flanks;

sanskrit_iast: daśa diśaḥ kukṣī sarvajñānāni vyākaraṇam udaraṃ pṛthivī śroṇī vāyuḥ sthānaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ nakṣatrāṇi śrīsarasvatīrūpā padakramamantrabrāhmaṇakalpaśarīrā sāvitrī gotreṇa brahmadeyā bhavati brahmadeyā bhavatīti brāhmaṇam ||
meaning: दश दिशः कुक्षी सर्वज्ञानानि व्याकरणम् उदरं पृथिवी श्रोणी वायुः स्थानं भूषणं नक्षत्राणि श्रीसरस्वतीरूपा पदक्रममन्त्रब्राह्मणकल्पशरीरा सावित्री गोत्रेण ब्रह्मदेया भवति ब्रह्मदेया भवतीति ब्राह्मणम् ॥
text_mt: the ten directions are the belly cavities; all branches of knowledge and grammar are the abdomen; the earth is the hips; the wind is its posture; the lunar mansions are its ornaments; having the form of Śrī and Sarasvatī, its body consisting of the isolated-word text, the step-by-step recitation, the mantras, the Brāhmaṇas, and the ritual handbooks, Sāvitrī is by lineage to be given in a Brahmā-marriage—'to be given in a Brahmā-marriage,' so says the Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: atha snānavidhiṃ puṇyaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ nibodhata | yena snātā divaṃ lokaṃ prāpnuvanti dvijottamāḥ ||
meaning: अथ स्नानविधिं पुण्यं वक्ष्यमाणं निबोधत । येन स्नाता दिवं लोकं प्राप्नुवन्ति द्विजोत्तमाः ॥
text_mt: Now learn the meritorious rules for bathing that will be spoken, / bathed by which the best of the twice-born attain the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast: saritsu vā taḍāge vā devakhāte hrade 'pi vā | gartaprasravaṇe vāpi puṇyaṃ snānaṃ samācaret ||
meaning: सरित्सु वा तडागे वा देवखाते ह्रदे ऽपि वा । गर्तप्रस्रवणे वापि पुण्यं स्नानं समाचरेत् ॥
text_mt: In rivers or a reservoir, or a pool dug by the gods, / or in a pit or a stream, one should perform a meritorious bath.

sanskrit_iast: pārakye tu tāḍāge hi snānaṃ naiva vidhīyate | taḍāgakartur duṣkṛtair lipyate snānam ācāran ||
meaning: पारक्ये तु ताडागे हि स्नानं नैव विधीयते । तडागकर्तुर् दुष्कृतैर् लिप्यते स्नानम् आचारन् ॥
text_mt: In another person's reservoir, however, bathing is not prescribed; / performing a bath [there], one is tainted by the misdeeds of the maker of the reservoir.

sanskrit_iast: saritāṃ sarasāṃ caiva aprāptau nirjharasya ca | uddhṛtya caturaḥ piṇḍān snāyāt tu parakhātake ||
meaning: सरितां सरसां चैव अप्राप्तौ निर्झरस्य च । उद्धृत्य चतुरः पिण्डान् स्नायात् तु परखातके ॥
text_mt: In the absence of rivers, lakes, and a waterfall, / one should bathe in an excavation belonging to another after lifting out four lumps [of earth].

sanskrit_iast: anvīkṣyamāṇaḥ pārśvāni kuśahastaḥ samāhitaḥ | dvijo madhyaṃdinād arvāg arogī snānam ācaret ||
meaning: अन्वीक्ष्यमाणः पार्श्वानि कुशहस्तः समाहितः । द्विजो मध्यंदिनाद् अर्वाग् अरोगी स्नानम् आचरेत् ॥
text_mt: Observing the quarters, holding kuśa grass in hand, concentrated in mind, / a twice-born man, free from disease, should perform the bath before midday.

sanskrit_iast: yat te bhūma iti mṛdaṃ saṃgṛhya rcā samāhitaḥ | yas te gandha iti tribhir mṛdhir ātmānam ālabhet ||
meaning: यत् ते भूम इति मृदं संगृह्य र्चा समाहितः । यस् ते गन्ध इति त्रिभिर् मृधिर् आत्मानम् आलभेत् ॥
text_mt: Taking up clay with the verse 'yat te bhūma', concentrated in mind, / one should smear oneself with the clay three times with [the verse] 'yas te gandha'.

sanskrit_iast: aghadviṣṭeti sūktena dūrvāṃ śirasi vinyaset | agramagram ity etayā gomayenānulepayet ||
meaning: अघद्विष्टेति सूक्तेन दूर्वां शिरसि विन्यसेत् । अग्रमग्रम् इत्य् एतया गोमयेनानुलेपयेत् ॥
text_mt: With the hymn 'aghadviṣṭā' one should place dūrvā grass on the head; / with this [verse] 'agramagram' one should smear oneself with cow-dung:

sanskrit_iast: agramagraṃ carantīnām oṣadhīnāṃ vanevane | yan me rogaṃ ca śokaṃ ca tan me tvaṃ nuda gomaya ||
meaning: अग्रमग्रं चरन्तीनाम् ओषधीनां वनेवने । यन् मे रोगं च शोकं च तन् मे त्वं नुद गोमय ॥
text_mt: “Of the herbs that graze the topmost tips in forest after forest, / whatever disease and grief is mine, that dispel for me, O cow-dung!”

sanskrit_iast: praṇavādyā vyāhṛtīs tu gāyatrīṃ ca śiroyutām | paṭhet trir anavānaṃ hi prāṇāyāmaḥ sa ucyate ||
meaning: प्रणवाद्या व्याहृतीस् तु गायत्रीं च शिरोयुताम् । पठेत् त्रिर् अनवानं हि प्राणायामः स उच्यते ॥
text_mt: The sacred utterances beginning with the syllable oṃ and the Gāyatrī accompanied by its head— / one should recite [these] three times without drawing breath; that indeed is called breath-control.

sanskrit_iast: ambayo yantīty ādīni trīṇi sūktāni hi kramāt | hiraṇyavarṇā yad ado vāyoḥ pūtaḥ punantu mā ||
meaning: अम्बयो यन्तीत्य् आदीनि त्रीणि सूक्तानि हि क्रमात् । हिरण्यवर्णा यद् अदो वायोः पूतः पुनन्तु मा ॥
text_mt: The three hymns beginning with 'ambayo yanti' in succession, / 'hiraṇyavarṇāḥ', 'yad adaḥ', 'vāyoḥ pūtaḥ', 'punantu mā',

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvānaro raśmibhiś ca tathāpsu ta iti smṛtam | etaiḥ saṃplāvayet sūktais tato 'ghamarṣaṇam ||
meaning: वैश्वानरो रश्मिभिश् च तथाप्सु त इति स्मृतम् । एतैः संप्लावयेत् सूक्तैस् ततो ऽघमर्षणम् ॥
text_mt: 'vaiśvānaro raśmibhiḥ', and likewise 'apsu te' is remembered: / with these hymns one should flood oneself; then [follows] the expiation of sin.

sanskrit_iast: apo divyāś ca saṃ māgne idam āpaḥ śivena mā | yad āpo naktam iti ca etat syād aghamarṣaṇam ||
meaning: अपो दिव्याश् च सं माग्ने इदम् आपः शिवेन मा । यद् आपो नक्तम् इति च एतत् स्याद् अघमर्षणम् ॥
text_mt: 'āpo divyāḥ', and 'saṃ māgne', 'idam āpaḥ', 'śivena mā', / and 'yad āpo naktam'—this should be the expiation of sin:

sanskrit_iast: yad āpo naktaṃ mithunaṃ cakāra yad vā dudroha duritaṃ purāṇam | hiraṇyavarṇās tata ut punantu pra mā muñcantu varuṇasya pāśāt ||
meaning: यद् आपो नक्तं मिथुनं चकार यद् वा दुद्रोह दुरितं पुराणम् । हिरण्यवर्णास् तत उत् पुनन्तु प्र मा मुञ्चन्तु वरुणस्य पाशात् ॥
text_mt: “Whatever pairing, O Waters, was done at night, or whatever ancient evil wrong was committed, / let the golden-colored ones cleanse me of that; let them release me from the fetter of Varuṇa!”

sanskrit_iast: sarasvatīṃ gayāṃ gaṅgāṃ naimiṣaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca | smṛtvā tīrthānipuṇyātni avagāhej jalaṃ tataḥ ||
meaning: सरस्वतीं गयां गङ्गां नैमिषं पुष्कराणि च । स्मृत्वा तीर्थानिपुण्यात्नि अवगाहेज् जलं ततः ॥
text_mt: Remembering Sarasvatī, Gayā, the Gaṅgā, Naimiṣa, and the Puṣkaras, / the sacred bathing-places, one should then plunge into the water.

sanskrit_iast: gacchataḥ snānakāryāya pitaraḥ saha daivataiḥ | pṛṣṭhataḥ tv anugacchanti tatsamīpaṃ jalārthinaḥ ||
meaning: गच्छतः स्नानकार्याय पितरः सह दैवतैः । पृष्ठतः त्व् अनुगच्छन्ति तत्समीपं जलार्थिनः ॥
text_mt: Behind him as he goes for the purpose of bathing, the ancestors together with the deities / follow close behind, seeking water.

sanskrit_iast: āśāṃ tyaktvā nivartante vastraniṣpīḍanena tu | tasmān na pīḍayed vastram akṛtvā pitṛtarpaṇam ||
meaning: आशां त्यक्त्वा निवर्तन्ते वस्त्रनिष्पीडनेन तु । तस्मान् न पीडयेद् वस्त्रम् अकृत्वा पितृतर्पणम् ॥
text_mt: Abandoning hope, they turn back when the garment is wrung out; / therefore one should not wring out the garment without having made the water libation to the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast: utsāhaṃ varuṇaḥ snāne agnir hotuḥ śriyaṃ haret | āyuṣyaṃ bhuñjato mṛtyus triṣu maunam ataś caret ||
meaning: उत्साहं वरुणः स्नाने अग्निर् होतुः श्रियं हरेत् । आयुष्यं भुञ्जतो मृत्युस् त्रिषु मौनम् अतश् चरेत् ॥
text_mt: Varuṇa takes away vigor during a bath; Agni takes away the fortune of a sacrificer; / Death takes away the lifespan of one who eats: therefore in these three one should observe silence.

sanskrit_iast: snānavastre mṛdas tisraḥ pradadyāc chuddhihetunā | ab | snātvā paryukṣya vāso 'nyac chodhye jaṅghe mṛdā punaḥ ||
meaning: स्नानवस्त्रे मृदस् तिस्रः प्रदद्याच् छुद्धिहेतुना । अब् । स्नात्वा पर्युक्ष्य वासो ऽन्यच् छोध्ये जङ्घे मृदा पुनः ॥
text_mt: One should apply three [lumps of] clay to the bathing garment for the sake of purification; / having bathed and sprinkled another garment, the two shanks must again be cleansed with clay,

sanskrit_iast: vastraniṣpīḍatoyena apavitrīkṛte hi te | uttirya vastraṃ niṣpīḍya japed ādhyātmikāni tu ||
meaning: वस्त्रनिष्पीडतोयेन अपवित्रीकृते हि ते । उत्तिर्य वस्त्रं निष्पीड्य जपेद् आध्यात्मिकानि तु ॥
text_mt: for they are defiled by the water from wringing out the garment; / having come out [of the water] and wrung out the garment, one should recite the spiritual texts:

sanskrit_iast: adhyātmam asyavāmīyaṃ kautsaṃ kauṣmāṇḍikaṃ tathā | japtvātharvaśiraś caiva bhavāśarvīyam eva ca ||
meaning: अध्यात्मम् अस्यवामीयं कौत्सं कौष्माण्डिकं तथा । जप्त्वाथर्वशिरश् चैव भवाशर्वीयम् एव च ॥
text_mt: Having recited the spiritual text 'asyavāmīya', the Kautsa, and the Kauṣmāṇḍika, / and the Atharvaśiras, and the Bhavāśarvīya,

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāś ca bhagavān kālaḥ puruṣo manyur eva ca | ucchiṣṭo rohito vrātya etāny ādhyātmikāni tu ||
meaning: प्राणाश् च भगवान् कालः पुरुषो मन्युर् एव च । उच्छिष्टो रोहितो व्रात्य एतान्य् आध्यात्मिकानि तु ॥
text_mt: and the Prāṇa [hymn], the venerable Kāla, the Puruṣa, and Manyu, / the Ucchiṣṭa, the Rohita, the Vrātya—these indeed are the spiritual texts.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsareṇa yat pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ ghoram avistaram | japtvaitāni tataḥ pāpān mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
meaning: संवत्सरेण यत् पापं कृतं घोरम् अविस्तरम् । जप्त्वैतानि ततः पापान् मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ॥
text_mt: Whatever terrible, manifold sin has been committed during the year, / having recited these, one is released from that sin; there is no doubt here.

sanskrit_iast: viṣāsahiṃ manasā hi japtvā gāyatrīṃ ca tathā tridivaṃ prāyāti | paribhraṣṭas tridivāt tapaḥkṣaye jātismaratvaṃ punar eva vindate ||
meaning: विषासहिं मनसा हि जप्त्वा गायत्रीं च तथा त्रिदिवं प्रायाति । परिभ्रष्टस् त्रिदिवात् तपःक्षये जातिस्मरत्वं पुनर् एव विन्दते ॥
text_mt: Having recited mentally the Viṣāsahi [hymn] and likewise the Gāyatrī, one goes to heaven; / fallen from heaven upon the exhaustion of austerities, one obtains anew the memory of former births.

sanskrit_iast: om atha tarpaṇavidhim anukramiṣyāmaḥ ||
meaning: ओम् अथ तर्पणविधिम् अनुक्रमिष्यामः ॥
text_mt: Om. Now we shall set forth in order the rules for the water libation.

sanskrit_iast: snātopasparśanakāle 'vagāhya devatās tarpayati ||
meaning: स्नातोपस्पर्शनकाले ऽवगाह्य देवतास् तर्पयति ॥
text_mt: Having plunged [into the water] at the time of ritual sipping after bathing, one satisfies the deities with libations:

sanskrit_iast: vasūnāṃ namo
meaning: वसूनां नमो

sanskrit_iast: brahmaṇe namo
meaning: ब्रह्मणे नमो

sanskrit_iast: vaiśravaṇāya namo
meaning: वैश्रवणाय नमो

sanskrit_iast: dharmāya namaḥ
meaning: धर्माय नमः

sanskrit_iast: kāmāya namo
meaning: कामाय नमो

sanskrit_iast: lokāya amo
meaning: लोकाय अमो

sanskrit_iast: devāya namo
meaning: देवाय नमो

sanskrit_iast: vedāya nama
meaning: वेदाय नम

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣibhyo nama
meaning: ऋषिभ्यो नम

sanskrit_iast: ārṣeyebhyo namo
meaning: आर्षेयेभ्यो नमो

sanskrit_iast: aṅgirobhyo nama
meaning: अङ्गिरोभ्यो नम

sanskrit_iast: āṅgirasebhyo namo
meaning: आङ्गिरसेभ्यो नमो

sanskrit_iast: atharvebhyo nama
meaning: अथर्वेभ्यो नम

sanskrit_iast: ātharvaṇebhyo namo
meaning: आथर्वणेभ्यो नमो

sanskrit_iast: marudbhyo namo
meaning: मरुद्भ्यो नमो

sanskrit_iast: mārutebhyo amo
meaning: मारुतेभ्यो अमो

sanskrit_iast: vasubhyo namo
meaning: वसुभ्यो नमो

sanskrit_iast: rudrebhyo nama
meaning: रुद्रेभ्यो नम

sanskrit_iast: ādityebhyo namaḥ
meaning: आदित्येभ्यो नमः

sanskrit_iast: siddhebhyo namaḥ
meaning: सिद्धेभ्यो नमः

sanskrit_iast: sādhyebhyo nama
meaning: साध्येभ्यो नम

sanskrit_iast: āpyebhyo namo
meaning: आप्येभ्यो नमो

sanskrit_iast: aśvibhyāṃ namo
meaning: अश्विभ्यां नमो

sanskrit_iast: gurubhyo namo
meaning: गुरुभ्यो नमो

sanskrit_iast: gurupatnībhyo namaḥ
meaning: गुरुपत्नीभ्यो नमः

sanskrit_iast: pitṛbhyo namo
meaning: पितृभ्यो नमो

sanskrit_iast: mātṛbhyo namaḥ ||
meaning: मातृभ्यो नमः ॥

sanskrit_iast: agnis tṛpyatu ||
meaning: अग्निस् तृप्यतु ॥

sanskrit_iast: vāyus tṛpyatu ||
meaning: वायुस् तृप्यतु ॥

sanskrit_iast: sūryas tṛpyatu ||
meaning: सूर्यस् तृप्यतु ॥

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇus tṛpyatu ||
meaning: विष्णुस् तृप्यतु ॥

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatis tṛpyatu ||
meaning: प्रजापतिस् तृप्यतु ॥

sanskrit_iast: virūpākṣas tṛpyatu ||
meaning: विरूपाक्षस् तृप्यतु ॥

sanskrit_iast: sahasrākṣas tṛpyatu ||
meaning: सहस्राक्षस् तृप्यतु ॥

sanskrit_iast: somas tṛpyatu ||
meaning: सोमस् तृप्यतु ॥

sanskrit_iast: brahmā tṛpyatu ||
meaning: ब्रह्मा तृप्यतु ॥

sanskrit_iast: devās tṛpyantu ||
meaning: देवास् तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: vedās tṛpyantu ||
meaning: वेदास् तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣayas tṛpyantu ||
meaning: ऋषयस् तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: ārṣeyās tṛpyantu ||
meaning: आर्षेयास् तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: sarvāṇi chandāṃsi tṛpyantu ||
meaning: सर्वाणि छन्दांसि तृप्यन्तु ॥
text_mt: May all the meters be satisfied.

sanskrit_iast: omkāravaṣaṭkārau tṛpyatām ||
meaning: ओम्कारवषट्कारौ तृप्यताम् ॥
text_mt: May the syllable Om and the vaṣaṭ-call be satisfied.

sanskrit_iast: mahāvyāhṛtayas tṛpyantu ||
meaning: महाव्याहृतयस् तृप्यन्तु ॥
text_mt: May the great sacred utterances be satisfied.

sanskrit_iast: sāvitrī tṛpyantu ||
meaning: सावित्री तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: gāyatrī tṛpyatu ||
meaning: गायत्री तृप्यतु ॥

sanskrit_iast: dyāvāpṛthivyau tṛpyatām ||
meaning: द्यावापृथिव्यौ तृप्यताम् ॥
