text_mt: May Heaven and Earth be satisfied.

sanskrit_iast: yajñās tṛpyantu ||
meaning: यज्ञास् तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: grahās tṛpyantu ||
meaning: ग्रहास् तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: nakṣatrāṇi tṛpyantu ||
meaning: नक्षत्राणि तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: antarikṣaṃ tṛpyatu ||
meaning: अन्तरिक्षं तृप्यतु ॥

sanskrit_iast: ahorātrāṇi tṛpyantu ||
meaning: अहोरात्राणि तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: saṃkhyās tṛpyantu ||
meaning: संख्यास् तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: saṃdhyās tṛpyantu ||
meaning: संध्यास् तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: samudrās tṛpyantu ||
meaning: समुद्रास् तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: nadyas tṛpyantu ||
meaning: नद्यस् तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: girayas tṛpyantu ||
meaning: गिरयस् तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: keṣetrauṣadhivanaspatayas tṛpyantu ||
meaning: केषेत्रौषधिवनस्पतयस् तृप्यन्तु ॥
text_mt: May fields, herbs, and lordly trees be satisfied.

sanskrit_iast: gandharvāpsarasas tṛpyantu ||
meaning: गन्धर्वाप्सरसस् तृप्यन्तु ॥
text_mt: May the Gandharvas and Apsarases be satisfied.

sanskrit_iast: nāgās tṛpyantu ||
meaning: नागास् तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: vayāṃsi tṛpyantu ||
meaning: वयांसि तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: siddhās tṛpyantu ||
meaning: सिद्धास् तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: sādhyās tṛpyantu ||
meaning: साध्यास् तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: viprās tṛpyantu ||
meaning: विप्रास् तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: yakṣās tṛpyantu ||
meaning: यक्षास् तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: rakṣāṃsi tṛpyantu ||
meaning: रक्षांसि तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: mantrās tṛpyantu ||
meaning: मन्त्रास् तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: bhūtāny evamādīni tṛpyantu ||
meaning: भूतान्य् एवमादीनि तृप्यन्तु ॥
text_mt: May the beings of these and other kinds be satisfied.

sanskrit_iast: śrutiṃ tarpayāmi ||
meaning: श्रुतिं तर्पयामि ॥

sanskrit_iast: nīlās tṛpyantu ||
meaning: नीलास् तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: śṛṅgiṇas tṛpyantu ||
meaning: शृङ्गिणस् तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: śvetās tṛpyantu ||
meaning: श्वेतास् तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇās tṛpyantu ||
meaning: कृष्णास् तृप्यन्तु ॥

sanskrit_iast: ajās tṛpyantu || iti yamadūtāḥ ||
meaning: अजास् तृप्यन्तु ॥ इति यमदूताः ॥
text_mt: May the Unborn Ones be satisfied. Thus the messengers of Yama.

sanskrit_iast: yāṃ kāṃ cit saritaṃ gatvā kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśīm | ekaikasya tilair miśrān dadyāt trīn udakāñjalīn ||
meaning: यां कां चित् सरितं गत्वा कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशीम् । एकैकस्य तिलैर् मिश्रान् दद्यात् त्रीन् उदकाञ्जलीन् ॥
text_mt: Having gone to any river on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, / one should offer to each three folded-hands offerings of water mixed with sesame seeds.

sanskrit_iast: ā yāteti hi tisṛbhiḥ pitṝn āvāhayet tataḥ | ud īratām iti tisṛbhiḥ pitṛbhyo dadyāt tilodakam ||
meaning: आ यातेति हि तिसृभिः पितॄन् आवाहयेत् ततः । उद् ईरताम् इति तिसृभिः पितृभ्यो दद्यात् तिलोदकम् ॥
text_mt: Then one should invoke the ancestors with the three [verses beginning] "Come hither"; / with the three [verses beginning] "Let them arise," one should offer water mixed with sesame to the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast: nābhimātre jale sthitvā cintayen manasā pitṝn | tathā mātāmahebhyaś ca śucau deśe 'tha barhiṣi ||
meaning: नाभिमात्रे जले स्थित्वा चिन्तयेन् मनसा पितॄन् । तथा मातामहेभ्यश् च शुचौ देशे ऽथ बर्हिषि ॥
text_mt: Standing in navel-deep water, one should mentally contemplate the ancestors; / likewise for maternal grandfathers, in a clean place, upon sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: parā yātety etayā pitṝṃs tṛptān visarjayet | mano nv ā hvāmahīty evaṃ pañcabhir mana upāhvayeta ||
meaning: परा यातेत्य् एतया पितॄंस् तृप्तान् विसर्जयेत् । मनो न्व् आ ह्वामहीत्य् एवं पञ्चभिर् मन उपाह्वयेत ॥
text_mt: With the [verse] "Depart," one should dismiss the satisfied ancestors. / With the five [verses beginning] "We summon the mind," one should invite the mind.

sanskrit_iast: etadd hi tarpaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ svayam uktaṃ svayaṃbhuvā | śraddhadhānaḥ samācaṣṭe brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati ||
meaning: एतद्द् हि तर्पणं श्रेष्ठं स्वयम् उक्तं स्वयंभुवा । श्रद्धधानः समाचष्टे ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति ॥
text_mt: For this best water libation was proclaimed by the Self-born himself; / believing in it, whoever performs it goes to the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast: om athātaḥ śrāddhavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||
meaning: ओम् अथातः श्राद्धविधिं व्याख्यास्यामः ॥
text_mt: Om. Now, therefore, we shall explain the rules for the ancestral offering.

sanskrit_iast: catuṣprakāraṃ śrāddhaṃ bhavati ||
meaning: चतुष्प्रकारं श्राद्धं भवति ॥
text_mt: The ancestral offering is of four kinds:

sanskrit_iast: nityam ābhyudayikaṃ kāmyam ekoddiṣṭaṃ ceti ||
meaning: नित्यम् आभ्युदयिकं काम्यम् एकोद्दिष्टं चेति ॥
text_mt: the regular, the prosperity-conferring, the desire-prompted, and the offering to a single ancestor.

sanskrit_iast: tatra nityam amāvāsyāyām ||
meaning: तत्र नित्यम् अमावास्यायाम् ॥
text_mt: Among them, the regular is [performed] on the new moon day.

sanskrit_iast: ābhyudayikaṃ mātṛpūrvakaṃ puṃsavanādiṣu saṃskāreṣu ||
meaning: आभ्युदयिकं मातृपूर्वकं पुंसवनादिषु संस्कारेषु ॥
text_mt: The prosperity-conferring is preceded by [offerings to] the mothers, during life-cycle rites such as the rite for conceiving a male child.

sanskrit_iast: kāmyaṃ tithidravyabrāhmaṇasaṃyoge ||
meaning: काम्यं तिथिद्रव्यब्राह्मणसंयोगे ॥
text_mt: The desire-prompted is [performed] upon the conjunction of an auspicious lunar day, [requisite] substances, and brahmins.

sanskrit_iast: ekoddiṣṭaṃ saṃcayanaprabhṛty ā sapiṇḍīkaraṇāt ||
meaning: एकोद्दिष्टं संचयनप्रभृत्य् आ सपिण्डीकरणात् ॥
text_mt: The offering to a single ancestor is [performed] from the gathering of the bones until the rite of incorporating into the ancestral body.

sanskrit_iast: tatra nitye yugmān daive brāhmaṇān upāmantrayet ||
meaning: तत्र नित्ये युग्मान् दैवे ब्राह्मणान् उपामन्त्रयेत् ॥
text_mt: There, in the regular [offering], one should invite an even number of brahmins for the gods.

sanskrit_iast: ābhyudayike ubhayatra yugmān ||
meaning: आभ्युदयिके उभयत्र युग्मान् ॥
text_mt: In the prosperity-conferring [offering], an even number on both [sides].

sanskrit_iast: yavais tilārthā ṛjavo darbhāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt ||
meaning: यवैस् तिलार्था ऋजवो दर्भाः प्रदक्षिणं कुर्यात् ॥
text_mt: Barley is used in place of sesame; straight darbha grass [is used]; one should perform [the rites] clockwise.

sanskrit_iast: kāmyaṃ tu nityavat ||
meaning: काम्यं तु नित्यवत् ॥

sanskrit_iast: athaikoddiṣṭaṃ tūṣṇīṃ yāvad uktam ||
meaning: अथैकोद्दिष्टं तूष्णीं यावद् उक्तम् ॥
text_mt: Now, the offering to a single ancestor is performed silently as far as has been stated.

sanskrit_iast: nāgnevaṃ na daivam ayugmānbrāhmaṇān ||
meaning: नाग्नेवं न दैवम् अयुग्मान्ब्राह्मणान् ॥
text_mt: There is no rite to Agni and none to the gods; [there should be] an odd number of brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāmukha upaviśya pitryeṇopacaryaikaṃ pavitram ekam udapātram apratyāvṛttim āsanaṃ nāmagotreṇaikaṃ piṇḍam etat te annam iti ||
meaning: दक्षिणामुख उपविश्य पित्र्येणोपचर्यैकं पवित्रम् एकम् उदपात्रम् अप्रत्यावृत्तिम् आसनं नामगोत्रेणैकं पिण्डम् एतत् ते अन्नम् इति ॥
text_mt: Sitting facing south, having served [them] according to the ancestral rite, [he provides] a single purifier, a single water vessel, a seat not returned, [and offers] a single rice-ball with name and lineage, [saying,] 'This is your food.'

sanskrit_iast: śve 'dyeti vā śrāddhaṃ kariṣyāmīti brāhmaṇān upāmantrayet ||
meaning: श्वे ऽद्येति वा श्राद्धं करिष्यामीति ब्राह्मणान् उपामन्त्रयेत् ॥
text_mt: He should invite the brāhmaṇas [saying], 'Tomorrow' or 'Today I shall perform an ancestral offering.'

sanskrit_iast: trīn pañca sapta vā na prasajyeta vistara iti vacanāt ||
meaning: त्रीन् पञ्च सप्त वा न प्रसज्येत विस्तर इति वचनात् ॥
text_mt: Three, five, or seven [brāhmaṇas]; on account of the teaching: 'one should not be attached to large numbers.'

sanskrit_iast: prāṅmukhān viśvedevān udaṅmukhān pitṝn ||
meaning: प्राङ्मुखान् विश्वेदेवान् उदङ्मुखान् पितॄन् ॥
text_mt: The Viśvedevas facing east, the ancestors facing north.

sanskrit_iast: vedavedāṅgavidaḥ pañcāgnir anūcāno 'vyavahārī śrotriyas triṇāciketas trimadhus trisuparṇī chandogo jyeṣṭhasāmago 'tharvaśiraso 'dhyetā saṃdhyāsnāyī devapitṛsadāhniko mātṛpitṛśuśrūṣur bhṛgvaṅgirovid dharmaśāstravid iti ||
meaning: वेदवेदाङ्गविदः पञ्चाग्निर् अनूचानो ऽव्यवहारी श्रोत्रियस् त्रिणाचिकेतस् त्रिमधुस् त्रिसुपर्णी छन्दोगो ज्येष्ठसामगो ऽथर्वशिरसो ऽध्येता संध्यास्नायी देवपितृसदाह्निको मातृपितृशुश्रूषुर् भृग्वङ्गिरोविद् धर्मशास्त्रविद् इति ॥
text_mt: [They should be] knowers of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, maintaining the five fires, learned, not involved in worldly litigations, versed in the Veda, knowers of the Triṇāciketa, knowers of the Trimadhu, knowers of the Trisuparṇa, chant-singers of the Sāmaveda, singers of the Jyeṣṭhasāman, students of the Atharvaśiras, bathers at the twilights, daily performing rites to gods and ancestors, devoted to the service of mother and father, knowers of the Bhṛgus and Aṅgirases, and knowers of the treatises on Dharma.

sanskrit_iast: prayato 'parāhṇe śuciḥ śuklavāsāḥ ||
meaning: प्रयतो ऽपराह्णे शुचिः शुक्लवासाः ॥
text_mt: Restrained, in the afternoon, pure, wearing white garments,

sanskrit_iast: svāgatenābhyarcyācamanīyaṃ kṛtvā dattvā brāhmaṇān upasaṃgṛhyopaveśayed
meaning: स्वागतेनाभ्यर्च्याचमनीयं कृत्वा दत्त्वा ब्राह्मणान् उपसंगृह्योपवेशयेद्
text_mt: having honored them with a welcome, having performed and offered water for sipping, having clasped the brāhmaṇas' [feet], he should seat them

sanskrit_iast: daive pitrye ca sadarbheṣv āsaneṣu
meaning: दैवे पित्र्ये च सदर्भेष्व् आसनेषु
text_mt: on seats spread with darbha-grass, for the divine and the ancestral [rites].

sanskrit_iast: tato 'nujñāpayed devān pitṝṃś cāvāhayiṣyāmīti
meaning: ततो ऽनुज्ञापयेद् देवान् पितॄंश् चावाहयिष्यामीति
text_mt: Then he should ask permission: 'I shall invite the gods and the ancestors.'

sanskrit_iast: āvāhaya saumyās te santv ity anujñātaḥ pūrvaṃ devān āvāhayed viśve devāsa ā gateti ||
meaning: आवाहय सौम्यास् ते सन्त्व् इत्य् अनुज्ञातः पूर्वं देवान् आवाहयेद् विश्वे देवास आ गतेति ॥
text_mt: Permitted with the words: 'Invoke them; may they be gentle to you,' he should first invoke the gods with: 'All gods, come!'

sanskrit_iast: viśve devāsa ā gata śṛṇutā ma imaṃ havam | edaṃ barhir ni ṣīdata iti ||
meaning: विश्वे देवास आ गत शृणुता म इमं हवम् । एदं बर्हिर् नि षीदत इति ॥
text_mt: 'All gods, come, hear this invocation of mine; / sit down here upon the sacrificial grass!'

sanskrit_iast: ā yāteti pitṝn āvāhayed ācyā jānv ity upaveśayet saṃ viśaṃtv iti saṃveśayed iti ||
meaning: आ यातेति पितॄन् आवाहयेद् आच्या जान्व् इत्य् उपवेशयेत् सं विशंत्व् इति संवेशयेद् इति ॥
text_mt: With 'Come,' he should invoke the ancestors; with 'Bending the knee,' he should seat them; with 'Enter,' he should settle them.

sanskrit_iast: yajñopavītī sāvitryodapātram abhimantrya
meaning: यज्ञोपवीती सावित्र्योदपात्रम् अभिमन्त्र्य
text_mt: Wearing the sacrificial thread over his left shoulder, having consecrated the water vessel with the Sāvitrī verse,

sanskrit_iast: viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ pādayam arghyam ācamanīyam iti brāhmaṇahasteṣu ninayet ||
meaning: विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः पादयम् अर्घ्यम् आचमनीयम् इति ब्राह्मणहस्तेषु निनयेत् ॥
text_mt: he should pour [water] into the hands of the Brahmins, saying: 'For the All-Gods: foot-water, respectful water offering, rinsing water.'

sanskrit_iast: trīṇy udapātrāṇi kalpayed gandhamālyatilair miśrāṇi kṛtvā'
meaning: त्रीण्य् उदपात्राणि कल्पयेद् गन्धमाल्यतिलैर् मिश्राणि कृत्वा'
text_mt: He should prepare three water vessels, having mixed [the water] with scent, garlands, and sesame seeds;

sanskrit_iast: 'ud īratām iti tisṛbhir udapātrāṇy anvṛcaṃ sapavitreṣu brāhmaṇahasteṣu ninayet ||
meaning: ऽउद् ईरताम् इति तिसृभिर् उदपात्राण्य् अन्वृचं सपवित्रेषु ब्राह्मणहस्तेषु निनयेत् ॥
text_mt: with the three [verses] beginning with 'Let them rise up,' he should pour [water from] the water vessels, verse by verse, into the hands of the Brahmins containing purification strainers.

sanskrit_iast: prapitāmahebhyaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaś ceti dattvā
meaning: प्रपितामहेभ्यः पितामहेभ्यः पितृभ्यश् चेति दत्त्वा
text_mt: Having presented it, saying: 'To the great-grandfathers, to the grandfathers, and to the fathers,'

sanskrit_iast: gandhamālyadhūpāñjanādarśapradīpasyopaharanam
meaning: गन्धमाल्यधूपाञ्जनादर्शप्रदीपस्योपहरनम्
text_mt: there is the offering of scent, garlands, incense, eye-salve, a mirror, and a lamp.

sanskrit_iast: sarvānnaprakāram ādāyāgnau kariṣyāmīty anujñāpya kuruṣvety anujñāto darbhair dakṣiṇāgrair agniṃ paristīrya juhuyād agnaye kavyavāhanāyeti tisṛbhir
meaning: सर्वान्नप्रकारम् आदायाग्नौ करिष्यामीत्य् अनुज्ञाप्य कुरुष्वेत्य् अनुज्ञातो दर्भैर् दक्षिणाग्रैर् अग्निं परिस्तीर्य जुहुयाद् अग्नये कव्यवाहनायेति तिसृभिर्
text_mt: Taking all varieties of food and asking permission: 'I will offer into the fire,' and permitted with: 'Offer,' having strewn sacrificial grass with tips pointing south around the fire, he should offer with the three [verses] beginning with: 'To Agni the bearer of kavya.'

sanskrit_iast: hutaśeṣaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadyād
meaning: हुतशेषं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो दद्याद्
text_mt: He should give the remnant of the oblation to the Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast: aṅguṣṭham upayamya pradakṣiṇaṃ daive prasavyaṃ pitrya idaṃ viṣṇur iti japej jānuṃ niṣadya bhūmāv
meaning: अङ्गुष्ठम् उपयम्य प्रदक्षिणं दैवे प्रसव्यं पित्र्य इदं विष्णुर् इति जपेज् जानुं निषद्य भूमाव्
text_mt: Holding his thumb, clockwise in the rite to the gods, counter-clockwise in the rite to the ancestors, placing his knee on the ground, he should mutter: 'This Viṣṇu.'

sanskrit_iast: atas tilair māṃsaiḥ śākair yuṣaiḥ kṛsarāpāyasāpūpair lājair bhakṣair ikṣuvikāraiḥ pānair madhunā ghṛtena dadhnā payasā caiva prabhūtamṛṣṭato 'nnaṃ dadyād anasūyaḥ ||
meaning: अतस् तिलैर् मांसैः शाकैर् युषैः कृसरापायसापूपैर् लाजैर् भक्षैर् इक्षुविकारैः पानैर् मधुना घृतेन दध्ना पयसा चैव प्रभूतमृष्टतो ऽन्नं दद्याद् अनसूयः ॥
text_mt: Then, free from malice, he should give abundant, purified food with sesame seeds, meats, vegetables, broths, kṛsara rice-gruel, rice pudding, cakes, fried grain, eatables, sugarcane products, beverages, honey, ghee, curd, and milk.

sanskrit_iast: pavitrapāṇir dharbheṣv āsīno madhu vātā iti japet
meaning: पवित्रपाणिर् धर्भेष्व् आसीनो मधु वाता इति जपेत्
text_mt: Holding a purification strainer in his hand, seated on sacrificial grass, he should mutter: 'Sweet winds [blow].'

sanskrit_iast: pavitraṃ dharmaśāstram apratirathaṃ prāṇasūktaṃ puruṣasūktam upaniṣadam anyad vādhyātmikaṃ kiṃ cit
meaning: पवित्रं धर्मशास्त्रम् अप्रतिरथं प्राणसूक्तं पुरुषसूक्तम् उपनिषदम् अन्यद् वाध्यात्मिकं किं चित्
text_mt: [He should recite] the Pavamāna hymn, a treatise on dharma, the Apratiratha hymn, the hymn to breath, the Puruṣasūkta, an Upaniṣad, or some other text concerning the self.

sanskrit_iast: tṛptāñ jñātvānnaṃ prakīrya dattvā cāpaḥ sakṛtsakṛd annaṃ ye 'gnidagdhā iti vikiram ||
meaning: तृप्ताञ् ज्ञात्वान्नं प्रकीर्य दत्त्वा चापः सकृत्सकृद् अन्नं ये ऽग्निदग्धा इति विकिरम् ॥
text_mt: Knowing them to be satisfied, having scattered food and having given water once each, there is the scattering of food with: 'Those who are burned by fire.'

sanskrit_iast: darbhir āstīrya dyuaur darvir akṣiteti tisṛbhiḥ sarvānnaprakāram uddhṛtyājyena saṃnīya trīn piṇḍān saṃhatān nidadhāty
meaning: दर्भिर् आस्तीर्य द्युऔर् दर्विर् अक्षितेति तिसृभिः सर्वान्नप्रकारम् उद्धृत्याज्येन संनीय त्रीन् पिण्डान् संहतान् निदधात्य्
text_mt: Having strewn sacrificial grass, having taken up all varieties of food with the three [verses] 'Heaven is the ladle, inexhaustible,' having mixed them with ghee, he sets down three compact balls of rice.

sanskrit_iast: etat te pratatāmaheti dakṣiṇataḥ patnībhya idaṃ vaḥ patnyā itīdam āśaṃsūnām idam āśaṃsamānānām ity annena prasavyaṃ parikiranam || ye dasyava ity ulmukenābhipariharaṇam
meaning: एतत् ते प्रततामहेति दक्षिणतः पत्नीभ्य इदं वः पत्न्या इतीदम् आशंसूनाम् इदम् आशंसमानानाम् इत्य् अन्नेन प्रसव्यं परिकिरनम् ॥ ये दस्यव इत्य् उल्मुकेनाभिपरिहरणम्
text_mt: To the south for the wives with: 'This to you, great-grandfather,' [and] 'This to your wife,' there is the counter-clockwise scattering of food with: 'This for those who hope, this for those who expect'; there is the circumambulation with a firebrand with: 'The Dasyus who.'

sanskrit_iast: ekoddiṣṭe tv ekaṃ piṇḍam ekam udapātram ācamyopotthāya etaṃ bhāgam etaṃ sadhasthāḥ śyeno nṛcakṣā iti ca śrāddhaṃ dattvābhimantrayec cheṣam
meaning: एकोद्दिष्टे त्व् एकं पिण्डम् एकम् उदपात्रम् आचम्योपोत्थाय एतं भागम् एतं सधस्थाः श्येनो नृचक्षा इति च श्राद्धं दत्त्वाभिमन्त्रयेच् छेषम्
text_mt: In the offering to a single ancestor, however, there is one ball of rice and one water vessel. Having sipped water and risen up, having presented the ancestral offering, he should consecrate the remainder with: 'This portion,' 'These co-dwellers,' and 'The eagle, watcher of men.'

sanskrit_iast: anujñāpyācamanīyaṃ dattvā puṇyāhaṃ vācayed dakṣiṇāṃ ca dattvā yathāśakty udapātraśeṣaṃ sapavitreṣu brāhmaṇahasteṣu ninayet
meaning: अनुज्ञाप्याचमनीयं दत्त्वा पुण्याहं वाचयेद् दक्षिणां च दत्त्वा यथाशक्त्य् उदपात्रशेषं सपवित्रेषु ब्राह्मणहस्तेषु निनयेत्
text_mt: Having asked permission, having given water for rinsing, he should cause [them] to declare the day auspicious; and having given a sacrificial fee according to his capacity, he should pour the remainder of the water vessel into the hands of the Brahmins containing purification strainers.

sanskrit_iast: putraṃ pautram ity ekam āpo agnim iti dvitīyaṃ yuktābhyāṃ tṛtīyaṃ putraṃ pautram ity ekayodapātram iti kauśikaḥ ||
meaning: पुत्रं पौत्रम् इत्य् एकम् आपो अग्निम् इति द्वितीयं युक्ताभ्यां तृतीयं पुत्रं पौत्रम् इत्य् एकयोदपात्रम् इति कौशिकः ॥
text_mt: One [pour] with 'Son, grandson,' the second with 'Water, fire,' the third with both combined; Kauśika says: the water vessel with the single verse 'Son, grandson.'

sanskrit_iast: prapitāmahebhyaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ pitṛbhyo mātulamātāmahebhyo nirdiṣṭaṃ tebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ sapatnīkebhyaḥ svadhāvad akṣayyam astv akṣayyam astv iti vrāhmaṇavacanam ||
meaning: प्रपितामहेभ्यः पितामहेभ्यः पितृभ्यो मातुलमातामहेभ्यो निर्दिष्टं तेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः सपत्नीकेभ्यः स्वधावद् अक्षय्यम् अस्त्व् अक्षय्यम् अस्त्व् इति व्राह्मणवचनम् ॥
text_mt: 'What has been designated for the great-grandfathers, grandfathers, fathers, maternal uncles, and maternal grandfathers—to all of them, along with their wives, may it be inexhaustible with svadhā! May it be inexhaustible!'—this is the utterance of the Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast: dātāro no 'bhivardhantāṃ vedāḥ saṃtatir eva ca | śraddhā ca no mā vyagamad bahudeyaṃ ca no 'stv ity
meaning: दातारो नो ऽभिवर्धन्तां वेदाः संततिर् एव च । श्रद्धा च नो मा व्यगमद् बहुदेयं च नो ऽस्त्व् इत्य्
text_mt: 'May our givers increase, and the Vedas, and lineage; / and may faith not depart from us, and may we have much to give!'

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ varān vācayitvā namo vaḥ pitara ity evamādi mano nv ā hvāmahīty evamantaṃ samānaṃ piṇḍapitṛyajñena madhyamapiṇḍapradānaṃ ceti ||
meaning: एवं वरान् वाचयित्वा नमो वः पितर इत्य् एवमादि मनो न्व् आ ह्वामहीत्य् एवमन्तं समानं पिण्डपितृयज्ञेन मध्यमपिण्डप्रदानं चेति ॥
text_mt: Having thus caused them to recite the wishes, beginning with 'Homage to you, O ancestors' and ending with 'Now we invoke the mind,' it is identical to the offering of rice-balls to the ancestors; and [there is] the presentation of the middle rice-ball.

sanskrit_iast: vājevāje 'vata vājino no dhaneṣu viprā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ | asya madhvaḥ pibata mādayadhvaṃ tṛptā yāta pathibhir devayānaiḥ ||
meaning: वाजेवाजे ऽवत वाजिनो नो धनेषु विप्रा अमृता ऋतज्ञाः । अस्य मध्वः पिबत मादयध्वं तृप्ता यात पथिभिर् देवयानैः ॥
text_mt: 'At every contest help us, O victors, at the acquisition of wealth, / wise, immortal, knowers of cosmic order! / Drink of this sweet drink, rejoice; / satisfied, go by the paths traveled by the gods!'

sanskrit_iast: iti brāhmaṇān hasteṣu gṛhītvotthāpya pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryād
meaning: इति ब्राह्मणान् हस्तेषु गृहीत्वोत्थाप्य प्रदक्षिणं कुर्याद्
text_mt: Having taken the Brahmins by the hands and raised them with this verse, he should walk clockwise around [them].

sanskrit_iast: eṣa śrāddhavidhir anena vidhinā putrān paśūn dhānyaṃ hiraṇyam āyuś ca labhate ya evaṃ vedeti ca brāhmaṇam ||
meaning: एष श्राद्धविधिर् अनेन विधिना पुत्रान् पशून् धान्यं हिरण्यम् आयुश् च लभते य एवं वेदेति च ब्राह्मणम् ॥
text_mt: This is the rules for the ancestral offering; by this rule, one who knows thus obtains sons, cattle, grain, gold, and long life—so says the Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: māhakiḥ kauśikāc ca māhakiḥ kauśikāc ceti ||
meaning: माहकिः कौशिकाच् च माहकिः कौशिकाच् चेति ॥
text_mt: [This is] Māhaki's from Kauśika, and Māhaki's from Kauśika.

sanskrit_iast: om agnihotram ||
meaning: ओम् अग्निहोत्रम् ॥

sanskrit_iast: sāyam ārambhaḥ prātar apavargaḥ ||
meaning: सायम् आरम्भः प्रातर् अपवर्गः ॥
text_mt: It begins in the evening and concludes in the morning.

sanskrit_iast: nāntareṇānyat kuryāt ||
meaning: नान्तरेणान्यत् कुर्यात् ॥

sanskrit_iast: prātar ārambhamity eke ||
meaning: प्रातर् आरम्भमित्य् एके ॥
text_mt: Some say it begins in the morning.

sanskrit_iast: yajñapātrāṇi prakṣālyāgnihotraṃ śrapayet ||
meaning: यज्ञपात्राणि प्रक्षाल्याग्निहोत्रं श्रपयेत् ॥
text_mt: Having washed the sacrificial vessels, he should cook the Agnihotra milk.

sanskrit_iast: śrapyamāṇaṃ ced viṣyandet tad adbhir upaninayet
meaning: श्रप्यमाणं चेद् विष्यन्देत् तद् अद्भिर् उपनिनयेत्
text_mt: If it should overflow while being cooked, he should pour water upon it.

sanskrit_iast: tad anumantrayate pṛthivīṃ turīyam ity etābhiḥ
meaning: तद् अनुमन्त्रयते पृथिवीं तुरीयम् इत्य् एताभिः
text_mt: He follows it with the recitation of these [verses] beginning with: 'The fourth [part] of the earth.'

sanskrit_iast: pratyānīyodag udvāsya barhir udapātram undayati paryukṣya ||
meaning: प्रत्यानीयोदग् उद्वास्य बर्हिर् उदपात्रम् उन्दयति पर्युक्ष्य ॥
text_mt: Having poured it back, having moved it off [the fire] to the north, having sprinkled [the area] with water, he moistens the sacrificial grass and the water vessel.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtaṃ tvā satyena pariṣiñcāmīti hoṣyan ||
meaning: ऋतं त्वा सत्येन परिषिञ्चामीति होष्यन् ॥
text_mt: When about to offer: 'I sprinkle you, cosmic order, with truth.'

sanskrit_iast: satyaṃ tva rteneti hute ||
meaning: सत्यं त्व र्तेनेति हुते ॥
text_mt: When offered: 'Truth with cosmic order.'

sanskrit_iast: gārhapatyād āhavanīyam udakadhārāṃ ninayati || amṛtam asy amṛtam amṛtena saṃdhehīti ||
meaning: गार्हपत्याद् आहवनीयम् उदकधारां निनयति ॥ अमृतम् अस्य् अमृतम् अमृतेन संधेहीति ॥
text_mt: He pours a stream of water from the Gārhapatya to the Āhavanīya [fire], saying: 'You are nectar; unite nectar with nectar!'

sanskrit_iast: āhavanīyaṃ paryukṣya gārhapatyaṃ prāpyāṅgārān avaloḍya carusthālyā saṃsparśayati ||
meaning: आहवनीयं पर्युक्ष्य गार्हपत्यं प्राप्याङ्गारान् अवलोड्य चरुस्थाल्या संस्पर्शयति ॥
text_mt: Having sprinkled around the Āhavanīya, having reached the Gārhapatya and stirred the burning coals, he touches them with the cooking-pot.

sanskrit_iast: nirūḍhaṃ japaty ubhayam iti pratyūḍham iti pratininayati
meaning: निरूढं जपत्य् उभयम् इति प्रत्यूढम् इति प्रतिनिनयति
text_mt: He mutters: 'Pushed away'; he pours back with: 'Both pushed together.'

sanskrit_iast: sruvaṃ srucaṃ ca pratitapati niṣṭaptaṃ rakṣo niṣṭaptā arātayaḥ pratyuṣṭaṃ rakṣaḥ pratyuṣṭā arātaya ity
meaning: स्रुवं स्रुचं च प्रतितपति निष्टप्तं रक्षो निष्टप्ता अरातयः प्रत्युष्टं रक्षः प्रत्युष्टा अरातय इत्य्
text_mt: He heats the dipping-spoon and the offering-ladle over the fire, with: 'Scorched are the demons, scorched the enemies! Burned up are the demons, burned up the enemies!'

sanskrit_iast: adbhir abhyukṣya carusthālyāṃ sruveṇa sruci gṛhītam iti samānam
meaning: अद्भिर् अभ्युक्ष्य चरुस्थाल्यां स्रुवेण स्रुचि गृहीतम् इति समानम्
text_mt: Having sprinkled them with water, [what is] taken from the cooking pot into the offering-ladle with the dipping-spoon is identical.

sanskrit_iast: srucam ādāya mukhasaṃmitām ud gṛhyāhavanīyam abhikrāmatīdam ahaṃ yajamānaṃ svargaṃ lokam unnayāmīti ||
meaning: स्रुचम् आदाय मुखसंमिताम् उद् गृह्याहवनीयम् अभिक्रामतीदम् अहं यजमानं स्वर्गं लोकम् उन्नयामीति ॥
text_mt: Taking the offering-ladle and raising it level with his mouth, he steps toward the Āhavanīya, saying: 'Here I lead the sacrificer up to the heavenly world!'

sanskrit_iast: barhiṣi srucaṃ nidhāya samidham ādadhāti ||
meaning: बर्हिषि स्रुचं निधाय समिधम् आदधाति ॥
text_mt: Placing the offering-ladle on the sacrificial grass, he adds a piece of firewood.

sanskrit_iast: agnijyotiṣaṃ tvā vāyumatīṃ prāṇavatīṃ svargyāṃ svargāyopadadhāmi bhāsvatīṃ svāheti sāyam || sūryajyotiṣam iti prātaḥ ||
meaning: अग्निज्योतिषं त्वा वायुमतीं प्राणवतीं स्वर्ग्यां स्वर्गायोपदधामि भास्वतीं स्वाहेति सायम् ॥ सूर्यज्योतिषम् इति प्रातः ॥
text_mt: 'Having the light of Agni, accompanied by Vāyu, full of breath, heavenly, for the heavenly world I place you, radiant, svāhā!'—in the evening. 'Having the light of Sūrya'—in the morning.

sanskrit_iast: samidhaṃ pradīptām abhijuhoti ||
meaning: समिधं प्रदीप्ताम् अभिजुहोति ॥
text_mt: He offers onto the ablaze piece of firewood.

sanskrit_iast: sajūr devena savitrā sajū rātryendravatyā juṣāṇo agnir vetu svāheti sāyam ||
meaning: सजूर् देवेन सवित्रा सजू रात्र्येन्द्रवत्या जुषाणो अग्निर् वेतु स्वाहेति सायम् ॥
text_mt: 'In company with the god Savitṛ, in company with the night possessing Indra, may Agni, being pleased, accept [it], svāhā!'—in the evening.

sanskrit_iast: sajūr devena savitrā sajūr uṣasendravatyā juṣāṇaḥ sūryo vetu svāheti prātar
meaning: सजूर् देवेन सवित्रा सजूर् उषसेन्द्रवत्या जुषाणः सूर्यो वेतु स्वाहेति प्रातर्
text_mt: 'In company with the god Savitṛ, in company with Dawn possessing Indra, may Sūrya, being pleased, accept [it], svāhā!'—in the morning.

sanskrit_iast: āhutir udayahome 'gner eva
meaning: आहुतिर् उदयहोमे ऽग्नेर् एव
text_mt: The oblation in the offering made after sunrise belongs to Agni alone:

sanskrit_iast: jyotiṣmān udety āyaṃtanatām iti ||
meaning: ज्योतिष्मान् उदेत्य् आयंतनताम् इति ॥
text_mt: 'May he rise luminous to his domain.'

sanskrit_iast: prajāpate na tvad etāny anya iti manasaivobhayatra prājāpatyottarābhutīr hutvā
meaning: प्रजापते न त्वद् एतान्य् अन्य इति मनसैवोभयत्र प्राजापत्योत्तराभुतीर् हुत्वा
text_mt: Having silently offered the subsequent oblations to Prajāpati in both [evening and morning rites] with 'Prajāpati, none other than you [embraced all these created forms],'

sanskrit_iast: sruvaṃ trir udañcam unnayati rudrān prīṇāmīti
meaning: स्रुवं त्रिर् उदञ्चम् उन्नयति रुद्रान् प्रीणामीति
text_mt: he lifts the dipping-spoon northward three times, saying: 'I please the Rudras.'

sanskrit_iast: barhiṣi sruvaṃ nidhāyonmṛjya
meaning: बर्हिषि स्रुवं निधायोन्मृज्य
text_mt: Having placed the dipping-spoon on the sacrificial grass and wiped it off,

sanskrit_iast: pitryupavītaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇataḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhāṃ karomīti ||
meaning: पित्र्युपवीतं कृत्वा दक्षिणतः पितृभ्यः स्वधां करोमीति ॥
text_mt: having placed the sacrificial thread over his right shoulder, [he offers] to the south, saying: 'To the ancestors I offer svadhā.'

sanskrit_iast: hutam agnihotraṃ sarveṣv ity eke ||
meaning: हुतम् अग्निहोत्रं सर्वेष्व् इत्य् एके ॥
text_mt: Some say the Agnihotra is offered in all [three fires].

sanskrit_iast: carusthālyāḥ sruveṇa ||
meaning: चरुस्थाल्याः स्रुवेण ॥

sanskrit_iast: iha puṣṭiṃ puṣṭipatir dadhātv iha prajāṃ janayatu prajāpatiḥ | agnaye gṛhapataye rayimate paśupataye puṣṭipataye svāheti gārhapatye ||
meaning: इह पुष्टिं पुष्टिपतिर् दधात्व् इह प्रजां जनयतु प्रजापतिः । अग्नये गृहपतये रयिमते पशुपतये पुष्टिपतये स्वाहेति गार्हपत्ये ॥
text_mt: 'Here may the lord of nourishment bestow nourishment; here may Prajāpati generate offspring. To Agni, master of the house, wealthy, lord of cattle, lord of nourishment, svāhā!'—in the Gārhapatya [fire].

sanskrit_iast: agnaye 'nnādāyānnapataye svāheti dakṣiṇāgnau hutvā ||
meaning: अग्नये ऽन्नादायान्नपतये स्वाहेति दक्षिणाग्नौ हुत्वा ॥
text_mt: Having offered into the Dakṣiṇāgni [fire] with: 'To Agni the food-eater, lord of food, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: manasaivobhayatra prajāpateś carusthālī
meaning: मनसैवोभयत्र प्रजापतेश् चरुस्थाली
text_mt: The pot of boiled rice-offering belonging to Prajāpati [is offered] with the mind alone in both cases.

sanskrit_iast: srucaṃ sruvaṃ barhiṣy ādhāyottarato 'gner upaviśya prāśnāti ||
meaning: स्रुचं स्रुवं बर्हिष्य् आधायोत्तरतो ऽग्नेर् उपविश्य प्राश्नाति ॥
text_mt: Having placed the offering ladle and dipping spoon upon the sacrificial grass, sitting down to the north of the fire, he eats.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇān prīṇāmīty upaspṛśya garbhān prīṇāmīti dvitīyaṃ viśvān devān prīṇāmīty antataḥ sarvam
meaning: प्राणान् प्रीणामीत्य् उपस्पृश्य गर्भान् प्रीणामीति द्वितीयं विश्वान् देवान् प्रीणामीत्य् अन्ततः सर्वम्
text_mt: Sipping water with 'I gratify the vital breaths,' a second time with 'I gratify the embryos,' [and] finally all of it with 'I gratify all the gods.'

sanskrit_iast: aprakṣālitayodakaṃ srucā ninayati sarpetarajanān prīṇāmīti
meaning: अप्रक्षालितयोदकं स्रुचा निनयति सर्पेतरजनान् प्रीणामीति
text_mt: With the ladle unwashed, he pours out water, saying: 'I gratify the serpents and other beings.'

sanskrit_iast: barhiṣā prakṣālya sarpapuṇyajanān prīṇāmīti dvitīyam ||
meaning: बर्हिषा प्रक्षाल्य सर्पपुण्यजनान् प्रीणामीति द्वितीयम् ॥
text_mt: Having washed it with sacrificial grass, [he pours water] a second time, saying: 'I gratify the serpents and holy folk.'

sanskrit_iast: gandharvāpsarasaḥ prīṇāmīti apareṇāhavanīyam udakaṃ tṛtīyam ||
meaning: गन्धर्वाप्सरसः प्रीणामीति अपरेणाहवनीयम् उदकं तृतीयम् ॥
text_mt: Saying 'I gratify the gandharvas and apsarases,' a third [pouring of] water [is made] behind the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: sapta rṣīn prīṇāmīti srucaṃ sruvaṃ ca pratitapati
meaning: सप्त र्षीन् प्रीणामीति स्रुचं स्रुवं च प्रतितपति
text_mt: Saying 'I gratify the seven seers,' he heats the offering ladle and dipping spoon at the fire.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇān nayāmīti rātrau srugdaṇḍam avamārṣṭi ||
meaning: दक्षिणान् नयामीति रात्रौ स्रुग्दण्डम् अवमार्ष्टि ॥
text_mt: Saying 'I lead the southern ones,' he wipes down the handle of the ladle at night.

sanskrit_iast: prātar unmārṣṭi ||
meaning: प्रातर् उन्मार्ष्टि ॥

sanskrit_iast: ity uktaṃ samidādhānam
meaning: इत्य् उक्तं समिदाधानम्
text_mt: Thus has been stated the laying on of firewood.

sanskrit_iast: agnyupasthānam || rātriṃ rātrim aprayātaṃ bharanta iti ||
meaning: अग्न्युपस्थानम् ॥ रात्रिं रात्रिम् अप्रयातं भरन्त इति ॥
text_mt: The adoration of the fire [is performed with]: 'Night after night, bringing before departure...'

sanskrit_iast: yathākālaṃ sāyamsāyaṃ gṛhapatir ayaṃ no agnir iti dve
meaning: यथाकालं सायम्सायं गृहपतिर् अयं नो अग्निर् इति द्वे
text_mt: At the proper time, each evening, [he adores the fire with] the two verses: 'The master of the house' and 'This fire of ours.'

sanskrit_iast: gārhapatyapaścād dugdhānnasyāgnihotraśrapaṇī vidhīyate ||
meaning: गार्हपत्यपश्चाद् दुग्धान्नस्याग्निहोत्रश्रपणी विधीयते ॥
text_mt: Behind the gārhapatya fire, the cooking vessel for the Agnihotra milk-food is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast: yajña te veda pṛṣṭham ity etayālabhyābhimantrayate ||
meaning: यज्ञ ते वेद पृष्ठम् इत्य् एतयालभ्याभिमन्त्रयते ॥
text_mt: Touching it with 'O sacrifice, I know your back,' he consecrates it with the mantra.

sanskrit_iast: ukhāyaṃ sravantyāṃ sa mardakarmabhyo 'nyasyāṃ dṛḍhatarāyāṃ pratyāsicya sutā deveṣv ity anumantrayate ||
meaning: उखायं स्रवन्त्यां स मर्दकर्मभ्यो ऽन्यस्यां दृढतरायां प्रत्यासिच्य सुता देवेष्व् इत्य् अनुमन्त्रयते ॥
text_mt: When the cooking pot leaks, pouring [the contents] into another, stronger one for the mashing rituals, he consecrates it with [the verse]: 'Sutā deveṣu...'

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ sarvāsūkhāsu somakalaśamahāvīre vā
meaning: एवं सर्वासूखासु सोमकलशमहावीरे वा
text_mt: Thus in all cooking pots, or in the Soma vessel and the mahāvīra pot.

sanskrit_iast: atha yasyāgnihotradhenvādi vyāpadyeta | tatra yathādevataṃ juhuyād apratibhāve vyāhṛtibhiḥ ||
meaning: अथ यस्याग्निहोत्रधेन्वादि व्यापद्येत । तत्र यथादेवतं जुहुयाद् अप्रतिभावे व्याहृतिभिः ॥
text_mt: Now, whose Agnihotra cow or other [requisite] should perish, there one should offer according to the appropriate deity, [or] if one does not occur to mind, with the sacred utterances.

sanskrit_iast: atha vedavratasyādeśanavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||
meaning: अथ वेदव्रतस्यादेशनविधिं व्याख्यास्यामः ॥
text_mt: Now we shall explain the rules for the instruction in the Veda-observance.

sanskrit_iast: sāṃvatsarikaṃ vedavratam ||
meaning: सांवत्सरिकं वेदव्रतम् ॥
text_mt: The Veda-observance lasts for one year.

sanskrit_iast: kalpānāṃ ṣāṇmāsikam ||
meaning: कल्पानां षाण्मासिकम् ॥

sanskrit_iast: romanakhāni dhārayet triṣavaṇaṃ tu snāyād dhaviṣyam aśnīyān na tu naktam aṇūn māśān masūrāṃs tu ||
meaning: रोमनखानि धारयेत् त्रिषवणं तु स्नायाद् धविष्यम् अश्नीयान् न तु नक्तम् अणून् माशान् मसूरांस् तु ॥
text_mt: He should keep his hair and nails [uncut], bathe at the three pressings, eat sacrificial food, but not at night, nor small beans, kidney beans, or lentils.

sanskrit_iast: daṇḍamathitam uddhṛtasnehaṃ nāśīyāt ||
meaning: दण्डमथितम् उद्धृतस्नेहं नाशीयात् ॥
text_mt: He should not consume [buttermilk] churned with a stick whose fat has been extracted.

sanskrit_iast: daṇḍakamaṇḍaludhāraṇaṃ vāsaś cāthorṇam
meaning: दण्डकमण्डलुधारणं वासश् चाथोर्णम्
text_mt: He carries a staff and water pot, and his garment is of wool.

sanskrit_iast: śirasvrataṃ ca sāṃvatsarikaṃ vedavratenaiva vyākhyātam ||
meaning: शिरस्व्रतं च सांवत्सरिकं वेदव्रतेनैव व्याख्यातम् ॥
text_mt: And the head-observance, lasting one year, is explained by the Veda-observance alone.

sanskrit_iast: atha pramāṇāni vakṣyāmo
meaning: अथ प्रमाणानि वक्ष्यामो
text_mt: Now we shall state the measures.

sanskrit_iast: yamānāṃ mitrasya mṛgārthasyākṣīrākṣārabhojanam ayugmam āchādanam anantarhitā śayyā
meaning: यमानां मित्रस्य मृगार्थस्याक्षीराक्षारभोजनम् अयुग्मम् आछादनम् अनन्तर्हिता शय्या
text_mt: For the restraints, for the friendly [observance], and for the deer-purpose: eating neither milk nor pungent seasoning, an odd number of coverings, and an uncovered bed.

sanskrit_iast: mṛgārtheṣv aviśeṣeṇa yameṣu sarvam eva śamīdhānyaṃ na bhuñjītā
meaning: मृगार्थेष्व् अविशेषेण यमेषु सर्वम् एव शमीधान्यं न भुञ्जीता
text_mt: In the deer-purposes, without exception, throughout the restraints, he must not eat any legume at all.

sanskrit_iast: athopasamādadhāti ||
meaning: अथोपसमादधाति ॥

sanskrit_iast: samās tvāsmai kṣatrāṇy etam idhmam agnir bhūmyām iti tisṛbhir mamāgne varca iti sarvasūktenāyuṣyair varcasyaiḥ svastyayanair abhayair aparājitaiḥ śarmavarmabhiś copasamādadhāti ||
meaning: समास् त्वास्मै क्षत्राण्य् एतम् इध्मम् अग्निर् भूम्याम् इति तिसृभिर् ममाग्ने वर्च इति सर्वसूक्तेनायुष्यैर् वर्चस्यैः स्वस्त्ययनैर् अभयैर् अपराजितैः शर्मवर्मभिश् चोपसमादधाति ॥
text_mt: He lays firewood with the three verses 'The years for you, O king...', 'This firewood...', and 'Fire upon the earth...', with the entire hymn 'Mine, O Fire, is splendor...', and with hymns promoting longevity, conferring splendor, ensuring well-being, granting fearlessness, unconquered, and conferring refuge and armor.

sanskrit_iast: vrataṃ nivedya vrātapatībhiḥ samidho 'bhyādadhyād
meaning: व्रतं निवेद्य व्रातपतीभिः समिधो ऽभ्यादध्याद्
text_mt: Having declared the observance, he should lay on kindling-sticks with the verses addressed to the Lord of Vows.

sanskrit_iast: āṅgirasān samāsān hutvā bhārgavair viparyastām āṅgirasīm
meaning: आङ्गिरसान् समासान् हुत्वा भार्गवैर् विपर्यस्ताम् आङ्गिरसीम्
text_mt: Having offered the collective Āṅgirasa [formulas], [he offers] the Āṅgirasa inverted with Bhārgava [formulas];

sanskrit_iast: vedādibhir vedottamaiḥ vargādibhir vargottamaiḥ padādibhiḥ padottamaiḥ kāṇḍādibhiḥ kāṇḍottamair anuvākādibhir anuvākottamair mahatkāṇḍair viśeṣeṇa sūktādibhiḥ sūktottamair
meaning: वेदादिभिर् वेदोत्तमैः वर्गादिभिर् वर्गोत्तमैः पदादिभिः पदोत्तमैः काण्डादिभिः काण्डोत्तमैर् अनुवाकादिभिर् अनुवाकोत्तमैर् महत्काण्डैर् विशेषेण सूक्तादिभिः सूक्तोत्तमैर्
text_mt: with the beginnings and ends of the Vedas, the beginnings and ends of sections, the beginnings and ends of words, the beginnings and ends of books, the beginnings and ends of lessons, especially with the great books, with the beginnings and ends of hymns.

sanskrit_iast: atraitāny aṣṭarcaprabhṛtīni vyākhyātāni ||
meaning: अत्रैतान्य् अष्टर्चप्रभृतीनि व्याख्यातानि ॥
text_mt: Here these starting with the eight-verse hymns are explained.

sanskrit_iast: brahmajyeṣṭheti ekā kāmojajñe kāmas tad iti hutvā
meaning: ब्रह्मज्येष्ठेति एका कामोजज्ञे कामस् तद् इति हुत्वा
text_mt: Having offered one [verse] beginning with 'Brahmā the eldest...' and [the hymns] 'Desire was born...' and 'Desire was that...',

sanskrit_iast: kalpavrate viśeṣo vacanakarmasu brāhmaṇaṃ śrāvayet ||
meaning: कल्पव्रते विशेषो वचनकर्मसु ब्राह्मणं श्रावयेत् ॥
text_mt: in the observance of the ritual manuals, there is a special rule in the spoken acts: he should recite the Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: keśībrāhmaṇaṃ ca
meaning: केशीब्राह्मणं च

sanskrit_iast: yeṣu vrataviśeṣaḥ syān na tān mantrān udāharet samāsavat sa hotavyaḥ purāṇārthaṃ vijānatā ||
meaning: येषु व्रतविशेषः स्यान् न तान् मन्त्रान् उदाहरेत् समासवत् स होतव्यः पुराणार्थं विजानता ॥
text_mt: In those rites where there is a special observance, he should not utter those mantras; it should be offered as a summary by one knowing the ancient purpose.

sanskrit_iast: agnim purohitaṃ yajñasya devam ṛtvijam | hotāraṃ ratnadhātamam ||
meaning: अग्निम् पुरोहितं यज्ञस्य देवम् ऋत्विजम् । होतारं रत्नधातमम् ॥
text_mt: 'I praise Agni, the household priest, the divine ministrant of the sacrifice, / the invoker, best bestower of treasure.'

sanskrit_iast: tac chaṃ yor āvṛṇīmahe gātuṃ yajñāya gātuṃ yajñapataye | daivī svastir astu naḥ svastir mānuṣebhyaḥ | ūrdhvaṃ jigātu bheṣajaṃ śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||
meaning: तच् छं योर् आवृणीमहे गातुं यज्ञाय गातुं यज्ञपतये । दैवी स्वस्तिर् अस्तु नः स्वस्तिर् मानुषेभ्यः । ऊर्ध्वं जिगातु भेषजं शं नो अस्तु द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे ॥
text_mt: 'We choose that blessing and peace, a song for the sacrifice, a song for the lord of the sacrifice; / divine well-being be ours, well-being for mortals; / may healing go upward; peace be to our two-footed, peace to our four-footed.'

sanskrit_iast: iṣe tvorje tvā vāyava sthopāyava stha devo vaḥ savitā prārpayatu śreṣṭhatamāya karmaṇa āpyāyadhvam aghnyā indrāya bhāgam ūrjasvatīḥ payasvatīḥ prajāvatīr anamīvā ayakṣmā mā va stena īśata māghaśaṃso rudrasya hetiḥ pari vo vṛṇaktu dhruvā asmin gopatau syāta bahvīr yajamānasya paśūn pāhi ||
meaning: इषे त्वोर्जे त्वा वायव स्थोपायव स्थ देवो वः सविता प्रार्पयतु श्रेष्ठतमाय कर्मण आप्यायध्वम् अघ्न्या इन्द्राय भागम् ऊर्जस्वतीः पयस्वतीः प्रजावतीर् अनमीवा अयक्ष्मा मा व स्तेन ईशत माघशंसो रुद्रस्य हेतिः परि वो वृणक्तु ध्रुवा अस्मिन् गोपतौ स्यात बह्वीर् यजमानस्य पशून् पाहि ॥
text_mt: 'For food you, for strength you! You are the winds, you are the approaching ones! May the god Savitṛ impel you to the most excellent rite! Swell, O inviolable ones, as a portion for Indra, [full of vigor, full of milk,] rich in offspring, free from disease, without consumption! May no thief master you, nor an evil-doer! May Rudra’s missile avoid you! Be steadfast with this protector of cattle! Protect the many cattle of the sacrificer!'

sanskrit_iast: dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣaṃ jiṣṇor aśvasya vājinaḥ | surabhi no mukhā karat pra ṇa āyumṣi tāriṣat ||
meaning: दधिक्राव्णो अकारिषं जिष्णोर् अश्वस्य वाजिनः । सुरभि नो मुखा करत् प्र ण आयुम्षि तारिषत् ॥
text_mt: 'I have sung of Dadhikrāvan, the victorious, swift steed; / may he make our mouths fragrant; may he prolong our lifespans!'

sanskrit_iast: agna ā yāhi vītaye gṛṇāno gavyadātaye | ni hotā satsi barhiṣi ||
meaning: अग्न आ याहि वीतये गृणानो गव्यदातये । नि होता सत्सि बर्हिषि ॥
text_mt: 'O Agni, come to the feast, praised for the gift of cattle; / sit down as the hotṛ upon the sacrificial grass.'

sanskrit_iast: eṣa sya te dhārayā suto 'vyo vārebhir yavane maditavyam | krīḍan raśmir apārthivaḥ ||
meaning: एष स्य ते धारया सुतो ऽव्यो वारेभिर् यवने मदितव्यम् । क्रीडन् रश्मिर् अपार्थिवः ॥
text_mt: 'This [soma] is pressed for you in a stream through the sheep's wool, exhilaration in the sieve, / playing, a heavenly ray.'

sanskrit_iast: ye triṣaptā vasyobhūyāya ye triṣaptā marmāṇi te vasyobhūyāya ye triṣaptā ye diśāṃ marmāṇi te yāṃ devā vasyobhūyāya ye triṣaptāḥ samānāṃ māsām ā te nayatv ā arjanyasya ye diśāṃ kṛtyākṛtaṃ valaginam akṣitās te marmāṇi te viṣam evendraṃ mitraṃ vaśāṃ devā yāṃ deyāḥ sūrya enam annādyena yaśasā pra budhyasvāhnā pratyag vasyobhūyāya ||
meaning: ये त्रिषप्ता वस्योभूयाय ये त्रिषप्ता मर्माणि ते वस्योभूयाय ये त्रिषप्ता ये दिशां मर्माणि ते यां देवा वस्योभूयाय ये त्रिषप्ताः समानां मासाम् आ ते नयत्व् आ अर्जन्यस्य ये दिशां कृत्याकृतं वलगिनम् अक्षितास् ते मर्माणि ते विषम् एवेन्द्रं मित्रं वशां देवा यां देयाः सूर्य एनम् अन्नाद्येन यशसा प्र बुध्यस्वाह्ना प्रत्यग् वस्योभूयाय ॥
text_mt: 'Those three times seven...', 'For greater well-being...', 'Those three times seven...', 'Your vital parts...', 'For greater well-being...', 'Those three times seven...', 'Who of the quarters...', 'Your vital parts...', 'Which the gods...', 'For greater well-being...', 'Those three times seven...', 'Of the equals...', 'Of the months...', 'May he lead to you...', 'Of Parjanya...', 'Who of the quarters...', 'Sorcery-maker, hidden charm...', 'Inexhaustible to you...', 'Your vital parts...', 'Poison indeed...', 'Indra, Mitra...', 'The barren cow...', 'The gods...', 'Which you must give...', 'Sūrya...', 'Him with food...', 'With fame...', 'Awake!...', 'With the day...', 'Westward...', 'For greater well-being...'

sanskrit_iast: ye triṣaptāḥ śaṃ na āpo yathā vāto yadi no gāṃ haṃsy apendra dviṣataḥ putram attu samānāṃ vṛṣāyamāṇaḥ sūryam ṛtaṃ paripāṇam asy ā harāmiye krimaya
meaning: ये त्रिषप्ताः शं न आपो यथा वातो यदि नो गां हंस्य् अपेन्द्र द्विषतः पुत्रम् अत्तु समानां वृषायमाणः सूर्यम् ऋतं परिपाणम् अस्य् आ हरामिये क्रिमय
text_mt: 'Those three times seven...', 'Auspicious to us the waters...', 'As the wind...', 'If you slay our cow...', 'Away, Indra, from the haters...', 'May he eat the son...', 'Of the equals...', 'Acting like a bull...', 'Sūrya...', 'Truth...', 'A defense you are...', 'I bring...', 'Which worms...'

sanskrit_iast: ā te nayatu parṇo 'sīndraputre viśvāhā te gosaniṃ vy asmai mitrāvaruṇāv ā parjānyasya svapna svapnābhikaraena devānām asthi mahāntaṃ kośaṃ yo antarikṣeṇopa śreṣṭhā aham eva vāta ivāva bādhe ye diśām
meaning: आ ते नयतु पर्णो ऽसीन्द्रपुत्रे विश्वाहा ते गोसनिं व्य् अस्मै मित्रावरुणाव् आ पर्जान्यस्य स्वप्न स्वप्नाभिकरएन देवानाम् अस्थि महान्तं कोशं यो अन्तरिक्षेणोप श्रेष्ठा अहम् एव वात इवाव बाधे ये दिशाम्
text_mt: 'May he lead to you...', 'A leaf you are...', 'In the son of Indra...', 'Always to you...', 'Winning cattle...', 'To him...', 'Mitrā-Varuṇā...', 'Of Parjanya...', 'O dream...', 'With dream-causing...', 'Of the gods...', 'Bone...', 'The great chest...', 'Who through the intermediate space...', 'Best...', 'I alone...', 'Like the wind I beat down...', 'Who of the quarters...'

sanskrit_iast: ardham ardhenaivā mahān arvāñcam indraṃ śīrṣāmayam upahatyām aśvasyāśna indrasya varūthaṃ hiraṇyavarṇā subhagā atrainān indrod āyur ud bṛhatā mano
meaning: अर्धम् अर्धेनैवा महान् अर्वाञ्चम् इन्द्रं शीर्षामयम् उपहत्याम् अश्वस्याश्न इन्द्रस्य वरूथं हिरण्यवर्णा सुभगा अत्रैनान् इन्द्रोद् आयुर् उद् बृहता मनो
text_mt: 'Half with half...', 'The great...', 'Hitherward Indra...', 'Head-disease...', 'Upon affliction...', 'Of the horse...', 'Indra’s shelter...', 'Golden-colored...', 'Auspicious...', 'Here them...', 'Indra...', 'Upward lifespan...', 'Uproot!...', 'Mind...'

sanskrit_iast: devo devāya sadyo jātas tastuvann agnir ivaitu śataṃ ca me yady ekādaśo 'si nāsya dhenur iṣur iva digdhā na varṣam acyutacyud etā devasenā
meaning: देवो देवाय सद्यो जातस् तस्तुवन्न् अग्निर् इवैतु शतं च मे यद्य् एकादशो ऽसि नास्य धेनुर् इषुर् इव दिग्धा न वर्षम् अच्युतच्युद् एता देवसेना
text_mt: 'God to god...', 'Just born...', 'Praising...', 'Like Agni may he go...', 'And a hundred for me...', 'If you are the eleventh...', 'Not his milch-cow...', 'Like a poisoned arrow...', 'Not rain...', 'Shaker of the unshakeable...', 'These divine armies...'

sanskrit_iast: gandhāribhyaḥ sarveṣāṃ ca krimīṇāṃ tatas tatāmahāḥ prajāpate śreṣṭhenāśvinā brahmaṇāgne svāhā ghṛtād ulluptaṃ tārṣṭāghīr ayaṃ lokaḥ kṛtyākrtaṃ valaginam ||
meaning: गन्धारिभ्यः सर्वेषां च क्रिमीणां ततस् ततामहाः प्रजापते श्रेष्ठेनाश्विना ब्रह्मणाग्ने स्वाहा घृताद् उल्लुप्तं तार्ष्टाघीर् अयं लोकः कृत्याक्र्तं वलगिनम् ॥
text_mt: 'From the Gandhāris...', 'And of all worms...', 'Father, grandfather...', 'O Prajāpati...', 'With the best...', 'O Aśvins...', 'By sacred lore, O Agni, svāhā...', 'Plucked from ghee...', 'Tārṣṭāghī...', 'This world...', 'Sorcery-maker, hidden charm...'

sanskrit_iast: dive cakṣuṣe ayaṃ nas triṃśad dhāma mā no hāsiṣur yat kiṃ cedam ahaṃ jajāna yāvadaṅgīnaṃ yas te 'ṅkuśas tānūṣ ṭe vājinn āñjanasya dvādaśadhā
meaning: दिवे चक्षुषे अयं नस् त्रिंशद् धाम मा नो हासिषुर् यत् किं चेदम् अहं जजान यावदङ्गीनं यस् ते ऽङ्कुशस् तानूष् टे वाजिन्न् आञ्जनस्य द्वादशधा
text_mt: 'To heaven...', 'To the eye...', 'This our...', 'Thirtyfold realm...', 'May they not abandon us...', 'Whatever this is...', 'I was born...', 'Pertaining to all limbs...', 'Which hook of yours...', 'Your bodies, O prize-winner...', 'Of the salve...', 'Twelvefold...'

sanskrit_iast: abhyañjanam akṣitās te yāvanto mā bradhnaḥ samīcīr yadi vāsi bṛhaspatir no yo naḥ śapāt sūyavasād yaṃ devā yathā śepo namaskṛtya marmāṇi te agneḥ śarīram
meaning: अभ्यञ्जनम् अक्षितास् ते यावन्तो मा ब्रध्नः समीचीर् यदि वासि बृहस्पतिर् नो यो नः शपात् सूयवसाद् यं देवा यथा शेपो नमस्कृत्य मर्माणि ते अग्नेः शरीरम्
text_mt: 'Ointment...', 'Inexhaustible to you...', 'As many as me...', 'Sun...', 'Facing together...', 'Or if you are...', 'Bṛhaspati our...', 'Whoever shall curse us...', 'From good pasture...', 'Whom the gods...', 'As the penis...', 'Having paid homage...', 'Your vital parts...', 'The body of Agni...'

sanskrit_iast: prati cakṣvāprajāstvam ito jaya yat pratyāhanti viṣam eva yās te śivā etaṃ vo yuvānaṃ jyotiṣmato lokān saṃ te śīrṣṇa indraṃ mitraṃ prabhrājamānām āre abhūd
meaning: प्रति चक्ष्वाप्रजास्त्वम् इतो जय यत् प्रत्याहन्ति विषम् एव यास् ते शिवा एतं वो युवानं ज्योतिष्मतो लोकान् सं ते शीर्ष्ण इन्द्रं मित्रं प्रभ्राजमानाम् आरे अभूद्
text_mt: 'Prati cakṣvāprajāstvam', 'Ito jaya', '[yat pratyāhanti]', 'Viṣam eva', 'Yās te śivāḥ', 'Etaṃ vo yuvānam', 'Jyotiṣmato lokān', 'Saṃ te śīrṣṇaḥ', 'Indraṃ mitram', 'Prabhrājamānām', 'Āre abhūt',

sanskrit_iast: etam idhmam akāmo dhīro vaśāṃ devā namas te ghoṣiṇībhyaḥ prāṇa mā mad yan mātalī apsu stīmāsu yāṃ devā bhūme mātaḥ pratyañcam arkam ūrdhvāyai tvā yadi hutām
meaning: एतम् इध्मम् अकामो धीरो वशां देवा नमस् ते घोषिणीभ्यः प्राण मा मद् यन् मातली अप्सु स्तीमासु यां देवा भूमे मातः प्रत्यञ्चम् अर्कम् ऊर्ध्वायै त्वा यदि हुताम्
text_mt: 'Etam idhmam', 'Akāmo dhīraḥ', 'Vaśāṃ devāḥ', 'Namas te ghoṣiṇībhyaḥ', 'Prāṇa mā mat', 'Yan mātalī', 'Apsu stīmāsu', 'Yāṃ devāḥ', 'Bhūme mātaḥ', 'Pratyañcam arkam', 'Ūrdhvāyai tvā', 'Yadi hutām',

sanskrit_iast: sūrya enaṃ yo yajñasyābodhy agniḥ kṛṣṇāyāḥ putro annādyena yaśasā brahmāparaṃ pra budhyasvainaṃ śraddhā ahnā pratyaṃ śakvarī stha vasyobhūyāya ||
meaning: सूर्य एनं यो यज्ञस्याबोध्य् अग्निः कृष्णायाः पुत्रो अन्नाद्येन यशसा ब्रह्मापरं प्र बुध्यस्वैनं श्रद्धा अह्ना प्रत्यं शक्वरी स्थ वस्योभूयाय ॥
text_mt: 'Sūrya enam', 'Yo yajñasya', 'Abodhy agniḥ', 'Kṛṣṇāyāḥ putraḥ', 'Annādyena yaśasā', 'Brahmāparam', 'Pra budhyasvainam', 'Śraddhā ahnā', 'Pratyaṃ', 'Śakvarī stha', 'Vasyobhūyāya'.

sanskrit_iast: vratair bhṛgvaṅgiraḥproktair ānupūrvyād vidhānataḥ | upasanne guruḥ kuryād vratavid brahmacāriṇi ||
meaning: व्रतैर् भृग्वङ्गिरःप्रोक्तैर् आनुपूर्व्याद् विधानतः । उपसन्ने गुरुः कुर्याद् व्रतविद् ब्रह्मचारिणि ॥
text_mt: When the student approaches, the teacher who knows the observances should perform [them] / through the observances taught by the Bhṛgus and Aṅgirases, in order, according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast: grāmād yathoktaṃ bāhyena sthaṇḍile 'gniṃ praṇīya tu | nityenopasamādhāya saṃskṛtya juhuyādd haviḥ ||
meaning: ग्रामाद् यथोक्तं बाह्येन स्थण्डिले ऽग्निं प्रणीय तु । नित्येनोपसमाधाय संस्कृत्य जुहुयाद्द् हविः ॥
text_mt: Having brought the fire outside the village as prescribed, upon a cleared spot of ground, / having laid it around with the regular [prayers], and having consecrated it, he should offer the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: aupagavyā vyāhṛtayaḥ sāvitrī śāntir eva ca | vrātapatyaḥ samāsau ca tanmantrāṃhomucaiḥ saha ||
meaning: औपगव्या व्याहृतयः सावित्री शान्तिर् एव च । व्रातपत्यः समासौ च तन्मन्त्रांहोमुचैः सह ॥
text_mt: The Aupagavī [verses], the sacred utterances, the Sāvitrī, and the Śānti, / the Vrātapatya [mantras] and the two Samāsa [hymns], along with those mantras that release from distress,

sanskrit_iast: kūṣmāṇḍyaḥ kāmasūktaṃ ca brahmavatyo 'tha devatāḥ | vratādeśe tathotsarge homaḥ kṣīrodanaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning: कूष्माण्ड्यः कामसूक्तं च ब्रह्मवत्यो ऽथ देवताः । व्रतादेशे तथोत्सर्गे होमः क्षीरोदनः स्मृतः ॥
text_mt: the Kūṣmāṇḍa [hymns], the desire hymn, and the deities accompanied by the Brahman: / at the instruction in the observance and likewise at its conclusion, the oblation is traditionally taught to be milk-rice.

sanskrit_iast: utsarge kāmasūktaṃ ca pūrvāṃ cāhutim uddharet | nivedya vrātapatyo 'nte idāvatsara eva ca ||
meaning: उत्सर्गे कामसूक्तं च पूर्वां चाहुतिम् उद्धरेत् । निवेद्य व्रातपत्यो ऽन्ते इदावत्सर एव च ॥
text_mt: At the conclusion, he should offer the desire hymn and the first oblation, / and having presented it, the Vrātapatya [mantras] at the end, and the Idāvatsara.

sanskrit_iast: āvartanāntaṃ sāmānyaṃ vyāhṛtyādy ubhayor api | etat sāmāsikaṃ proktam ādeśoddīkṣaṇaṃ budhaiḥ ||
meaning: आवर्तनान्तं सामान्यं व्याहृत्याद्य् उभयोर् अपि । एतत् सामासिकं प्रोक्तम् आदेशोद्दीक्षणं बुधैः ॥
text_mt: Up to the Āvartana is common, beginning with the sacred utterances for both; / this is proclaimed in summary by the wise as the initiation into the observance and the release.

sanskrit_iast: vrateṣu dakṣiṇā dhenuḥ kalyāṇī taruṇī ca yā | anaḍvān vā dhuraṃdharas tatsamaṃ vāpi kāñcanam ||
meaning: व्रतेषु दक्षिणा धेनुः कल्याणी तरुणी च या । अनड्वान् वा धुरंधरस् तत्समं वापि काञ्चनम् ॥
text_mt: At the observances, the sacrificial fee is a cow that is auspicious and young, / or an ox that bears the yoke, or else gold equal to that.

sanskrit_iast: sāvitryā atha vedasya kalpānāṃ tadanantaram | mailaṃ mailottaraṃ caiva ṣaṣṭhaṃ saṃmitam ucyate ||
meaning: सावित्र्या अथ वेदस्य कल्पानां तदनन्तरम् । मैलं मैलोत्तरं चैव षष्ठं संमितम् उच्यते ॥
text_mt: [The observance] of the Sāvitrī, then of the Veda, immediately after that of the Kalpas, / the Maila, the Mailottara, and the sixth is called the Saṃmita.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍvrataṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vidyāt trivrataṃ kṣatriyaṃ viduḥ | dvivratas tu bhaved vaiśya etad ācāryaśāsanam ||
meaning: षड्व्रतं ब्राह्मणं विद्यात् त्रिव्रतं क्षत्रियं विदुः । द्विव्रतस् तु भवेद् वैश्य एतद् आचार्यशासनम् ॥
text_mt: One should know the brāhmaṇa as having six observances; they know the kṣatriya as having three observances; / but the vaiśya should have two observances: this is the instruction of the teachers.

sanskrit_iast: viṣāsahiṃ sahamānam agnir mā goptā o cit sakhāyam ita eta udāruhan dhanur hastād etad ā roha candramā apsv iti ||
meaning: विषासहिं सहमानम् अग्निर् मा गोप्ता ओ चित् सखायम् इत एत उदारुहन् धनुर् हस्ताद् एतद् आ रोह चन्द्रमा अप्स्व् इति ॥
text_mt: 'Viṣāsahiṃ sahamānam', 'Agnir mā goptā', 'O cit sakhāyam', 'Ita eta udāruhan', 'Dhanur hastāt', 'Etad ā roha', 'Candramā apsu'.

sanskrit_iast: om āṅgirasānām ādyaiḥ pañcānuvākaiḥ svāhā ||
meaning: ओम् आङ्गिरसानाम् आद्यैः पञ्चानुवाकैः स्वाहा ॥

sanskrit_iast: brahmaṇe svāhā ||

meaning: ब्रह्मज्येष्ठा संभृता वीर्याणि ब्रह्माग्रे ज्येष्ठं दिवम् आ ततान । भूतानां ब्रह्मा प्रथमो ऽथ जज्ञे तेनार्हति ब्रह्मणा स्पर्धितुं कः ॥
text_mt: With Brahman as first, heroic powers were gathered together; Brahman first stretched out the highest sky; / Brahman was born as the first of beings: who can vie with that Brahman?

sanskrit_iast: ātharvaṇānāṃ caturṛcebhyaḥ svāhā ||

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭādaśarcebhyaḥ svāhā ||

text_mt: To the eighteen-verse [hymns], svāhā!

sanskrit_iast: ekanaviṃśarcebhyaḥ svāhā ||

sanskrit_iast: brahmaṇe svāhā ||

sanskrit_iast: brahmajyeṣṭhā saṃbhṛtā vīryāṇi brahmāgre jyeṣṭhaṃ divam ā tatāna | bhūtānāṃ brahmā prathamo 'tha jajñe tenārhati brahmanā spardhituṃ ka iti ||
meaning: ब्रह्मज्येष्ठा संभृता वीर्याणि ब्रह्माग्रे ज्येष्ठं दिवम् आ ततान । भूतानां ब्रह्मा प्रथमो ऽथ जज्ञे तेनार्हति ब्रह्मना स्पर्धितुं क इति ॥
text_mt: "With Brahman as the eldest, heroic powers were gathered; Brahman as the eldest spread out the sky in the beginning. / Brahman was born as the first among beings; by that Brahman, who can contend [with him]?"

sanskrit_iast: oṃ varṇān pūrvaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ prākṛtā ye ca vaikṛtāḥ | śrutinirvacanāt sarve vivadante vivṛttiṣu ||
meaning: ओं वर्णान् पूर्वं व्याख्यास्यामः प्राकृता ये च वैकृताः । श्रुतिनिर्वचनात् सर्वे विवदन्ते विवृत्तिषु ॥
text_mt: Om. First we shall explain the phonemes, both primary and secondary; based on the phonetic analysis of the Veda, all debate during pause [or hiatus].

sanskrit_iast: vṛttiḥ karaṇaṃ varṇānāṃ karṇayos tu śrutir yathā | śrutipradeśād vimatas tad yathā varṇa ucyate ||
meaning: वृत्तिः करणं वर्णानां कर्णयोस् तु श्रुतिर् यथा । श्रुतिप्रदेशाद् विमतस् तद् यथा वर्ण उच्यते ॥
text_mt: The production [of sound] is the articulation of phonemes, just as audition belongs to the two ears; because of a discrepancy with the place of audition, thus a phoneme is spoken of.

sanskrit_iast: samānasaṃdhyakṣarāṇi sparśā antaḥsthā ūṣmāṇaḥ | etair anye na dṛśyante etāvān varṇasaṃcayaḥ ||
meaning: समानसंध्यक्षराणि स्पर्शा अन्तःस्था ऊष्माणः । एतैर् अन्ये न दृश्यन्ते एतावान् वर्णसंचयः ॥
text_mt: Monophthongs, diphthongs, stops, semivowels, and sibilants: none are seen other than these; such is the collection of phonemes.

sanskrit_iast: yeṣāṃ ca śrutisaṃhitāyāṃ vibhāge asadṛśī syāt || tān eva varnān virudrādaye ca pradise kṛtaḥ ||
meaning: येषां च श्रुतिसंहितायां विभागे असदृशी स्यात् ॥ तान् एव वर्नान् विरुद्रादये च प्रदिसे कृतः ॥
text_mt: [And for those where it is dissimilar in the division of the Saṃhitā text of the Veda, for those very phonemes an instruction is made [...].]

sanskrit_iast: ye varṇābhyāṃ śrūyante ca yeṣāṃ nāsti vibhāgataḥ | mānasāṃś cāpi saṃgrāhyān upadeśena vartayet ||
meaning: ये वर्णाभ्यां श्रूयन्ते च येषां नास्ति विभागतः । मानसांश् चापि संग्राह्यान् उपदेशेन वर्तयेत् ॥
text_mt: And those which are heard through two phonemes, and those which lack division, as well as mental ones to be grasped, one should operate according to instruction.

sanskrit_iast: krāntān bahir nidhānasya yamāṃś cānanunāsikān | savyākṣepaṃ tato varṇān upadeśena vartayet ||
meaning: क्रान्तान् बहिर् निधानस्य यमांश् चाननुनासिकान् । सव्याक्षेपं ततो वर्णान् उपदेशेन वर्तयेत् ॥
text_mt: Having passed beyond the outer [boundary] of the hold, the non-nasal twin-sounds, and then the phonemes with leftward deflection, one should operate according to instruction.

sanskrit_iast: iti varṇāḥ svarāḥ proktās teṣām ādyāś caturdaśa | samānākṣarāṇy ucyante śeṣaḥ saṃdhyakṣarāṇi tu ||
meaning: इति वर्णाः स्वराः प्रोक्तास् तेषाम् आद्याश् चतुर्दश । समानाक्षराण्य् उच्यन्ते शेषः संध्यक्षराणि तु ॥
text_mt: Thus the phonemes are declared to be vowels; among them the first fourteen are called simple vowels, while the rest are diphthongs.

sanskrit_iast: anavarṇasvaro nāmi kādayo vyañjanaṃ smṛtam | pañcaviṃśatir ādyaiṣāṃ sparśā vargāś ca pañcakāḥ ||
meaning: अनवर्णस्वरो नामि कादयो व्यञ्जनं स्मृतम् । पञ्चविंशतिर् आद्यैषां स्पर्शा वर्गाश् च पञ्चकाः ॥
text_mt: A vowel other than the a-phoneme is [called] nāmin; the consonants are traditionally taught beginning with k; the first twenty-five of them are stops, and [they comprise] five classes.

sanskrit_iast: catvāro yādayo 'ntaḥsthāḥ śādir ūṣmāṣṭako gaṇaḥ | ayogavāhā vartante teṣām ādyāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ ||
meaning: चत्वारो यादयो ऽन्तःस्थाः शादिर् ऊष्माष्टको गणः । अयोगवाहा वर्तन्ते तेषाम् आद्याः पृथग्विधाः ॥
text_mt: The four beginning with y are semivowels; the group of eight beginning with ś is the sibilants. There exist ayogavāhas, the first varieties of which are distinct:

sanskrit_iast: visarjanīyo 'nusvāro jigvāmūlīya ity adhaḥ | upadhmānīya ity ete catvāro 'tha pare yamāḥ ||
meaning: विसर्जनीयो ऽनुस्वारो जिग्वामूलीय इत्य् अधः । उपध्मानीय इत्य् एते चत्वारो ऽथ परे यमाः ॥
text_mt: Visarjanīya, anusvāra, the jihvāmūlīya [below], and the upadhmānīya: these are four; then the next are the yamas,

sanskrit_iast: nāsikyābhinidhānau ca vidyate yena pūraṇam | pañcaṣaṣṭir iyān vāco rāśir yo vedalokayoḥ ||
meaning: नासिक्याभिनिधानौ च विद्यते येन पूरणम् । पञ्चषष्टिर् इयान् वाचो राशिर् यो वेदलोकयोः ॥
text_mt: and the nāsikya and abhinidhāna, by which the full complement is found. Such is the totality of sixty-five speech-sounds in the Veda and in the worldly [language].

sanskrit_iast: mukhanāsike ye varṇā ucyante te 'nunāsikāḥ | samānāsyaprayatnā ye te savarṇā iti smṛtāḥ ||
meaning: मुखनासिके ये वर्णा उच्यन्ते ते ऽनुनासिकाः । समानास्यप्रयत्ना ये ते सवर्णा इति स्मृताः ॥
text_mt: Those phonemes that are uttered with both mouth and nose are nasal; those that have the same oral effort [and place] are traditionally termed homorganic.

sanskrit_iast: hrasvo 'varṇaparas tasya savarṇasya ca vācakaḥ | hrasvottaras tu dīrgho 'pi tasmāt tasmāt tasyaiva vācakaḥ ||
meaning: ह्रस्वो ऽवर्णपरस् तस्य सवर्णस्य च वाचकः । ह्रस्वोत्तरस् तु दीर्घो ऽपि तस्मात् तस्मात् तस्यैव वाचकः ॥
text_mt: A short [vowel] followed by the a-phoneme designates its homorganic [vowel]; and also a long [vowel] following a short one designates that very same [vowel] alone.

sanskrit_iast: vargāntaras tu vargādir vargasya grāhako mataḥ | vargāṇāṃ ca yathāsaṃkhyaṃ prathamāditvam iṣyate ||
meaning: वर्गान्तरस् तु वर्गादिर् वर्गस्य ग्राहको मतः । वर्गाणां च यथासंख्यं प्रथमादित्वम् इष्यते ॥
text_mt: The first of a class, however, among other classes, is considered to denote the class; and the ordinal sequence beginning with the first is prescribed for the classes.

sanskrit_iast: akāreṇocyate 'tas tu kāro yasmāt paro bhavet | tasya tad grahaṇaṃ bodhyaṃ kakāro 'tra nidarśanam ||
meaning: अकारेणोच्यते ऽतस् तु कारो यस्मात् परो भवेत् । तस्य तद् ग्रहणं बोध्यं ककारो ऽत्र निदर्शनम् ॥
text_mt: It is denoted with the sound a; and that sound following which kāra stands, its grasping is to be understood from that; the sound k (kakāra) is an example here.

sanskrit_iast: vyañjanaṃ ghoṣavatsaṃjñam antaḥsthā haḥ parau yamau | trayastrayaś ca vargāntyā agoṣaḥ śeṣa ucyate ||
meaning: व्यञ्जनं घोषवत्संज्ञम् अन्तःस्था हः परौ यमौ । त्रयस्त्रयश् च वर्गान्त्या अगोषः शेष उच्यते ॥
text_mt: The consonants termed voiced are the semivowels, h, the following two yamas, and three each of the class-finals; the remainder is declared unvoiced.

sanskrit_iast: śaṣasāś ca yamau dvau ca dvitīyāḥ prathamāś ca ye | aghoṣā vyañjanaśeṣaṃ ghoṣavad dṛśyate budhaiḥ ||
meaning: शषसाश् च यमौ द्वौ च द्वितीयाः प्रथमाश् च ये । अघोषा व्यञ्जनशेषं घोषवद् दृश्यते बुधैः ॥
text_mt: ś, ṣ, s, two yamas, and the second and first [class consonants] are unvoiced; the remainder of the consonants is viewed as voiced by the learned.

sanskrit_iast: ataḥ sthānāni varṇānāṃ kaṇṭho 'varṇahakārayoḥ | vosarjanīya ai au ca svādyayor mātrayoḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning: अतः स्थानानि वर्णानां कण्ठो ऽवर्णहकारयोः । वोसर्जनीय ऐ औ च स्वाद्ययोर् मात्रयोः स्मृतः ॥
text_mt: Now the places of articulation of the phonemes: the throat is [the place] of the a-phoneme and the sound h, the visarjanīya, and ai and au for their initial morae, as taught.

sanskrit_iast: śeṣas tālvoṣṭhayor bodhyaḥ sa yathāsaṃkhyam iṣyate | dvisthānaṃ yamayoś cāpi vargāntyānāṃ ca śiṣyate ||
meaning: शेषस् ताल्वोष्ठयोर् बोध्यः स यथासंख्यम् इष्यते । द्विस्थानं यमयोश् चापि वर्गान्त्यानां च शिष्यते ॥
text_mt: The rest is to be understood as palate and lips, prescribed respectively. A dual place of articulation remains for the two yamas and the class-finals.

sanskrit_iast: jihvāmūlām ṛvarṇasya kavargasya ca bhāṣyate | yaś caiva jihvāmūlīya ceti ca smṛtaḥ ||
meaning: जिह्वामूलाम् ऋवर्णस्य कवर्गस्य च भाष्यते । यश् चैव जिह्वामूलीय चेति च स्मृतः ॥
text_mt: The root of the tongue is stated for the ṛ-phoneme and the k-class, and also what is the jihvāmūlīya; and the ḷ-phoneme is traditionally taught likewise.

sanskrit_iast: tālv eyaśacavargāṇām ivarṇasya ca bhāṣyate | mūrdhā sthānaṃ ṣakārasya ṭavargasya tathā mataḥ ||
meaning: ताल्व् एयशचवर्गाणाम् इवर्णस्य च भाष्यते । मूर्धा स्थानं षकारस्य टवर्गस्य तथा मतः ॥
text_mt: The palate is stated for e, y, ś, the c-class, and the i-phoneme. The roof of the mouth is regarded as the place of the sound ṣ and likewise of the ṭ-class.

sanskrit_iast: dantā lasatavargāṇām uvarṇas tv oṣṭhya ucyate | upadhmānīya okāro vaḥ pavargaś ca tathā matāḥ ||
meaning: दन्ता लसतवर्गाणाम् उवर्णस् त्व् ओष्ठ्य उच्यते । उपध्मानीय ओकारो वः पवर्गश् च तथा मताः ॥
text_mt: The teeth are [the place] of l, s, and the t-class; but the u-phoneme is called labial. The upadhmānīya, the sound o, v, and the p-class are likewise regarded [as labial].

sanskrit_iast: nāsikye nāsikā sthānaṃ tathānusvāra iṣyate | yamā vargottamāś cāpi yathoktaṃ caiva te matāḥ ||
meaning: नासिक्ये नासिका स्थानं तथानुस्वार इष्यते । यमा वर्गोत्तमाश् चापि यथोक्तं चैव ते मताः ॥
text_mt: For the nāsikya, the nose is the place, and so it is desired for the anusvāra; the yamas and the class-finals are also considered just as stated.

sanskrit_iast: rephasya dantamūlāni pratyag vā tebhya iṣyate | iti sthānāni varṇānāṃ kīrtitāni yathākramam ||
meaning: रेफस्य दन्तमूलानि प्रत्यग् वा तेभ्य इष्यते । इति स्थानानि वर्णानां कीर्तितानि यथाक्रमम् ॥
text_mt: For the sound r, the roots of the teeth or [the place] behind them is desired. Thus the places of articulation of the phonemes have been proclaimed in order.

sanskrit_iast: apara āha | hanumūle tu rephaḥ syād dantamūleṣu vā punaḥ | pratyag vā dantamūlebhyo mūrdhanya iti cāpare ||
meaning: अपर आह । हनुमूले तु रेफः स्याद् दन्तमूलेषु वा पुनः । प्रत्यग् वा दन्तमूलेभ्यो मूर्धन्य इति चापरे ॥
text_mt: Another says: "The sound r is at the root of the jaw, or at the roots of the teeth, or behind the roots of the teeth; and others [say] retroflex."

sanskrit_iast: uraḥstho ghoṣo visṛṣṭaḥ kaṇṭhadeśe nihanyate | tato nādo vitiṣṭhate tasya vikṛtir akṣaram ||
meaning: उरःस्थो घोषो विसृष्टः कण्ठदेशे निहन्यते । ततो नादो वितिष्ठते तस्य विकृतिर् अक्षरम् ॥
text_mt: The chest-residing voice, being emitted, strikes in the throat region; from that resonance arises; its modification is the syllable.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvābhir aṇumātrābhiḥ kaṇṭhyaṃ saṃsevyate 'kṣaram | uttarābhis tu mātrābhir mukhavikṛtir ucyate ||
meaning: पूर्वाभिर् अणुमात्राभिः कण्ठ्यं संसेव्यते ऽक्षरम् । उत्तराभिस् तु मात्राभिर् मुखविकृतिर् उच्यते ॥
text_mt: By the preceding minimal morae the guttural syllable is produced; but by the subsequent morae oral modification is spoken of.

sanskrit_iast: api prayogasya hetoḥ saṃyogaḥ saha dhāryate | avyavahito 'kṣareṇa nānāvarṇaḥ svarodayaḥ ||
meaning: अपि प्रयोगस्य हेतोः संयोगः सह धार्यते । अव्यवहितो ऽक्षरेण नानावर्णः स्वरोदयः ॥
text_mt: Also, for the sake of actual pronunciation, combination is held together: the non-intervened emergence of vowels of various phonemes with a syllable.

sanskrit_iast: dvitīyeṣu tathoṣmaṇāṃ tṛtīyeṣu ca ghoṣāṇām | caturtheṣu ghoṣoṣmaṇām upadeśena vartayet ||
meaning: द्वितीयेषु तथोष्मणां तृतीयेषु च घोषाणाम् । चतुर्थेषु घोषोष्मणाम् उपदेशेन वर्तयेत् ॥
text_mt: In the second [class-letters], one should operate according to instruction as having aspiration; in the third, as having voice; in the fourth, as having voice and aspiration.

sanskrit_iast: uttameṣu tu nāsikyam antaḥstheṣu ghoṣaṃ smṛtam | hakārasya ghoṣoṣmāṇāv upadeśena vartayet ||
meaning: उत्तमेषु तु नासिक्यम् अन्तःस्थेषु घोषं स्मृतम् । हकारस्य घोषोष्माणाव् उपदेशेन वर्तयेत् ॥
text_mt: In the finals [nasality] is traditionally taught as nasal, and in the semivowels as voice; one should operate according to instruction as having voice and aspiration for the sound h.

sanskrit_iast: ṛkārākṣarayo repham aṇumātra sarva … | svaritasya dvaidhībhāve upadeśena vartayet ||
meaning: ऋकाराक्षरयो रेफम् अणुमात्र सर्व … । स्वरितस्य द्वैधीभावे उपदेशेन वर्तयेत् ॥
text_mt: In the syllables with the sound ṛ, the sound r is an atomic mora [...] in the splitting of the circumflex (svarita) accent, one should operate according to instruction.

sanskrit_iast: ṛvarṇadeśasaṃdeho 'svaraḥ syāt syād anantaram | paro vā yadi vā pūrvo repham eva tu viddhi tam ||
meaning: ऋवर्णदेशसंदेहो ऽस्वरः स्यात् स्याद् अनन्तरम् । परो वा यदि वा पूर्वो रेफम् एव तु विद्धि तम् ॥
text_mt: Where there is doubt regarding the place of the ṛ-phoneme, whether the vowel is immediate, following or preceding, know it to be just the sound r.

sanskrit_iast: akāraś ca ikāraś ca ukāra ṛkāra eva ca | hrasvadīrghaplutāḥ sarve nāsti dīrghatā ||
meaning: अकारश् च इकारश् च उकार ऋकार एव च । ह्रस्वदीर्घप्लुताः सर्वे नास्ति दीर्घता ॥
text_mt: The sounds a, i, u, and ṛ: all these are short, long, and protracted; in the ḷ-phoneme there is no length.

sanskrit_iast: ekāraś ca tathāikāra okāra aukāra eva ca | dīrghamātraplutās teṣāṃ saṃjjā saṃdhyakṣarāṇi ca ||
meaning: एकारश् च तथाइकार ओकार औकार एव च । दीर्घमात्रप्लुतास् तेषां संज्जा संध्यक्षराणि च ॥
text_mt: And the sounds e, ai, o, and au: these consist of only long and protracted morae; their technical name is diphthongs.

sanskrit_iast: udāttaś cānudāttāś ca svaritāḥ kampitāś ca ye | anunāsikās tathā śuddhā dṛśyate hrasvatā budhaiḥ ||
meaning: उदात्तश् चानुदात्ताश् च स्वरिताः कम्पिताश् च ये । अनुनासिकास् तथा शुद्धा दृश्यते ह्रस्वता बुधैः ॥
text_mt: Acute (udātta), grave (anudātta), circumflex (svarita), and tremulous (kampita), nasal as well as pure: shortness is seen by the wise [in them].

sanskrit_iast: varṇāḥ pañcaṣaṣṭiḥ svarā dvāviṃśatiḥ samānākṣarāṇi caturdaśa aṣṭau saṃdhyakṣarāṇy ekonaviṃśatir nāminas tricatvāriṃśad vyañjanānisparśāḥ pañcaviṃśatiś catvāras tv antaḥsthāḥ catvāro yamāś cāṣṭāv ūṣmāṇo 'yogavāhā daśāyogavāhā daśa ||
meaning: वर्णाः पञ्चषष्टिः स्वरा द्वाविंशतिः समानाक्षराणि चतुर्दश अष्टौ संध्यक्षराण्य् एकोनविंशतिर् नामिनस् त्रिचत्वारिंशद् व्यञ्जनानिस्पर्शाः पञ्चविंशतिश् चत्वारस् त्व् अन्तःस्थाः चत्वारो यमाश् चाष्टाव् ऊष्माणो ऽयोगवाहा दशायोगवाहा दश ॥
text_mt: The phonemes are sixty-five: vowels twenty-two; simple vowels fourteen; diphthongs eight; nāmin vowels nineteen; consonants forty-three; stops twenty-five; semivowels four; yamas four; sibilants eight; ayogavāhas ten, ayogavāhas ten.

sanskrit_iast: om atharvaṇe namaḥ || | vaśmi | vaśmi | uśmasi | ava veti | vāñchati | veṣṭi | vanoti | juṣate | haryati | ācake | uśik | manyate | achāntsuḥ || chantsat | cākanat | cakamānaḥ | kanati
