saṃyogaḥ, saṃyogaḥ, āśuśukṣaṇiḥ, jahā, śitāma, mehanā, mūṣaḥ, mandū, īrmāntāsaḥ, [vājarāndhyam], kāyamānaḥ, vidradhe, tugvani, [nodhāt, nadaḥ], cyavanaḥ, kaśyapaḥ, nū cit, akūpārasya, aprāyuvaḥ, rajaḥ, juhure, krāṇā, viṣuṇaḥ, jāmiḥ, jasuriḥ, cayase, andhaḥ, dugdham, āhanaḥ, nadaḥ, arkaḥ, sacā, cit, pavitram, pṛthujrayāḥ, kāṇukā, adhriguḥ, āṅgūṣaḥ, āpāntamanyuḥ, śmaśā, vājagandhyam, [jarādhya], pākasthāmā kaurayāṇaḥ, vrandī, niṣṣapī, kṣumpam, nicumpuṇaḥ, [majāyema, dhṛruḥ], joṣavākam, kuṭasya, kepayaḥ, salalūkam, askṛdhoyuḥ, niśṛmbhāḥ, [dhruvadrakṣam], upalaprakṣiṇī, upasi, savīmani, vidathāni, śrāyanta iva, amūraḥ, vijāmātuḥ, amavān, amīvā, amatiḥ, riśādasaḥ, ānuṣak, girvaṇāḥ, amyak, yādṛśmin, śurudhaḥ, apratiṣkutaḥ, dvibarhāḥ, urāṇaḥ, javāru, tatanuṣṭim, ilībiśaḥ, [irāviṇaḥ], kiyedhāḥ, turīpam, pratadvasū, diviṣṭiṣu, dūtaḥ, ṛcīṣamaḥ, anarśarātim, ||64 || anarvā, [anarvā, cāṇḍā, vālhā], jaḍhavaḥ, bakuraḥ, [vaktāraḥ], bekanāṭān, abhi dhetana, sadānve, parāśaraḥ, karūḍatī, danaḥ;

ikṣuṇā, kīlālam, vijāmni, doṣā, [aṣṭamartyaḥ], ||65 || jyeṣṭham, [jyeṣṭham, asipakva], viśvāhā, vivasavān, vāte, [tanyantaḥ, vrālma, kāmpīvakaṃsam, jasyatyam, jalālī], andhaḥ, vipaśyan, ayā ciṣṭhā, [āṃsā, rantu, tamāyīvayaḥ], śamopyāt, gulphaḥ, biṣkale khargalā, pratodaḥ, vedaḥ, [yatrāsmannataḥ, radhraḥ, cikriḥ, nuluḥ], pucchadhau, [suniḥ], apāṣṭhaḥ, medī, [jyenā], maryaḥ, [saptaghnetaḥ], vālini, yātāram, [ruṣaṃkiḥ, siktaḥ], sagaṇāḥ, [muḍimnānā, liṅgakāḥ, nādinā], malvaḥ, amnaḥ, [juguḥ], nīlāgalasālā, ailabaḥ, [daridraḥ], nīlalohitaḥ, śvāpadaḥ, kunakhī, kurīram, [upasaḥ], tāduri, [kamatha, rumathā, sarvartebhyaḥ, idam, adhvaryuḥ, dyumnī, kuvitaḥ, damnanā], duroṇe, [parektauti], titau, [utpavādhata], kimīdī, vāmasya, ekacakram, amatiḥ, sumatiḥ, [dayate, dayanti, vrīhi, vṛtte]; ||66 || īḍe, īḍe, kṣayati, tapati, rajati: these have multiple meanings.

prapitve, abhīke—[these are synonyms] of what has arrived.

tiraḥ, sataḥ—[these are synonyms] of what has not arrived.

ṛkṣāḥ, stṛbhiḥ—these are [synonyms] of the lunar mansions.

vamrībhiḥ, upajihvikā—[these are synonyms] of ants.

rambhaḥ, [rathaḥ], pinākam—these are [synonyms] of a staff.

śepaḥ, vaitasaḥ—these are [synonyms] of the male generative organ.

[paraṃgativilīke]—this is [a synonym] of the female generative organ.

maki, hvakir—these are [synonyms] of prohibition.

varūtham, [asagram]—[these are synonyms] of leather [armor], of lack of energy.

paṇiḥ, prakalavid—[these are synonyms] of a merchant.

śvaghnī—[a synonym] of a gambler, of a dice-cheat.

Agni, Jātavedas, Vaiśvānara, Draviṇodās, Vanaspati: these share in hymn-cycles.

Sacrificial fuel, [Viṣṇu], Tanūnapāt, Narāśaṃsa, the divine doors, Dawn and Night, the two divine Hotṛ priests, the three goddesses, Tvaṣṭṛ, the tree, the svāhā-invocations: these share in incidental mentions.

Indra, Viṣṇu, Soma, Parjanya, Ṛtu, Agnāyī, Pṛthivī, Iḍā, the Bhṛgus, the Atharvans: [these deities are] praised together with him in the singular, plural, and feminine.

Conveying <the oblations and summoning> the gods, and whatever pertains to the sphere of offerings, that is his function.

This terrestrial world, spring, the morning pressing, the gāyatrī metre, the ninefold chant, the rathaṃtara melody: these are of his division. ||67

sanskrit_iast: tatra catvāro vedā bhavanti | ṛgvedo yajurvedaḥ sāmavedo brahmavedaś ceti ||
meaning: तत्र चत्वारो वेदा भवन्ति । ऋग्वेदो यजुर्वेदः सामवेदो ब्रह्मवेदश् चेति ॥
text_mt:
Vāyu, Varuṇa, Indra, Rudra, Parjanya, Bṛhaspati, Brahmaṇaspati, Vāstoṣpati, Kṣetrasyapati, Ka, Yama, Apāṃ Napāt, Mitra, Viśvakarman, Manyu, Tārkṣya, Dadhikrāvan, Sarasvat, Agni, Asunīti, Vāja, Kuta, Vāta, Ṛta, Mṛtyu, Dhātṛ, Vidhātṛ, Purūravas, the Gandharvas, the draft-ox, the vital breaths, Skambha, the Vrātya: these share in hymn-cycles.

Prajāpati, Candramas, Soma, Indu, Aditi, the milk-cows, Ahi Budhnya: these share in incidental mentions.

Sarasvatī, Vāc, Aditi, Urvaśī, Gauḥ, Dhenu, Saramā, Uṣas, Indrāṇī, Pṛthivī, Dasyā, Godhukasā, Virāj, Aghnyā, Sinīvālī, Kuhū, Anumati, Rākā, Yamī, Saraṇyū, Pathyā, Rodasī, the wives of the gods, the Maruts, the Rudras, the Ṛbhus, the Aṅgirases, the Bhṛgus, the Atharvans: [these deities are] praised together with him in the singular, plural, and feminine.

Bestowal of moisture, slaying of Vṛtra, and whatever act of strength there is, that is his function.

The intermediate world, summer, the midday pressing, the triṣṭubh metre, the fifteenfold chant, the bṛhat melody: these are of his division. ||68

Āditya, Savitṛ, Bhaga, Sūrya, Pūṣan, Viṣṇu, Keśin, Viśvānara, Vṛṣākapi, Kāla, the Vedic student, Rohita: these share in hymn-cycles.

Dadhyañc, Atharvan, Yama, Aja Ekapād, Manu, Vivasvat, Dakṣa, Aryaman, Vaiśvānara, and Suparṇa share incidental mentions.

Uṣas, Sūryā, Vṛṣākapāyī, the Sādhyas, the Vasus, the Ādityas, the Seven Ṛṣis, the Vājins, and the Viśve Devas are lauded together with him, [addressed] in the singular, the plural, and the feminine.

Drawing up moisture with rays, maintaining moisture, and whatever is enigmatic—that is the function [of the sun].

His realm, the rainy season, the third pressing, the jagatī metre, the seventeenfold stoma, and the vairūpa sāman are his subordinate parts.

Of these very worlds, seasons, metres, stomas, and pṛṣṭhas, in regular order, the remainder of subordinate distribution is an alternative rule.

And in a pair of deities, the latter is praised together with the former; the latter is praised together with the former.

Om. Now, therefore, we shall explain the Caraṇavyūha (Arrangement of Vedic Schools).

In that regard, there are four Vedas: the Ṛgveda, the Yajurveda, the Sāmaveda, and the Brahmaveda.

sanskrit_iast: tatra ṛgvedasyārthaśāstram upavedaḥ | yajurvedasya dhanurvedopavedaḥ | sāmavedasya gāndharvavedopavedaḥ | brahmavedasyāyurvedopavedaḥ | abhicārakārthaśāstram ity ucyate ||
meaning: तत्र ऋग्वेदस्यार्थशास्त्रम् उपवेदः । यजुर्वेदस्य धनुर्वेदोपवेदः । सामवेदस्य गान्धर्ववेदोपवेदः । ब्रह्मवेदस्यायुर्वेदोपवेदः । अभिचारकार्थशास्त्रम् इत्य् उच्यते ॥
text_mt: Herein, the Arthaśāstra is the secondary Veda of the Ṛgveda; the Dhanurveda is the secondary Veda of the Yajurveda; the Gāndharvaveda is the secondary Veda of the Sāmaveda; and the Āyurveda is the secondary Veda of the Brahmaveda, [which] is called the manual of sorcery and statecraft.

sanskrit_iast: ṛgveda ātreyasagotro 'gnir devatā | yajurvedaḥ kāśyapasagotro vāyur devatā | sāmavedo bhāradvājasagotro viṣṇur devatā | brahmavedo vaitāyanasagotro brahmā devatā ||
meaning: ऋग्वेद आत्रेयसगोत्रो ऽग्निर् देवता । यजुर्वेदः काश्यपसगोत्रो वायुर् देवता । सामवेदो भारद्वाजसगोत्रो विष्णुर् देवता । ब्रह्मवेदो वैतायनसगोत्रो ब्रह्मा देवता ॥
text_mt: The Ṛgveda belongs to the Ātreya gotra and has Agni as its deity. The Yajurveda belongs to the Kāśyapa gotra and has Vāyu as its deity. The Sāmaveda belongs to the Bhāradvāja gotra and has Viṣṇu as its deity. The Brahmaveda belongs to the Vaitāyana gotra and has Brahmā as its deity.

sanskrit_iast: athāta ṛgvedaḥ pītavarṇaḥ padmapattrākṣaḥ suvibhaktagrīvaḥ kuñcitakeśaśmaśruḥ supratiṣṭhitajānujaṅghaḥ | pramāṇena sa vitastayaḥ pañca ||
meaning: अथात ऋग्वेदः पीतवर्णः पद्मपत्त्राक्षः सुविभक्तग्रीवः कुञ्चितकेशश्मश्रुः सुप्रतिष्ठितजानुजङ्घः । प्रमाणेन स वितस्तयः पञ्च ॥
text_mt: Now, the Ṛgveda is yellow in colour, has eyes like lotus petals, a well-proportioned neck, curly hair and beard, and firmly established knees and shanks; in measure it is five spans.

sanskrit_iast: tatra ṛgvedasya sapta śākhā bhavanti | tad yathā | āśvalāyanāḥ | śāṅkhāyanāḥ | sādhyāyanāḥ | śākalāḥ | bāṣkalāḥ | audumbarāḥ | māṇḍūkāś ceti ||
meaning: तत्र ऋग्वेदस्य सप्त शाखा भवन्ति । तद् यथा । आश्वलायनाः । शाङ्खायनाः । साध्यायनाः । शाकलाः । बाष्कलाः । औदुम्बराः । माण्डूकाश् चेति ॥
text_mt: There are seven branches of the Ṛgveda, namely: the Āśvalāyanas, Śāṅkhāyanas, Sādhyāyanas, Śākalas, Bāṣkalas, Audumbaras, and Māṇḍūkas.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām adhyayanam | ṛcāṃ daśa sahasrāṇi ṛcāṃ pañca śatāni ca | ṛcām aśītiḥ pādaś ca etat pāraṇam ucyate ||
meaning: तेषाम् अध्ययनम् । ऋचां दश सहस्राणि ऋचां पञ्च शतानि च । ऋचाम् अशीतिः पादश् च एतत् पारणम् उच्यते ॥
text_mt: Their text for recitation: / Ten thousand verses, and five hundred verses, / eighty verses, and a quarter-verse—this is declared to be the complete text.

sanskrit_iast: tatra yajurvedasya caturviṃśatir bhedā bhavanti || tad yathā | kāṇvāḥ | mādhyaṃdināḥ | jābālāḥ | śāpeyāḥ | śvetāḥ | śvetatarāḥ | tāmrāyaṇīyāḥ | paurṇavatsāḥ | āvaṭikāḥ | paramāvaṭikāḥ | hauṣyāḥ | dhauṣyāḥ | khāḍikāḥ | āhvarakāḥ | carakāḥ maitrāḥ | maitrāyaṇīyāḥ | hāritakarṇāḥ | śālāyanīyāḥ | marcakaṭhāḥ | prācyakaṭhāḥ | kapiṣṭhalakaṭhāḥ | upalāḥ | taittirīyāś ceti ||
meaning: तत्र यजुर्वेदस्य चतुर्विंशतिर् भेदा भवन्ति ॥ तद् यथा । काण्वाः । माध्यंदिनाः । जाबालाः । शापेयाः । श्वेताः । श्वेततराः । ताम्रायणीयाः । पौर्णवत्साः । आवटिकाः । परमावटिकाः । हौष्याः । धौष्याः । खाडिकाः । आह्वरकाः । चरकाः मैत्राः । मैत्रायणीयाः । हारितकर्णाः । शालायनीयाः । मर्चकठाः । प्राच्यकठाः । कपिष्ठलकठाः । उपलाः । तैत्तिरीयाश् चेति ॥
text_mt: There are twenty-four divisions of the Yajurveda, namely: the Kāṇvas, Mādhyaṃdinas, Jābālas, Śāpeyas, Śvetas, Śvetataras, Tāmrāyaṇīyas, Paurṇavatsas, Āvaṭikas, Paramāvaṭikas, Hauṣyas, Dhauṣyas, Khāḍikas, Āhvarakas, Carakas, Maitras, Maitrāyaṇīyas, Hāritakarṇas, Śālāyanīyas, Marcakaṭhas, Prācyakaṭhas, Kapiṣṭhalakaṭhas, Upalas, and Taittirīyas.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām adhyayanam | dve sahasre śate nyūne vede vājasaneyake | sakalaṃ parisaṃkhyātaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tu caturguṇam ||
meaning: तेषाम् अध्ययनम् । द्वे सहस्रे शते न्यूने वेदे वाजसनेयके । सकलं परिसंख्यातं ब्राह्मणं तु चतुर्गुणम् ॥
text_mt: Their text for recitation: / In the Vājasaneyaka Veda, there are two thousand minus two hundred [verses] / completely enumerated, but the Brāhmaṇa is four times that.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭādaśa śatāni bhavanti | tāny eva triguṇam adhītya kramapāro bhavati | saptasu vīrāś ceti ||
meaning: अष्टादश शतानि भवन्ति । तान्य् एव त्रिगुणम् अधीत्य क्रमपारो भवति । सप्तसु वीराश् चेति ॥
text_mt: There are eighteen hundred [verses]. Having studied three times that number, one becomes a master of the krama step-recitation; and among the seven [branches there are] heroes.

sanskrit_iast: śākhās tisro bhavanti | tad yathā | vārcikam arthādhyayanīyāḥ | pāraścaryāḥ | pāraśramaṇīyāḥ | pārakramavaṭaḥ | kramapāraś ceti ||
meaning: शाखास् तिस्रो भवन्ति । तद् यथा । वार्चिकम् अर्थाध्ययनीयाः । पारश्चर्याः । पारश्रमणीयाः । पारक्रमवटः । क्रमपारश् चेति ॥
text_mt: There are three branches, namely: the Vārcika [division of] those studying the text together with meaning, the Pāraścaryas, the Pāraśramaṇīyas, the Pārakramavaṭa, and the master of the step-recitation.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍ aṅgāny adhītya ṣaḍaṅgavid bhavati | śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ chando jyotiṣam iti ṣaḍ aṅgāni ||
meaning: षड् अङ्गान्य् अधीत्य षडङ्गविद् भवति । शिक्षा कल्पो व्याकरणं निरुक्तं छन्दो ज्योतिषम् इति षड् अङ्गानि ॥
text_mt: Having studied the six auxiliary limbs, one becomes a knower of the six limbs. Phonetics, ritual manual, grammar, etymology, metre, and astronomy are the six auxiliary limbs.

sanskrit_iast: atha yajurvedaḥ prāṃśuḥ pralambajaṭharaḥ sthūlagalakapālo rakto varṇena prādeśāḥ ṣaḍ dīrghatvena yajurvedasyaitad rūpaṃ bhavati ||
meaning: अथ यजुर्वेदः प्रांशुः प्रलम्बजठरः स्थूलगलकपालो रक्तो वर्णेन प्रादेशाः षड् दीर्घत्वेन यजुर्वेदस्यैतद् रूपं भवति ॥
text_mt: Now the Yajurveda is tall, has a protruding belly, a thick neck and head, is red in colour, and is six spans in length; such is the bodily form of the Yajurveda.

sanskrit_iast: tatra sāmavedasya śākhāsahasram āsīd anadhyāyeṣv adhīyānāḥ sarve te śakreṇa vinihatāḥ | pravilīnās
meaning: तत्र सामवेदस्य शाखासहस्रम् आसीद् अनध्यायेष्व् अधीयानाः सर्वे ते शक्रेण विनिहताः । प्रविलीनास्
text_mt: There were a thousand branches of the Sāmaveda; while reciting on days forbidden for study, all of them were destroyed by Indra [and] dissolved away.

sanskrit_iast: tatra ke cid avaśiṣṭāḥ pracaranti | tad yathā | rāṇāyanīyāḥ | sādyamugrāḥ | kālapāḥ | mahākālapāḥ | kauthumāḥ | lāṅgalikāś ceti ||
meaning: तत्र के चिद् अवशिष्टाः प्रचरन्ति । तद् यथा । राणायनीयाः । साद्यमुग्राः । कालपाः । महाकालपाः । कौथुमाः । लाङ्गलिकाश् चेति ॥
text_mt: Of these, some remnants survive, namely: the Rāṇāyanīyas, Sādyamugras, Kālapas, Mahākālapas, Kauthumas, and Lāṅgalikas.

sanskrit_iast: kauthumānāṃ ṣaḍ bhedā bhavanti | tad yathā | sārāyaṇīyāḥ | vātarāyaṇīyāḥ | vaitadhṛtāḥ | prācīnās tejasāḥ | aniṣṭakāś ceti ||
meaning: कौथुमानां षड् भेदा भवन्ति । तद् यथा । सारायणीयाः । वातरायणीयाः । वैतधृताः । प्राचीनास् तेजसाः । अनिष्टकाश् चेति ॥
text_mt: There are six subdivisions of the Kauthumas, namely: the Sārāyaṇīyas, Vātarāyaṇīyas, Vaitadhṛtas, Prācīnas, Tejasas, and Aniṣṭakas.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām adhyayanam | aṣṭau sāmasahasrāṇi sāmāni ca caturdaśa | sohyāni sarahasyāni etat sāmagaṇaṃ smṛtam ||
meaning: तेषाम् अध्ययनम् । अष्टौ सामसहस्राणि सामानि च चतुर्दश । सोह्यानि सरहस्यानि एतत् सामगणं स्मृतम् ॥
text_mt: Their text for recitation: / Eight thousand sāmans, and fourteen sāmans, / together with the uhya and rahasya chants—this is handed down as the corpus of sāmans.

sanskrit_iast: atha sāmavedaḥ suvarcāḥ sugandhis tejasvī mṛduvaktā brahmaṇyaḥ pralambabāhur duścarmī kṛṣṇo varṇena kātaraḥ svareṇeti ||
meaning: अथ सामवेदः सुवर्चाः सुगन्धिस् तेजस्वी मृदुवक्ता ब्रह्मण्यः प्रलम्बबाहुर् दुश्चर्मी कृष्णो वर्णेन कातरः स्वरेणेति ॥
text_mt: Now the Sāmaveda has great radiance, is fragrant, energetic, gentle in speech, devoted to holy learning, has long arms, bad skin, is dark in colour, and timid in voice.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍaratniḥ pramāṇena ca smṛtaḥ | stuvanty ṛṣayo brahmā sāmāni tiṣṭhati saṃnidhau sa bhagavān sāmavedo maheśvarabhaktaḥ ||
meaning: षडरत्निः प्रमाणेन च स्मृतः । स्तुवन्त्य् ऋषयो ब्रह्मा सामानि तिष्ठति संनिधौ स भगवान् सामवेदो महेश्वरभक्तः ॥
text_mt: And in measure it is handed down as six cubits. The Ṛṣis praise it, Brahmā stands nearby along with the sāmans; that venerable Sāmaveda is devoted to Maheśvara.

sanskrit_iast: tatra brahmavedasya nava bhedā bhavanti | tad yathā | paippalādāḥ | staudāḥ | maudāḥ | śaunakīyāḥ | jājalāḥ | jaladāḥ | brahmavadāḥ | devadarśāḥ | cāraṇavaidyāś ceti |
meaning: तत्र ब्रह्मवेदस्य नव भेदा भवन्ति । तद् यथा । पैप्पलादाः । स्तौदाः । मौदाः । शौनकीयाः । जाजलाः । जलदाः । ब्रह्मवदाः । देवदर्शाः । चारणवैद्याश् चेति ।
text_mt: There are nine divisions of the Brahmaveda, namely: the Paippalādas, Staudas, Maudas, Śaunakīyas, Jājalas, Jaladas, Brahmavadas, Devadarśas, and Cāraṇavaidyas.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām adhyayanam | ṛcāṃ dvādaśa sahasrāṇy aśītis triśatāni ca | paryāyikaṃ dvisahasrāṇy anyāṃs caivārcikān bahūn ity
meaning: तेषाम् अध्ययनम् । ऋचां द्वादश सहस्राण्य् अशीतिस् त्रिशतानि च । पर्यायिकं द्विसहस्राण्य् अन्यांस् चैवार्चिकान् बहून् इत्य्
text_mt: Their text for recitation: / Twelve thousand verses, eighty, and three hundred; / two thousand related to the turns, and many other verses.

sanskrit_iast: etadgrāmyāraṇyakāni ṣaṭ sahasrāṇi bhavanti ||
meaning: एतद्ग्राम्यारण्यकानि षट् सहस्राणि भवन्ति ॥
text_mt: These village and forest [hymns] amount to six thousand.

sanskrit_iast: tatra brahmavedasyāṣṭāviṃśatir upaniṣado bhavanti | muṇḍakā praśnakā brahmavidyā kṣurikā cūlikā atharvaśiro atharvaśikhā garbhopaniṣan mahopaniṣad brahmopaniṣat prāṇāgnihotraṃ māṇḍukyaṃ nādabindu brahmabindu amṛtabindu dhyānabindu tejobindu yogaśikhā yogatattvaṃ nīlarudraḥ pañcatāpinī ekadaṇḍī saṃnyāsavidhiḥ aruṇiḥ haṃsaḥ paramahaṃsaḥ nārāyaṇopaniṣad vaitathyaṃ ceti ||
meaning: तत्र ब्रह्मवेदस्याष्टाविंशतिर् उपनिषदो भवन्ति । मुण्डका प्रश्नका ब्रह्मविद्या क्षुरिका चूलिका अथर्वशिरो अथर्वशिखा गर्भोपनिषन् महोपनिषद् ब्रह्मोपनिषत् प्राणाग्निहोत्रं माण्डुक्यं नादबिन्दु ब्रह्मबिन्दु अमृतबिन्दु ध्यानबिन्दु तेजोबिन्दु योगशिखा योगतत्त्वं नीलरुद्रः पञ्चतापिनी एकदण्डी संन्यासविधिः अरुणिः हंसः परमहंसः नारायणोपनिषद् वैतथ्यं चेति ॥
text_mt: There are twenty-eight Upaniṣads of the Brahmaveda: the Muṇḍakā, Praśnakā, Brahmavidyā, Kṣurikā, Cūlikā, Atharvaśiras, Atharvaśikhā, Garbhopaniṣad, Mahopaniṣad, Brahmopaniṣad, Prāṇāgnihotra, Māṇḍūkya, Nādabindu, Brahmabindu, Amṛtabindu, Dhyānabindu, Tejobindu, Yogaśikhā, Yogatattva, Nīlarudra, Pañcatāpinī, Ekadaṇḍī, Saṃnyāsavidhi, Āruṇi, Haṃsa, Paramahaṃsa, Nārāyaṇopaniṣad, and Vaitathya.

sanskrit_iast: tatra gopathaḥ śataprapāṭhakaṃ brāhmaṇam āsīt tasyāvaśiṣṭe dve brāhmaṇe pūrvam uttaraṃ ceti ||
meaning: तत्र गोपथः शतप्रपाठकं ब्राह्मणम् आसीत् तस्यावशिष्टे द्वे ब्राह्मणे पूर्वम् उत्तरं चेति ॥
text_mt: In that regard, the Gopatha was a Brāhmaṇa of one hundred chapters; of it two Brāhmaṇas remain, the Former and the Latter.

sanskrit_iast: tatra ṣaḍ aṅgāny adhītya ṣaḍaṅgavid bhavati ṣaḍ aṅgāni bhavanti, śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ chando jyotiṣam iti ||
meaning: तत्र षड् अङ्गान्य् अधीत्य षडङ्गविद् भवति षड् अङ्गानि भवन्ति, शिक्षा कल्पो व्याकरणं निरुक्तं छन्दो ज्योतिषम् इति ॥
text_mt: In that regard, by studying the six auxiliary limbs one becomes a knower of the six limbs. The six auxiliary limbs are phonetics, ritual manual, grammar, etymology, metre, and astronomy.

sanskrit_iast: kalpā bhavanti | nakṣatrakalpo vaitānakalpas tṛtīyaḥ saṃhitāvidhiḥ | caturtha āṅgirasaḥ kalpaḥ śāntikalpas tu pañcamaḥ ||
meaning: कल्पा भवन्ति । नक्षत्रकल्पो वैतानकल्पस् तृतीयः संहिताविधिः । चतुर्थ आङ्गिरसः कल्पः शान्तिकल्पस् तु पञ्चमः ॥
text_mt: There are five ritual manuals: / the Nakṣatrakalpa, the Vaitānakalpa, and the Saṃhitāvidhi is the third; / the fourth is the Āṅgirasa kalpa, and the Śāntikalpa is the fifth.

sanskrit_iast: lakṣaṇagranthā bhavanti | caturādhyāyikā prātiśākhyaṃ pañcapaṭalikā dantyoṣṭhavidhir bṛhatsarvānukramaṇī ceti ||
meaning: लक्षणग्रन्था भवन्ति । चतुराध्यायिका प्रातिशाख्यं पञ्चपटलिका दन्त्योष्ठविधिर् बृहत्सर्वानुक्रमणी चेति ॥
text_mt: The descriptive treatises are: the Caturādhyāyikā, the Prātiśākhya, the Pañcapaṭalikā, the Dantyoṣṭhavidhi, and the Bṛhatsarvānukramaṇī.

sanskrit_iast: tatra dvāsaptatiḥ pariśiṣṭāni bhavanti kauśikoktāni | kṛttikārohiṇī | rāṣṭrasaṃvargaḥ | rājaprathamābhiṣekaḥ | purohitakarmāṇi | puṣyābhiṣekaḥ | piṣṭarātryāḥ kalpaḥ | ārātrikam | ghṛtāvekṣaṇam | tiladhenuḥ | bhūmidānam | tulāpuruṣaḥ | ādityamaṇḍakaḥ | hiraṇyagarbhaḥ | hastirathaḥ | aśvarathaḥ | gosahasradānam | hastidīkṣā | aśvadīkṣā | vṛṣotsargaḥ | indrotsavaḥ | brahmayāgaḥ | skandayāgāḥ | saṃbhāralakṣaṇam | araṇilakṣaṇam | yajñapātralakṣaṇam | vedilakṣaṇam | kuṇḍalakṣaṇam | samillakṣaṇam | sruvalakṣaṇam | hastalakṣaṇam | jvālālakṣaṇam | lakṣahomaḥ | kāṅkāyanokto bṛhallakṣahomaḥ | koṭihomaḥ | gaṇamālā | ghṛtakambalam | anulomakalpaḥ | āsurīkalpaḥ | ucchuṣmakalpaḥ | samuccayaprāyaścittāni | brahmakūrcavidhiḥ | paiṭhīnasitaḍāgavidhiḥ | pāśupatavratavidhiḥ | saṃdhyopāsanavidhiḥ | snānavidhiḥ | tarpaṇavidhiḥ | śrāddhavidhiḥ | agnihotravidhiḥ | uttamapaṭalam | varṇapaṭalam | nighaṇtuḥ | caraṇavyūhaḥ | candraprātipadikam | grahayuddham | grahasaṃgrahaḥ | rāhucāraḥ | ketucāraḥ | ṛtuketulakṣaṇam | kūrmavibhāgaḥ | maṇḍalāni | digdāhalakṣaṇam | ulkālakṣaṇam | vidyullakṣaṇam | nirghātalakṣaṇam | pariveṣalakṣaṇam | bhūmikampalakṣaṇam | nakṣatragrahotpātalakṣaṇam | utpātalakṣaṇam | sadyovṛṣṭilakṣaṇam | gośāntiḥ | adbhutaśāntiḥ | svapnādhyāyaḥ | atharvahṛdayam | bhārgavīyagārgyabārhaspatyośanasādbhutāni | mahādbhutāni bṛhatsarvānukramaṇī ceti ||
meaning: तत्र द्वासप्ततिः परिशिष्टानि भवन्ति कौशिकोक्तानि । कृत्तिकारोहिणी । राष्ट्रसंवर्गः । राजप्रथमाभिषेकः । पुरोहितकर्माणि । पुष्याभिषेकः । पिष्टरात्र्याः कल्पः । आरात्रिकम् । घृतावेक्षणम् । तिलधेनुः । भूमिदानम् । तुलापुरुषः । आदित्यमण्डकः । हिरण्यगर्भः । हस्तिरथः । अश्वरथः । गोसहस्रदानम् । हस्तिदीक्षा । अश्वदीक्षा । वृषोत्सर्गः । इन्द्रोत्सवः । ब्रह्मयागः । स्कन्दयागाः । संभारलक्षणम् । अरणिलक्षणम् । यज्ञपात्रलक्षणम् । वेदिलक्षणम् । कुण्डलक्षणम् । समिल्लक्षणम् । स्रुवलक्षणम् । हस्तलक्षणम् । ज्वालालक्षणम् । लक्षहोमः । काङ्कायनोक्तो बृहल्लक्षहोमः । कोटिहोमः । गणमाला । घृतकम्बलम् । अनुलोमकल्पः । आसुरीकल्पः । उच्छुष्मकल्पः । समुच्चयप्रायश्चित्तानि । ब्रह्मकूर्चविधिः । पैठीनसितडागविधिः । पाशुपतव्रतविधिः । संध्योपासनविधिः । स्नानविधिः । तर्पणविधिः । श्राद्धविधिः । अग्निहोत्रविधिः । उत्तमपटलम् । वर्णपटलम् । निघण्तुः । चरणव्यूहः । चन्द्रप्रातिपदिकम् । ग्रहयुद्धम् । ग्रहसंग्रहः । राहुचारः । केतुचारः । ऋतुकेतुलक्षणम् । कूर्मविभागः । मण्डलानि । दिग्दाहलक्षणम् । उल्कालक्षणम् । विद्युल्लक्षणम् । निर्घातलक्षणम् । परिवेषलक्षणम् । भूमिकम्पलक्षणम् । नक्षत्रग्रहोत्पातलक्षणम् । उत्पातलक्षणम् । सद्योवृष्टिलक्षणम् । गोशान्तिः । अद्भुतशान्तिः । स्वप्नाध्यायः । अथर्वहृदयम् । भार्गवीयगार्ग्यबार्हस्पत्योशनसाद्भुतानि । महाद्भुतानि बृहत्सर्वानुक्रमणी चेति ॥
text_mt: In that connection, there are seventy-two supplements spoken by Kauśika: Kṛttikā-Rohiṇī, Gathering of the Kingdom, The First Consecration of a King, Ritual Acts of the Royal Chaplain, Puṣya Consecration, Ordinance of Piṣṭarātrī, Evening Lamp Offering, Gazing into Ghee, Sesame-Cow, Gift of Land, Weighing against Gold, Solar Disk, Golden Embryo, Elephant Chariot, Horse Chariot, Gift of a Thousand Cows, Consecration with Elephants, Consecration with Horses, Setting Free of a Bull, Indra's Festival, Brahmā Offering, Skanda Offerings, Characteristics of Requisites, Characteristics of Kindling Sticks, Characteristics of Sacrificial Vessels, Characteristics of the Altar, Characteristics of the Fire Pit, Characteristics of Sacrificial Firesticks, Characteristics of the Sruva Spoon, Characteristics of the Hand, Characteristics of the Flame, Hundred-Thousandfold Oblation, Great Hundred-Thousandfold Oblation Spoken by Kāṅkāyana, Ten-Millionfold Oblation, Garland of Hymn Cycles, sanskrit_iast: tatra pañcadaśopaniṣado bhavanti | muṇḍakā | praśnakā | brahmavidyā | kṣurikā | cūlikā | atharvaśiraḥ | atharvaśikhā | garbhopaniṣat | mahopaniṣat | brahmopaniṣat | prāṇāgnihotram | māṇḍūkyam | vaitathyam | advaitam | alātaśāntiś ceti ||
meaning: तत्र पञ्चदशोपनिषदो भवन्ति । मुण्डका । प्रश्नका । ब्रह्मविद्या । क्षुरिका । चूलिका । अथर्वशिरः । अथर्वशिखा । गर्भोपनिषत् । महोपनिषत् । ब्रह्मोपनिषत् । प्राणाग्निहोत्रम् । माण्डूक्यम् । वैतथ्यम् । अद्वैतम् । अलातशान्तिश् चेति ॥
text_mt: In that connection, there are fifteen Upaniṣads: Muṇḍakā, Praśnakā, Brahmavidyā, Kṣurikā, Cūlikā, Atharvaśiras, Atharvaśikhā, Garbhopaniṣad, Mahopaniṣad, Brahmopaniṣad, Prāṇāgnihotram, Māṇḍūkyam, Vaitathyam, Advaitam, and Alātaśānti.

sanskrit_iast: tatra brahmavede 'ṣṭādaśa vratāni cariṣyan sāvitrīvratam | vedavratam | vedottaravratam | mailavratam | mailottaravratam | mṛgāravratam | rohitavratam | viṣāsahivratam | yamavratam | śāntivratam | śikhivratam | gaṇavratam | śirovratam | śikhāvratam | marudvratam | adhivratam | aṅgirovratam | pāśupatavrataṃ caret ||
meaning: तत्र ब्रह्मवेदे ऽष्टादश व्रतानि चरिष्यन् सावित्रीव्रतम् । वेदव्रतम् । वेदोत्तरव्रतम् । मैलव्रतम् । मैलोत्तरव्रतम् । मृगारव्रतम् । रोहितव्रतम् । विषासहिव्रतम् । यमव्रतम् । शान्तिव्रतम् । शिखिव्रतम् । गणव्रतम् । शिरोव्रतम् । शिखाव्रतम् । मरुद्व्रतम् । अधिव्रतम् । अङ्गिरोव्रतम् । पाशुपतव्रतं चरेत् ॥
text_mt: In that connection, one about to practice the eighteen observances in the Brahmaveda should practice: the Sāvitrī observance, the Veda observance, the Upper Veda observance, the Maila observance, the Upper Maila observance, the Mṛgāra observance, the Rohita observance, the Viṣāsahi observance, the Yama observance, the Śānti observance, the Śikhin observance, the Gaṇa observance, the Śiras observance, the Śikhā observance, the Marut observance, the Adhi observance, the Aṅgiras observance, and the Pāśupata observance.

sanskrit_iast: kṛcchram | taptakṛcchram | atikṛcchram | sarvakṛcchram | maundabhāyaḥ | tulāpuruṣaḥ | sāṃtapanam | mahāsāṃtapanaṃ ceti ||
meaning: कृच्छ्रम् । तप्तकृच्छ्रम् । अतिकृच्छ्रम् । सर्वकृच्छ्रम् । मौन्दभायः । तुलापुरुषः । सांतपनम् । महासांतपनं चेति ॥
text_mt: [The penances are:] the kṛcchra, the taptakṛcchra, the atikṛcchra, the sarvakṛcchra, the maundabhāya, the tulāpuruṣa, the sāṃtapana, and the mahāsāṃtapana.

sanskrit_iast: yo vai brahmavedeṣūpanītaḥ sa sarvavedeṣūpanito
meaning: यो वै ब्रह्मवेदेषूपनीतः स सर्ववेदेषूपनितो
text_mt: Whoever is initiated into the Brahmaveda is initiated into all the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast: yo vai brahmavedeṣv anupanītaḥ sa sarvavedeṣv anupanītaḥ ||
meaning: यो वै ब्रह्मवेदेष्व् अनुपनीतः स सर्ववेदेष्व् अनुपनीतः ॥
text_mt: Whoever is not initiated into the Brahmaveda is not initiated into all the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast: anyavede dvijo yo brahmavedam adhītukāmaḥ sa punar upaneyo
meaning: अन्यवेदे द्विजो यो ब्रह्मवेदम् अधीतुकामः स पुनर् उपनेयो
text_mt: A twice-born man belonging to another Veda who desires to study the Brahmaveda must be initiated again.

sanskrit_iast: devāś ca ṛṣayaś ca brahmāṇam ūcuḥ ||
meaning: देवाश् च ऋषयश् च ब्रह्माणम् ऊचुः ॥
text_mt: The gods and the seers said to Brahmā:

sanskrit_iast: ko no smo jyeṣṭhaḥ | ka upanetā | ka ācāryaḥ | ko brahmatvaṃ ceti ||
meaning: को नो स्मो ज्येष्ठः । क उपनेता । क आचार्यः । को ब्रह्मत्वं चेति ॥
text_mt: "Who is the senior among us? Who is the initiator? Who is the teacher? And who is the office of the Brahman priest?"

sanskrit_iast: tān brahmābravīt ||
meaning: तान् ब्रह्माब्रवीत् ॥

sanskrit_iast: atharvā vo jyeṣṭho 'tharvopanetātharvācāryo 'tharvā brahmatvaṃ ceti ||
meaning: अथर्वा वो ज्येष्ठो ऽथर्वोपनेताथर्वाचार्यो ऽथर्वा ब्रह्मत्वं चेति ॥
text_mt: "Atharvan is your senior, Atharvan is the initiator, Atharvan is the teacher, and Atharvan is the office of the Brahman priest."

sanskrit_iast: tad apy etad ṛcoktam | brahmajyeṣṭheti etayā |
meaning: तद् अप्य् एतद् ऋचोक्तम् । ब्रह्मज्येष्ठेति एतया ।
text_mt: That is also stated by this verse: namely, by the one beginning "brahmajyeṣṭhā".

sanskrit_iast: iti tasyārhaṃ brahmavedaś caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ sāṅgopāṅgānām tam savākovākyānāṃ setihāsapurāṇānām ||
meaning: इति तस्यार्हं ब्रह्मवेदश् चतुर्णां वेदानां साङ्गोपाङ्गानाम् तम् सवाकोवाक्यानां सेतिहासपुराणानाम् ॥
text_mt: Such is the worth of the Brahmaveda among the four Vedas, complete with auxiliary sciences, sub-auxiliaries, dialogues, and traditional histories and mythologies.

sanskrit_iast: athāto brahmavedaḥ kapilo varṇena tīkṣṇaḥ pracaṇḍaḥ kāmarūpī viśvātmā jitendriyaḥ | sa tasmin bhagavati durvārajvālaḥ |
meaning: अथातो ब्रह्मवेदः कपिलो वर्णेन तीक्ष्णः प्रचण्डः कामरूपी विश्वात्मा जितेन्द्रियः । स तस्मिन् भगवति दुर्वारज्वालः ।
text_mt: Now then, the Brahmaveda is brown in color, sharp, fierce, shape-shifting, the universal self, and of conquered senses; in that venerable one is an irresistible flame;

sanskrit_iast: kṣudrakarmā sa ca bhagavān brahmavedaś caturmukho dvipakṣo dānto dharmī balavān prājñaḥ kṛtotthāpanīyaḥ krūraḥ ṣaḍrātrāṇi vimṛśī ṣaḍrātrāṇi ṣaḍ vaitāyano gotreṇa
meaning: क्षुद्रकर्मा स च भगवान् ब्रह्मवेदश् चतुर्मुखो द्विपक्षो दान्तो धर्मी बलवान् प्राज्ञः कृतोत्थापनीयः क्रूरः षड्रात्राणि विमृशी षड्रात्राणि षड् वैतायनो गोत्रेण
text_mt: the venerable Brahmaveda performs minor acts, has four faces, two factions, is restrained, righteous, mighty, wise, to be invoked after ritual acts, cruel, deliberate for six nights, and of the Vaitāyana lineage by clan.

sanskrit_iast: ya ekaikasmin vedānāṃ nāmavarṇagotrarūpapramāṇaṃ ca kīrtayed yo vidvān jātismaro bhavati mṛtaḥ sa brahmalokaṃ gacchati ||
meaning: य एकैकस्मिन् वेदानां नामवर्णगोत्ररूपप्रमाणं च कीर्तयेद् यो विद्वान् जातिस्मरो भवति मृतः स ब्रह्मलोकं गच्छति ॥
text_mt: A wise man who recites the name, color, clan, form, and measure of each of the Vedas, remembering his past lives, goes to the world of Brahmā upon death.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ vṛttaṃ prātar amāvāsyāṃ paścād dṛśyeta candramāḥ | tasya varṇaṃ gatiṃ rūpaṃ sthānaṃ caivoccanīcatām ||
meaning: ओं वृत्तं प्रातर् अमावास्यां पश्चाद् दृश्येत चन्द्रमाः । तस्य वर्णं गतिं रूपं स्थानं चैवोच्चनीचताम् ॥
text_mt: Om. When, after the morning of the new moon has passed, the moon becomes visible in the west, / one should observe its color, motion, form, position, and elevation or depression,

sanskrit_iast: hrāsavṛddhiṃ ca śṛṅgāṇāṃ nakṣatraṃ yac ca yojayet | tāni lakṣeta somasya varṣāvarṣaṃ bhayābhayam ||
meaning: ह्रासवृद्धिं च शृङ्गाणां नक्षत्रं यच् च योजयेत् । तानि लक्षेत सोमस्य वर्षावर्षं भयाभयम् ॥
text_mt: as well as the decrease and increase of its horns and the lunar mansion to which it is conjoined: / from these one should observe rain and drought, danger and safety regarding Soma.

sanskrit_iast: prathame darśane tv indoḥ samāsādya yadā graham | uttaraṃ vardhate śṛṅgaṃ nīcībhavati dakṣiṇam ||
meaning: प्रथमे दर्शने त्व् इन्दोः समासाद्य यदा ग्रहम् । उत्तरं वर्धते शृङ्गं नीचीभवति दक्षिणम् ॥
text_mt: When, however, upon the moon's first appearance it approaches a planet, / and the northern horn rises while the southern horn becomes depressed,

sanskrit_iast: evam eva śraviṣṭhābhyas teṣām ante ca candramāḥ | udyacched dakṣiṇaṃ śṛṅgaṃ nīcībhavati cottaram ||
meaning: एवम् एव श्रविष्ठाभ्यस् तेषाम् अन्ते च चन्द्रमाः । उद्यच्छेद् दक्षिणं शृङ्गं नीचीभवति चोत्तरम् ॥
text_mt: and in this very manner from the two Śraviṣṭhās onward, and at the end of them, the moon / raises its southern horn and its northern horn becomes depressed,

sanskrit_iast: anupaśyeta rāṣṭraṃ ca antargirimahāgirim | vidarbhān madrakāṃś caiva bharatāṃś cāpi sarvataḥ ||
meaning: अनुपश्येत राष्ट्रं च अन्तर्गिरिमहागिरिम् । विदर्भान् मद्रकांश् चैव भरतांश् चापि सर्वतः ॥
text_mt: one should keep watch over the realm, the region within the mountains and the great mountain, / Vidarbha, the Madras, and the Bharatas on all sides;

sanskrit_iast: sārāṇāṃ vijarāṇāṃ ca samudre ye ca dakṣiṇe | etāñ janapadān hanti yadā syād uttaronnataḥ ||
meaning: साराणां विजराणां च समुद्रे ये च दक्षिणे । एताञ् जनपदान् हन्ति यदा स्याद् उत्तरोन्नतः ॥
text_mt: and the Sāras, the Vijaras, and those dwelling by the southern ocean— / these regions it destroys when it is elevated to the north.

sanskrit_iast: kāśmīrān daradān darvāñ śūrasenān yayāvarān | śālvānāṃ ca virājānāṃ samudre ye ca paścime ||
meaning: काश्मीरान् दरदान् दर्वाञ् शूरसेनान् ययावरान् । शाल्वानां च विराजानां समुद्रे ये च पश्चिमे ॥
text_mt: Kāśmīra, the Daradas, the Darvas, the Śūrasenas, the Yayāvaras, / the Śālvas, the Virājas, and those dwelling by the western ocean—

sanskrit_iast: etāj janapadān hanti yadā syād dakṣinonnataḥ | puruṣaḥ strīnṛpaṃ hanti aparānto vinaśyati ||
meaning: एताज् जनपदान् हन्ति यदा स्याद् दक्षिनोन्नतः । पुरुषः स्त्रीनृपं हन्ति अपरान्तो विनश्यति ॥
text_mt: these regions it destroys when it is elevated to the south; / a man kills a female king, and the western borderland perishes.

sanskrit_iast: bālhikān yavanakāmbojāñ śālvān madrān uśīnarān | godhāṃś ca bhadrakāṃś caiva madhyaṃ ca kurubhiḥ saha ||
meaning: बाल्हिकान् यवनकाम्बोजाञ् शाल्वान् मद्रान् उशीनरान् । गोधांश् च भद्रकांश् चैव मध्यं च कुरुभिः सह ॥
text_mt: Bālhika, the Yavanas, the Kāmbojas, the Śālvas, the Madras, the Uśīnaras, / the Godhas, the Bhadrakas, and the middle country along with the Kurus,

sanskrit_iast: saurāṣṭrān sindhusauvīrān vāneyāṃś cāpi siṃsakān | kṣudrakān mālavān matsyān mlecchān saha pulindakaiḥ ||
meaning: सौराष्ट्रान् सिन्धुसौवीरान् वानेयांश् चापि सिंसकान् । क्षुद्रकान् मालवान् मत्स्यान् म्लेच्छान् सह पुलिन्दकैः ॥
text_mt: Saurāṣṭra, the Sindhusauvīras, the Vāneyas, the Siṃsakas, / the Kṣudrakas, the Mālavas, the Matsyas, and the Mlecchas along with the Pulindas,

sanskrit_iast: śastropajījikuḍyāṃś ca brāhmaṇā yodhinaś ca ye | etāñ janapadān hanti somaḥ puruṣalakṣaṇaḥ ||
meaning: शस्त्रोपजीजिकुड्यांश् च ब्राह्मणा योधिनश् च ये । एताञ् जनपदान् हन्ति सोमः पुरुषलक्षणः ॥
text_mt: those living by weapons, the Kuḍyas, and those brahmins who are warriors— / these regions Soma destroys when possessing male characteristics.

sanskrit_iast: lakṣaṇād vā bhavet sthūlaḥ kāye śṛṅge ca hīyate | alpe śarīre durbhikṣaṃ bhayaṃ rogaṃ vinirdiśet ||
meaning: लक्षणाद् वा भवेत् स्थूलः काये शृङ्गे च हीयते । अल्पे शरीरे दुर्भिक्षं भयं रोगं विनिर्दिशेत् ॥
text_mt: Or if it is larger than its normal measure, but deficient in body and horns: / when its body is small, one should predict famine, danger, and disease.

sanskrit_iast: yadā pratipadaś candraḥ prakṛtyā vikṛto bhavet | anudbhinno vilūno vā rājamṛtyuṃ vinirdiśet ||
meaning: यदा प्रतिपदश् चन्द्रः प्रकृत्या विकृतो भवेत् । अनुद्भिन्नो विलूनो वा राजमृत्युं विनिर्दिशेत् ॥
text_mt: When the moon of the first day is deformed by nature, / failing to sprout or severed, one should predict the death of the king.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṣṭhyāṃ madhyaṃ yadā gacched rājā vadhyeta pārthivaḥ | avantīnāṃ ca pūrvārdhaṃ māgadhāś ca viśeṣataḥ ||
meaning: षष्ठ्यां मध्यं यदा गच्छेद् राजा वध्येत पार्थिवः । अवन्तीनां च पूर्वार्धं मागधाश् च विशेषतः ॥
text_mt: When it reaches the center on the sixth [tithi], an earthly king will be slain, / and especially the eastern half of the Avantīs and the Māgadhas.

sanskrit_iast: paraṃ kumāreṣv aṣṭamyāṃ rājānaṃ daśamī param | evaṃ ca pakṣāpacaye madhye dṛśyeta dvādaśī ||
meaning: परं कुमारेष्व् अष्टम्यां राजानं दशमी परम् । एवं च पक्षापचये मध्ये दृश्येत द्वादशी ॥
text_mt: On the eighth [it portends danger] especially to princes, on the tenth especially to the king; / and thus when the fortnight wanes, [if] the twelfth is seen in the center,

sanskrit_iast: hanti pañcanadaṃ tatra rājānaṃ sumahadbalam | sarvāṃś ca kuryād rājñas tu tasminn utpātadarśane ||
meaning: हन्ति पञ्चनदं तत्र राजानं सुमहद्बलम् । सर्वांश् च कुर्याद् राज्ञस् तु तस्मिन्न् उत्पातदर्शने ॥
text_mt: it destroys the king of the Pañcanada there, whose army is very great, / and it will affect all kings upon the appearance of that portent.

sanskrit_iast: adbhutāni ca dṛśyante tasminn utpātadarśane | vaiśvānarapathaṃ prāptaḥ samudram api śoṣayet ||
meaning: अद्भुतानि च दृश्यन्ते तस्मिन्न् उत्पातदर्शने । वैश्वानरपथं प्राप्तः समुद्रम् अपि शोषयेत् ॥
text_mt: Portents are seen upon the appearance of that portent; / having entered the path of Vaiśvānara, it would dry up even the ocean.

sanskrit_iast: kṛttikānāṃ maghānāṃ ca rohiṇyāś ca viśākhayoḥ | eteṣām uttaro mārgo rājavīthīti tāṃ viduḥ ||
meaning: कृत्तिकानां मघानां च रोहिण्याश् च विशाखयोः । एतेषाम् उत्तरो मार्गो राजवीथीति तां विदुः ॥
text_mt: The northern path of Kṛttikā, Maghā, / Rohiṇī, and the two Viśākhās—they know that as the Rājavīthī.

sanskrit_iast: yadīmaṃ mārgam āsthāya candramā vinivartate | nāvarṣā uttamā jñeyā yogakṣemaṃ tathaiva ca ||
meaning: यदीमं मार्गम् आस्थाय चन्द्रमा विनिवर्तते । नावर्षा उत्तमा ज्ञेया योगक्षेमं तथैव च ॥
text_mt: If the Moon turns back after setting out upon this path, / rains should be known as most excellent, and likewise acquisition and preservation.

sanskrit_iast: gajavīthīṃ nāgavīthīṃ yadi gacchati candramāḥ | … govīthīti tadāpy āhur gargasya vacanaṃ yathā ||
meaning: गजवीथीं नागवीथीं यदि गच्छति चन्द्रमाः । … गोवीथीति तदाप्य् आहुर् गर्गस्य वचनं यथा ॥
text_mt: If the Moon goes along the Gajavīthī or Nāgavīthī, / [...] they also call it Govīthī, according to the word of Garga.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭau sthānāni candrasya kroṣṭukir yāni veda vai | nausthāyī lāṅgalī caiva tṛtīyaś cottaronnataḥ ||
meaning: अष्टौ स्थानानि चन्द्रस्य क्रोष्टुकिर् यानि वेद वै । नौस्थायी लाङ्गली चैव तृतीयश् चोत्तरोन्नतः ॥
text_mt: There are eight positions of the Moon that Kroṣṭuki indeed knows: / boat-standing, plow-like, and third, raised to the north;

sanskrit_iast: daṇḍasthāyī caturthas tu daṇḍaśāyī tu pañcamaḥ | ṣaṣthas tu yūpasthāyī syāt pārśvaśāyī tu saptamaḥ ||
meaning: दण्डस्थायी चतुर्थस् तु दण्डशायी तु पञ्चमः । षष्थस् तु यूपस्थायी स्यात् पार्श्वशायी तु सप्तमः ॥
text_mt: the fourth is staff-standing, but the fifth is staff-lying; / the sixth would be post-standing, and the seventh flank-lying;

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭamo 'vāṅśirāś caiva phalam asya nibodhata | rājānaḥ sveṣu rāṣṭreṣu yuktadaṇḍāḥ praśāsati ||
meaning: अष्टमो ऽवाङ्शिराश् चैव फलम् अस्य निबोधत । राजानः स्वेषु राष्ट्रेषु युक्तदण्डाः प्रशासति ॥
text_mt: and the eighth is turned-down-headed: understand the result of this! / [In the first,] kings rule their realms, properly applying punishment;

sanskrit_iast: lāṅgalī grasate lokān yugāntaṃ pratipādayet | mārīṃ samadhikām āhur yadā syād uttaronnataḥ ||
meaning: लाङ्गली ग्रसते लोकान् युगान्तं प्रतिपादयेत् । मारीं समधिकाम् आहुर् यदा स्याद् उत्तरोन्नतः ॥
text_mt: the plow-like devours the worlds and brings about the end of the age; / they declare pestilence to be excessive when it is raised to the north;

sanskrit_iast: daṇḍasthāyī tv amātyānāṃ bhayaṃ rogaṃ vinirdiśet | śaktichedā granthichedā gostenāḥ pāradārikāḥ ||
meaning: दण्डस्थायी त्व् अमात्यानां भयं रोगं विनिर्दिशेत् । शक्तिछेदा ग्रन्थिछेदा गोस्तेनाः पारदारिकाः ॥
text_mt: when staff-standing, one should predict fear and disease for ministers; / cut-throats, pickpockets, cattle-thieves, and adulterers—

sanskrit_iast: ete deśān vilumpanti daṇḍasthāyī yadā bhavet | daṇḍaśāyī tu viprāṇāṃ bhayaṃ tatra vinirdiśet ||
meaning: एते देशान् विलुम्पन्ति दण्डस्थायी यदा भवेत् । दण्डशायी तु विप्राणां भयं तत्र विनिर्दिशेत् ॥
text_mt: these pillage the regions when it is staff-standing; / when staff-lying, one should predict fear for Brahmins there;

sanskrit_iast: yūpasthāyī tu dhānyānāṃ bhayaṃ tatra vinirdiśet | harite śarīre somasya paśūnāṃ vadham ādiśet ||
meaning: यूपस्थायी तु धान्यानां भयं तत्र विनिर्दिशेत् । हरिते शरीरे सोमस्य पशूनां वधम् आदिशेत् ॥
text_mt: when post-standing, one should predict danger to grains there. / When Soma's body is green, one should announce the destruction of livestock;

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇe śarīre somasya śūdrāṇāṃ vadham ādiśet | pīte śarīre somasya vaiśyānāṃ vadham ādiśet
meaning: कृष्णे शरीरे सोमस्य शूद्राणां वधम् आदिशेत् । पीते शरीरे सोमस्य वैश्यानां वधम् आदिशेत्
text_mt: when Soma's body is black, one should announce the destruction of Śūdras; / when Soma's body is yellow, one should announce the destruction of Vaiśyas;

sanskrit_iast: rakte śarīre somasya rājñāṃ tu vadham ādiśet | śukle śarīre somasya brahmavṛddhiṃ vinirdiśet ||
meaning: रक्ते शरीरे सोमस्य राज्ञां तु वधम् आदिशेत् । शुक्ले शरीरे सोमस्य ब्रह्मवृद्धिं विनिर्दिशेत् ॥
text_mt: when Soma's body is red, one should announce the destruction of kings; / when Soma's body is white, one should predict the increase of Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast: snigdhaḥ pītaḥ suvarṇābhaḥ pakṣādau yadi candramāḥ | gosthāyī saṃpradṛśyeta vipravṛddhiṃ vinirdiśet ||
meaning: स्निग्धः पीतः सुवर्णाभः पक्षादौ यदि चन्द्रमाः । गोस्थायी संप्रदृश्येत विप्रवृद्धिं विनिर्दिशेत् ॥
text_mt: If the Moon at the beginning of the fortnight is glossy, yellow, resembling gold, / and appears resting in cattle, one should predict the increase of Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast: uccasthāne yadā pītaḥ samaśṛṅgaḥ śaśī bhavet | nāgavīthīgataḥ snigdhaḥ sa sarvaguṇapūjitaḥ ||
meaning: उच्चस्थाने यदा पीतः समशृङ्गः शशी भवेत् । नागवीथीगतः स्निग्धः स सर्वगुणपूजितः ॥
text_mt: When the Moon is in an exalted position, yellow, with even horns, / gone into the Nāgavīthī, and glossy, it is honored with all virtues.

sanskrit_iast: dhūmrābho lāṅgalasthāyī śrīmān salakṣmamaṇḍalaḥ | pakṣādau yadi dṛśyeta brahmakṣatrasukhāvaḥ ||
meaning: धूम्राभो लाङ्गलस्थायी श्रीमान् सलक्ष्ममण्डलः । पक्षादौ यदि दृश्येत ब्रह्मक्षत्रसुखावः ॥
text_mt: If, at the beginning of the fortnight, it is seen smoke-colored, plow-standing, / splendid, with a marked disk, it brings happiness to Brahmins and Kṣatriyas.

sanskrit_iast: rājavīthīṃ tu saṃprāpta ugradaṇḍī yadā bhavet | haridrākuṅkumābhaś ca śmaśānam avalokayet ||
meaning: राजवीथीं तु संप्राप्त उग्रदण्डी यदा भवेत् । हरिद्राकुङ्कुमाभश् च श्मशानम् अवलोकयेत् ॥
text_mt: When it has reached the Rājavīthī, possessing a terrible staff, / resembling turmeric and saffron, it looks upon a cremation ground.

sanskrit_iast: mṛtyuṃ saṃyojayet somo bālākṛtir avāṅchirāḥ | lākṣārudhirasaṃkāśo dhanuḥsthāyī yadā bhavet ||
meaning: मृत्युं संयोजयेत् सोमो बालाकृतिर् अवाङ्छिराः । लाक्षारुधिरसंकाशो धनुःस्थायी यदा भवेत् ॥
text_mt: Soma inflicts death when it has the form of a child with head turned downward; / when it resembles lac and blood, standing like a bow,

sanskrit_iast: saṃgrāmaṃ yojayet somo loke tu tumulaṃ bhayam | dvicandraṃ gaganaṃ dṛṣṭvā brūyād brahmavadho mahān ||
meaning: संग्रामं योजयेत् सोमो लोके तु तुमुलं भयम् । द्विचन्द्रं गगनं दृष्ट्वा ब्रूयाद् ब्रह्मवधो महान् ॥
text_mt: Soma inflicts war and tumultuous terror in the world. / Seeing two moons in the sky, one should declare a great slaughter of Brahmins;

sanskrit_iast: dvau sūryau vā yadā syātāṃ tadā kṣatravadho mahān | dṛṣṭvā tu caturaḥ sūryān uditān sarvatodiśam ||
meaning: द्वौ सूर्यौ वा यदा स्यातां तदा क्षत्रवधो महान् । दृष्ट्वा तु चतुरः सूर्यान् उदितान् सर्वतोदिशम् ॥
text_mt: or when there are two suns, then there is a great slaughter of Kṣatriyas; / but seeing four suns risen in all directions,

sanskrit_iast: śastreṇa janamāreṇa tad yugāntasya lakṣaṇam | āditye pāṇḍuraṃ chattraṃ saṃdhyāvelāṃ yadā bhavet ||
meaning: शस्त्रेण जनमारेण तद् युगान्तस्य लक्षणम् । आदित्ये पाण्डुरं छत्त्रं संध्यावेलां यदा भवेत् ॥
text_mt: with weapon[-wounds] and the death of people—that is the mark of the end of the age. / When there is a pale parasol over the Sun at twilight,

sanskrit_iast: deśasya vidravaṃ sūryo rājamṛtyuṃ vinirdiśet | ādityasya rathaḥ śvetaḥ saṃdhyāvelāṃ yadā bhavet ||
meaning: देशस्य विद्रवं सूर्यो राजमृत्युं विनिर्दिशेत् । आदित्यस्य रथः श्वेतः संध्यावेलां यदा भवेत् ॥
text_mt: the Sun portends the flight of the country and the death of the king. / When the Sun's chariot is white at twilight,

sanskrit_iast: pratyāsannaṃ bhayaṃ vidyāt tasminn utpātadarśane ||
meaning: प्रत्यासन्नं भयं विद्यात् तस्मिन्न् उत्पातदर्शने ॥
text_mt: one should know danger is imminent upon the appearance of that portent.

sanskrit_iast: ādityaḥ sarvataś chinno dvaidhībhutaḥ pradṛśyate | deśasya vidravaṃ sūryo rājamṛtyuṃ vinirdiśet ||
meaning: आदित्यः सर्वतश् छिन्नो द्वैधीभुतः प्रदृश्यते । देशस्य विद्रवं सूर्यो राजमृत्युं विनिर्दिशेत् ॥
text_mt: When the Sun is seen severed on all sides, split into two, / the Sun portends the flight of the country and the death of the king.

sanskrit_iast: kṣemaṃ vikukṣile brūyāt sthālīpiṭharasaṃsthite | saṃkṣipte kṣīyate loko durbhikṣaṃ vajrasaṃsthite ||
meaning: क्षेमं विकुक्षिले ब्रूयात् स्थालीपिठरसंस्थिते । संक्षिप्ते क्षीयते लोको दुर्भिक्षं वज्रसंस्थिते ॥
text_mt: When it is pot-bellied, one should declare security; when shaped like a cooking pot or pan; / when compressed, the world perishes; when shaped like a vajra, famine [ensues].

sanskrit_iast: divā hy asmin pataty ulkā satataṃ kampate mahī | aparvāśaninirghoṣāḥ saṃdhyā ca jvalanacchavā ||
meaning: दिवा ह्य् अस्मिन् पतत्य् उल्का सततं कम्पते मही । अपर्वाशनिनिर्घोषाः संध्या च ज्वलनच्छवा ॥
text_mt: A meteor falls by day during this, the earth constantly quakes, / there are unseasonal claps of thunder, and the twilight has the hue of blazing fire,

sanskrit_iast: nakṣatrapātasyotpattir dhūmasya rajaso 'pi vā | śṛṅgaṃ bhavaty ādityasya tṛṇakāṣṭhaṃ ca śuṣyati ||
meaning: नक्षत्रपातस्योत्पत्तिर् धूमस्य रजसो ऽपि वा । शृङ्गं भवत्य् आदित्यस्य तृणकाष्ठं च शुष्यति ॥
text_mt: the occurrence of falling stars, or of smoke and dust; / a horn appears on the Sun, and grass and wood dry up;

sanskrit_iast: rājāno hy aśivās tatra citraṃ varṣati mādhavaḥ | dvādaśānāṃ tu māsānāṃ madhye naśyati pārthivaḥ ||
meaning: राजानो ह्य् अशिवास् तत्र चित्रं वर्षति माधवः । द्वादशानां तु मासानां मध्ये नश्यति पार्थिवः ॥
text_mt: kings there become unprosperous, [the god] Mādhava rains varied things; / and within twelve months the earthly king perishes.

sanskrit_iast: kārttikyāṃ śuklapakṣasya bahulasya trayodaśīm | vidyāt tu svātisaṃpātaṃ divasān ekaviṃśatim ||
meaning: कार्त्तिक्यां शुक्लपक्षस्य बहुलस्य त्रयोदशीम् । विद्यात् तु स्वातिसंपातं दिवसान् एकविंशतिम् ॥
text_mt: From the full moon day of Kārttika of the bright fortnight to the thirteenth of the dark fortnight, / one should know the impact of Svāti for twenty-one days:

sanskrit_iast: saptāhaṃ tu bhaved goṣu saptāhaṃ mṛgapakṣiṣu | mānuṣeṣu ca saptāhaṃ tataḥ śreyas tu kalpayet ||
meaning: सप्ताहं तु भवेद् गोषु सप्ताहं मृगपक्षिषु । मानुषेषु च सप्ताहं ततः श्रेयस् तु कल्पयेत् ॥
text_mt: it will be on cattle for seven days, on beasts and birds for seven days, / and on human beings for seven days; after that, one should expect prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ ke cid grahā nārarān āśrayante ke cid grahā jyotiṣi saṃgrahe ca | graho graheṇaiva hataḥ kathaṃ syād vijñāya tattvaṃ bhagavān bravītu ||
meaning: ओं के चिद् ग्रहा नाररान् आश्रयन्ते के चिद् ग्रहा ज्योतिषि संग्रहे च । ग्रहो ग्रहेणैव हतः कथं स्याद् विज्ञाय तत्त्वं भगवान् ब्रवीतु ॥
text_mt: Oṃ. Some planets resort to men, and some planets [abide] in the collection [of luminaries]. / How can a planet be defeated by another planet? Knowing the truth, let the venerable one speak!

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ sa pṛṣṭo munibhir mahātmā provāca gargo grahayuddhatantram | parājayaṃ caiva jayaṃ ca teṣāṃ śubhāsubham aśubhamñ caiva jagaddhitāya ||
meaning: एवं स पृष्टो मुनिभिर् महात्मा प्रोवाच गर्गो ग्रहयुद्धतन्त्रम् । पराजयं चैव जयं च तेषां शुभासुभम् अशुभम्ञ् चैव जगद्धिताय ॥
text_mt: Thus questioned by the sages, the great-souled Garga proclaimed the treatise on the war of planets, / and their defeat and victory, auspicious and inauspicious, for the welfare of the world:

sanskrit_iast: arko jātaḥ kaliṅgeṣu yavaneṣu ca candramāḥ | aṅgārakas tv avantyāyāṃ magadhāyāṃ budhas tathā ||
meaning: अर्को जातः कलिङ्गेषु यवनेषु च चन्द्रमाः । अङ्गारकस् त्व् अवन्त्यायां मगधायां बुधस् तथा ॥
text_mt: The Sun was born in the Kaliṅgas, and the Moon among the Yavanas; / Mars in Avantī, and Budha likewise in Magadhā;

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspatiḥ saindhaveṣu mahārāṣṭre tu bhārgavaḥ | śanaiścaraḥ surāṣṭrāyāṃ rāhus tu giriśṛṅgajaḥ | ketur malayake jāta ity etad grahajātakam ||
meaning: बृहस्पतिः सैन्धवेषु महाराष्ट्रे तु भार्गवः । शनैश्चरः सुराष्ट्रायां राहुस् तु गिरिशृङ्गजः । केतुर् मलयके जात इत्य् एतद् ग्रहजातकम् ॥
text_mt: Bṛhaspati among the Saindhavas, Bhārgava in Mahārāṣṭra, / Śanaiścara in Surāṣṭrā, Rāhu born on a mountain peak, / and Ketu was born in Malayaka: this is the nativity of the planets.

sanskrit_iast: yasmin deśe tu yo jātaḥ sa grahaḥ pīḍyate yadā taṃ deśaṃ ghātitaṃ vidyād durbhikṣeṇa bhayena vā ||
meaning: यस्मिन् देशे तु यो जातः स ग्रहः पीड्यते यदा तं देशं घातितं विद्याद् दुर्भिक्षेण भयेन वा ॥
text_mt: In whichever country a planet is born, when that planet is afflicted, / one should know that country to be struck by famine or terror.

sanskrit_iast: divākaraś caiva śanaiścaras tathā bṛhaspatiś caiva budhaś ca nāgarāḥ | prajāpatiḥ ketur athāpi candramās tathaiva rāhūśanasau ca yāyinaḥ ||
meaning: दिवाकरश् चैव शनैश्चरस् तथा बृहस्पतिश् चैव बुधश् च नागराः । प्रजापतिः केतुर् अथापि चन्द्रमास् तथैव राहूशनसौ च यायिनः ॥
text_mt: The Sun, Śanaiścara, Bṛhaspati, and Budha are city-dwellers; / Prajāpati, Ketu, also the Moon, and likewise Rāhu and Uśanas are marchers.

sanskrit_iast: yadā graho nagara eva nāgaraṃ vijeṣyate yāyy atha vāpi yāyinam | tadā nṛpo nāgara eva nāgaraṃ vijeṣyate vāyy atha vāpi yāyinam ||
meaning: यदा ग्रहो नगर एव नागरं विजेष्यते याय्य् अथ वापि यायिनम् । तदा नृपो नागर एव नागरं विजेष्यते वाय्य् अथ वापि यायिनम् ॥
text_mt: When a city-dwelling planet conquers a city-dweller in the city itself, or a marcher [conquers] a marcher, / then an urban king conquers an urban king, or a marching king a marching [king].

sanskrit_iast: ārohaṇaṃ ca bhedaś ca lekhanaṃ savyadakṣiṇam | raśmisaṃsarjanaṃ caiva grahayuddhaṃ caturvidham ||
meaning: आरोहणं च भेदश् च लेखनं सव्यदक्षिणम् । रश्मिसंसर्जनं चैव ग्रहयुद्धं चतुर्विधम् ॥
text_mt: Ascending, piercing, scraping left and right, / and mingling of rays: the war of the planets is fourfold.

sanskrit_iast: prasavye vigrahaṃ brūyāt saṃgrāmaṃ raśmisaṃgame | lekhane 'mātyapūḍā syād bhedane tu janakṣayaḥ ||
meaning: प्रसव्ये विग्रहं ब्रूयात् संग्रामं रश्मिसंगमे । लेखने ऽमात्यपूडा स्याद् भेदने तु जनक्षयः ॥
text_mt: One should declare discord in [scraping] to the left; battle when rays unite; / in scraping there would be affliction to ministers; and in piercing, the destruction of people.

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣāṃ nabhasi samāgame grahāṇām uktṛṣṭo bhavati tathaiva raśmivān yaḥ | snigdhatvaṃ bhavati tu yasya sa graho graheṇa saṃyukto bhavati tu yaḥ parājayeta śeṣaḥ ||
meaning: सर्वेषां नभसि समागमे ग्रहाणाम् उक्तृष्टो भवति तथैव रश्मिवान् यः । स्निग्धत्वं भवति तु यस्य स ग्रहो ग्रहेण संयुक्तो भवति तु यः पराजयेत शेषः ॥
text_mt: In an encounter of all the planets in the sky, whichever is superior and full of rays, / and whichever has glossiness—that planet joined with [another] planet [wins], while the other would be defeated.

sanskrit_iast: śyāmo vā vyapagataraśmimaṇḍalo vā rūkṣo vā vyapagataraśmivān kṛśo vā | ākrānto vinipatitas tato 'pasavyo vijñeyo hata iti sa graho graheṇa ||
meaning: श्यामो वा व्यपगतरश्मिमण्डलो वा रूक्षो वा व्यपगतरश्मिवान् कृशो वा । आक्रान्तो विनिपतितस् ततो ऽपसव्यो विज्ञेयो हत इति स ग्रहो ग्रहेण ॥
text_mt: Whether dark or stripped of its halo of rays, rough, devoid of rays, or slender, / overwhelmed, fallen down, and then moving counter-clockwise, that planet is to be known as struck by [another] planet.

sanskrit_iast: budhaś ca bhaumaḥ śanibhārgavāṅgirāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ yāti yadā niśākaram | anamayatvaṃ triṣu saukhyam uttamaṃ viparyaye cāpi mahāñ janakṣayaḥ ||
meaning: बुधश् च भौमः शनिभार्गवाङ्गिराः प्रदक्षिणं याति यदा निशाकरम् । अनमयत्वं त्रिषु सौख्यम् उत्तमं विपर्यये चापि महाञ् जनक्षयः ॥
text_mt: When Mercury, Mars, Saturn, Venus, and Jupiter move clockwise around the Moon, / there is freedom from disease, supreme happiness in the three [worlds]; but in the reverse case, great loss of life.

sanskrit_iast: dhanakanakarajatasaṃcayāś ca sarve śamadamamantraparāś caye manuṣyāḥ | śakayavanatukhārabālhikāś ca kṣayam upayānti divākarasya ghāte ||
meaning: धनकनकरजतसंचयाश् च सर्वे शमदममन्त्रपराश् चये मनुष्याः । शकयवनतुखारबाल्हिकाश् च क्षयम् उपयान्ति दिवाकरस्य घाते ॥
text_mt: All hoards of wealth, gold, and silver, and those men devoted to calmness, self-restraint, and mantras, / and the Śakas, Yavanas, Tukhāras, and Bālhikas go to ruin upon the striking of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast: atha some hate vidyād dhrvaṃ rājño viparyayaḥ | saṃharanti ca bhūtāni bhūmipālāḥ pṛthakpṛthak ||
meaning: अथ सोमे हते विद्याद् ध्र्वं राज्ञो विपर्ययः । संहरन्ति च भूतानि भूमिपालाः पृथक्पृथक् ॥
text_mt: Now, when the Moon is struck, one should know [there will] surely [be] the overthrow of the king, / and the protectors of the earth severally destroy creatures.

sanskrit_iast: parasparaṃ virudhyante kṣudbhayaṃ cāpi dāruṇām | anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ ghoraṃ vidyāt somaviparyaye ||
meaning: परस्परं विरुध्यन्ते क्षुद्भयं चापि दारुणाम् । अनावृष्टिभयं घोरं विद्यात् सोमविपर्यये ॥
text_mt: They conflict with one another, and there is dreadful fear of hunger; / one should know there is terrible danger of drought upon the adversity of the Moon.

sanskrit_iast: traigartāḥ kṣitipatayaḥ sayodhamukhyāḥ pīḍyante girinilayāgnijīvinaś ca | saṃgrāmāḥ sarudhirapāṃsuvarṣamiśrā durbhikṣaṃ bhavati dharāsutasya ghāte ||
meaning: त्रैगर्ताः क्षितिपतयः सयोधमुख्याः पीड्यन्ते गिरिनिलयाग्निजीविनश् च । संग्रामाः सरुधिरपांसुवर्षमिश्रा दुर्भिक्षं भवति धरासुतस्य घाते ॥
text_mt: The rulers of Trigarta together with their chief warriors, those dwelling in mountains, and those who live by fire are afflicted; / battles mixed with showers of blood and dust [occur, and] famine arises upon the striking of the son of the Earth.

sanskrit_iast: sāgaranilayāḥ paurāḥ kṣayam upayānti narā vaṇikpradhānāḥ | bhavati tu rājā vijayī prayāyī budhabandhane prapatanti cātra sobhyāḥ ||
meaning: सागरनिलयाः पौराः क्षयम् उपयान्ति नरा वणिक्प्रधानाः । भवति तु राजा विजयी प्रयायी बुधबन्धने प्रपतन्ति चात्र सोभ्याः ॥
text_mt: Citizens dwelling by the ocean [and] men who are chief merchants go to ruin; / the king on the march, however, becomes victorious, and those living in aerial cities crash down during the binding of Mercury.

sanskrit_iast: daivajñās tapasi ciraṃ suniścitārthāḥ syur dāntā nṛpatigaṇaḥ purohitāś ca | āgantur jayati vadhaś ca nāgarāṇāṃ trailokyam ca bhayam upaiti guros tu ghāte ||
meaning: दैवज्ञास् तपसि चिरं सुनिश्चितार्थाः स्युर् दान्ता नृपतिगणः पुरोहिताश् च । आगन्तुर् जयति वधश् च नागराणां त्रैलोक्यम् च भयम् उपैति गुरोस् तु घाते ॥
text_mt: Astrologers firmly resolute in asceticism for a long time, the multitude of kings, and royal priests become restrained; / an invader conquers, there is slaughter of city-dwellers, and fear comes upon the three worlds at the striking of Jupiter.

sanskrit_iast: yo rājā prathitaparākramaḥ pṛthivyāṃ vaṅgāṅgādiṣu madadhāḥ saśūrasenāḥ | ye yodhāḥ samaraṇabhumilabdhaśabdās te sainyaiḥ kṣayam upayānti śukraghāte ||
meaning: यो राजा प्रथितपराक्रमः पृथिव्यां वङ्गाङ्गादिषु मदधाः सशूरसेनाः । ये योधाः समरणभुमिलब्धशब्दास् ते सैन्यैः क्षयम् उपयान्ति शुक्रघाते ॥
text_mt: Whatever king has renowned valor on earth among the Vaṅgas, Aṅgas, and others, the Magadhas along with the Śūrasenas, / [and] those warriors who have gained fame on the battlefield perish along with their armies at the striking of Venus.

sanskrit_iast: mahiṣakavṛṣabhāḥ sabhasmapauṇḍrāḥ kṛṣipaśupālyaratāś ca ye manuṣyāḥ | vividhabhayasamāhitās tu sarve kṣayam upayānti śanaiścarasya ghāte ||
meaning: महिषकवृषभाः सभस्मपौण्ड्राः कृषिपशुपाल्यरताश् च ये मनुष्याः । विविधभयसमाहितास् तु सर्वे क्षयम् उपयान्ति शनैश्चरस्य घाते ॥
text_mt: Buffaloes and bulls, those marked with ash-lines, and those men engaged in agriculture and cattle-rearing, / all beset by various fears, go to ruin at the striking of Saturn.

sanskrit_iast: ye ke cin nṛpatiṣu dāmbhikāḥ piśācāḥ kāryāṇāṃ vrataniyameṣu channapāpāḥ | ye cānye śabarapulindacedigādhā bādhyante yadi bhavate 'tra rāhughātaḥ ||
meaning: ये के चिन् नृपतिषु दाम्भिकाः पिशाचाः कार्याणां व्रतनियमेषु छन्नपापाः । ये चान्ये शबरपुलिन्दचेदिगाधा बाध्यन्ते यदि भवते ऽत्र राहुघातः ॥
text_mt: Whatever hypocrites among kings are fiends, evil ones concealed in the rites and observances of their duties, / and whatever other Śabaras, Pulindas, Cedis, and Gādhas are afflicted if there is a striking by Rāhu here.

sanskrit_iast: ākrāntaṃ samanubhavanti yāyisaṃghā vadhyante yadi bhavate paras paro 'highātaḥ | saṃgrāmāḥ sarudhirapāṃsuvarṣamiśra durbhikṣaṃ bhavati tu ketupīḍanena ||
meaning: आक्रान्तं समनुभवन्ति यायिसंघा वध्यन्ते यदि भवते परस् परो ऽहिघातः । संग्रामाः सरुधिरपांसुवर्षमिश्र दुर्भिक्षं भवति तु केतुपीडनेन ॥
text_mt: Armies on the march experience assault; they are slain if there is mutual striking by the serpent [Rāhu]; / battles mixed with showers of blood and dust, and famine arise through the affliction of a comet.

sanskrit_iast: yat kiṃ cid divigatam antarikṣajaṃ vā bhaumaṃ vā bhavati nimittam apraśastam | tat savaṃ stanitamahābhrabidyudvarṣaiḥ śāntaṃ syād bhavati sadakṣiṇaiś ca homaiḥ ||
meaning: यत् किं चिद् दिविगतम् अन्तरिक्षजं वा भौमं वा भवति निमित्तम् अप्रशस्तम् । तत् सवं स्तनितमहाभ्रबिद्युद्वर्षैः शान्तं स्याद् भवति सदक्षिणैश् च होमैः ॥
text_mt: Whatever inauspicious sign occurs in the sky, in the atmosphere, or on the earth, / all that becomes pacified through thundering, large clouds, lightning, and rain, and through oblations endowed with sacrificial fees.

sanskrit_iast: ye deśā grahagaṇabhinnabhūmikampā yeṣāṃ vā graha upayātacandrasūryaḥ | tān deśān grahagaṇabhinnabhumikampān parjanyaḥ śamayati saptarātravṛṣṭyā ||
meaning: ये देशा ग्रहगणभिन्नभूमिकम्पा येषां वा ग्रह उपयातचन्द्रसूर्यः । तान् देशान् ग्रहगणभिन्नभुमिकम्पान् पर्जन्यः शमयति सप्तरात्रवृष्ट्या ॥
text_mt: Whatever regions have earthquakes caused by planetary conjunctions, or whose Moon and Sun are overtaken by a planet, / Parjanya calms those regions [having earthquakes caused by planetary conjunctions] with a rain of seven nights.

sanskrit_iast: prasavyas triṣu māseṣu saṃsargo māsikaḥ smṛtaḥ | lekhane pakṣa ity āhur bhedane saptarātrikam ||
meaning: प्रसव्यस् त्रिषु मासेषु संसर्गो मासिकः स्मृतः । लेखने पक्ष इत्य् आहुर् भेदने सप्तरात्रिकम् ॥
text_mt: A counter-clockwise conjunction is recorded as lasting three months, an encounter as lasting one month; / they say it lasts a fortnight in scratching, and seven nights in piercing.

sanskrit_iast: āgneyā vāsavāś caiva vāyavyā vāruṇās tathā | sarva eva śubhā jñeyā gargasya vacanaṃ yathā ||
meaning: आग्नेया वासवाश् चैव वायव्या वारुणास् तथा । सर्व एव शुभा ज्ञेया गर्गस्य वचनं यथा ॥
text_mt: Those belonging to Agni, Indra, Vāyu, and Varuṇa— / all are to be known as auspicious, according to the word of Garga.

sanskrit_iast: om atharvāṇaṃ namaskṛtya uvāca bhagavān ṛṣiḥ | kīdṛśā grahaputrāś ca kiyanto vā vadasva me ||
meaning: ओम् अथर्वाणं नमस्कृत्य उवाच भगवान् ऋषिः । कीदृशा ग्रहपुत्राश् च कियन्तो वा वदस्व मे ॥
text_mt: Oṃ. Having paid homage to Atharvan, the venerable ṛṣi said: / "What are the sons of the planets like, and how many are they? Tell me!"

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭaha sa śaunakenātha brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāya vai | saṃkhyām uvāca bhagavān padmayonimataṃ yathā ||
meaning: पृष्टह स शौनकेनाथ ब्राह्मणानां हिताय वै । संख्याम् उवाच भगवान् पद्मयोनिमतं यथा ॥
text_mt: Thus questioned by Śaunaka for the welfare of the brahmins, / the venerable one stated their number according to the doctrine of the Lotus-born [Brahmā]:

sanskrit_iast: dikcāriṇo divicarā bhūcarā vyomacāriṇaḥ | divācarā rātricarā divārātricarāś caye ||
meaning: दिक्चारिणो दिविचरा भूचरा व्योमचारिणः । दिवाचरा रात्रिचरा दिवारात्रिचराश् चये ॥
text_mt: Those moving in the cardinal directions, moving in the sky, moving on earth, moving in space, / those moving by day, moving by night, and those moving by day and night;

sanskrit_iast: pṛthikcarāś ca ye tatra te ca syuḥ saṃghacāriṇaḥ | caranty aparavīthīṣu ye ca vibhrāntamaṇḍalāḥ ||
meaning: पृथिक्चराश् च ये तत्र ते च स्युः संघचारिणः । चरन्त्य् अपरवीथीषु ये च विभ्रान्तमण्डलाः ॥
text_mt: and those which move individually there, and those which move in groups, / and those which move in other paths, having wandering orbits;

sanskrit_iast: te grahāḥ saṃgraheṇāhaṃ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ | anekavidhasaṃsthānaṃ pravakṣyāmy anupūrvaśaḥ ||
meaning: ते ग्रहाः संग्रहेणाहं शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः । अनेकविधसंस्थानं प्रवक्ष्याम्य् अनुपूर्वशः ॥
text_mt: those planets by hundreds and thousands, in a compendium, / I shall proclaim in proper order, according to their manifold forms.

sanskrit_iast: gokṣīrakumudaprakhyās tīvreṇa vapuṣānvitāḥ | caranty antaravīthīṣu snigdhā vipulatejasaḥ ||
meaning: गोक्षीरकुमुदप्रख्यास् तीव्रेण वपुषान्विताः । चरन्त्य् अन्तरवीथीषु स्निग्धा विपुलतेजसः ॥
text_mt: Resembling cow's milk and white water-lilies, endowed with an intense appearance, / they move in the intermediate orbits, glossy, of vast splendor.

sanskrit_iast: ete visarpakā nāma arciṣmanto mahāprabhāḥ | vijñeyāś caturaśītiḥ śukraputrā mahāgrahāḥ ||
meaning: एते विसर्पका नाम अर्चिष्मन्तो महाप्रभाः । विज्ञेयाश् चतुरशीतिः शुक्रपुत्रा महाग्रहाः ॥
text_mt: These are named Visarpakas, radiant, of great splendor; / eighty-four great planets, the sons of Venus, are to be known.

sanskrit_iast: śuklā nikarāḥ saurābhās tyajanta iva cārciṣaḥ | sphuranta iva cākāśe bimbakā raśmibhir vṛtāḥ ||
meaning: शुक्ला निकराः सौराभास् त्यजन्त इव चार्चिषः । स्फुरन्त इव चाकाशे बिम्बका रश्मिभिर् वृताः ॥
text_mt: White, dense, with solar radiance, as if casting off flames, / and as if flashing in the sky, disc-like, enveloped in rays;

sanskrit_iast: prāyaśo dakṣiṇe mārge nīcair vibhrāntamaṇḍalāḥ | vikacāḥ pañcaṣaṣṭis te bṛhaspatisutāḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning: प्रायशो दक्षिणे मार्गे नीचैर् विभ्रान्तमण्डलाः । विकचाः पञ्चषष्टिस् ते बृहस्पतिसुताः स्मृतः ॥
text_mt: mostly in the southern path, low, with wandering orbits, / hairless, sixty-five of them are remembered as sons of Jupiter.

sanskrit_iast: ye śvetāḥ kiṃcid ākṛṣṇā viśikhāḥ syur vitārakāḥ | te ṣaṣṭiḥ kanakā nāma śanaiścarasutā grahāḥ ||
meaning: ये श्वेताः किंचिद् आकृष्णा विशिखाः स्युर् वितारकाः । ते षष्टिः कनका नाम शनैश्चरसुता ग्रहाः ॥
text_mt:
Those that are white, somewhat blackish, crestless, [and] without stars, / those sixty, named Kanakas, are planets, the sons of Saturn.

Fifty-one Taskaras of subtle rays are to be known; / sons of Mercury, resembling the interior of a lotus, having somewhat pale splendor.

sanskrit_iast: jñeyās taskarāḥ sūkṣmaraśmayaḥ | baudhāḥ kamalagarbhābhāḥ kiṃcit pāṇḍuratejasaḥ ||
meaning: ज्ञेयास् तस्कराः सूक्ष्मरश्मयः । बौधाः कमलगर्भाभाः किंचित् पाण्डुरतेजसः ॥

sanskrit_iast: kauṅkumā lohitāṅgasya putrā vidrumatejasaḥ | triśikhā vā tribhāgā vā ṣaṣṭir ity uttare pathi ||
meaning: कौङ्कुमा लोहिताङ्गस्य पुत्रा विद्रुमतेजसः । त्रिशिखा वा त्रिभागा वा षष्टिर् इत्य् उत्तरे पथि ॥
text_mt: Saffron-colored are the sons of Mars, possessing the splendor of coral, / three-crested or tripartite, sixty [in number] in the northern path.

sanskrit_iast: nānādhūmanibhā rūkṣā dhūmavyākularaśmayaḥ | śatam ekādhikaṃ mṛtyoḥ putrāḥ syur dhūmaketavaḥ ||
meaning: नानाधूमनिभा रूक्षा धूमव्याकुलरश्मयः । शतम् एकाधिकं मृत्योः पुत्राः स्युर् धूमकेतवः ॥
text_mt: Resembling various [kinds of] smoke, rough, with rays agitated by smoke, / one hundred and one sons of Mṛtyu are comets.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇābhāḥ kṛṣṇaparyantāḥ kaluṣākṛtiraśmayaḥ | rāhoḥ putrās trayas triṃśad grahās tāmasakīlakāḥ ||
meaning: कृष्णाभाः कृष्णपर्यन्ताः कलुषाकृतिरश्मयः । राहोः पुत्रास् त्रयस् त्रिंशद् ग्रहास् तामसकीलकाः ॥
text_mt: Dark-colored, with dark edges, having rays of turbid appearance, / the thirty-three sons of Rāhu are planets [named] Tāmasakīlakas.

sanskrit_iast: nānāvarṇāgnisaṃkāśā jvālāmālā visarpiṇaḥ | viśvarūpāḥ sutā agner grahā viṃśaṃ śataṃ smṛtam ||
meaning: नानावर्णाग्निसंकाशा ज्वालामाला विसर्पिणः । विश्वरूपाः सुता अग्नेर् ग्रहा विंशं शतं स्मृतम् ॥
text_mt: Resembling fire of various colors, spreading with wreaths of flames, / all-formed, one hundred and twenty sons of Agni are recorded as planets.

sanskrit_iast: aruṇās tu sutā vāyor dāruṇāḥ saptasaptatiḥ | vāteritā bhramantīva rūkṣā vikīrṇaraśmayaḥ ||
meaning: अरुणास् तु सुता वायोर् दारुणाः सप्तसप्ततिः । वातेरिता भ्रमन्तीव रूक्षा विकीर्णरश्मयः ॥
text_mt: Ruddy are the seventy-seven fierce sons of Vāyu; / rough, with scattered rays, they seem to wander as if stirred by the wind.

sanskrit_iast: tārāpuñjapratīkāśās tārāmaṇḍalasaṃvṛtāḥ | prājāpatyā grahās tv aṣṭau gaṇakā nāmanāmataḥ ||
meaning: तारापुञ्जप्रतीकाशास् तारामण्डलसंवृताः । प्राजापत्या ग्रहास् त्व् अष्टौ गणका नामनामतः ॥
text_mt: Resembling clusters of stars, surrounded by a circle of stars, / eight planets, children of Prajāpati, are named Gaṇakas by name.

sanskrit_iast: catvāras tārajā yuktāḥ sūkṣmāṇo rūparaśmayaḥ | brahmasaṃtānakā nāma dve śate caturuttare ||
meaning: चत्वारस् तारजा युक्ताः सूक्ष्माणो रूपरश्मयः । ब्रह्मसंतानका नाम द्वे शते चतुरुत्तरे ॥
text_mt: Four star-born ones are united, having fine rays of form; / two hundred and four are named Brahmasaṃtānakas.

sanskrit_iast: vaṃśagulmapratīkāśā vaṃśagulmasaraśmayaḥ | kākatuṇḍanibhābhiś ca raśmibhiḥ kiṃcid āvṛtāḥ ||
meaning: वंशगुल्मप्रतीकाशा वंशगुल्मसरश्मयः । काकतुण्डनिभाभिश् च रश्मिभिः किंचिद् आवृताः ॥
text_mt: Resembling a thicket of bamboo, [having rays like a thicket of bamboo], / and somewhat enveloped by rays resembling crows' beaks,

sanskrit_iast: udakaṃ cotsṛjantīva snigdhatvāt saumyadarśanāḥ | ete nāmnā smṛtāḥ kaṅkās triṃśad dvau vāruṇā grahāḥ ||
meaning: उदकं चोत्सृजन्तीव स्निग्धत्वात् सौम्यदर्शनाः । एते नाम्ना स्मृताः कङ्कास् त्रिंशद् द्वौ वारुणा ग्रहाः ॥
text_mt: and as if emitting water due to their glossiness, gentle in appearance, / these are recorded by name as Kaṅkas, thirty-two planets belonging to Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: muṇḍatārāḥ kabandhābhā rukmakeśāś ca raśmayaḥ | kālaputrāḥ kabandhās te smṛtāḥ ṣaṇṇavatir grahāḥ ||
meaning: मुण्डताराः कबन्धाभा रुक्मकेशाश् च रश्मयः । कालपुत्राः कबन्धास् ते स्मृताः षण्णवतिर् ग्रहाः ॥
text_mt: Bald stars, resembling headless torsos, and with rays like golden hair, / ninety-six planets, the sons of Kāla, are recorded as Kabandhas.

sanskrit_iast: arciṣmāṃś ca prabhāsaś ca romaśo viṣamāṃs tathā | asnigdhāś cātikāyāś ca kiṃśuko rājasāyakaḥ ||
meaning: अर्चिष्मांश् च प्रभासश् च रोमशो विषमांस् तथा । अस्निग्धाश् चातिकायाश् च किंशुको राजसायकः ॥
text_mt: Arciṣmat, Prabhāsa, Romaśa, Viṣama, / Asnigdha, Atikāya, Kiṃśuka, Rājasāyaka,

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣakaiś caiva rādhātaḥ kumudaḥ phanako ghanaḥ | eṣām aśveti vijñeyā ārās tu parisarpakāḥ ||
meaning: ऋषकैश् चैव राधातः कुमुदः फनको घनः । एषाम् अश्वेति विज्ञेया आरास् तु परिसर्पकाः ॥
text_mt: Ṛṣaka, and Rādhāta, Kumuda, Phanaka, Ghana— / of these, the meandering Ārās are to be known as not white.

sanskrit_iast: nakṣatracāriṇo hy ete bhṛguputrā mahābalāḥ | pāṇḍurābhiḥ sudīrghābhiḥ śikhābhiḥ śītaraśmayaḥ ||
meaning: नक्षत्रचारिणो ह्य् एते भृगुपुत्रा महाबलाः । पाण्डुराभिः सुदीर्घाभिः शिखाभिः शीतरश्मयः ॥
text_mt: For these move among the lunar mansions, sons of Bhṛgu of great power, / cool-rayed, with pale, very long crests.

sanskrit_iast: atisaṃtānakāś tv anye ṣaṣṭir vāyoḥ sutā grahāḥ | vikesarāḥ prakāśante kṛṣṇalohitaraśmayaḥ ||
meaning: अतिसंतानकाश् त्व् अन्ये षष्टिर् वायोः सुता ग्रहाः । विकेसराः प्रकाशन्ते कृष्णलोहितरश्मयः ॥
text_mt: The Atisaṃtānakas, however, are other planets, sixty sons of the Wind; / devoid of filaments, they shine with black-and-red rays.

sanskrit_iast: miśrībhūtās tu te jñeyā guṇṭhitā iva reṇunā | dhūmaketoḥ sutā jñeyāḥ śatam ekādhikaṃ ca tat ||
meaning: मिश्रीभूतास् तु ते ज्ञेया गुण्ठिता इव रेणुना । धूमकेतोः सुता ज्ञेयाः शतम् एकाधिकं च तत् ॥
text_mt: They are to be known as blended together, as though veiled in dust; / they are known as the sons of Dhūmaketu, one hundred and one in number.

sanskrit_iast: atyarthaṃ kanakās tv anye prataptakanakaprabhāḥ | antakaputrakāḥ ṣaṣṭir asnigdhā madhyacāriṇaḥ ||
meaning: अत्यर्थं कनकास् त्व् अन्ये प्रतप्तकनकप्रभाः । अन्तकपुत्रकाः षष्टिर् अस्निग्धा मध्यचारिणः ॥
text_mt: The Kanakas, however, are other [planets], extremely bright like heated gold; / sixty sons of Death, unctuous-less, moving through the middle.

sanskrit_iast: ye tu nakṣatravaṃśasya bhāgam uttaram āśritāḥ | ekatārā vapuṣmanto mahākāyāḥ prabhānvitāḥ ||
meaning: ये तु नक्षत्रवंशस्य भागम् उत्तरम् आश्रिताः । एकतारा वपुष्मन्तो महाकायाः प्रभान्विताः ॥
text_mt: Those, however, that abide in the northern portion of the lineage of lunar mansions, / single-starred, shapely, large-bodied, and endowed with radiance,

sanskrit_iast: vyālakasya tu ye putrāḥ saptaṣaṣṭiḥ samantataḥ | nāmato 'dhikacā nāma tattvajñaiḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||
meaning: व्यालकस्य तु ये पुत्राः सप्तषष्टिः समन्ततः । नामतो ऽधिकचा नाम तत्त्वज्ञैः परिकीर्तिताः ॥
text_mt: are the sixty-seven sons of Vyālaka on all sides; / by name they are proclaimed by knowers of reality as the Adhikacās.

sanskrit_iast: saṃtānakanibhā ye tu dṛśyante sūkṣmaraśmayaḥ | ekatārā dvitārā vā atha vā pañcatārakaḥ ||
meaning: संतानकनिभा ये तु दृश्यन्ते सूक्ष्मरश्मयः । एकतारा द्वितारा वा अथ वा पञ्चतारकः ॥
text_mt: Those that are seen resembling the Saṃtānaka, having subtle rays, / being single-starred, or two-starred, or else five-starred,

sanskrit_iast: brahmarāśes tu te putrā grahāḥ saṃtānasaṃsthitāḥ | saṃcaranti nabhaḥ sarvam utpanne puruṣakṣaye ||
meaning: ब्रह्मराशेस् तु ते पुत्रा ग्रहाः संतानसंस्थिताः । संचरन्ति नभः सर्वम् उत्पन्ने पुरुषक्षये ॥
text_mt: are planets, the sons of Brahmarāśi, abiding in continuous lineages; / they wander throughout the whole sky when the destruction of men has arisen.

sanskrit_iast: aṇavo lohitās tv anye prakāśante 'dhikeśakāḥ | pañcaṣaṣṭis tu te jñeyāḥ prājāpatyā grahāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
meaning: अणवो लोहितास् त्व् अन्ये प्रकाशन्ते ऽधिकेशकाः । पञ्चषष्टिस् तु ते ज्ञेयाः प्राजापत्या ग्रहाः स्मृताः ॥
text_mt: Others shine as minute, red, and having excessive crests; / sixty-five in number, they are remembered as planets born of Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: pariveṣeṣu jāteṣu grahāṇāṃ maṇḍaleṣu ca | dṛśyante kārmukā nāma saptatyekā samāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
meaning: परिवेषेषु जातेषु ग्रहाणां मण्डलेषु च । दृश्यन्ते कार्मुका नाम सप्तत्येका समाः स्मृताः ॥
text_mt: When halos and discs of planets arise, / [planets] called Kārmukas are seen; seventy-one of them are recorded as equal.

sanskrit_iast: adharmasaṃbhavās tv anye caturdaśa parikramāḥ | adhaḥśikhāḥ prakāśante vivarṇā ghoratārakāḥ ||
meaning: अधर्मसंभवास् त्व् अन्ये चतुर्दश परिक्रमाः । अधःशिखाः प्रकाशन्ते विवर्णा घोरतारकाः ॥
text_mt: Fourteen other wanderers, however, are born of unrighteousness; / pointing their crests downward, they shine as discolored, terrible stars.

sanskrit_iast: karṇachidraprātīkāśāḥ kṛṣṇās te tārakākṛtau | kīlakā rāhuputrās tu candrasūryatalāśrayāḥ ||
meaning: कर्णछिद्रप्रातीकाशाः कृष्णास् ते तारकाकृतौ । कीलका राहुपुत्रास् तु चन्द्रसूर्यतलाश्रयाः ॥
text_mt: Resembling ear-cavities, black in the form of stars, / are the Kīlakas, sons of Rāhu, resting at the discs of the moon and sun.

sanskrit_iast: vajraḥ kavandhas triśirāḥ śaṅkhabhedī śikhāvataḥ | daṇḍāś ca rāhuputrāḥ syur nāmabhis tulyavarcasaḥ ||
meaning: वज्रः कवन्धस् त्रिशिराः शङ्खभेदी शिखावतः । दण्डाश् च राहुपुत्राः स्युर् नामभिस् तुल्यवर्चसः ॥
text_mt: Vajra, Kavandha, Triśiras, Śaṅkhabhedin, Śikhavat, / and the Daṇḍas are sons of Rāhu, whose luster corresponds to their names.

sanskrit_iast: yathā somārkayor jyoter maṇḍalābhyāśasevinaḥ | rājanyatvāt pradṛśyante prajānāṃ saṃkṣayāvahāḥ ||
meaning: यथा सोमार्कयोर् ज्योतेर् मण्डलाभ्याशसेविनः । राजन्यत्वात् प्रदृश्यन्ते प्रजानां संक्षयावहाः ॥
text_mt: Resorting to the vicinity of the luminous orb of the sun and moon, / they are seen as royal portents, bringing destruction to subjects.

sanskrit_iast: tatra mandaphalā jñeyāḥ śaśāṅkatalasevinaḥ | divākaratalābhyāśaṃ sevino bhṛśadāruṇāḥ ||
meaning: तत्र मन्दफला ज्ञेयाः शशाङ्कतलसेविनः । दिवाकरतलाभ्याशं सेविनो भृशदारुणाः ॥
text_mt: Among them, those resorting to the underside of the moon are to be known as yielding slight fruits; / those resorting near the underside of the sun are exceedingly dreadful.

sanskrit_iast: pannagās tu caturviṃśat kṛṣṇā dvātriṃśatir grahāḥ | dakṣiṇādyāsu vīkṣyante nīcair vibhrāntamaṇḍalāḥ ||
meaning: पन्नगास् तु चतुर्विंशत् कृष्णा द्वात्रिंशतिर् ग्रहाः । दक्षिणाद्यासु वीक्ष्यन्ते नीचैर् विभ्रान्तमण्डलाः ॥
text_mt: The Pannagas are twenty-four, and thirty-two planets are black; / revolving in erratic orbits down low, they are observed in the southern and other [quarters].

sanskrit_iast: kevalaṃ tārakākārā dṛśyante niḥprabhaprabhāḥ | pītaraktā grahāḥ pañca pūrvadakṣiṇataḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning: केवलं तारकाकारा दृश्यन्ते निःप्रभप्रभाः । पीतरक्ता ग्रहाः पञ्च पूर्वदक्षिणतः स्मृतः ॥
text_mt: They are seen purely in the form of stars, possessing luster without brightness; / five yellow-red planets are recorded in the south-east.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāparataś cāpi pītaraktau grahau smṛtau | uttarāparatas tv ekaḥ pītarakto grahaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning: दक्षिणापरतश् चापि पीतरक्तौ ग्रहौ स्मृतौ । उत्तरापरतस् त्व् एकः पीतरक्तो ग्रहः स्मृतः ॥
text_mt: In the south-west also, two yellow-red planets are recorded; / in the north-west, however, one yellow-red planet is recorded.

sanskrit_iast: aiśānyāṃ śvetaraktābha ekas tiṣṭhati sūryakaḥ | yaḥ saṃdhivelāsv arkābho dikṣu sarvāsu dṛśyate ||
meaning: ऐशान्यां श्वेतरक्ताभ एकस् तिष्ठति सूर्यकः । यः संधिवेलास्व् अर्काभो दिक्षु सर्वासु दृश्यते ॥
text_mt: In the north-east stands a single sunlet, having a white-and-red appearance, / which is seen at the twilight hours in all quarters, resembling the sun.

sanskrit_iast: nātidūre raveḥ snigdhaḥ sa varṣāyābhayāya ca | yavakrītoṣaraibhyāś ca nāradaḥ sarvatas tathā ||
meaning: नातिदूरे रवेः स्निग्धः स वर्षायाभयाय च । यवक्रीतोषरैभ्याश् च नारदः सर्वतस् तथा ॥
text_mt: When glossy and not very far from the sun, it brings rain and safety. / Yavakrīta, Raibhya, and Nārada on all sides;

sanskrit_iast: karṇaś ca raibhyasya putrau cārvāvasuparāvasū | saptaite sthāvarā jñeyāḥ saha sūryeṇa sarpiṇaḥ ||
meaning: कर्णश् च रैभ्यस्य पुत्रौ चार्वावसुपरावसू । सप्तैते स्थावरा ज्ञेयाः सह सूर्येण सर्पिणः ॥
text_mt: and Karṇa, and Raibhya's two sons, Arvāvasu and Parāvasu: / these seven are to be known as fixed, gliding along with the sun.

sanskrit_iast: sthāvarāṇāṃ narendrāṇāṃ prācyānāṃ pakṣam āśritāḥ | svastyātreyo mṛgavyādha ṛmucuḥ pramṛcus tathā ||
meaning: स्थावराणां नरेन्द्राणां प्राच्यानां पक्षम् आश्रिताः । स्वस्त्यात्रेयो मृगव्याध ऋमुचुः प्रमृचुस् तथा ॥
text_mt: Taking the side of the eastern fixed kings: / Svastyātreya, Mṛgavyādha, Ṛmucu, and Pramṛcu,

sanskrit_iast: prabhāsaś candrabhāsaś ca tathāgastyaḥ pratāpavān | dṛḍhavratas triśaṅkuś ca ajau vaiśvānare mṛḍaḥ ||
meaning: प्रभासश् चन्द्रभासश् च तथागस्त्यः प्रतापवान् । दृढव्रतस् त्रिशङ्कुश् च अजौ वैश्वानरे मृडः ॥
text_mt: Prabhāsa, Candrabhāsa, and the powerful Agastya, / Dṛḍhavrata, Triśaṅku, the two Ajas in Vaiśvānara, Mṛḍa,

sanskrit_iast: aruṇaś ca danuś caiva yāmyāyāṃ sthāvarāḥ smṛtāḥ | gautamo 'trir vasiṣṭhaś ca viśvāmitras tu kaśyapaḥ ||
meaning: अरुणश् च दनुश् चैव याम्यायां स्थावराः स्मृताः । गौतमो ऽत्रिर् वसिष्ठश् च विश्वामित्रस् तु कश्यपः ॥
text_mt: Aruṇa, and Danu are recorded as fixed in the southern quarter. / Gautama, Atri, Vasiṣṭha, Viśvāmitra, Kaśyapa,

sanskrit_iast: ṛcīkaputraś ca tathā bharadvājaś ca vīryavān | ete sapta mahātmāna udīcyāṃ sthāvarāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
meaning: ऋचीकपुत्रश् च तथा भरद्वाजश् च वीर्यवान् । एते सप्त महात्मान उदीच्यां स्थावराः स्मृताः ॥
text_mt: the son of Ṛcīka, and the mighty Bharadvāja: / these seven great souls are recorded as fixed in the northern quarter.

sanskrit_iast: śiśumāreṇa sahitā dhruveṇa ca mahātmanā | pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ somo bhṛgur aṅgirasā saha ||
meaning: शिशुमारेण सहिता ध्रुवेण च महात्मना । पुलस्त्यः पुलहः सोमो भृगुर् अङ्गिरसा सह ॥
text_mt: Together with the Porpoise and the great-souled Dhruva: / Pulastya, Pulaha, Soma, Bhṛgu along with Aṅgiras,

sanskrit_iast: hāhāhūhū ca vijñeyau viṣṇoś ca padam uttamam | madhyāntasthāvarāṇāṃ tu niyatāv iti buddhimān ||
meaning: हाहाहूहू च विज्ञेयौ विष्णोश् च पदम् उत्तमम् । मध्यान्तस्थावराणां तु नियताव् इति बुद्धिमान् ॥
text_mt: and Hāhā and Hūhū are to be known, as well as the supreme step of Viṣṇu; / the wise man should understand them as fixed in the middle and the intermediate [regions].

sanskrit_iast: kūṭasthānāni sarvāṇi dikṣv etāny upadhārayet | prabhānvitāni śvetāni snigdhāni vimalāni ca ||
meaning: कूटस्थानानि सर्वाणि दिक्ष्व् एतान्य् उपधारयेत् । प्रभान्वितानि श्वेतानि स्निग्धानि विमलानि च ॥
text_mt: One should contemplate all these as motionless pivots in the directions; / endowed with radiance, white, unctuous, and stainless,

sanskrit_iast: arciṣmanti prasannāni tāni kuryuḥ prajāhitam | niḥprabhāṇi vivarṇāni nirarcīmṣy amalāni ca ||
meaning: अर्चिष्मन्ति प्रसन्नानि तानि कुर्युः प्रजाहितम् । निःप्रभाणि विवर्णानि निरर्चीम्ष्य् अमलानि च ॥
text_mt: flaming and serene, they bring welfare to subjects; / [when] lusterless, discolored, flameless, and murky,

sanskrit_iast: hrasvāny asnehayuktāni na bhāvāya bhavanti hi | yat kiṃcit sthāvaraṃ loke tat prasanneṣu vardhate ||
meaning: ह्रस्वान्य् अस्नेहयुक्तानि न भावाय भवन्ति हि । यत् किंचित् स्थावरं लोके तत् प्रसन्नेषु वर्धते ॥
text_mt: short, and devoid of gloss, they indeed do not lead to prosperity. / Whatever is fixed in the world increases when they are serene;

sanskrit_iast: kūṭastheṣv aprasanneṣu sthāvaraṃ parihīyate | ādityaś caiva śukraś ca lohitāṅgas tathaiva ca ||
meaning: कूटस्थेष्व् अप्रसन्नेषु स्थावरं परिहीयते । आदित्यश् चैव शुक्रश् च लोहिताङ्गस् तथैव च ॥
text_mt: when the motionless pivots are unpropitious, what is fixed wastes away. / The Sun, Venus, and Mars;

sanskrit_iast: rāhuḥ somaḥ śanaiścaro bṛhaspatibudhau tathā | aindra āgneyo yāmyaś ca nairṛto vāruṇas tathā ||
meaning: राहुः सोमः शनैश्चरो बृहस्पतिबुधौ तथा । ऐन्द्र आग्नेयो याम्यश् च नैरृतो वारुणस् तथा ॥
text_mt: Rāhu, the Moon, Saturn, Jupiter, and Mercury; / [the planets of] Indra, Agni, Yama, Nirṛti, Varuṇa,

sanskrit_iast: vāyavyaś caiva saumyaś ca brāhmaś caivāṣṭamo grahaḥ | navamaś caiva vijñeyo dhūmaketur mahāgrahaḥ ||
meaning: वायव्यश् चैव सौम्यश् च ब्राह्मश् चैवाष्टमो ग्रहः । नवमश् चैव विज्ञेयो धूमकेतुर् महाग्रहः ॥
text_mt: Vāyu, Soma, and the eighth planet of Brahmā; / and the ninth is to be known as the great planet Dhūmaketu.

sanskrit_iast: yugagrahā na cānye te tatrāṣṭau diggrahāḥ smṛtāḥ | sanakṣatreṣu mārgeṣu dṛśyante tu yugagrahāḥ ||
meaning: युगग्रहा न चान्ये ते तत्राष्टौ दिग्ग्रहाः स्मृताः । सनक्षत्रेषु मार्गेषु दृश्यन्ते तु युगग्रहाः ॥
text_mt: The age-planets are not others; the eight directional planets are recorded among them. / The age-planets are seen in the paths containing lunar mansions,

sanskrit_iast: vibhrāntamaṇḍalāḥ śeṣā dṛśyante khacarā grahaḥ | mṛtyor niśvāsajāś cānye jñeyāḥ ṣoḍaśa ketavaḥ ||
meaning: विभ्रान्तमण्डलाः शेषा दृश्यन्ते खचरा ग्रहः । मृत्योर् निश्वासजाश् चान्ये ज्ञेयाः षोडश केतवः ॥
text_mt: while the remaining sky-roaming planets are seen with revolving discs. / Others born from the sigh of Death are to be known as sixteen comets.

sanskrit_iast: kūṣmāṇḍavad visaṃchannas triṇavā dakṣiṇe pathi | ekādaśaiva vijñeyā dvādaśādityasaṃbhavāḥ ||
meaning: कूष्माण्डवद् विसंछन्नस् त्रिणवा दक्षिणे पथि । एकादशैव विज्ञेया द्वादशादित्यसंभवाः ॥
text_mt: Covered like pumpkins, twenty-seven [wander] in the southern path; / eleven are to be known as sprung from the twelve suns.

sanskrit_iast: sūryavarcanirīkṣās te tejodhātumayā grahāḥ | dakṣayajñe tu rudrasya krodhād anye tu niḥsṛtāḥ ||
meaning: सूर्यवर्चनिरीक्षास् ते तेजोधातुमया ग्रहाः । दक्षयज्ञे तु रुद्रस्य क्रोधाद् अन्ये तु निःसृताः ॥
text_mt: Gazing with solar luster, they are planets composed of the element of fire. / Others emerged from Rudra's wrath at the sacrifice of Dakṣa:

sanskrit_iast: bhīmarūpā daśaikaś ca jvalāṅkuśadharā grahāḥ | sapta paitāmahās tv anye tiryaggā jarjaragrahāḥ ||
meaning: भीमरूपा दशैकश् च ज्वलाङ्कुशधरा ग्रहाः । सप्त पैतामहास् त्व् अन्ये तिर्यग्गा जर्जरग्रहाः ॥
text_mt: eleven planets of terrible form, holding flaming goads. / Seven other decrepit planets belong to the Grandfather, moving crosswise,

sanskrit_iast: śikhāḥ sṛjanto vitatās tantuśuklapaṭopamāḥ | śvetaketava ity anye vyākhyātā daśa pañca ca ||
meaning: शिखाः सृजन्तो विततास् तन्तुशुक्लपटोपमाः । श्वेतकेतव इत्य् अन्ये व्याख्याता दश पञ्च च ॥
text_mt: sending forth extended crests resembling white woven cloth. / Fifteen others are explained as Śvetaketus;

sanskrit_iast: uddālakarṣiputrās te nīcair vibhrāntamaṇḍalāḥ | te syuḥ śvetaśikhāḥ sarve saumyāḥ kāntās tanuprabhāḥ ||
meaning: उद्दालकर्षिपुत्रास् ते नीचैर् विभ्रान्तमण्डलाः । ते स्युः श्वेतशिखाः सर्वे सौम्याः कान्तास् तनुप्रभाः ॥
text_mt: they are sons of the sage Uddālaka, with orbits wandering low; / they all have white crests, are benign, beautiful, and of slender light.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭādaśendunā sārdhaṃ mathyamāne purāmṛte | ketavaḥ kundapuṣpābhāḥ kṣīrodanabhasi smṛtāḥ ||
meaning: अष्टादशेन्दुना सार्धं मथ्यमाने पुरामृते । केतवः कुन्दपुष्पाभाः क्षीरोदनभसि स्मृताः ॥
text_mt: Eighteen along with the Moon, when ambrosia was churned of old, / are recorded in the sky of the Milk Ocean as comets shining like jasmine blossoms.

sanskrit_iast: viraśmayaś ca viśikhā mahākāyā nirarciṣaḥ | raupyakumbhanibhāḥ saumyā grahāḥ syuḥ śītatejasaḥ ||
meaning: विरश्मयश् च विशिखा महाकाया निरर्चिषः । रौप्यकुम्भनिभाः सौम्या ग्रहाः स्युः शीततेजसः ॥
text_mt: Rayless, crestless, large-bodied, devoid of flames, / resembling silver pitchers, they are benign planets of cool radiance.

sanskrit_iast: brahmakopamayas tv eko viśvātmā sarvato grahaḥ | caturyugānte lokānām udayas tasya vidyate ||
meaning: ब्रह्मकोपमयस् त्व् एको विश्वात्मा सर्वतो ग्रहः । चतुर्युगान्ते लोकानाम् उदयस् तस्य विद्यते ॥
text_mt: One planet, however, consists of Brahmā's anger, the self of the universe in every respect; / its rising takes place for the worlds at the end of the four ages.

sanskrit_iast: nakṣatrapatham utsṛjya nabhoaṃśāḥ pārśvacāriṇaḥ | pūrvato 'bhyuditā vā syur nīcair uttaratas tathā ||
meaning: नक्षत्रपथम् उत्सृज्य नभोअंशाः पार्श्वचारिणः । पूर्वतो ऽभ्युदिता वा स्युर् नीचैर् उत्तरतस् तथा ॥
text_mt: Leaving the path of the lunar mansions, occupying portions of the sky, moving on the flank, / they may rise in the east, or low down in the north,

sanskrit_iast: bhūmyām abhyuditā vā syur hrasvasnehapariplutāḥ | sarva eva tu vijñeyā grahā mandaphalodayāḥ ||
meaning: भूम्याम् अभ्युदिता वा स्युर् ह्रस्वस्नेहपरिप्लुताः । सर्व एव तु विज्ञेया ग्रहा मन्दफलोदयाः ॥
text_mt: or they may rise from the earth, bathed in meager oiliness; / all planets indeed are to be known as having outcomes yielding little good fruit.

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣāṃ paitṛkaṃ karma prajābhāgyodbhavaṃ mahat | sarve te sarvato hanyur aśubhaṃ yad vadanti ca ||
