text_mt: with rumbling from a load of clouds, in a shining halo, / even out of season, one should know that great danger is imminent;

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇanīhāratimire prakṛtyākrāntamaṇḍale | vikārair nābhasaiḥ kīrṇe sphuliṅgopacite 'śubhe ||
meaning: कृष्णनीहारतिमिरे प्रकृत्याक्रान्तमण्डले । विकारैर् नाभसैः कीर्णे स्फुलिङ्गोपचिते ऽशुभे ॥
text_mt: in dark mist and darkness, when the disc is naturally overwhelmed, / scattered with aerial modifications, covered in sparks, inauspicious;

sanskrit_iast: viṣame vigatasnehe vidhvastakaluṣābhrake | triṣu saṃdhiṣu bhūyiṣṭhaṃ darśanaṃ copagacchati ||
meaning: विषमे विगतस्नेहे विध्वस्तकलुषाभ्रके । त्रिषु संधिषु भूयिष्ठं दर्शनं चोपगच्छति ॥
text_mt: irregular, devoid of gloss, with broken and foul clouds, / and appearing mostly at the three twilight junctions;

sanskrit_iast: dvitrinakṣatrage vāpi nakṣatrārdhagate 'pi vā | pradīptair vā rasadbhiś ca vīkṣyamāṇe mṛgadvijaiḥ ||
meaning: द्वित्रिनक्षत्रगे वापि नक्षत्रार्धगते ऽपि वा । प्रदीप्तैर् वा रसद्भिश् च वीक्ष्यमाणे मृगद्विजैः ॥
text_mt: or covering two or three lunar mansions, or covering half a lunar mansion, / or being watched by burning or crying beasts and birds—

sanskrit_iast: pariveṣe vijānīyān nṛpādyānām upasthitam | saptarātrād bhayaṃ ghoraṃ cauraśastrāgnimṛtyubhiḥ ||
meaning: परिवेषे विजानीयान् नृपाद्यानाम् उपस्थितम् । सप्तरात्राद् भयं घोरं चौरशस्त्राग्निमृत्युभिः ॥
text_mt: During a halo, one should know that imminent danger for kings and others / approaches within seven nights, terrifying on account of thieves, weapons, fire, and death.

sanskrit_iast: dhūmakarburamāñjiṣṭharaktapītāsitākṛtiḥ | bhavaty ekatare pārśve rūpeṇāvilamaṇḍalaḥ ||
meaning: धूमकर्बुरमाञ्जिष्ठरक्तपीतासिताकृतिः । भवत्य् एकतरे पार्श्वे रूपेणाविलमण्डलः ॥
text_mt: Smoky, variegated, madder-red, red, yellow, and black in appearance, / it becomes a turbid circle on one side in form.

sanskrit_iast: tanunā cātra jālena samantāt pariveṣṭitaḥ | muhurmuhuś ca vilayaṃ saṃsthānaṃ cāpi gacchati ||
meaning: तनुना चात्र जालेन समन्तात् परिवेष्टितः । मुहुर्मुहुश् च विलयं संस्थानं चापि गच्छति ॥
text_mt: And surrounded on all sides by a thin web, / it repeatedly undergoes dissolution and also reformation.

sanskrit_iast: so 'pi vāyvātmako jñeyo mṛdumandadivākaraḥ | pariveṣo 'lpaphalado vātavṛṣṭiḥ pravṛṃhate ||
meaning: सो ऽपि वाय्वात्मको ज्ञेयो मृदुमन्ददिवाकरः । परिवेषो ऽल्पफलदो वातवृष्टिः प्रवृंहते ॥
text_mt: That [halo] is also to be known as wind-natured, with the sun soft and dim; / the halo yields little fruit, [while] wind and rain increase.

sanskrit_iast: atha ced vātavṛṣṭis tu trirātrān nāpajāyate | jalajvalanacaurāṇāṃ prādurbhāvaḥ prajāyate ||
meaning: अथ चेद् वातवृष्टिस् तु त्रिरात्रान् नापजायते । जलज्वलनचौराणां प्रादुर्भावः प्रजायते ॥
text_mt: If, however, wind and rain do not arise within three nights, / the manifestation of floods, fires, and thieves occurs.

sanskrit_iast: pariveṣagato 'lkā syād dvimaṇḍalaparigrahe | dvābhyāṃ senāpatibhayaṃ yuvarājabhayaṃ tribhiḥ ||
meaning: परिवेषगतो ऽल्का स्याद् द्विमण्डलपरिग्रहे । द्वाभ्यां सेनापतिभयं युवराजभयं त्रिभिः ॥
text_mt: A meteor may be situated within the halo when there is a double ring; / with two, there is fear for the commander-in-chief; with three, fear for the crown prince.

sanskrit_iast: maṇḍalaiḥ purarodhaḥ syāt tribhir abhyadhikair dhryvan | trāṇi yatrāvarudhyante nakṣatragrahacandramāḥ ||
meaning: मण्डलैः पुररोधः स्यात् त्रिभिर् अभ्यधिकैर् ध्र्य्वन् । त्राणि यत्रावरुध्यन्ते नक्षत्रग्रहचन्द्रमाः ॥
text_mt: With rings exceeding three, a siege of the city certainly takes place; / where the three—a lunar mansion, a planet, and the moon—are enclosed,

sanskrit_iast: tryahād varṣaṃ samācaṣṭe sa māsād vigrahaṃ vadet | senāpatikumārāṇāṃ senāyāś cāpi vidravaḥ ||
meaning: त्र्यहाद् वर्षं समाचष्टे स मासाद् विग्रहं वदेत् । सेनापतिकुमाराणां सेनायाश् चापि विद्रवः ॥
text_mt: he declares rain after three days; after a month, he should predict war; / and there is the rout of the commanders, the princes, and also the army.

sanskrit_iast: lohitāṅgapariveṣe śastrāgnyutpāta eva ca | sthāvarāḥ karṣakāś cāpi kṣudradhānyaṃ ca pīḍyate ||
meaning: लोहिताङ्गपरिवेषे शस्त्राग्न्युत्पात एव च । स्थावराः कर्षकाश् चापि क्षुद्रधान्यं च पीड्यते ॥
text_mt: When there is a halo around Mars, there is a portent of weapons and fire, / and stationary beings, farmers, and minor grains are afflicted.

sanskrit_iast: vātavṛṣṭiṃ ca janayet pariviṣṭaḥ śanaiścaraḥ | rājyam eva hi garbhāṃś ca rāhuḥ pīḍayate dhruvam ||
meaning: वातवृष्टिं च जनयेत् परिविष्टः शनैश्चरः । राज्यम् एव हि गर्भांश् च राहुः पीडयते ध्रुवम् ॥
text_mt: Surrounded by a halo, Saturn would cause wind and rain; / Rāhu certainly afflicts the realm and pregnant wombs.

sanskrit_iast: vyādhīṃś caiva prajanayet pariviṣṭaś ca candramāḥ | kṣucśvāsāgnibhayaṃ ghoraṃ rājato mṛtyutas tathā ||
meaning: व्याधींश् चैव प्रजनयेत् परिविष्टश् च चन्द्रमाः । क्षुच्श्वासाग्निभयं घोरं राजतो मृत्युतस् तथा ॥
text_mt: And the moon, surrounded by a halo, generates diseases, / as well as terrible fear from hunger, asthma, fire, the king, and death.

sanskrit_iast: pariviṣṭo 'mbare ketuḥ śikhinaś ca hinasti saha | dvayoḥ saṃgrāmam ācaṣṭe grahayoḥ pariviṣṭayoḥ ||
meaning: परिविष्टो ऽम्बरे केतुः शिखिनश् च हिनस्ति सह । द्वयोः संग्रामम् आचष्टे ग्रहयोः परिविष्टयोः ॥
text_mt: Ketu, surrounded by a halo in the sky, destroys together with comets; / when two planets are surrounded by halos, he declares battle.

sanskrit_iast: kṣudbhayaṃ triṣu vijñeyaṃ varṣanigraha eva ca | caturbhir mriyate rājā sāmātyaḥ sapurohitaḥ ||
meaning: क्षुद्भयं त्रिषु विज्ञेयं वर्षनिग्रह एव च । चतुर्भिर् म्रियते राजा सामात्यः सपुरोहितः ॥
text_mt: When three [are haloed], fear of hunger and withholding of rain are to be known; / with four, the king dies along with his minister and royal chaplain.

sanskrit_iast: yugānta iva jānīyāt patriviṣṭeṣu pañcasu | brahmakṣatriyaviṭśūdrān hanyāt pratipadādiṣu ||
meaning: युगान्त इव जानीयात् पत्रिविष्टेषु पञ्चसु । ब्रह्मक्षत्रियविट्शूद्रान् हन्यात् प्रतिपदादिषु ॥
text_mt: One should know it as like the end of the age when five are surrounded by halos. / On the first lunar day and following, it destroys Brahmins, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, and śūdras;

sanskrit_iast: grāmān puraṃ ca kośaṃ ca pañcamyādiṣv atas triṣu | aṣṭamyāṃ yuvarājānāṃ camūpālān hinasti saha ||
meaning: ग्रामान् पुरं च कोशं च पञ्चम्यादिष्व् अतस् त्रिषु । अष्टम्यां युवराजानां चमूपालान् हिनस्ति सह ॥
text_mt: on the next three beginning with the fifth: villages, the capital city, and the treasury; / on the eighth, it destroys along with the crown princes the army commanders;

sanskrit_iast: navamyāṃ ca daśamyāṃ ca ekādaśyāṃ ca pārthivān | trayodaśyāṃ balakṣobho dvādaśyāṃ rudhyate puram ||
meaning: नवम्यां च दशम्यां च एकादश्यां च पार्थिवान् । त्रयोदश्यां बलक्षोभो द्वादश्यां रुध्यते पुरम् ॥
text_mt: and on the ninth, the tenth, and the eleventh, kings; / on the thirteenth, agitation of the army; on the twelfth, the city is besieged;

sanskrit_iast: rājapatnīṃ caturdaśyāṃ pajcadaśyāṃ nṛpasya ca | purohitāmātyanṛpā hanyur anyonyam eva tu ||
meaning: राजपत्नीं चतुर्दश्यां पज्चदश्यां नृपस्य च । पुरोहितामात्यनृपा हन्युर् अन्योन्यम् एव तु ॥
text_mt: on the fourteenth, the king's wife; and on the fifteenth, of the king— / the chaplain, ministers, and kings slay one another.

sanskrit_iast: purarodhaṃ vijānīyāt pariviṣṭe bṛhaspatau | mantriṇo lekhakāś cāpi rudhyante sthāvarāṇi ca ||
meaning: पुररोधं विजानीयात् परिविष्टे बृहस्पतौ । मन्त्रिणो लेखकाश् चापि रुध्यन्ते स्थावराणि च ॥
text_mt: One should know that there is a siege of the city when Jupiter is haloed; / counselors and scribes are also besieged, and stationary entities.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣṭiṃ cāpi vijānīyāt pariviṣṭe budhe grahe | yāyinaḥ kṣatriyāś cāpi rājapakṣaś ca pīḍyate ||
meaning: वृष्टिं चापि विजानीयात् परिविष्टे बुधे ग्रहे । यायिनः क्षत्रियाश् चापि राजपक्षश् च पीड्यते ॥
text_mt: And one should know rain when the planet Mercury is haloed; / marching kings, kṣatriyas, and the royal faction are afflicted.

sanskrit_iast: dhānyārghaṃ ca priyaṃ kuryāt pariviṣṭo bhṛgoḥ sutaḥ | tārāgrahapariveṣā nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca kevalam ||
meaning: धान्यार्घं च प्रियं कुर्यात् परिविष्टो भृगोः सुतः । ताराग्रहपरिवेषा नक्षत्राणां च केवलम् ॥
text_mt: The son of Bhṛgu, haloed, makes the price of grain dear. / Halos around star-planets and lunar mansions alone

sanskrit_iast: mahāgrahodayaṃ kuryān maraṇaṃ vā mahīpateḥ | rakte pīte 'site tāmre kṛṣṇe ca harite 'ruṇe ||
meaning: महाग्रहोदयं कुर्यान् मरणं वा महीपतेः । रक्ते पीते ऽसिते ताम्रे कृष्णे च हरिते ऽरुणे ॥
text_mt: cause the rising of a great planet, or the death of the king. / In red, yellow, dark, copper-colored, black, green, and reddish-brown,

sanskrit_iast: kṣucśastravyādhivarṣāgnimṛtyusasyānilānayoḥ | varṇānāṃ ca bhayaṃ jñeyaṃ yathā varṇaparigrahaḥ ||
meaning: क्षुच्शस्त्रव्याधिवर्षाग्निमृत्युसस्यानिलानयोः । वर्णानां च भयं ज्ञेयं यथा वर्णपरिग्रहः ॥
text_mt: fear of hunger, weapons, disease, rain, fire, death, crops, wind, and two misfortunes / of the social classes is to be known, corresponding to the colors assumed.

sanskrit_iast: kāpotaḥ śabalaś cāpi tiryagyonibhayāvahau | mayūragalaśaṅkhendumuktāgokṣīrapāṇḍurāḥ ||
meaning: कापोतः शबलश् चापि तिर्यग्योनिभयावहौ । मयूरगलशङ्खेन्दुमुक्तागोक्षीरपाण्डुराः ॥
text_mt: Pigeon-gray and motley bring fear to animals. / Those colored like a peacock’s throat, conch, moon, pearl, or cow's milk,

sanskrit_iast: madhūkaghṛtamaṇḍābhā dūrvāśyāmāś ca vṛṣṭaye | vimuktāriṣṭakākārās tailāmalakasaṃnibhāḥ ||
meaning: मधूकघृतमण्डाभा दूर्वाश्यामाश् च वृष्टये । विमुक्तारिष्टकाकारास् तैलामलकसंनिभाः ॥
text_mt: resembling madhūka-flowers, ghee, or scum, and dark like dūrvā-grass, indicate rain. / Resembling soapberries, looking like sesame oil and myrobalan,

sanskrit_iast: snigdhāmalajalaprakhyā darpaṇābhās ca pūjitāḥ | babhravaḥ paruṣā rukṣā haridrāruṇasaṃnibhāḥ | vichinnā lohitā hrasvā vivarṇāś ca śubhāvahāḥ ||
meaning: स्निग्धामलजलप्रख्या दर्पणाभास् च पूजिताः । बभ्रवः परुषा रुक्षा हरिद्रारुणसंनिभाः । विछिन्ना लोहिता ह्रस्वा विवर्णाश् च शुभावहाः ॥
text_mt: glossy, appearing like clear water, and shining like mirrors are auspicious; / tawny, harsh, rough, looking like turmeric or dawn, / broken, red, short, and pale bring good fortune.

sanskrit_iast: yāyināṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ ca tathaivākrandasāriṇām | pariveṣān vijānīyād bāhyābhyantaramadhyataḥ ||
meaning: यायिनां स्थावराणां च तथैवाक्रन्दसारिणाम् । परिवेषान् विजानीयाद् बाह्याभ्यन्तरमध्यतः ॥
text_mt: For marching kings, stationary kings, and likewise allies who come to aid, / one should understand the halos according to the outer, inner, and middle positions.

sanskrit_iast: saṃraktaśyāmakaluṣo yeṣāṃ bhāgo hataprabhaḥ | teṣāṃ parājayaṃ vidyāt snigdhe śvete ca vai jayaḥ ||
meaning: संरक्तश्यामकलुषो येषां भागो हतप्रभः । तेषां पराजयं विद्यात् स्निग्धे श्वेते च वै जयः ॥
text_mt: Those whose portion is deeply red, dark, turbid, and bereft of luster— / one should know their defeat; when glossy and white, there is indeed victory.

sanskrit_iast: yenayenābhravarṇena yoyo bhāgo 'nurajyate | tattat teṣāṃ phalaṃ vidyāt tad bhūtyādiṣu kīrtitam ||
meaning: येनयेनाभ्रवर्णेन योयो भागो ऽनुरज्यते । तत्तत् तेषां फलं विद्यात् तद् भूत्यादिषु कीर्तितम् ॥
text_mt: By whichever cloud-color whichever portion is tinted, / one should know that corresponding result for them; that has been proclaimed in prosperity and the like.

sanskrit_iast: chidrāṇy etāny ataś cāhur mahānti vimalāni ca | tair dvāraiḥ pārthivo yāyāt panthānas te vikaṇṭakāḥ ||
meaning: छिद्राण्य् एतान्य् अतश् चाहुर् महान्ति विमलानि च । तैर् द्वारैः पार्थिवो यायात् पन्थानस् ते विकण्टकाः ॥
text_mt: And they call these openings large and pure; / the king should march through those doors: those paths are free of thorns.

sanskrit_iast: kālāmbudaparisrāvair grahodayanimittakam | ityarthaṃ janma sarveṣāṃ śeṣam utpātalakṣaṇam ||
meaning: कालाम्बुदपरिस्रावैर् ग्रहोदयनिमित्तकम् । इत्यर्थं जन्म सर्वेषां शेषम् उत्पातलक्षणम् ॥
text_mt: Caused by the rising of planets during the downpours of monsoon clouds— / for this reason is the origin of them all; the rest is the sign of portents.

sanskrit_iast: raudrī sadakṣiṇā śāntir utpāteṣu prakīrtitā | samuccaye tu vijñeyā vaiśvadevy abhayā tathā ||
meaning: रौद्री सदक्षिणा शान्तिर् उत्पातेषु प्रकीर्तिता । समुच्चये तु विज्ञेया वैश्वदेव्य् अभया तथा ॥
text_mt: A propitiatory rite to Rudra, with sacrificial fee, is prescribed for portents; / in combination, however, a rite to the Viśvedevas and a fear-dispelling rite are to be recognized.

sanskrit_iast: atharvotpātahṛdayaṃ jñātvā svayam anāturaḥ | prayuñjīta mahāśāntiṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśinīm ||
meaning: अथर्वोत्पातहृदयं ज्ञात्वा स्वयम् अनातुरः । प्रयुञ्जीत महाशान्तिं सर्वकल्मषनाशिनीम् ॥
text_mt: Knowing the heart of Atharvan portents, undisturbed oneself, / one should perform the great propitiatory rite that destroys all taint.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ yān provācāṅgirāḥ pūrvaṃ yāṃśca vedo 'śanāḥ kaviḥ | tān ahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi utpātāṃs trividhān api ||
meaning: ओं यान् प्रोवाचाङ्गिराः पूर्वं यांश्च वेदो ऽशनाः कविः । तान् अहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि उत्पातांस् त्रिविधान् अपि ॥
text_mt: Om. Those which Aṅgiras proclaimed of old, and which Uśanas the sage knows— / those three kinds of portents I shall fully declare.

sanskrit_iast: prakṛter anyathābhavo yatrayatropajāyate | tatratatra vijānīyāt sarvam utpātalakṣaṇam ||
meaning: प्रकृतेर् अन्यथाभवो यत्रयत्रोपजायते । तत्रतत्र विजानीयात् सर्वम् उत्पातलक्षणम् ॥
text_mt: Wherever an alteration of normal nature arises, / in every such case one should recognize the sign of a portent.

sanskrit_iast: pārthivaṃ cāntarikṣaṃ ca divyaṃ cotpātalakṣaṇam | nakṣatropadraveṣūktaṃ yathāvidhi tathaiva tat ||
meaning: पार्थिवं चान्तरिक्षं च दिव्यं चोत्पातलक्षणम् । नक्षत्रोपद्रवेषूक्तं यथाविधि तथैव तत् ॥
text_mt: The characteristics of portents are earthly, atmospheric, and celestial; / as declared during afflictions of the lunar mansions, in just that manner it stands according to rule.

sanskrit_iast: teṣūtpātagaṇeṣu āhū rasātalasamudbhavān | nirghātān bhūmikampāṃś ca kīrtyamānān nibodhata ||
meaning: तेषूत्पातगणेषु आहू रसातलसमुद्भवान् । निर्घातान् भूमिकम्पांश् च कीर्त्यमानान् निबोधत ॥
text_mt: Among those hosts of portents, hear spoken of those arising from the underworld: / thunderclaps without rain and earthquakes.

sanskrit_iast: vāruṇāgneyavāyavyāḥ kampayanti vasuṃdharām | śubhāśubhārthaṃ lokānāṃ rātrau ahani cakravat ||
meaning: वारुणाग्नेयवायव्याः कम्पयन्ति वसुंधराम् । शुभाशुभार्थं लोकानां रात्रौ अहनि चक्रवत् ॥
text_mt: Earthquakes of Varuṇa, Agni, and Vāyu shake the earth / for the good and ill of creatures, by night and day, like a wheel.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi kampānāṃ lakṣaṇāni phalāni ca | yatrovācāuśanāḥ khyātān nāradāya sma pṛcchate ||
meaning: तेषां वक्ष्यामि कम्पानां लक्षणानि फलानि च । यत्रोवाचाउशनाः ख्यातान् नारदाय स्म पृच्छते ॥
text_mt: I shall declare their earthquake characteristics and results, / wherein the famous Uśanas spoke to Nārada who questioned him.

sanskrit_iast: saptāhābhyantare kampe bhaved vajradharātmake | sasvanair āptaparyantaṃ svastikābhraghanair nabhaḥ ||
meaning: सप्ताहाभ्यन्तरे कम्पे भवेद् वज्रधरात्मके । सस्वनैर् आप्तपर्यन्तं स्वस्तिकाभ्रघनैर् नभः ॥
text_mt: Within seven days, during an earthquake of Indra's nature, / the sky becomes filled to its edges with resounding swastika-shaped clouds,

sanskrit_iast: saindracāpāyudhā kampād vidyudgaṇagavākṣakaiḥ | pāśorminagarākārair naganāganibhair ghanaiḥ ||
meaning: सैन्द्रचापायुधा कम्पाद् विद्युद्गणगवाक्षकैः । पाशोर्मिनगराकारैर् नगनागनिभैर् घनैः ॥
text_mt: armed with rainbows from the quake, with cloud-apertures of lightning flashes, / with clouds resembling nooses, waves, and cities, resembling mountains and elephants.

sanskrit_iast: nabhaso 'ntaṃ ca sevinyo vidyutaḥ svārkasaṃnibhāḥ | prānte susaṃvṛtāś cāpi śītāśītāś ca mārutāḥ ||
meaning: नभसो ऽन्तं च सेविन्यो विद्युतः स्वार्कसंनिभाः । प्रान्ते सुसंवृताश् चापि शीताशीताश् च मारुताः ॥
text_mt: And lightnings resembling their own suns reach the edge of the sky; / at the horizon winds are well enclosed, cold and non-cold.

sanskrit_iast: dhārāṅkuraparisrāvair nīlotpaladalaprabhaiḥ | svanadbhiś chādyate vyoma kampayed varuṇaḥ svayam ||
meaning: धाराङ्कुरपरिस्रावैर् नीलोत्पलदलप्रभैः । स्वनद्भिश् छाद्यते व्योम कम्पयेद् वरुणः स्वयम् ॥
text_mt: When the sky is covered with streams of pouring torrents, resembling blue lotus petals / and thundering, Varuṇa himself shakes [the earth].

sanskrit_iast: tārāpātair diśaṃ dāhair ulkāpātaiś ca sasvanaiḥ | hāhākṛtam ivābhūti pradīpitapathaṃ nabhaḥ ||
meaning: तारापातैर् दिशं दाहैर् उल्कापातैश् च सस्वनैः । हाहाकृतम् इवाभूति प्रदीपितपथं नभः ॥
text_mt: With falling stars, burning of the quarters, and sounding meteor falls, / the sky, its paths ablaze, becomes as if wailing in despair.

sanskrit_iast: saptāhābhyantare vāpi kṣitau vahniḥ prakupyate | sa āgneyo bhavet kampo rājarāṣtrabhayāvahaḥ ||
meaning: सप्ताहाभ्यन्तरे वापि क्षितौ वह्निः प्रकुप्यते । स आग्नेयो भवेत् कम्पो राजराष्त्रभयावहः ॥
text_mt: Or within seven days fire breaks out upon the earth; / that is an Agni-earthquake, bringing danger to king and realm.

sanskrit_iast: niḥprakāśam ivākāśe bhāskaro nātibhāskaraḥ | diśas tu na prakāśante duḥkhāṛtā iva yoṣitaḥ ||
meaning: निःप्रकाशम् इवाकाशे भास्करो नातिभास्करः । दिशस् तु न प्रकाशन्ते दुःखाऋता इव योषितः ॥
text_mt: The sun is as if devoid of light in the sky, not very bright; / and the quarters do not shine, like women stricken with grief.

sanskrit_iast: saghoṣā mārutā rūkṣā vānti śarkarakarṣiṇaḥ | saptāhābhyantare kampe mārute 'tibhayāvahe ||
meaning: सघोषा मारुता रूक्षा वान्ति शर्करकर्षिणः । सप्ताहाभ्यन्तरे कम्पे मारुते ऽतिभयावहे ॥
text_mt: Harsh, noisy winds blow, dragging along gravel: / within seven days, in a wind-earthquake bringing immense danger.

sanskrit_iast: subhikṣakṣemadau kampau vijñeyāv aindravāruṇau | vāyavyāgneyajau kampau rājarāṣtrabhayāvahau ||
meaning: सुभिक्षक्षेमदौ कम्पौ विज्ञेयाव् ऐन्द्रवारुणौ । वायव्याग्नेयजौ कम्पौ राजराष्त्रभयावहौ ॥
text_mt: Earthquakes belonging to Indra and Varuṇa are known to bestow abundance of food and safety; / earthquakes arising from Vāyu and Agni bring danger to the king and kingdom.

sanskrit_iast: yasyāṃ yasyāṃ diśi dharā virauti vikṛtasvarā | tasyāṃ tasyāṃ diśi bhayṃ sārdhaṃ syād adhikāridbhiḥ ||
meaning: यस्यां यस्यां दिशि धरा विरौति विकृतस्वरा । तस्यां तस्यां दिशि भय्ं सार्धं स्याद् अधिकारिद्भिः ॥
text_mt: In whichever quarter the earth cries out with an unnatural sound, / in that quarter there is danger along with the governing officials.

sanskrit_iast: nirghātā bhūmikampāś ca sasamāsam udāhṛtāḥ | ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śeṣam utpātalakṣaṇam ||
meaning: निर्घाता भूमिकम्पाश् च ससमासम् उदाहृताः । अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि शेषम् उत्पातलक्षणम् ॥
text_mt: Meteoric crashes and earthquakes have thus been declared in brief. / Hereafter I shall declare the remaining characteristics of portents:

sanskrit_iast: prāgyāmyāparasaumyānāṃ gandharvanagaraṃ tathā | raktapītāśitaiś caiva varṇair dikṣu pradṛśyate ||
meaning: प्राग्याम्यापरसौम्यानां गन्धर्वनगरं तथा । रक्तपीताशितैश् चैव वर्णैर् दिक्षु प्रदृश्यते ॥
text_mt: When a city of the Gandharvas is seen in the quarters of the east, south, west, and north, / appearing in the quarters with red, yellow, and black colors,

sanskrit_iast: rājñaḥ senāpateś cāpi yuvarājapurodhasām | vyasanaṃ maraṇaṃ vāpi vijñeyam anupūrvaśaḥ ||
meaning: राज्ञः सेनापतेश् चापि युवराजपुरोधसाम् । व्यसनं मरणं वापि विज्ञेयम् अनुपूर्वशः ॥
text_mt: misfortune or even death is to be known, in order, / for the king, the commander of the army, the crown prince, and the royal priests.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇāmāṇ ca bhayaṃ jñeyaṃ yathāvarṇaparigrahāt | vidikṣu ca vivarṇāsu pīḍā jñeyā vivarṇinām ||
meaning: वरुणामाण् च भयं ज्ञेयं यथावर्णपरिग्रहात् । विदिक्षु च विवर्णासु पीडा ज्ञेया विवर्णिनाम् ॥
text_mt: Danger to the classes is to be known from the assumption of the respective colors; / and when the intermediate quarters lose their color, affliction of color-lacking people is to be known.

sanskrit_iast: satataṃ dṛśyamāne ca rājarāṣṭrabhayāvaham | āśādhikārikāṇāṃ ca pīḍā jñeyā yathāvidhi ||
meaning: सततं दृश्यमाने च राजराष्ट्रभयावहम् । आशाधिकारिकाणां च पीडा ज्ञेया यथाविधि ॥
text_mt: When it is seen continuously, it brings danger to the king and kingdom; / and affliction of the guardians of the quarters is to be known according to rule.

sanskrit_iast: viruddhayonigamanam anyasattvaprasūtayaḥ | hastapādākṣiśirasām adhikānāṃ pradarśanam ||
meaning: विरुद्धयोनिगमनम् अन्यसत्त्वप्रसूतयः । हस्तपादाक्षिशिरसाम् अधिकानां प्रदर्शनम् ॥
text_mt: Mating in contrary wombs, offspring born of different kinds of beings, / the appearance of redundant hands, feet, eyes, or heads,

sanskrit_iast: abhyaṅgatā ca saṃyoge gatihīnaṃ ca ceṣṭitam | viruddhānāṃ ca sattvānām anyonyapratisaṃgamam ||
meaning: अभ्यङ्गता च संयोगे गतिहीनं च चेष्टितम् । विरुद्धानां च सत्त्वानाम् अन्योन्यप्रतिसंगमम् ॥
text_mt: anointedness during union, movement lacking motion, / and mutual coupling among discordant creatures,

sanskrit_iast: calatvam acalānāṃ ca calānām acalakṛyā | bhāṣitaṃ cāpi abhāṣāṇām aśabdānāṃ ca bhāṣaṇam ||
meaning: चलत्वम् अचलानां च चलानाम् अचलकृया । भाषितं चापि अभाषाणाम् अशब्दानां च भाषणम् ॥
text_mt: movement of immovable things, and cessation of motion of moving things, / speaking by the speechless, and speech uttered without sound,

sanskrit_iast: anagnau darśanaṃ cāgneḥ śītoṣṇasya viparyayaḥ | lohādīnāṃ plavaś cāpsu nodake cāmbhasāṃ sravaḥ ||
meaning: अनग्नौ दर्शनं चाग्नेः शीतोष्णस्य विपर्ययः । लोहादीनां प्लवश् चाप्सु नोदके चाम्भसां स्रवः ॥
text_mt: the appearance of fire where there is no fire, inversion of cold and heat, / floating of iron and other heavy objects upon water, and flow of water where there is no water,

sanskrit_iast: akālapuṣpaprasavaḥ sasyāḥ pañcacaturguṇāha | saṃyogo lāṅgalānāṃ ca prabhānāṃ ceṣṭitāni ca ||
meaning: अकालपुष्पप्रसवः सस्याः पञ्चचतुर्गुणाह । संयोगो लाङ्गलानां च प्रभानां चेष्टितानि च ॥
text_mt: unseasonal blossoming and fruiting, crops yielding four or fivefold, / joining of plows, and unusual movements of rays of light,

sanskrit_iast: vicitrair devatāsadbhir vṛkṣaprasravaṇāni ca | diśo dhūmāndhakārāś ca dīptāś ca mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ ||
meaning: विचित्रैर् देवतासद्भिर् वृक्षप्रस्रवणानि च । दिशो धूमान्धकाराश् च दीप्ताश् च मृगपक्षिणः ॥
text_mt: oozing of trees with strange divine seats, / the quarters filled with smoky darkness, and burning beasts and birds,

sanskrit_iast: rajastamāśritaṃ vyoma kaluṣau candrabhāskarau | vastramāṃsāmbhasāṃ dīptirāgaprajvalitāni ca ||
meaning: रजस्तमाश्रितं व्योम कलुषौ चन्द्रभास्करौ । वस्त्रमांसाम्भसां दीप्तिरागप्रज्वलितानि च ॥
text_mt: the sky enveloped in dust and darkness, the moon and sun turbid, / and garments, meat, and water inflamed with fiery glow,

sanskrit_iast: akasmād gopurāṭṭālaśailaprasādaveśmanām | daraṇaṃ jvalanaṃ vāpi kampo dhūmapravartanam ||
meaning: अकस्माद् गोपुराट्टालशैलप्रसादवेश्मनाम् । दरणं ज्वलनं वापि कम्पो धूमप्रवर्तनम् ॥
text_mt: sudden cracking, burning, / shaking, or emission of smoke from city gates, watchtowers, hills, palaces, and dwellings,

sanskrit_iast: abhīkṣṇā mārutāś caṇḍā vānti śarkarakarṣiṇaḥ | saṃhitā maṇḍalānāṃ ca nīlalohitapītakāḥ ||
meaning: अभीक्ष्णा मारुताश् चण्डा वान्ति शर्करकर्षिणः । संहिता मण्डलानां च नीललोहितपीतकाः ॥
text_mt: frequent, fierce winds blowing, sweeping along gravel, / and dark-blue, red, and yellow conjunctions of halos,

sanskrit_iast: dhvajastambhendrakīlānāṃ śuṣkacaityādibhiḥ saha | chinne bhinne drumāṇāṃ ca skandhaśākhāṅkurodbhavaḥ ||
meaning: ध्वजस्तम्भेन्द्रकीलानां शुष्कचैत्यादिभिः सह । छिन्ने भिन्ने द्रुमाणां च स्कन्धशाखाङ्कुरोद्भवः ॥
text_mt: falling of flagpoles and Indra's posts together with dry sacred shrines, / and the sprouting of trunks and branches on trees cut down or split,

sanskrit_iast: gītānāṃ ca mṛdaṅgānāṃ vāditrāṇāṃ nisvanāḥ | bhaveyur ākāśapathe sagandharvapurogamāḥ ||
meaning: गीतानां च मृदङ्गानां वादित्राणां निस्वनाः । भवेयुर् आकाशपथे सगन्धर्वपुरोगमाः ॥
text_mt: sounds of songs, drums, and musical instruments / occurring in the path of the sky, led by Gandharvas,

sanskrit_iast: chāyādarśanam adravye virātre virutāni ca | divārātricarāṇāṃ ca viparītapracāratā ||
meaning: छायादर्शनम् अद्रव्ये विरात्रे विरुतानि च । दिवारात्रिचराणां च विपरीतप्रचारता ॥
text_mt: appearance of shadows without an object, cries in the dead of night, / and reversed conduct of diurnal and nocturnal creatures,

sanskrit_iast: nirabhravṛṣṭayaś caiva nirabhrastanitāni ca | sasvanānām adhūmānām ulkānāṃ patanaṃ divā ||
meaning: निरभ्रवृष्टयश् चैव निरभ्रस्तनितानि च । सस्वनानाम् अधूमानाम् उल्कानां पतनं दिवा ॥
text_mt: rains without clouds, thunderings without clouds, / and daytime falling of noisy, smokeless meteors,

sanskrit_iast: indor arkasya vā cāpi pāṃsvaśmādiṣu darśanam | abhīkṣṇapariveṣāśca kaluśā ravisomayoḥ ||
meaning: इन्दोर् अर्कस्य वा चापि पांस्वश्मादिषु दर्शनम् । अभीक्ष्णपरिवेषाश्च कलुशा रविसोमयोः ॥
text_mt: appearance of the moon or sun in dust, stones, and the like, / and frequent turbid halos around the sun and moon,

sanskrit_iast: mayūrakokilādīnāṃ madāvāptir anārtavā | vanānāṃ ca nagānāṃ ca devatānāṃ ca nirgamāḥ ||
meaning: मयूरकोकिलादीनां मदावाप्तिर् अनार्तवा । वनानां च नगानां च देवतानां च निर्गमाः ॥
text_mt: unseasonal onset of rut among peacocks, cuckoos, and the like, / and departures of forests, mountains, and deities,

sanskrit_iast: āraṇyānāṃ ca sattvānāṃ puragrāmaniveśanam | abhūtānāṃ pravṛtiśca pravṛttānāṃ ca nāśanam ||
meaning: आरण्यानां च सत्त्वानां पुरग्रामनिवेशनम् । अभूतानां प्रवृतिश्च प्रवृत्तानां च नाशनम् ॥
text_mt: entry of wild animals into cities and villages, / the occurrence of non-existent things, and the destruction of existing things:

sanskrit_iast: etad utpātajaṃ rājño yasyā deśe abhyudīryate | tasya deśo vinaśyeta kṣīyate ca sapārthivaḥ ||
meaning: एतद् उत्पातजं राज्ञो यस्या देशे अभ्युदीर्यते । तस्य देशो विनश्येत क्षीयते च सपार्थिवः ॥
text_mt: in whatever king's country such an omen-born event arises, / his realm will perish and the ruler will be ruined.

sanskrit_iast: tyajanti vāpi yaṃ deśaṃ pāṣaṇḍā dvijadevatāḥ | vidveṣaṃ vāpi gacchanti so 'pi deśo vinaśyati ||
meaning: त्यजन्ति वापि यं देशं पाषण्डा द्विजदेवताः । विद्वेषं वापि गच्छन्ति सो ऽपि देशो विनश्यति ॥
text_mt: Or whatever country the heretics, twice-born, and gods abandon, / or turn against with enmity, that country too perishes.

sanskrit_iast: nartanaṃ ca kuśūlānāṃ dhānyarāśeśca kampanam | ulūkhālānāṃ saṃsarpo musalānāṃ praveśanam ||
meaning: नर्तनं च कुशूलानां धान्यराशेश्च कम्पनम् । उलूखालानां संसर्पो मुसलानां प्रवेशनम् ॥
text_mt: Dancing of grain-granaries, trembling of heaps of corn, / creeping of mortars, entering of pestles,

sanskrit_iast: ceṣṭitaṃ rājadarvīṇāṃ mṛdbhāṇḍānāṃ tathaiva ca | dahanaṃ caiva śītānām śabdā hy uttarāṇi ca ||
meaning: चेष्टितं राजदर्वीणां मृद्भाण्डानां तथैव च । दहनं चैव शीतानाम् शब्दा ह्य् उत्तराणि च ॥
text_mt: movement of royal ladles and earthenware pots, / burning of cold objects, and noises in the north,

sanskrit_iast: purīṣabhakṣaṇaṃcaiva dīnānāṃ mṛgapakṣiṇām | grāmyāṇāṃ dīnavapuṣāṃ pradhānyastanitāni ca ||
meaning: पुरीषभक्षणंचैव दीनानां मृगपक्षिणाम् । ग्राम्याणां दीनवपुषां प्रधान्यस्तनितानि च ॥
text_mt: feces-eating by miserable beasts and birds, / and thundering of prominent domestic animals with wretched frames,

sanskrit_iast: vālukāṅgāradhānyānāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ vāpi vṛṣṭayaḥ | puradvāre ca bakavad vāyasānāṃ ca ceṣṭitam ||
meaning: वालुकाङ्गारधान्यानां भक्षणं वापि वृष्टयः । पुरद्वारे च बकवद् वायसानां च चेष्टितम् ॥
text_mt: eating of sand, charcoal, or grain, or raining thereof, / and behavior of crows like egrets at the city gate,

sanskrit_iast: biḍālamatsyamajjānāṃ jantūnāṃ kṣudrasaṃjñinām | anyonyabhakṣaṇāni syur ekasaṃsthāśca rātrayaḥ ||
meaning: बिडालमत्स्यमज्जानां जन्तूनां क्षुद्रसंज्ञिनाम् । अन्योन्यभक्षणानि स्युर् एकसंस्थाश्च रात्रयः ॥
text_mt: cats, fish, and bone marrow being mutually eaten / by wretched creatures, and nights prolonged into one,

sanskrit_iast: māṃsasasyānnavidveṣaḥ kriyāvyuparamas tathā | yasmin deśe pradṛśyante tasmin kṣudbhayam ādiśet ||
meaning: मांससस्यान्नविद्वेषः क्रियाव्युपरमस् तथा । यस्मिन् देशे प्रदृश्यन्ते तस्मिन् क्षुद्भयम् आदिशेत् ॥
text_mt: aversion to meat, grain, and cooked food, and the cessation of rites: / in whatever land these are seen, one should predict danger of famine.

sanskrit_iast: śastrajvalanasaṃsarpaḥ sthūṇīsaraṇapūraṇam | chattravastradhvajānāṃ ca valmīkeṣu pradarśanam ||
meaning: शस्त्रज्वलनसंसर्पः स्थूणीसरणपूरणम् । छत्त्रवस्त्रध्वजानां च वल्मीकेषु प्रदर्शनम् ॥
text_mt: Flaring and crawling of weapons, running and filling of quivers, / and appearance of umbrellas, garments, and banners on ant-hills,

sanskrit_iast: arke abhraparighādīnāṃ pariveṣo arkacandrayoḥ | lākṣālohitavarṇatvaṃ sarveṣāṃ ca vicāraṇam ||
meaning: अर्के अभ्रपरिघादीनां परिवेषो अर्कचन्द्रयोः । लाक्षालोहितवर्णत्वं सर्वेषां च विचारणम् ॥
text_mt: a halo of cloud-bars and the like at the sun, a halo at the sun and moon, / lacquer-red coloration, and trembling of all [celestial bodies],

sanskrit_iast: tvacmāṃsarudhirāsthīnāṃ medomajjāsthivṛṣṭayaḥ | nirabhravṛṣṭayaścāsya rajatakṣatasaprabham ||
meaning: त्वच्मांसरुधिरास्थीनां मेदोमज्जास्थिवृष्टयः । निरभ्रवृष्टयश्चास्य रजतक्षतसप्रभम् ॥
text_mt: rains of skin, flesh, blood, bone, fat, marrow, and skeletons, / rains without clouds, and rays like silver and wounds,

sanskrit_iast: praghātākampanirghātāvidyutā cābhrapātanam | bhavecca devatādīnāṃ śiroabhiṣṭhānavarjanam ||
meaning: प्रघाताकम्पनिर्घाताविद्युता चाभ्रपातनम् । भवेच्च देवतादीनां शिरोअभिष्ठानवर्जनम् ॥
text_mt: strokes, earthquakes, meteoric crashes, lightning, and falling of clouds, / and missing of heads and pedestal-bases of deities,

sanskrit_iast: strīṇāṃ nṛṇāṃ ca prasavaṃ tṛṇādīnāṃ ca mānuṣam | amānuṣāṇāṃ sattvānāṃ bhāṣitāni manuṣyavat ||
meaning: स्त्रीणां नृणां च प्रसवं तृणादीनां च मानुषम् । अमानुषाणां सत्त्वानां भाषितानि मनुष्यवत् ॥
text_mt: human births from women, men, grass, and the like, / and inhuman creatures speaking like human beings,

sanskrit_iast: vasāśoṇitagandhatvaṃ gajadaivatavājinām | yasmin deśe bhavet tasmin śastrakopabhayaṃ mahat ||
meaning: वसाशोणितगन्धत्वं गजदैवतवाजिनाम् । यस्मिन् देशे भवेत् तस्मिन् शस्त्रकोपभयं महत् ॥
text_mt: the smell of fat and blood in elephants, deities, and horses: / in whatever country this occurs, there will be great danger from the wrath of weapons.

sanskrit_iast: śoṇitāśruparisrāvāḥ prahāsodvīkṣaṇakriyā | nṛtyavāditragītāni sākrośābhāṣitāni ca ||
meaning: शोणिताश्रुपरिस्रावाः प्रहासोद्वीक्षणक्रिया । नृत्यवादित्रगीतानि साक्रोशाभाषितानि च ॥
text_mt: Discharges of blood and tears, laughing and looking upward, / dancing, instrumental music, singing, and abusive speech,

sanskrit_iast: prakampanaṃ devatānāṃ tathaiva jvalanāni ca | apāṃ śoṣavikārāśca ceṣṭitaṃ ca manuṣyavat ||
meaning: प्रकम्पनं देवतानां तथैव ज्वलनानि च । अपां शोषविकाराश्च चेष्टितं च मनुष्यवत् ॥
text_mt: shaking of deities and their burning, / drying up and alterations of waters, and behaving like human beings,

sanskrit_iast: daraṇaṃ rasanaṃ rājño vaikṛtyodvartanāni ca | kṣiteḥ kampaprahāsāśca rodanotkrośāani ca ||
meaning: दरणं रसनं राज्ञो वैकृत्योद्वर्तनानि च । क्षितेः कम्पप्रहासाश्च रोदनोत्क्रोशाअनि च ॥
text_mt: cracking, roaring, unnatural states, and rolling about of the king, / and shaking, laughing, weeping, and shouting of the earth,

sanskrit_iast: pīṭhikāvyañjanaṃ chattramśasatrakīlakamaṇḍalau | nīlāṅgalohitatalau udye arkaniśāakarau ||
meaning: पीठिकाव्यञ्जनं छत्त्रम्शसत्रकीलकमण्डलौ । नीलाङ्गलोहिततलौ उद्ये अर्कनिशाअकरौ ॥
text_mt: alteration of the pedestal, umbrella, weapon, bolt, and water pot, / the sun and moon having blue bodies and red surfaces at dawn,

sanskrit_iast: candrārkolkāprabhedāśca bhāskarendudvayaṃ tathā | pratisrotavahā nadya iṣavaḥ pratikomagāḥ ||
meaning: चन्द्रार्कोल्काप्रभेदाश्च भास्करेन्दुद्वयं तथा । प्रतिस्रोतवहा नद्य इषवः प्रतिकोमगाः ॥
text_mt: fissuring of the sun, moon, and meteors, and a double sun and moon, / rivers flowing upstream, and arrows flying backwards,

sanskrit_iast: dantabhaṅgāḥ sakūrmāśca naravarṇavājinām | chattrabhaṅgāḥ sakūrmāśca naravāraṇavājinām ||
meaning: दन्तभङ्गाः सकूर्माश्च नरवर्णवाजिनाम् । छत्त्रभङ्गाः सकूर्माश्च नरवारणवाजिनाम् ॥
text_mt: broken teeth and tortoise-marks among men, colored horses, and chargers, / broken umbrellas and tortoise-marks among men, elephants, and chargers,

sanskrit_iast: māṃsatailavipākaśca caityatailaparisravāḥ | śakradhvajapatākānāṃ bhaṅgakravyadasvanam ||
meaning: मांसतैलविपाकश्च चैत्यतैलपरिस्रवाः । शक्रध्वजपताकानां भङ्गक्रव्यदस्वनम् ॥
text_mt: the cooking of meat and oil, oozing of oil from sacred shrines, / breaking of Indra's banner and flags, and the howling of carrion-eaters,

sanskrit_iast: biḍalolūkyor yuddhaṃ nṛpaprāsādasaṃnidhau | pāṃsunā cāvṛtaṃ vyoma rajasā tamasāpi vā ||
meaning: बिडलोलूक्योर् युद्धं नृपप्रासादसंनिधौ । पांसुना चावृतं व्योम रजसा तमसापि वा ॥
text_mt: fighting between a cat and an owl near the king's palace, / and the sky enveloped in dust, pollen, or darkness,

sanskrit_iast: lohitāgniprabhākāśaṃ dīptā dvijamṛgas tathā | vātāvartās tusaṃdhyāsu prasphuranto apasavyagāḥ ||
meaning: लोहिताग्निप्रभाकाशं दीप्ता द्विजमृगस् तथा । वातावर्तास् तुसंध्यासु प्रस्फुरन्तो अपसव्यगाः ॥
text_mt: the sky glowing with red fire, birds and beasts inflamed, / and whirlwinds flashing at twilights, moving counterclockwise,

sanskrit_iast: maṇḍalāni samājāśca sarvato mṛgapakṣiṇām | kravyādair ārasadbhiśca vyākulāḥ sarvato diśaḥ ||
meaning: मण्डलानि समाजाश्च सर्वतो मृगपक्षिणाम् । क्रव्यादैर् आरसद्भिश्च व्याकुलाः सर्वतो दिशः ॥
text_mt: circles and gatherings of beasts and birds on all sides, / and all the quarters confounded by shrieking carnivores,

sanskrit_iast: trirātrād aparaṃ vṛṣṭiḥ pranaṣṭendudivākarau | anṛtau cāpi dṛśyeta ghorastanitadīrghatā ||
meaning: त्रिरात्राद् अपरं वृष्टिः प्रनष्टेन्दुदिवाकरौ । अनृतौ चापि दृश्येत घोरस्तनितदीर्घता ॥
text_mt: rain continuing beyond three nights, the sun and moon disappeared, / and protracted, terrifying thunder seen out of season,

sanskrit_iast: vajrādayo rāhuputrā vṛkṣāḥ śakunayas tathā | maṇḍalābhyantarasthāśca bhavanti ravisomayoḥ ||
meaning: वज्रादयो राहुपुत्रा वृक्षाः शकुनयस् तथा । मण्डलाभ्यन्तरस्थाश्च भवन्ति रविसोमयोः ॥
text_mt: Vajra and other sons of Rāhu, trees, and birds / appearing inside the disks of the sun and moon,

sanskrit_iast: ākāśe vā pradṛśyante prakampanti va parvatāḥ | viṣyeta ravisomau ca ābhīkṣaṃ tārakās tathā ||
meaning: आकाशे वा प्रदृश्यन्ते प्रकम्पन्ति व पर्वताः । विष्येत रविसोमौ च आभीक्षं तारकास् तथा ॥
text_mt: seen in the sky, or mountains trembling, / the sun and moon afflicted, and stars continually [falling]—

sanskrit_iast: naradanaṃ ca biḍālāṇāṃ kṣīravṛkṣaniṣevaṇam | kharair dīptair ulūkaiśca rasadbhiḥ saha vigrahaḥ ||
meaning: नरदनं च बिडालाणां क्षीरवृक्षनिषेवणम् । खरैर् दीप्तैर् उलूकैश्च रसद्भिः सह विग्रहः ॥
text_mt: The human-like crying of cats, their frequenting of milk-trees, / and conflict with inflamed donkeys and shrieking owls;

sanskrit_iast: siṃhāsanāni chattrāṇi bhṛṅgārāḥ śayanās tathā | kampanti akasmād bhajyante saṃsarpanti ārasanti ca ||
meaning: सिंहासनानि छत्त्राणि भृङ्गाराः शयनास् तथा । कम्पन्ति अकस्माद् भज्यन्ते संसर्पन्ति आरसन्ति च ॥
text_mt: Thrones, parasols, water jars, and beds / tremble, suddenly break, slide about, and screech.

sanskrit_iast: rājñāṃ bhayakaraṃ sarvam etad utpātalakṣaṇam | deśasya ca vijānīyād gargasya vacanaṃ yathā ||
meaning: राज्ञां भयकरं सर्वम् एतद् उत्पातलक्षणम् । देशस्य च विजानीयाद् गर्गस्य वचनं यथा ॥
text_mt: All this is the sign of portents that causes fear to kings / and to the land, as stated by Garga.

sanskrit_iast: saṃdhyādaṇḍapariveṣā rajoarkaparighādayaḥ | maṇḍalānāṃ samūhāśca dikṣu pītāruṇaprabhāḥ ||
meaning: संध्यादण्डपरिवेषा रजोअर्कपरिघादयः । मण्डलानां समूहाश्च दिक्षु पीतारुणप्रभाः ॥
text_mt: Twilight shafts, halos, dust, solar bars, and the like, / and clusters of discs in the quarters shining yellow and reddish;

sanskrit_iast: kravyādā vānarā dvāri visphūrjanti ārasanti ca | tuṇḍaiśca vāyasā bhūmiṃ kuṭṭayanto ramanti ca ||
meaning: क्रव्यादा वानरा द्वारि विस्फूर्जन्ति आरसन्ति च । तुण्डैश्च वायसा भूमिं कुट्टयन्तो रमन्ति च ॥
text_mt: Carnivores and monkeys flash, thunder, and roar at the gateway, / and crows, striking the earth with their beaks, sport about;

sanskrit_iast: mlāyate mālyam atyarthaṃ gandhāḥ kuṇapagandhinaḥ | vastreṣu bhakṣabhojyeṣu bhavati utpātalakṣaṇam ||
meaning: म्लायते माल्यम् अत्यर्थं गन्धाः कुणपगन्धिनः । वस्त्रेषु भक्षभोज्येषु भवति उत्पातलक्षणम् ॥
text_mt: Garlands wither excessively, perfumes smell of corpses— / on garments, foods, and snacks, this is a portentous sign.

sanskrit_iast: kṣaudraṃ ghṛtaṃ ca dadhi ca prasravet prathitā drumāḥ | sārameyāḥ śmaśāneṣu rudanti viruvanti ca ||
meaning: क्षौद्रं घृतं च दधि च प्रस्रवेत् प्रथिता द्रुमाः । सारमेयाः श्मशानेषु रुदन्ति विरुवन्ति च ॥
text_mt: Honey, clarified butter, and curd flow forth from famous trees; / dogs weep and howl in cremation grounds.

sanskrit_iast: etad autpātikaṃ grāme yasmiṃś ca dṛśyate pure | tasmin grāme pure vāpi vidyād atibhayaṃ mahat ||
meaning: एतद् औत्पातिकं ग्रामे यस्मिंश् च दृश्यते पुरे । तस्मिन् ग्रामे पुरे वापि विद्याद् अतिभयं महत् ॥
text_mt: In whatever village or town this omen is seen, / one should know there will be exceedingly great danger in that village or town.

sanskrit_iast: aśvatthodumbaraplakṣanyagrodhe kusumodbhavaḥ | śvetalohitapītāni kṛṣṇānīndrāyudhāni ca ||
meaning: अश्वत्थोदुम्बरप्लक्षन्यग्रोधे कुसुमोद्भवः । श्वेतलोहितपीतानि कृष्णानीन्द्रायुधानि च ॥
text_mt: The appearance of blossoms on aśvattha, udumbara, plakṣa, and nyagrodha trees, / and white, red, yellow, and black rainbows;

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ varṇaduṇānāṃ ca patanaṃ devaveśmanām | brahmakṣatriyaviṭśūdravināśo rājasaṃvṛtām ||
meaning: एवं वर्णदुणानां च पतनं देववेश्मनाम् । ब्रह्मक्षत्रियविट्शूद्रविनाशो राजसंवृताम् ॥
text_mt: Thus the collapse of temples according to classes / destroys Brahmins, Kṣatriyas, Vaiśyas, and Śūdras, enveloped in dust.

sanskrit_iast: rūkṣasrāvā citivṛkṣe tadbhayaṃ sumahad bhavet | ghṛtakṣīraphalāśrāve ghṛtakṣīrāmbhasāṃ kṣayaḥ ||
meaning: रूक्षस्रावा चितिवृक्षे तद्भयं सुमहद् भवेत् । घृतक्षीरफलाश्रावे घृतक्षीराम्भसां क्षयः ॥
text_mt: If there is a rough discharge on a funeral-pyre tree, there will be very great danger; / if clarified butter, milk, or fruit juice discharges, there is loss of clarified butter, milk, and water.

sanskrit_iast: surāśrāve mithobhedo rudhire rāṣṭravidravaḥ | rudhire goviṣāṇācca srute gobrāhmaṇakṣayaḥ ||
meaning: सुराश्रावे मिथोभेदो रुधिरे राष्ट्रविद्रवः । रुधिरे गोविषाणाच्च स्रुते गोब्राह्मणक्षयः ॥
text_mt: When liquor oozes out, there is dissension; when blood [oozes], disaster in the realm; / and when blood drips from the horn of a cow, destruction of cattle and Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast: phale phalaṃ yadā paśyet puṣpe puṣpaṃ samāvṛtam | garbhāḥ sravanti nārīṇāṃ yuddhaṃ rājavadho api vā ||
meaning: फले फलं यदा पश्येत् पुष्पे पुष्पं समावृतम् । गर्भाः स्रवन्ति नारीणां युद्धं राजवधो अपि वा ॥
text_mt: When one sees a fruit inside a fruit, or a flower enveloped within a flower, / women miscarry, or there is war and the killing of a king.

sanskrit_iast: phaṇābhṛto mahatsarpān maṇḍūlā atha vṛścikāḥ | maṇḍūkā grasate yatra tatra rājāvahanyate ||
meaning: फणाभृतो महत्सर्पान् मण्डूला अथ वृश्चिकाः । मण्डूका ग्रसते यत्र तत्र राजावहन्यते ॥
text_mt: Where frogs or scorpions / swallow hooded serpents, great snakes, there the king is slain.

sanskrit_iast: himapātānilotpātā vikṛtādbhutadarśanam | kṛṣṇāñjanābhram ākāśaṃ tārolkāpātapiṅgalam ||
meaning: हिमपातानिलोत्पाता विकृताद्भुतदर्शनम् । कृष्णाञ्जनाभ्रम् आकाशं तारोल्कापातपिङ्गलम् ॥
text_mt: Snowfall, wind-portents, the sight of deformed monstrosities, / the sky overcast with clouds black as collyrium and tawny with shooting stars and meteors;

sanskrit_iast: citrā garbhodbhavāḥ strīṣu goajāśvamṛgapakṣiṣu | pattrāṅkuralatānāṃ ca vikārāḥ śiśire śubhāḥ ||
meaning: चित्रा गर्भोद्भवाः स्त्रीषु गोअजाश्वमृगपक्षिषु । पत्त्राङ्कुरलतानां च विकाराः शिशिरे शुभाः ॥
text_mt: Unusual births among women, cows, goats, horses, wild beasts, and birds, / and anomalies in leaves, sprouts, and creepers are auspicious in winter.

sanskrit_iast: vajrāśanimahīkampāḥ saṃdhyānirghātanisvanāḥ | pariveṣarajodhūmā raktārkāstamanodayāḥ ||
meaning: वज्राशनिमहीकम्पाः संध्यानिर्घातनिस्वनाः । परिवेषरजोधूमा रक्तार्कास्तमनोदयाः ॥
text_mt: Thunderbolts, lightning, earthquakes, twilight thunderclaps, / halos, dust, smoke, red sunrises and sunsets;

sanskrit_iast: drumebhyo annarasasnehamadhupuṣpaphalodgamāḥ | gopakṣiśabdavṛddhiśca śivāni madhumādhave ||
meaning: द्रुमेभ्यो अन्नरसस्नेहमधुपुष्पफलोद्गमाः । गोपक्षिशब्दवृद्धिश्च शिवानि मधुमाधवे ॥
text_mt: The emergence from trees of food, sap, oil, honey, flowers, and fruits, / and an increase in the cries of cows and birds are auspicious in spring.

sanskrit_iast: tārolkāpātakaluṣaṃ kapilārkendumaṇḍalam | anagnijvalanasphoṭadhūmareṇvanilāhatam ||
meaning: तारोल्कापातकलुषं कपिलार्केन्दुमण्डलम् । अनग्निज्वलनस्फोटधूमरेण्वनिलाहतम् ॥
text_mt: The discs of the sun and moon tawny, sullied by shooting stars and meteors; / non-fire burning, bursting, and stricken by smoke, dust, and wind;

sanskrit_iast: raktapītāruṇāṃ saṃdhyāṃ nabhaḥ saṃkṣubhītārṇavam | saritāṃ cāmbusaṃśoṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā grīṣme śubhaṃ vadet ||
meaning: रक्तपीतारुणां संध्यां नभः संक्षुभीतार्णवम् । सरितां चाम्बुसंशोषं दृष्ट्वा ग्रीष्मे शुभं वदेत् ॥
text_mt: Red, yellow, and tawny twilights, the sky agitated like an ocean, / and seeing the drying up of waters in rivers, one should declare auspicious in summer.

sanskrit_iast: śakrāyudhaparīveṣavidyutśuṣkavirohaṇam | akasmād varṇavaikṛtyaṃ rasanaṃ daraṇaṃ kṣiteḥ ||
meaning: शक्रायुधपरीवेषविद्युत्शुष्कविरोहणम् । अकस्माद् वर्णवैकृत्यं रसनं दरणं क्षितेः ॥
text_mt: Rainbows, halos, lightning, the sprouting of dry wood, / sudden transformation of color, rumbling, and the cracking open of the earth;

sanskrit_iast: saronadyudapānānāṃ vṛddhir vā uttaraṇaplavāḥ | taraṇaṃ cārdravegānāṃ varṣāsu na bhayāvaham ||
meaning: सरोनद्युदपानानां वृद्धिर् वा उत्तरणप्लवाः । तरणं चार्द्रवेगानां वर्षासु न भयावहम् ॥
text_mt: The swelling of lakes, rivers, and wells, or their overflowing and rising, / and traversing rapid torrents: these do not bring danger during the rains.

sanskrit_iast: divyastrīgītagandharvavimānādbhutanisvanāḥ | grahanakṣatratārāṇāṃ darśanaṃ ca divāmbare ||
meaning: दिव्यस्त्रीगीतगन्धर्वविमानाद्भुतनिस्वनाः । ग्रहनक्षत्रताराणां दर्शनं च दिवाम्बरे ॥
text_mt: The wondrous sounds of divine women's songs, Gandharvas, and celestial aerial cars, / and the sighting of planets, lunar mansions, and stars in the daytime sky;

sanskrit_iast: gītavāditranirghoṣo vanaparvatasānuṣu | sasyavṛddhī rasotpattir na pāpāḥ śaradi smṛtāḥ ||
meaning: गीतवादित्रनिर्घोषो वनपर्वतसानुषु । सस्यवृद्धी रसोत्पत्तिर् न पापाः शरदि स्मृताः ॥
text_mt: The sound of singing and musical instruments on forest and mountain slopes, / the growth of crops, and the emergence of sap are recorded as not evil in autumn.

sanskrit_iast: śītānilatuṣāratvaṃ nardanaṃ mṛgapakṣiṇām | rakṣoyakṣādisattvānāṃ darśanaṃ vāg amānuṣī ||
meaning: शीतानिलतुषारत्वं नर्दनं मृगपक्षिणाम् । रक्षोयक्षादिसत्त्वानां दर्शनं वाग् अमानुषी ॥
text_mt: Cold winds, frostiness, the roaring of wild animals and birds, / the sight of creatures such as Rakṣases and Yakṣas, non-human speech;

sanskrit_iast: dīptadhūmarajasdhvastā diṅnāgā vanaparvatāḥ | uccais toyadasomārkā hemante śobhanāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
meaning: दीप्तधूमरजस्ध्वस्ता दिङ्नागा वनपर्वताः । उच्चैस् तोयदसोमार्का हेमन्ते शोभनाः स्मृताः ॥
text_mt: Direction-elephants, forests, and mountains covered with blazing smoke and dust, / high clouds, moon, and sun are recorded as auspicious in early winter.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtusvabhāvā ete hi dṛṣṭāḥ svartau śubhapradāḥ | ṛtau anyatra ca utpātā dṛṣṭāḥ svartau śubhapradāḥ ||
meaning: ऋतुस्वभावा एते हि दृष्टाः स्वर्तौ शुभप्रदाः । ऋतौ अन्यत्र च उत्पाता दृष्टाः स्वर्तौ शुभप्रदाः ॥
text_mt: For these, being the inherent nature of the seasons, are auspicious when seen in their own season; / when seen in another season, they are portents, [yet] in their own season they bring good fortune.

sanskrit_iast: unmattānāṃ ca yā gāthā bālānāṃ ceṣṭitaṃ ca yat | striyaśca yat prabhāṣante tatra nāsti vyatikramaḥ ||
meaning: उन्मत्तानां च या गाथा बालानां चेष्टितं च यत् । स्त्रियश्च यत् प्रभाषन्ते तत्र नास्ति व्यतिक्रमः ॥
text_mt: The songs that madmen sing, the behavior of children, / and what women say: in that there is no error.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvaṃ vadati deveṣu paścād gacchati mānuṣe | nācoditā āg vadati satyā hi eṣā sarasvatī ||
meaning: पूर्वं वदति देवेषु पश्चाद् गच्छति मानुषे । नाचोदिता आग् वदति सत्या हि एषा सरस्वती ॥
text_mt: First she speaks among the gods; later she goes to humans; / unprompted speech speaks, for this Sarasvatī is truthful.

sanskrit_iast: utpātāḥ sarva eva ete kadācid rājamṛtyave | jñeyā deśavināśāya rāhor āgamanāyā vā ||
meaning: उत्पाताः सर्व एव एते कदाचिद् राजमृत्यवे । ज्ञेया देशविनाशाय राहोर् आगमनाया वा ॥
text_mt: All these portents should be understood at times to portend the king's death, / the destruction of the country, or the arrival of Rāhu;

sanskrit_iast: kālāmbudaparisrāvā grahāṇām udayāya vā | svacakraparacakrebhyo bhaye vā samupasthite ||
meaning: कालाम्बुदपरिस्रावा ग्रहाणाम् उदयाय वा । स्वचक्रपरचक्रेभ्यो भये वा समुपस्थिते ॥
text_mt: Or the torrential pour of dark storm clouds, or the rising of planets, / or when danger approaches from internal or external rebellions;

sanskrit_iast: rāṣṭre senāpatau putre pure vātha purodhasi | amātye vāhane dāre nṛpatau vā palanti ca ||
meaning: राष्ट्रे सेनापतौ पुत्रे पुरे वाथ पुरोधसि । अमात्ये वाहने दारे नृपतौ वा पलन्ति च ॥
text_mt: They bear fruit in the realm, in the general, in the son, in the city, or in the royal chaplain, / in the minister, the vehicle, the queen, or in the king.

sanskrit_iast: etān samutthitāṃ jñātvā rājā sabalavāhanaḥ | praṇipatya guruṃ brūyād bhagavan śamayasva me ||
meaning: एतान् समुत्थितां ज्ञात्वा राजा सबलवाहनः । प्रणिपत्य गुरुं ब्रूयाद् भगवन् शमयस्व मे ॥
text_mt: Knowing that these have arisen, the king along with his army and mounts, / bowing down to his preceptor, should say: 'Reverend Sir, pacify for me

sanskrit_iast: bhayam utpātajaṃ sarvaṃ brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te | iti uktaḥ śraddadhānena rājñā svahitam icchatā ||
meaning: भयम् उत्पातजं सर्वं ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते । इति उक्तः श्रद्दधानेन राज्ञा स्वहितम् इच्छता ॥
text_mt: all fear born of portents; tell me, what shall I do for you?' / Addressed thus by the faithful king desiring his own welfare,

sanskrit_iast: nimittāni samālokya kṛtvā pāvanam āditaḥ | mahāśāntiṃ prayuñjīta sarvopadravanāśinīm ||
meaning: निमित्तानि समालोक्य कृत्वा पावनम् आदितः । महाशान्तिं प्रयुञ्जीत सर्वोपद्रवनाशिनीम् ॥
text_mt: observing the omens, having performed a purification first, / he should employ the great propitiatory rite that destroys all calamities,

sanskrit_iast: sarvarogapraśamanīm utpātaphalanāśinīm | raudrīṃ kuryān mahāśāntiṃ śraddhayā bahudakṣiṇāṃ śraddhayā bahudakṣiṇām ||
meaning: सर्वरोगप्रशमनीम् उत्पातफलनाशिनीम् । रौद्रीं कुर्यान् महाशान्तिं श्रद्धया बहुदक्षिणां श्रद्धया बहुदक्षिणाम् ॥
text_mt: which pacifies all diseases and destroys the fruit of portents; / he should perform the Rudra great propitiatory rite with faith and with lavish sacrificial fees, with faith and with lavish sacrificial fees.

sanskrit_iast: om atha ato lakṣaṇopāṅge sadyovṛṣṭilakṣaṇaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||
meaning: ओम् अथ अतो लक्षणोपाङ्गे सद्योवृष्टिलक्षणं व्याख्यास्यामः ॥
text_mt: Om. Now, therefore, in the auxiliary section on signs, we shall explain the signs of immediate rain.

sanskrit_iast: snigdhavimalataladarśane 'rciṣmaty atitejasi sthūlaraśmau harijvalanasaṃnibhe savitari sadyo varṣati parjanyo viśuddhāsu ca dikṣu kākāṇḍavarṇeṣu giriṣv atirajaskandheṣu hradamagneṣu vimalavipulasnigdhaprasannahṛṣṭapradarśaneṣu nīcair iva jyotirgaṇeṣv anukūleṣu śive śite nīce mārute bhavati cātra ślokaḥ ||
meaning: स्निग्धविमलतलदर्शने ऽर्चिष्मत्य् अतितेजसि स्थूलरश्मौ हरिज्वलनसंनिभे सवितरि सद्यो वर्षति पर्जन्यो विशुद्धासु च दिक्षु काकाण्डवर्णेषु गिरिष्व् अतिरजस्कन्धेषु ह्रदमग्नेषु विमलविपुलस्निग्धप्रसन्नहृष्टप्रदर्शनेषु नीचैर् इव ज्योतिर्गणेष्व् अनुकूलेषु शिवे शिते नीचे मारुते भवति चात्र श्लोकः ॥
text_mt: When the sun appears with a glossy, pure disk, radiant, intensely brilliant, with thick rays, resembling glowing fire, Parjanya rains immediately; and when the quarters are clear, the mountains resemble crow's eggs, with great dust ridges, plunged into lakes, appearing pure, vast, glossy, serene, and cheerful, when the constellations of lights seem low, and when the wind is favorable, auspicious, cool, and low. And here is a verse:

sanskrit_iast: pūrvo 'bhrajanamo vāyur itaro 'bhravināśanaḥ | udag janayate vṛṣṭiṃ varṣaty eva ca dakṣiṇaḥ ||
meaning: पूर्वो ऽभ्रजनमो वायुर् इतरो ऽभ्रविनाशनः । उदग् जनयते वृष्टिं वर्षत्य् एव च दक्षिणः ॥
text_mt: The east wind produces clouds; the other destroys clouds; / the north produces rain; and the south certainly rains.

sanskrit_iast: abhreṣu timiramakaranaganāganakragrāhaśiṃśumāraśaṅkhadrumakūrmormijhaṣamahiṣavarāhadigdviradanavakumudakhaṇḍākṛtinalakalaśakuḍmalāpīḍatoraṇāvartasvastikavardhamānaravauhvarajatamadrāṇipatākāśvatātyāsthānavividhajalacarapakṣivirutacatuṣpadākāreṣu naktanīlotpalakamalapalāśakomaleṣu ||
meaning: अभ्रेषु तिमिरमकरनगनागनक्रग्राहशिंशुमारशङ्खद्रुमकूर्मोर्मिझषमहिषवराहदिग्द्विरदनवकुमुदखण्डाकृतिनलकलशकुड्मलापीडतोरणावर्तस्वस्तिकवर्धमानरवौह्वरजतमद्राणिपताकाश्वतात्यास्थानविविधजलचरपक्षिविरुतचतुष्पदाकारेषु नक्तनीलोत्पलकमलपलाशकोमलेषु ॥
text_mt: When clouds have the shape of a whale, makara, mountain, serpent, alligator, aquatic monster, porpoise, conch shell, tree, turtle, wave, fish, buffalo, boar, quarter-elephant, fresh white water lily petal, lotus stem, pot, bud, garland, archway, whirlpool, swastika, vardhamāna dish, chariot, silver-colored, banner, horse, falcon, assembly hall, various aquatic creatures, bird-crying quadrupeds, soft as night blue water lilies and lotus leaves;

sanskrit_iast: muktāsphaṭikarajatavaiḍuryāñjanabhramarasarpasaṃnikāśeṣu | kṣaudrakṣīrapalāśadhūmadūrvārajatakanakavidrumaprabheṣ ||
meaning: मुक्तास्फटिकरजतवैडुर्याञ्जनभ्रमरसर्पसंनिकाशेषु । क्षौद्रक्षीरपलाशधूमदूर्वारजतकनकविद्रुमप्रभेष् ॥
text_mt: resembling pearls, crystal, silver, lapis lazuli, collyrium, black bees, and serpents; with the luster of honey, milk, flame-of-the-forest flowers, smoke, dūrvā grass, silver, gold, and coral:

sanskrit_iast: dviguṇatriguṇadarśaneṣu mūlavatsu viśikhareṣu mahāvarteṣu taralarathanemighoṣeṣu udadhijalanirghoṣasaṃhrādeṣu kṣubdhadundubhininādeṣu kiñjalkāravindasaṃnibheṣu vā kumudamayūragalakālakeṣu cābhrajālāvanādeṣu chinnābhreṣu vā chinnamūleṣu kāleṣu kāñcanamanahśiloupameṣu suvarṇapūrṇeṣu jaleṣv asmin na cābhyantarato deśaśobhiteṣu dakṣiṇamāruteritaparitate grahāntargatastanitagambhīranisvaneṣu ardhāntareṣu sadyovarṣam ādiśet || atra ślokau ||
meaning: द्विगुणत्रिगुणदर्शनेषु मूलवत्सु विशिखरेषु महावर्तेषु तरलरथनेमिघोषेषु उदधिजलनिर्घोषसंह्रादेषु क्षुब्धदुन्दुभिनिनादेषु किञ्जल्कारविन्दसंनिभेषु वा कुमुदमयूरगलकालकेषु चाभ्रजालावनादेषु छिन्नाभ्रेषु वा छिन्नमूलेषु कालेषु काञ्चनमनह्शिलोउपमेषु सुवर्णपूर्णेषु जलेष्व् अस्मिन् न चाभ्यन्तरतो देशशोभितेषु दक्षिणमारुतेरितपरितते ग्रहान्तर्गतस्तनितगम्भीरनिस्वनेषु अर्धान्तरेषु सद्योवर्षम् आदिशेत् ॥ अत्र श्लोकौ ॥
text_mt: When [clouds] are seen doubled or tripled, rooted, having high peaks, with great whirls, making sounds like trembling chariot-fellies, reverberating with the roar of ocean waters, booming like agitated kettledrums, or resembling lotus-filaments; or dark like white lotuses or peacock necks, resounding with masses of clouds; or when there are broken clouds, or clouds broken at the base; at times resembling gold or realgar, filled with golden [hues], in these waters and adorned within by [various] places; stirred and spread by the south wind, sounding with deep thundering within the planets; [or] in the middle of half [the sky], one should predict immediate rain. On this there are two verses:

sanskrit_iast: udayāstamaye meghā garbhabhūtā divākare | pradīptā iva citrāsu viṣamāsu khakoṭiṣu ||
meaning: उदयास्तमये मेघा गर्भभूता दिवाकरे । प्रदीप्ता इव चित्रासु विषमासु खकोटिषु ॥
text_mt: clouds appearing as embryos at sunrise or sunset while the sun shines, / as if blazing on the manifold, uneven points of the sky;

sanskrit_iast: pañca mārutaparyaṅkā maṇayaḥ kāñcanā iva | yatrayatropalakṣyante tatratatra pravarṣati ||
meaning: पञ्च मारुतपर्यङ्का मणयः काञ्चना इव । यत्रयत्रोपलक्ष्यन्ते तत्रतत्र प्रवर्षति ॥
text_mt: five wind-couches, appearing like golden gems— / wherever they are observed, there it pours down rain.

sanskrit_iast: ghananicayaṃ virohaṇe vādhirohaṇāstagamane vā savitur dṛṣṭvā ca varṣad udadhijīvarādrariṣṭakavaiḍūryotpalakamalapalāśadhūmaśevālavadhrajabakasaṃnikāśasnigdhaghoṣagambhīragabhastividvanbhaiḥ pravṛddhaiḥ samārutān vañcibhiḥ pravṛddhaskandhaśākhānvitapāvanitalaruhān sadyovarṣam ādiśet || atra ślokau ||
meaning: घननिचयं विरोहणे वाधिरोहणास्तगमने वा सवितुर् दृष्ट्वा च वर्षद् उदधिजीवराद्ररिष्टकवैडूर्योत्पलकमलपलाशधूमशेवालवध्रजबकसंनिकाशस्निग्धघोषगम्भीरगभस्तिविद्वन्भैः प्रवृद्धैः समारुतान् वञ्चिभिः प्रवृद्धस्कन्धशाखान्वितपावनितलरुहान् सद्योवर्षम् आदिशेत् ॥ अत्र श्लोकौ ॥
text_mt: Having observed a mass of clouds at the rising, ascending, or setting of the sun, and rain-giving [clouds] having the appearance of marine animals, ariṣṭaka-berries, beryl, blue lotuses, lotus leaves, smoke, moss, or herons, possessing a glossy rumble, deep rays, and lightning, increasing together with the wind and bending the wind-blown trees on the ground that have grown large trunks and branches, one should predict immediate rain. On this there are two verses:

sanskrit_iast: antarājitadīptāgnikāñcanāmalasaṃnibhaiḥ | abhraiś cotpalavaidūryaprabhāvāñjanasaṃnibhaiḥ ||
meaning: अन्तराजितदीप्ताग्निकाञ्चनामलसंनिभैः । अभ्रैश् चोत्पलवैदूर्यप्रभावाञ्जनसंनिभैः ॥
text_mt: "With clouds resembling blazing fire within, pure gold, / or resembling the lustre of blue lotuses, beryl, or collyrium,

sanskrit_iast: nīlarśmiprarohantaḥ śākhāvanta iva drumāḥ | yatrayatra pradṛśyante dhruvaṃ tara pravarṣati ||
meaning: नीलर्श्मिप्ररोहन्तः शाखावन्त इव द्रुमाः । यत्रयत्र प्रदृश्यन्ते ध्रुवं तर प्रवर्षति ॥
text_mt: growing with dark rays like branching trees— / wherever they are seen, it certainly rains there."

sanskrit_iast: saṃdhyā ca jvalanaravīndīvarakaraṇdatapanīyārkodayaharitālanīlotpalaghṛtamadhubandhujīvakajapāpuṣpakiṃśukarāśisaṃnikāśā tathā drutakanakavidrumasphaṭikavaiḍūryavarṇam uddyotayanti diśaḥ śāntamṛgaśakuniviśeṣāḥ ||
meaning: संध्या च ज्वलनरवीन्दीवरकरण्दतपनीयार्कोदयहरितालनीलोत्पलघृतमधुबन्धुजीवकजपापुष्पकिंशुकराशिसंनिकाशा तथा द्रुतकनकविद्रुमस्फटिकवैडूर्यवर्णम् उद्द्योतयन्ति दिशः शान्तमृगशकुनिविशेषाः ॥
text_mt: And twilight resembling fire, the sun, blue lotus, karnikāra, refined gold, sunrise, yellow orpiment, blue lotus, ghee, honey, bandhujīvaka, hibiscus flowers, and heaps of kiṃśuka flowers, as well as molten gold, coral, crystal, and beryl colors illuminating the quarters, with tranquil animals and birds;

sanskrit_iast: kiṃtanā snigdhā ghanā gabhastimālini saṃprati saṃdhyāṃ dṛṣṭvā nīcair nirmalasnigdhaparidhipariveṣābhravṛkṣapratisūryakā lohitākṣapakṣiptā sārdhaṃ pañcakāvaliptaiś ca mahiṣavṛṣavarāhādidviradajalagaṇair ivācaritaviṣayā atra ślokaḥ ||
meaning: किंतना स्निग्धा घना गभस्तिमालिनि संप्रति संध्यां दृष्ट्वा नीचैर् निर्मलस्निग्धपरिधिपरिवेषाभ्रवृक्षप्रतिसूर्यका लोहिताक्षपक्षिप्ता सार्धं पञ्चकावलिप्तैश् च महिषवृषवराहादिद्विरदजलगणैर् इवाचरितविषया अत्र श्लोकः ॥
text_mt: or when the sun is garlanded with rays, seeing a twilight with glossy, dense, low-hanging clouds, spotless, smooth halos, optical rings, cloud-trees, mock-suns, streaked with red corners, having regions frequented as if by herds of water-buffaloes, bulls, boars, elephants, and aquatic creatures along with smears of fivefold colors. On this there is a verse:

sanskrit_iast: sāṃdhyaiś ca pariveṣaiś ca pratighaiḥ pratisūryakaiḥ | jalajaiś cāvṛtānindyaiḥ sadyaḥ saṃdhyā pravarṣati ||
meaning: सांध्यैश् च परिवेषैश् च प्रतिघैः प्रतिसूर्यकैः । जलजैश् चावृतानिन्द्यैः सद्यः संध्या प्रवर्षति ॥
text_mt: "When surrounded by unblemished halos of twilight, counter-glows, / mock-suns, and water-born [clouds], the twilight immediately brings rain."

sanskrit_iast: yathālakṣaṇaṃ śastrakāṃsyatāmrāyasānāṃ kledavatāṃ khadyotāni || tatra svedanti kāmahurdhunināś ca uttaṭaprākāragopuragṛhāgādhirohaṇapāṃsusnānam aṇḍajānām
meaning: यथालक्षणं शस्त्रकांस्यताम्रायसानां क्लेदवतां खद्योतानि ॥ तत्र स्वेदन्ति कामहुर्धुनिनाश् च उत्तटप्राकारगोपुरगृहागाधिरोहणपांसुस्नानम् अण्डजानाम्
text_mt: According to the characteristics: when weapons, bronze, copper, and iron become moist; fireflies; when there is sweating, […] and the climbing upon high riverbanks, ramparts, city-gates, and house-tops, or dust-bathing of birds;

sanskrit_iast: pracaraṇe taḍāgakūpān setubandhākrītāś ca śiśūnāṃ dṛṣṭvā prasaṃkhyāyāś ca citrāviśākhāsvātibahulāṣāḍhāhirbudhnyayāmyasya saṃgrahasaṃpāteṣu mahadvarṣasaṃvṛte ca tryahād ūrdhvaṃ cātra ślokau ||
meaning: प्रचरणे तडागकूपान् सेतुबन्धाक्रीताश् च शिशूनां दृष्ट्वा प्रसंख्यायाश् च चित्राविशाखास्वातिबहुलाषाढाहिर्बुध्न्ययाम्यस्य संग्रहसंपातेषु महद्वर्षसंवृते च त्र्यहाद् ऊर्ध्वं चात्र श्लोकौ ॥
text_mt: or seeing the play of children roaming around tanks, wells, and causeways, and reckoning during the conjunctions of planets in Citrā, Viśākhā, Svāti, Kṛttikā, Aṣāḍhā, Uttarabhadrapadā, and Bharaṇī, when covered by great rain after three days; and on this there are two verses:

sanskrit_iast: ākrīḍāś caiva matsyānāṃ gavāṃ dṛṣṭvāgamo gṛham | prācuryadaṃśamaśakair dhiṣṇyānāṃ cātha mokṣeṇe ||
meaning: आक्रीडाश् चैव मत्स्यानां गवां दृष्ट्वागमो गृहम् । प्राचुर्यदंशमशकैर् धिष्ण्यानां चाथ मोक्षेणे ॥
text_mt: "The playful frolicking of fish, seeing the cows returning home, / an abundance of gnats and mosquitoes, and the release of shooting stars;

sanskrit_iast: jalājalajasaṃtānān ekatra bilavāsinām | pipīlikāṇḍasaṃkrāntir athoṣṇaṃ cāmbu vṛṣṭaye ||
meaning: जलाजलजसंतानान् एकत्र बिलवासिनाम् । पिपीलिकाण्डसंक्रान्तिर् अथोष्णं चाम्बु वृष्टये ॥
text_mt: the coming together of water-dwelling and land-dwelling broods of hole-dwellers, / the carrying of ants' eggs, and warm water—these portend rain."

sanskrit_iast: satkṛtya ca daivajñaṃ palvalakūpataḍāganadītīre || sāddālagṛheṣu deśeṣv ārdravāsārdrapāṇiḥ prṛcchet || sadyovarṣam adiśet ||
meaning: सत्कृत्य च दैवज्ञं पल्वलकूपतडागनदीतीरे ॥ साद्दालगृहेषु देशेष्व् आर्द्रवासार्द्रपाणिः प्रृच्छेत् ॥ सद्योवर्षम् अदिशेत् ॥
text_mt: Having honoured the astrologer, on the bank of a pool, well, pond, or river, or in grassy places, with wet clothes and wet hands, one should ask; he should predict immediate rain.

sanskrit_iast: diśy aiśānyāṃ vā madhurasvarariṣṭavyāharaṇaṃ jalagotrasābhūtaṃ talliṅgānām antarālaṃ bālānāṃ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā varṣatīti brūyāt ||
meaning: दिश्य् ऐशान्यां वा मधुरस्वररिष्टव्याहरणं जलगोत्रसाभूतं तल्लिङ्गानाम् अन्तरालं बालानां श्रुत्वा दृष्ट्वा वर्षतीति ब्रूयात् ॥
text_mt: Hearing in the north-eastern quarter the sweet cry of a jay belonging to the water-lineage, or seeing the space between the marks of young children, he should say, 'It will rain.'

sanskrit_iast: rātristanito divā vidyudbhir vādyamākṣetre varṇaḥ snigdho dviguṇendracāpa darśane vyomni nirabhre paśuvirāvābhradaṇḍābhasvalpāñ cābhrarājiprādurbhāvaiḥ sadyovṛṣṭir atra ślokāḥ ||
meaning: रात्रिस्तनितो दिवा विद्युद्भिर् वाद्यमाक्षेत्रे वर्णः स्निग्धो द्विगुणेन्द्रचाप दर्शने व्योम्नि निरभ्रे पशुविरावाभ्रदण्डाभस्वल्पाञ् चाभ्रराजिप्रादुर्भावैः सद्योवृष्टिर् अत्र श्लोकाः ॥
text_mt: Thunder at night, lightning by day, the colour [of the sky] glossy in the field of music, the sight of a double rainbow in a cloudless sky, the bellowing of cattle, and the appearance of clouds resembling rods and short lines of clouds portend immediate rain. On this there are verses:

sanskrit_iast: pratisūryako bhaved yas tu raver uttarato yadā | toyaṃ nivārayen nityaṃ dakṣiṇe salilād bhayam ||
meaning: प्रतिसूर्यको भवेद् यस् तु रवेर् उत्तरतो यदा । तोयं निवारयेन् नित्यं दक्षिणे सलिलाद् भयम् ॥
text_mt: "When there is a mock-sun to the north of the sun, / it continually checks the rain; when to the south, there is danger from flood.

sanskrit_iast: tridhā nimittasaṃpannā vṛṣṭir bhavati pārthivī | nimitte tāvad ekasmin pañcayojanikaṃ bhavet ||
meaning: त्रिधा निमित्तसंपन्ना वृष्टिर् भवति पार्थिवी । निमित्ते तावद् एकस्मिन् पञ्चयोजनिकं भवेत् ॥
text_mt: Earthly rain occurs when endowed with three kinds of omens; / indeed, by a single omen it will extend for five yojanas.

sanskrit_iast: yeṣuyeṣu nimitteṣu nakṣatreṣu ca vartmani | praśastam iti teṣv eva prādurbhūteṣu varṣati ||
meaning: येषुयेषु निमित्तेषु नक्षत्रेषु च वर्त्मनि । प्रशस्तम् इति तेष्व् एव प्रादुर्भूतेषु वर्षति ॥
text_mt: Under whatever omens and lunar mansions along its course / it is deemed auspicious, precisely when those appear does it rain.

sanskrit_iast: viparyayanimittāni pratibandhakarāṇi tu | teṣu śāntiṃ prakurvīta atharvā śamanāya vai ||
meaning: विपर्ययनिमित्तानि प्रतिबन्धकराणि तु । तेषु शान्तिं प्रकुर्वीत अथर्वा शमनाय वै ॥
text_mt: However, omens of the contrary kind cause an obstruction; / in their case, an Atharvan priest should perform a propitiatory rite for appeasement."

sanskrit_iast: sam ut patantu sūktena pra nabhasveti cāpare | vaitasyaḥ samidho 'nye tu śamīmayyo 'pare viduḥ ||
meaning: सम् उत् पतन्तु सूक्तेन प्र नभस्वेति चापरे । वैतस्यः समिधो ऽन्ये तु शमीमय्यो ऽपरे विदुः ॥
text_mt: With the hymn 'sam ut patantu' and others with 'pra nabhasva'; / some prescribe kindling sticks of reed, while others know those made of śamī.

sanskrit_iast: samidhāṃ vaitasīnāṃ tu agnāv arkendhanāhute | ahorātrikahomaḥ syāt parjanyo bahuvarṣadaḥ ||
meaning: समिधां वैतसीनां तु अग्नाव् अर्केन्धनाहुते । अहोरात्रिकहोमः स्यात् पर्जन्यो बहुवर्षदः ॥
text_mt: [With kindling sticks of reed offered into the fire fed with calotropis fuel, / there should be an oblation lasting a day and a night; Parjanya will give abundant rain.

sanskrit_iast: sam ut patantu sūktena maruto yajate pākayajñavidhānena yathā varuṇaṃ vṛṣṭikāmaḥ || pra nabhasvety ṛcau dve maruto yajate vṛṣṭikāmo yathā varuṇaṃ juhoti ||
meaning: सम् उत् पतन्तु सूक्तेन मरुतो यजते पाकयज्ञविधानेन यथा वरुणं वृष्टिकामः ॥ प्र नभस्वेत्य् ऋचौ द्वे मरुतो यजते वृष्टिकामो यथा वरुणं जुहोति ॥
text_mt: Desiring rain, he sacrifices to the Maruts with the hymn 'sam ut patantu' according to the ordinance of domestic sacrifices, just as to Varuṇa. Desiring rain, he sacrifices to the Maruts with the two verses beginning 'pra nabhasva', offering just as to Varuṇa.]

sanskrit_iast: ādadhyāt samidhaḥ plākṣīḥ sakṣīrā ghṛtasaṃyutāḥ | tatas tac chamam āyāti kṛtsnam utpātalakṣaṇam ||
meaning: आदध्यात् समिधः प्लाक्षीः सक्षीरा घृतसंयुताः । ततस् तच् छमम् आयाति कृत्स्नम् उत्पातलक्षणम् ॥
text_mt: He should lay on kindling sticks of plakṣa, full of sap and smeared with ghee; / then that entire ominous symptom attains appeasement.

sanskrit_iast: aindrīṃ vā vāruṇīṃ vāpi mahāśāntiṃ vidhānataḥ | varṣādau tu prayuñjīta avṛṣṭes tu vināśanīm ||
meaning: ऐन्द्रीं वा वारुणीं वापि महाशान्तिं विधानतः । वर्षादौ तु प्रयुञ्जीत अवृष्टेस् तु विनाशनीम् ॥
text_mt: He should properly perform the great propitiatory rite dedicated to Indra or to Varuṇa / at the beginning of the rainy season to destroy drought.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣṭer yāni nimittāni tāny apratihatāni tu | bhavanti vṛṣṭidāyīni sasyavṛddhikarāṇi tu ||
meaning: वृष्टेर् यानि निमित्तानि तान्य् अप्रतिहतानि तु । भवन्ति वृष्टिदायीनि सस्यवृद्धिकराणि तु ॥
text_mt: Those omens of rain which are unobstructed / indeed bring rain and promote the growth of crops.

sanskrit_iast: vaitasānāṃ tu pattrāṇāṃ lakṣaṃ kṣīrasamāyutam | vratānte bhārgavo juhvad avarṣāsv api varṣayed iti ||
meaning: वैतसानां तु पत्त्राणां लक्षं क्षीरसमायुतम् । व्रतान्ते भार्गवो जुह्वद् अवर्षास्व् अपि वर्षयेद् इति ॥
text_mt: A descendant of Bhṛgu, offering one hundred thousand reed-leaves mixed with milk / at the end of his observance, can cause it to rain even during droughts.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ bhagavan devadeveśa surāsuranamaskṛta | gavāṃ sarveṣu rogeṣu pratijñāteṣu vai prabho ||
meaning: ओं भगवन् देवदेवेश सुरासुरनमस्कृत । गवां सर्वेषु रोगेषु प्रतिज्ञातेषु वै प्रभो ॥
text_mt: "O Lord, ruler of the gods, revered by gods and asuras, / when all diseases of cattle are diagnosed, O Master,

sanskrit_iast: kathaṃ śāntiṃ dvijaḥ kuryāt kena mantreṇa prokṣaṇam | homamantrāś ca ke proktāḥ kasmiṃs tantre prayojayet ||
meaning: कथं शान्तिं द्विजः कुर्यात् केन मन्त्रेण प्रोक्षणम् । होममन्त्राश् च के प्रोक्ताः कस्मिंस् तन्त्रे प्रयोजयेत् ॥
text_mt: how should a twice-born perform the propitiatory rite? With what mantra is the sprinkling? / And what oblation mantras are declared? In which ritual procedure should he employ them?"

sanskrit_iast: uvāca paripṛṣṭaḥ san brahmā sarvajagatpatiḥ | śṛṇvantu ṛṣayaḥ sarve gośāntiṃ mahaduttamām ||
meaning: उवाच परिपृष्टः सन् ब्रह्मा सर्वजगत्पतिः । शृण्वन्तु ऋषयः सर्वे गोशान्तिं महदुत्तमाम् ॥
text_mt: Thus questioned, Brahmā, the lord of the entire universe, said: / "Listen, all you seers, to the supreme and great propitiatory rite for cattle,

sanskrit_iast: atharvavihitāṃ samyak sarvarogavināśanīm | yāṃ śrutvā savarogās tu vidravanti sahasraśaḥ ||
meaning: अथर्वविहितां सम्यक् सर्वरोगविनाशनीम् । यां श्रुत्वा सवरोगास् तु विद्रवन्ति सहस्रशः ॥
text_mt: duly prescribed by the Atharvan, destroying all diseases, / hearing which all ailments flee by the thousands.

sanskrit_iast: goṣṭhamadhye gṛhe vāpi govāṭe gokulāntile | ācāryas tu śucir bhūtvā kārayen maṇḍalaṃ śubham ||
meaning: गोष्ठमध्ये गृहे वापि गोवाटे गोकुलान्तिले । आचार्यस् तु शुचिर् भूत्वा कारयेन् मण्डलं शुभम् ॥
text_mt: In the middle of a cow-pen, in a house, in a cattle enclosure, or near a herd of cows, / the preceptor, becoming purified, should draw an auspicious diagram.

sanskrit_iast: snātaś cāhatavāsāś ca ahorātroṣitaḥ śuciḥ | caturaśraṃ caturdvāram ālikhet tatra maṇḍalam ||
meaning: स्नातश् चाहतवासाश् च अहोरात्रोषितः शुचिः । चतुरश्रं चतुर्द्वारम् आलिखेत् तत्र मण्डलम् ॥
text_mt: Having bathed, wearing fresh clothes, purified after fasting for a day and a night, / he should draw there a square diagram with four doors.

sanskrit_iast: tasya madhye tu deveśaṃ gomayena nidhāpayet | tataḥ kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ caiva gugguluṃ candanāgurum ||
meaning: तस्य मध्ये तु देवेशं गोमयेन निधापयेत् । ततः क्षीरं घृतं चैव गुग्गुलुं चन्दनागुरुम् ॥
text_mt: In the middle of it, he should install the lord of gods with cow-dung; / then milk, ghee, bdellium, sandalwood, and aloe-wood,

sanskrit_iast: puṣpāṇi ca sugandhīni tathā vai sarṣapāṃs tilān | lājāś ca samidhaś caiva samāhṛtya vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
meaning: पुष्पाणि च सुगन्धीनि तथा वै सर्षपांस् तिलान् । लाजाश् च समिधश् चैव समाहृत्य विचक्षणः ॥
text_mt: fragrant flowers, as well as mustard seeds and sesame seeds, / roasted grain and kindling sticks—the wise priest having gathered these,

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāṃs tu tarpayet tatra dadhikṣīraghṛtādibhiḥ | tataḥ śāntiṃ prayuñjita namaskṛtvā svayaṃbhuvam ||
meaning: प्राणांस् तु तर्पयेत् तत्र दधिक्षीरघृतादिभिः । ततः शान्तिं प्रयुञ्जित नमस्कृत्वा स्वयंभुवम् ॥
text_mt: should gratify the vital breaths there with curd, milk, ghee, and the like; / then, having bowed to the self-born [Brahmā], he should perform the propitiatory rite.

sanskrit_iast: ājyabhāgāntājyatantram abhyātānāni caiva hi ||
meaning: आज्यभागान्ताज्यतन्त्रम् अभ्यातानानि चैव हि ॥
text_mt: The ritual of clarified butter ending with the ghee portions, and the abhyātāna formulas:

sanskrit_iast: namojñāya sureśāya namas te viśvatomukha | namaḥ kālāya tīkṣṇāya jaṭilāya sarvabhūtahitāya ca ||
meaning: नमोज्ञाय सुरेशाय नमस् ते विश्वतोमुख । नमः कालाय तीक्ष्णाय जटिलाय सर्वभूतहिताय च ॥
text_mt: 'Obeisance to the knower, to the lord of gods! Obeisance to you who face all directions! / Obeisance to Time, fierce, [matted-haired,] and benevolent to all beings!'

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ sarṣapatilalājā ūrdhvāḥ samidhaś ca dadhimadhughṛtāktā juhuyāt ||
meaning: ततः सर्षपतिललाजा ऊर्ध्वाः समिधश् च दधिमधुघृताक्ता जुहुयात् ॥
text_mt: Then he should offer the mustard seeds, sesame, and roasted grain, and upright kindling sticks smeared with curd, honey, and ghee.

sanskrit_iast: yajāmi || kālāya svāhā || piṅgalāya tīkṣṇāya jaṭilāya babhrave oṃ bhūr oṃ bhuva oṃ svar oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar jayavijayāya jayādhipataye kapardine karālāya vikaṭāya kaṭiramāṭarāyāṅgirasabārhaspatyakakapilamaṇḍalamuṇḍajaṭilakapāleśvarādhipataye kapardine svāheti ||
meaning: यजामि ॥ कालाय स्वाहा ॥ पिङ्गलाय तीक्ष्णाय जटिलाय बभ्रवे ओं भूर् ओं भुव ओं स्वर् ओं भूर् भुवः स्वर् जयविजयाय जयाधिपतये कपर्दिने करालाय विकटाय कटिरमाटरायाङ्गिरसबार्हस्पत्यककपिलमण्डलमुण्डजटिलकपालेश्वराधिपतये कपर्दिने स्वाहेति ॥
text_mt: "I sacrifice! To Kāla, svāhā! To the reddish-brown, sharp, matted-haired, brown one, oṃ bhūr oṃ bhuva oṃ svar oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar, to the victorious and conquering, the lord of victory, the one with braided hair, the frightful, the terrible, the broad-hipped and wide-bellied, the Angirasa-Bṛhaspati-Kapila circle-shaven-headed, matted-haired lord of skulls, the sovereign, the braided-haired one, svāhā!"

sanskrit_iast: eṣa karmasu tu gośānteḥ saṃsṛṣṭa ṛṣibhiḥ purā | proktā svayaṃbhuvā caiṣā gośāntis tu hitāya vai ||
meaning: एष कर्मसु तु गोशान्तेः संसृष्ट ऋषिभिः पुरा । प्रोक्ता स्वयंभुवा चैषा गोशान्तिस् तु हिताय वै ॥
text_mt: This rite of propitiation for cattle was instituted in ancient times by the seers; / and this propitiation for cattle was declared by the Self-born for their welfare.

sanskrit_iast: yo vipraḥ paṭhatīmāṃ hi gokule cāpi hitāya vai | gāvas tasya pravardhante mahatīṃ cāśnute śriyam ||
meaning: यो विप्रः पठतीमां हि गोकुले चापि हिताय वै । गावस् तस्य प्रवर्धन्ते महतीं चाश्नुते श्रियम् ॥
text_mt: The brahmin who recites this in a cow-pen for its welfare, / his cattle flourish and he attains great fortune.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ puruṣas putradāraṃ vā dhanadhānyam atha api vā | nimittair yair vinaśyeta śāntiṃ tatra nibodhata ||
meaning: ओं पुरुषस् पुत्रदारं वा धनधान्यम् अथ अपि वा । निमित्तैर् यैर् विनश्येत शान्तिं तत्र निबोधत ॥
text_mt: Oṃ. When a man, his sons and wife, or wealth and grain / might perish through portents, learn the propitiatory rite for that situation:

sanskrit_iast: indrāyudhaṃ bhavet rātrau dṛśyate yasya kasya cit | darvī kare vā bhidyeta maṇis kumbhas tathā eva ca ||
meaning: इन्द्रायुधं भवेत् रात्रौ दृश्यते यस्य कस्य चित् । दर्वी करे वा भिद्येत मणिस् कुम्भस् तथा एव च ॥
text_mt: If a rainbow appears at night, seen by anyone, / or a ladle breaks in the hand, or a jewel or a jar,

sanskrit_iast: chattraṃ śayyā āsanaṃ ca eva anyat vā api svayaṃ kva cit | strī hanyāt ca striyaṃ vā api gaur avaghret ulūkhalam ||
meaning: छत्त्रं शय्या आसनं च एव अन्यत् वा अपि स्वयं क्व चित् । स्त्री हन्यात् च स्त्रियं वा अपि गौर् अवघ्रेत् उलूखलम् ॥
text_mt: or an umbrella, bed, seat, or anything else breaks by itself anywhere, / or a woman strikes another woman, or a cow sniffs a mortar,

sanskrit_iast: śvā pidet gām anaḍvāhaṃ kalis saṃpadyate kule | gajavājino mriyante vivādo rājakīyakas ||
meaning: श्वा पिदेत् गाम् अनड्वाहं कलिस् संपद्यते कुले । गजवाजिनो म्रियन्ते विवादो राजकीयकस् ॥
text_mt: or a dog nurses from a cow or a draft-ox, or strife arises in the family, / or elephants and horses die, or a royal dispute occurs,

sanskrit_iast: kuṭumbam aśubhaṃ sarvam aindrāṇi etāni nirdiśet | śāmyanti yena sarvāṇi nirvapet pāyasaṃ carum ||
meaning: कुटुम्बम् अशुभं सर्वम् ऐन्द्राणि एतानि निर्दिशेत् । शाम्यन्ति येन सर्वाणि निर्वपेत् पायसं चरुम् ॥
text_mt: or the entire household is afflicted with misfortune, one should declare these to be of Indra. / So that all of them may be pacified, he should prepare an oblation of boiled milk-rice.

sanskrit_iast: samāvaoya ghṛtaṃ tatra āhutiṃ jihuyāt imām | indram id devatātaye sthālīpākasya homayet ||
meaning: समावओय घृतं तत्र आहुतिं जिहुयात् इमाम् । इन्द्रम् इद् देवतातये स्थालीपाकस्य होमयेत् ॥
text_mt: Pouring clarified butter into it, he should offer this oblation: / with "Indram id devatātaye..." he should make an offering of the boiled mess of rice.

sanskrit_iast: indras śacīpatis śakro vajrapāṇis sureāśvaras | sarvādbhutānāṃ śamano mahāvyāhṛtayas tathā ||
meaning: इन्द्रस् शचीपतिस् शक्रो वज्रपाणिस् सुरेआश्वरस् । सर्वाद्भुतानां शमनो महाव्याहृतयस् तथा ॥
text_mt: "Indra, lord of Śacī, Śakra, vajra-in-hand, lord of gods, / pacifier of all portents," and also the great sacred utterances.

sanskrit_iast: hutvā sviṣṭakṛtaṃ ca eva carutantraṃ samāpayet | vimuktotpātadoṣas tu jīvet tu śaradas śatam ||
meaning: हुत्वा स्विष्टकृतं च एव चरुतन्त्रं समापयेत् । विमुक्तोत्पातदोषस् तु जीवेत् तु शरदस् शतम् ॥
text_mt: Having offered the sviṣṭakṛt oblation as well, he should conclude the rite of the boiled oblations. / Freed from the fault of portents, he shall live for a hundred autumns.

sanskrit_iast: uddīpikā gṛhe yasya valmīkā madhujālakam | abjānāṃ maṇike śabde tailaṃ sthīyata eva vā ||
meaning: उद्दीपिका गृहे यस्य वल्मीका मधुजालकम् । अब्जानां मणिके शब्दे तैलं स्थीयत एव वा ॥
text_mt: In whose house a termite, an ant-hill, or a honeycomb appears, / or oil settles in the lotus jar or emits a sound,

sanskrit_iast: aśubhā vikṛtir dadhnāṃ dugdhānāṃ vā yadā bhavet | akasmāt ca praroheyur bījāni kṛmayas tathā ||
meaning: अशुभा विकृतिर् दध्नां दुग्धानां वा यदा भवेत् । अकस्मात् च प्ररोहेयुर् बीजानि कृमयस् तथा ॥
text_mt: or when an inauspicious alteration occurs in curds or milk, / or seeds and worms sprout suddenly,

sanskrit_iast: kāryo varuṇayāgas tu vāruṇīvidhipūrvakas | ud uttamaṃ pradhānaṃ syāt pañcājyāhutayas tathā ||
meaning: कार्यो वरुणयागस् तु वारुणीविधिपूर्वकस् । उद् उत्तमं प्रधानं स्यात् पञ्चाज्याहुतयस् तथा ॥
text_mt: a sacrifice to Varuṇa preceded by the Varuṇa procedure should be performed. / "Ud uttamaṃ..." shall be the principal [verse], and likewise five oblations of clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇas pāśapāṇis ca yadāsāṃ patir eva ca | śe aṃ tu pūrvavat ca eva carutantraṃ samāpayet ||
meaning: वरुणस् पाशपाणिस् च यदासां पतिर् एव च । शे अं तु पूर्ववत् च एव चरुतन्त्रं समापयेत् ॥
text_mt: "Varuṇa, noose-in-hand, and lord of these waters..." / The remainder is just as before, and he should conclude the rite of the boiled oblations.

sanskrit_iast: vimuktotpātadoṣas tu jīvet tu śaradas śatam ||
meaning: विमुक्तोत्पातदोषस् तु जीवेत् तु शरदस् शतम् ॥
text_mt: Freed from the fault of portents, he shall live for a hundred autumns.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhe yasya patet gṛdhra ulūko vā kathaṃ cana | kapotas praviśet ca eva jīvā vā araṇyasaṃbhavās ||
meaning: गृहे यस्य पतेत् गृध्र उलूको वा कथं चन । कपोतस् प्रविशेत् च एव जीवा वा अरण्यसंभवास् ॥
text_mt: On whose house a vulture or an owl somehow lands, / or a dove or wild animals enter,

sanskrit_iast: dhuryau ca patato yuktau gostrījanma ca vaikṛtam | jāyante yamalāni eva ghoras svapnas ca dṛśyate ||
meaning: धुर्यौ च पततो युक्तौ गोस्त्रीजन्म च वैकृतम् । जायन्ते यमलानि एव घोरस् स्वप्नस् च दृश्यते ॥
text_mt: or two draft animals fall while yoked, or a deformed birth occurs among cattle or women, / or twins are born, or a terrible dream is seen,

sanskrit_iast: abhidravanti rakṣāṃsi yatra ca eva kumārakān | unnidrako atunidro vā atyalpam atibhojanam ||
meaning: अभिद्रवन्ति रक्षांसि यत्र च एव कुमारकान् । उन्निद्रको अतुनिद्रो वा अत्यल्पम् अतिभोजनम् ॥
text_mt: or where demons run after young children, / or [there is] sleeplessness, excessive sleep, eating too little, or eating too much,

sanskrit_iast: ālasya ca evam eteṣāṃ devatā yama ucyate | nāke suparṇam iti etat sthālīpākasya homayet ||
meaning: आलस्य च एवम् एतेषां देवता यम उच्यते । नाके सुपर्णम् इति एतत् स्थालीपाकस्य होमयेत् ॥
text_mt: and also indolence—the deity of these is declared to be Yama. / With "Nāke suparṇam..." he should make an offering of the boiled mess of rice:

sanskrit_iast: yamas pretapatis ca eva daṇḍapāṇis tathā īśvaras | śamanaḥ sarvādbhutānām … ||
meaning: यमस् प्रेतपतिस् च एव दण्डपाणिस् तथा ईश्वरस् । शमनः सर्वाद्भुतानाम् … ॥
text_mt: "Yama, lord of the dead, staff-in-hand, and lord, / pacifier of all portents..."

sanskrit_iast: anagnir utthito yasya dhūmo vā api gṛhe kva cit | āmaṃ vā jvalate māṃsaṃ bhaveyur visphuliṅgakās ||
meaning: अनग्निर् उत्थितो यस्य धूमो वा अपि गृहे क्व चित् । आमं वा ज्वलते मांसं भवेयुर् विस्फुलिङ्गकास् ॥
text_mt: In whose house unignited [fire] arises, or smoke anywhere, / or raw meat burns, or sparks appear,

sanskrit_iast: chattradhvajapatākās ca jvalante toraṇāni ca || āsanaṃ ca eva ;ayyā ca vastrāṇi kusumāni ca ||
meaning: छत्त्रध्वजपताकास् च ज्वलन्ते तोरणानि च ॥ आसनं च एव ;अय्या च वस्त्राणि कुसुमानि च ॥
text_mt: and parasols, standards, flags, and archways catch fire, / as well as a seat, a bed, garments, and flowers,

sanskrit_iast: hastyaśvānāṃ ca pucchāni varṣatyaṅgāravarṣaṇam | akāle ca diśāṃ dāha oṣadhīnāṃ ca pācanam ||
meaning: हस्त्यश्वानां च पुच्छानि वर्षत्यङ्गारवर्षणम् । अकाले च दिशां दाह ओषधीनां च पाचनम् ॥
text_mt: and the tails of elephants and horses, or a rain of charcoal falls, / and untimely burning of the quarters, and ripening of medicinal plants,

sanskrit_iast: hastinyas ca eva madyante agnirūpaṃ tad adbhutam | agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe sthālīpākasya homayet ||
meaning: हस्तिन्यस् च एव मद्यन्ते अग्निरूपं तद् अद्भुतम् । अग्निं दूतं वृणीमहे स्थालीपाकस्य होमयेत् ॥
text_mt: and cow-elephants run wild—that portent has the form of Agni. / With "Agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe..." he should make an offering of the boiled mess of rice:

sanskrit_iast: agnir hiraṇyapatis ca arciṣpāṇis tathā īśvaras | śamanas sarvādbhutānām … ||
meaning: अग्निर् हिरण्यपतिस् च अर्चिष्पाणिस् तथा ईश्वरस् । शमनस् सर्वाद्भुतानाम् … ॥
text_mt: "Agni, lord of gold, flame-in-hand, and lord, / pacifier of all portents..."

sanskrit_iast: suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vajraṃ vaiḍūryaṃ mauktikāni ca | pravālavastranāśas ca mitrāṇāṃ ca viparyayas ||
meaning: सुवर्णं रजतं वज्रं वैडूर्यं मौक्तिकानि च । प्रवालवस्त्रनाशस् च मित्राणां च विपर्ययस् ॥
text_mt: The loss of gold, silver, diamond, cat's-eye gem, pearls, / coral, and garments, and the alienation of friends,

sanskrit_iast: ārambhās ca vipadyante na soddhis karmaṇām api | carur vaiśravaṇas tatra abhi tyaṃ devam ṛk smṛtā ||
meaning: आरम्भास् च विपद्यन्ते न सोद्धिस् कर्मणाम् अपि । चरुर् वैश्रवणस् तत्र अभि त्यं देवम् ऋक् स्मृता ॥
text_mt: and undertakings fail, and works achieve no success— / a boiled offering to Vaiśravaṇa [is required] there; the verse remembered is "Abhi tyaṃ devam...".

sanskrit_iast: vaiśravaṇo yakṣapatis arthapāṇis tathā īśvaras | śamanas sarvādbhutānām … ||
meaning: वैश्रवणो यक्षपतिस् अर्थपाणिस् तथा ईश्वरस् । शमनस् सर्वाद्भुतानाम् … ॥
text_mt: "Vaiśravaṇa, lord of Yakṣas, wealth-in-hand, and lord, / pacifier of all portents..."

sanskrit_iast: atha yasya svanakṣatre ulkā nirghāta eva vā | rāhur grasati candrārkau kabandhaṃ darpaṇe bhavet ||
meaning: अथ यस्य स्वनक्षत्रे उल्का निर्घात एव वा । राहुर् ग्रसति चन्द्रार्कौ कबन्धं दर्पणे भवेत् ॥
text_mt: Now, upon whose lunar mansion a meteor or a thunderclap falls, / or Rāhu seizes the moon and sun, or a headless torso appears in a mirror,

sanskrit_iast: patet svayaṃ vā musalaṃ devatā vā kathaṃ cana | unmīlate ca eva yadā tathā ca api nimīlate ||
meaning: पतेत् स्वयं वा मुसलं देवता वा कथं चन । उन्मीलते च एव यदा तथा च अपि निमीलते ॥
text_mt: or a pestle falls by itself, or an image of a deity somehow / opens its eyes and likewise closes them,

sanskrit_iast: prachidyate ca yadi vā tathā vā api prakampate | prayāto vā api dṛśyeta pratisroto nadī vahet ||
meaning: प्रछिद्यते च यदि वा तथा वा अपि प्रकम्पते । प्रयातो वा अपि दृश्येत प्रतिस्रोतो नदी वहेत् ॥
text_mt: or if it breaks or trembles, / or appears to set out, or a river flows against its current,

sanskrit_iast: vimale na eva arkachāyā pratīpā vā api tu sāyakās | pariveṣas tu anabhreṣu dṛśyate candrasūryayos ||
meaning: विमले न एव अर्कछाया प्रतीपा वा अपि तु सायकास् । परिवेषस् तु अनभ्रेषु दृश्यते चन्द्रसूर्ययोस् ॥
text_mt: or the sun's shadow does not appear when the sky is clear, or arrows fly backward, / or a halo is seen around the moon and sun in a cloudless sky,
